bsdud zer ba la/ sngags pa dang bon po gnyis kyis khel/ btsun pas ma khel lo/ der sngags bon gnyis kyis lo res mos su mi tog bsdus pas/ btsun pa na re/ rgya phebs ma khel kyang bdag cag slongs re zhu zer bas lo gcig byin pas/ lo res sdud du song zhing / lo ri'i yul gyi rgya yang bsrung ba lags skad do/ /de ltar sgro sbug gi gtsang khang 'byongs tsam la rgya bo ba la gtad nas/ 'ug pa lung pa di gung lo drug cu rtsa gcig pa cig sku gshegs so/ 'bangs rtse mo bzhi'i snang nas mchog tu gyur pa bde gshegs rgya bo ba ni/ mes bo a tsa ra bya ba'i bu zur sgom bya ba sdom bu byed pa'i btsun rgan gcig yod pa la/ lha rje rgya bo ba kha btsun chung pha'i phyir 'breng ba cig yod pa/ 'ug pa lung du phyin nas/lha rje zur po che'i zhal nas/ khyod kyi rus pa ci yin gsung / zur lags byas pas/ 'o na btsun chung 'di nga'i rtsar zhog ngas gsos pas chog khyod rang gis gos 'dra ba rnyed na skyol gsungs pas/ kho dga' ste/ 'o na de tsug zhu zer nas bu lha rje'i rtsar bzhag nas gsos/ ming shes rab grags pa bya ba yin/ bla dwags su zur chung zhes bya bar thogs/phyis zur chung shes rab grags sa grags/ brag rgya bo dgu 'du kyi rtse mo la sgrub pa mdzad pas bde gshegs rgya bo ba zhis bya'o/ /de ltar 'ug khri lung pas btsun chung gsos pas shes rab shin tu che ba cig byung ste/ slob gnyer byed du bcug pas chos mkhas par shes kyang yo byad med pa'i tsābs 147

kyis dbang rnams ma thob cing dpe cha'ang ma bris par yod tsa na/ lha rje lug pa lung pa la ban gyi khang sngon na jo mo g.yu mo bya ba sgom ma phyug mo ma smad gnyis yod pas/ lha rje'i zhal nas/ khyod rang ma smad 'di gnyis kyi thog tu sdod gsung / nga khyim thab mi byed byas pas/ 'du shes ma chung /khyod yo byad med pa la khong gnyis kyi yo byad spyad nas dbang zhus/ dpe bris/ chos thams cad lhag ma ma lus par rdzogs par nyan pas chog pa yin/ des khong gnyis kyi chos kyang rdzogs/ khyod rang gi don yang grub pa de dga' mod gsung / der gsung bzhin nyan pas 'dod pa thams cad rdzogs par gyur pa dang / da khyod der ma bsdad par dpe cha la sogs pa khyod rang gi yo byad rngams rim gyis skyos la nga'i 'dir shog gsung / de ltar byas pas cang mchi 'am/ khong gnyis kyang drin che zhus pas/ blo ma chung / khyod kyis 'gro ba'i don nus pa zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas/snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rgyas par byas nas 'gro ba mtha' dag gi don byed dgos pa yin/ khong gnyis kyi drin lan du yang de che/ khong gnyis po la gab pas rang don gzhan don gang yang mi nus gsung / de nan ji skad gsung ba bzhin nyan pas/ lung stong bye ma'i gseb tu tshad pas tshig cing zhal skems pa'i tshe chang 'dren pa byung ba dang / ri stong gi rtse mo la byon pas sku bkres pa la zhal zas 'dren pa byung ba la sogs pa gang 'dod pa'i thugs dgongs 'bad pa meng pa grub pa 148

grub pa byung bas/ da ni ngas 'gro ba'i don byas kyang 'grub 'ong bar 'dug snyam pa la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ da khyod kyis bshad pa gyis gaskokyings nas/ der mdo dgongs 'dus gsungs pas dus gcig la dpe 'grems sum brgya byung ngo/ /de la dang po btsun chung gi dus na/ 'ug pa lung gi sgo rtsa na mchod rten cig yod pa la skor ba byed cing 'dug pa lha rjes gzigs pas/ zhabs sa la mi reg pa khru gang tsam na yar sgo ra ra gda' bas/ 'o na 'di sprul pa'i sku zhig yin nyen 'dug pas ngo mtshar can cig 'ong bar 'dug snyam nas shin tu dgyes so/ /yang lha rjes shangs kyi bsam pa sgrub khang du yang dag gi lo sgrub mdzad pa'i tshe/ lha rje'i zhal nas khyed 'bangs rtse mo bzhi po dang dgongs pa 'gran dang gsung bas/ thams cad kyis mnyam par bzhag pas/ gsum po la dgongs pa ri bo ltar g.yo 'gul med pa byung ba la/ zur chung pa tal gang tsam 'phags nas gda' skad/ g.yog mo cig la zur chung gi ru lu'i sgra 'di che chung nyon dang gsungs nas/ g.yog mo des sgrub khang gi phyi rol nas nyan pas sngar bas chung du ma song / ri zur gcig 'das nas nyan pas kyang chung du ma song bar 'dug la/ der lha rje'i zhal nas/ khyed tsho mched grogs mnyam po yin kyang gsum pos zur chung gi grib ma la ma 'gong zhig gsung / spyir bde gshegs 'di/ lha rje 'ug pa lung pa'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du longs pa/ mkhyen pa thams cad bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnga' ba/149

chos kyi don la blo gros kyi spobs pa mchog dang ldan pa lags so/ de yang g.yas ru khang khri'i lha khang na 'chad nyan skyong ba'i dus su/ grwa pa snams rgo ma chod mi gsum la gtad nas/ khyed tshos 'chad nyan gyi bstan pa skyongs shig nga sgom sgrab la 'gro gsungs nas brag rgya bo la gshegs/ te/brag rgya bo de bcom ldang 'das dpal chen po la gi rī ma brgyad kyis bskor ba 'dra ba yin pas/ 'di la sgrub pa byas na byin rlabs che ba/ sgrub thag nye ba 'ong gsung nas/ ming la brag rgya bo dgu 'dus zhes zer la/der byon nas sgrub pa mdzad pas dang po skyo 'phrul shin tu che bar byung ste/sa phyogs thams cad sdig pas khengs kyi byung ba dang sdigapa rtsid bu tsam yang byung / nub gcig gi mnas lam na/ brag rgya bo'i rtse mor mi nag po chen po cig byung nas lha rje'i zhabs gnyis nas bsdus te klad la bskor na bskyur bas/ brag gi mdun du thang chen po cig yod pa'i dkyiladu bdebs pa cig rmis/ mnal phras de sad tsa na/ thang dkyil na dngos su 'dug skad/ yang yar la 'dzegs te de 'dra ba'i cho 'phrul chen bo kun la ma 'dzem par bzhugs nas sgrub pa mdzad do/ /de yang dang po rdo rje sems dpa'i khang bu bya bar / gsang ba sgyu 'phrul las byung ba'i phyag rgya bsam gtan gyi sgrub pa bya ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub thabs shig la phyag len mdzad nas bsgrubs pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal gzigs te thag gi lung pa rdo rje sems dpas khengs pa byung / snang ba zad par gyi 150

skye mched brnyes shing / cir snang thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du bkra lam lam gsal ba byung ba la/ de da kyang bzang rtog gi mthu brtas pa yin/ yang dag par gtad pa ci yang med snyam du dgongs nas/ba ma gtan gyi khang bur rdzogs pa chen po rtsol bral gyi ngang la bzhugs pas/ rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa shar te/ sa rdo ri brag thams cad la thogs pa med par 'gro ba byung ngo / mtshan nyid pa'i dge bshes sba dge mthong bya ba zhig de'i dus su thag tu chos 'khor la byon nas/ khong gi grwa pa mkha pa zhig lha rje la bgro smreng byed du byung ste /khos mdun na ka ba yod pa de chos can du bzhag nas/ ka ba chos can byas pas/ ka ba chos can ka ba chos can khyod 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i 'khrul ngo la ka ba rang rgyud du snang yang / rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi don la ka ba grub pa mi gda' gsung nas phyag yug yug mdzad pas ka ba la thogs chags med par phyam phyam gda' skad/ der kho ngo mtshar skyes nas smra ma nus par dad pa thob nas lha rje'i slob ma byas pa ni ma thog byang 'bar yin no yang zer/ de ltar brag rgya bo la lo ril po bcu gsum yal yol gcig dang bcu bzhi bzhugs pa la/ dgon pa nas 'byon pa'i rkyen gnyis lags skad/ gcig ni go ma chod mi gsum gyis rgyab tshol tshol nas mdun skar te/ 'go bya tsha na re/ gsang ba snying po 'di la thabs lam gyi skabs su rgyab tu ma rgyud dgos pa 'du zer nas/ 'gos khug 151

pa lhas btsas kyi sar dgyes rdor nyan du byon pas/ lam du btsun pa gnyis dang phrad nas jo bo ban de lam du dgra 'dag go zer ba la/ lan du/ gzung 'dzin gyi 'phrang la nyon mongs kyi jag pa bkye nas/ nyan thos kyi byis pa btson du mchi 'o ga sto nga / btsun pa gnyis na re/ ban de sku mthong can sbos su re ba cig 'dug go zer bas/ yang lan du/theg rgyal gyi kha nas lta rgyal gyi rbab 'dril nas/ nyan thos kyi grong khyer bcom par mchi'o gsung / der 'gos kyi grwa sar byon tsa na/ grwa sa de na rma ra jo zas mi bya zhes bya ba/ zhabs tog che ba/ dregs pa che ba/ sta gur byed byed pa cig yod pas/ 'go bya tsha khong rang la sta gur 'ong du re ba la ma byung nas/ phyag zur la phul gyi phyin pas/ nam zhig 'gos kyi zhal nas/ dge bshes 'go bya tsha chos kyang gus par nyon/the sa yang tshul bzhin du phul gsungs pas/ lan du/ nyid kyi 'bangs mi ra jo sras rma bya ba 'di dor ma drud nas byung / ske rags gon nas byung / gong du ni khos mi gtong / 'og tu ni ngos mi mchi/ chos ni gus pas nyan zhing mchis/ zhe sa zur la phul ba la bka' bkron mi mdzad par zhu gsung skad/ mes dbang seng na re/ sgyu 'phrul 'di la dkyil 'khor phyir 'don pa'i dus su/ sgrub tu yo ga cig dgos pa 'dug gsungs nas/ sum pa ye 'bar gyi sar yo ga nyan du song / 'go chung dbang de na re/ sgyu 'phrul 'di la gzhi lam gyi grub mtha'i skabs su/ rgyab 153

rten du tshad ma cig dgos pa 'dug gsung / spang ka ngar chung ba'i sar tshad ma nyan du song ngo / de ltar gsum gyis bstan pa ma 'khyongs pas grwa pa bskyang dgos pa byung nas byon pa lags skad/ de gsum go ma chod du song ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de lags/ gcig ni lha khang ma 'byongs pa la lhare zhug pa lung pa sku gshegs te/ nga'i lag rjes 'di khyod kyis sbyongs shig gsungs nas bla ma'i bka' byung bas byon pa yin no/ /de la slob ma ka ba bzhi/ gdang brgyad/ phyam bcu drug dral ma sum cu gnyis/ sgom chen mi gnyis/ yus po che mi gcig dkyus pa mi gnyis/ sta gur mi gnyis/ go ma chod mi gsum pa la sogs mang du byon no/ ka ba bzhi po 'di/ dang po dge bshes khyung po grags se'i grwa pa mtshan nyid pa chen po shin tu mkhas pa yin pa la/ dge bshes khyung po dang lha rje chen po gnyis yon bdag gcig gis myang ror gdan drangs nas chos stabs gcig tu btsugs te 'dzom pa'i dus su/ dge bshes khyung po'i zhal nas/ zur chung shes rab grags bya ba chos log mkhan 'di sun phyung la shog gsungs nas/ khong bzhi po btang ba na/ khong bzhis kyang lha rje'i spyan sngar phyin te/ thog mar skyo ston shāka yes dris pa/ lha rje chen po lags/ khyed rdzogs pa chen po ba'i lugs kyi sgom kho na la gtso bo mdzad pa lags sam zhus pas/ nga dmigs pa gang la gtad 'dug gsung /'o na mi sgom pa lags sam zhus pas/ nga gang la g.yengs 'dug gsungs 153

pas/ spobs pa lan med par rgyur to/ de'i rjes la blan ston shāka ba ngas kyis dris pa/ khyed gsang ba sgyu 'phrul pa'i lugs kyis snang ba thams cad lha ngang lha mi'i dkyil 'khor du 'dod pa ma lags sam zhus pas/yul bem po rang rgyud du snang ba mngon sum gyi tshad ma sus 'gegs gsung /'o na mi 'dod dam byas pas/ sems can rnams kyi ma nga/ga pa'i 'khrul snang rang rgyud pa sbyong bar bya ba'i ched du/ bka' mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs pa dang sus 'gal bar nus gsungs pas/ yang lan med par gyur to/ /de ltar khong bgi rim gyis dris pas/ thams cad spobs pa ma med du rgyur ti/ der khong gi sri na re/ theg pa chen po'i chos phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa/ rigs pa dang grol ba'i spobs pa dang ldan pa 'di 'dra ba'i bshes gnyin gang nas kyang rnyed pas/ 'on kyang bu gcig dngos su zin na slodza dbon mi rdagyes pa 'ong bas/ sang phod babs kyis slob dkon dang ze'i la zur chung gi zhabs drung du mi 'dud re mna' mtho gyis zer nas mna' mtho bcad / dam bcas nas sang phod lha rje'i spyan sngar byung bas/ de rnams la ka ba bzhi byung ba yin no/ /de nas khong rnams tshur log nas slob dpon gyi drung du byin tsa na/ khyed tshos zur chung ba sun phyin nam gsung / gyin phyin par mi gda' byas pas/ ma dgyes te phrag dog gi mun pas ba pa gi spur chung shes rab grags pa dang 'dra ba'i sta ba ngan pa can/ bo thams cad log pa'i lam la 'khrid pa 158

'di bsad na/ sangs rgya nges ti the tshom med par thag chod/ de ci'i phyir na don du 'orgyur na bkag pa rnams gnang ba'i phyir ro gsung skad/ de lha rje'i grwa pa rnams kyis thos nas/ dge bshes khyung pos nged rang snyen 'di skad gsung gi 'dug zer zhes snyan du gsol bas/ de'i tshe cang mi gsung bar nang par chos khri'i khar byon nas chos gsung khor bzhad kyi 'dug ste/ ci la dgyes zhus pas/ chos bya ba nga'i theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di yin par 'dug sgrol ba la brten nas sangs sgye bar 'dod pa 'di gsang sngags kyi lugs yin/ mtshan nyid pa la med snyam tsa na/ zur chung ba lta bu bsad na sangs rgya gsung nas khyung po grags se lta bu'i mtshan nyid pa chen po yang blo phugs nga'i chos la gtod par 'dug pas/de dga' ba cig byung gsung skad/ de la sems phyogs kyi ka ba guṇa bu'i skyo ston shāka yes/ mdo'i la ba skyed lungs kyi yang kheng bla ma/ sgyu 'phrul gyi gi spro chu bar gyi min shākya bzang po/ phrin sgrab kyi ka ba dag mo ri'i mda' ti dzi shāka go /ma thog byang 'bar dang ba da pa lnga zhes kyang grags/ gdung brgyad ni/ ma thog pa dong / skya ston cho seng /glan shākya byang chub/ rtsags shāka rings/ snubs ston bag ma/ dbus pa sa 'thor/ shu ston zla grags/ rtse phrom byang dpal dang brgyad do/yang 'a li gzi chen/ nal rba snying po/ ram ston rgyal ba gsum bcug pa yang 'dug go /sgom chen mi gnyis ni/ 'ba' sgom dig ma dang /155

bon sgom do ba'o/ yus po che ni/ las stod kyi zi ston bsod rgyal lo/sta gur mi gnyis ni/ zhang ston sngags se dang khyung po rta chung grags se'o/phyam phran dang dral ma dang dkyus pa'i ming ma smos so/ de ltar lha rje rgya bo ba sku bsod bsdo ba'i dus sa/ bod kyi sngags pa 'tshogs tshad kyis phyag mi byed pa dang gral gong du 'gro ba med/ 'gos lo tsā ba na re/gsar ma ba rnams la/ nged rang tsho kho la phyag 'tshal don yang med/gral zhabs su bsgrig don yang med pas/ nged rang tsho khrims gyis shig zer nas khrims byas pa la/ nam zhig shangs su ston mo chen po zhig byung ba'i tshe sngags pa thams cad 'tshogs pa na/ zur chung ba gral 'go na bzhugs pa'i sbyan sngar 'gos lo tsā ba byon nas phyag 'tshal gyi 'dug goder khong rnams kyis kyang phyag byas te/ ston mo gyes pa'i tshe khong rnams na re/ zur chung ba la phyag mi byed pa'i khrims byed zer nas khyed rang phyag mdzad pa ji tsug lags byas pas/ kho'i drung du phyin tsa na bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po 'am de 'di ka yin par 'dug snyam pa las/ mi yin pa'i 'du shes mi skye ba sku 'dug gsung ngo / gzhan yang lha rje yang khyed de grwa pa'i dus su shin tu 'byor pa chung ba bkres pa cig yod pa la/ dus nam zhig na lha rje chen pos khong gi brang khang du gse'i ga'u phul dgu shong ba cig yod pa de khyer nas byon te/ nga kha skom khyod la skom med dam gsung / zan chang bdog ste zhus pas/ 'o na khyer la shog gsung /156

bon po'i yas rtags bsdus pa'i zan chang yod pa drangs pas gse'i ga'u do gsol nas da med dam gsung / yang drangs pas gang gsol nas yod na da rung khyog gsung yang gang drangs pa na da med dam gsung / da dung bre gang tsam bdog zhus pas 'o na mi yog pa 'dug yog na khyod la bsod nams bod 'dir mi shong ba zhig thong ba yin te/ 'on kyang bsod nams che ba zhig 'ong gi gsungs nas/ nas khal gsum gnang na de'i bar la 'di zo/ de nas khyod rang la ster ba 'ong gi gsung / de nas nas de zad pa dang sku bsod rgyas nas byung ba yin skad/ de lta bu la sogs pa'i che ba'i yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i lha rje bde gshegs rgya bo ba'i sku'i zas lcam sring gsum byung ba yin te/ snga tshar phyi tshar gnyis las/ jo mo snga ma btsad mo dar ma bo sdo la btsad tsha lcam dral gnyis 'khrungs te/ jo btsun rdo rje 'bar dang / jo sras ma shākya lcam mo/ snyi tshar rje btsun sgro phug pa chen po'i yum ni/ jo sras mo mnga' mo gtsug tor lcam bya ba mnga' tig jo shāka gi lcam mo yin/ dang por nas jo mo bzhes pa min na'ang / grwa sa na chos nyan zhing yod pa jo mo ltar song nas/ grwa pa rnams la bag sdang bar byung bas 'don par byas pa la/ skyo ston shāka yes na re/'di'i srin lag la bstan pa'i gtso bo gcig 'dug pa kho bo la rmis pas/gal te sras 'dra ba mthong na 'u cag rnams la phan thog pa 'ong nyen che bas thog gsung skad/ der ma bton par bzhag pas/ lha rje chen po 157

sgro phug pa shing pho stag la 'khrung so/ yab kyi zhal nas/ skyo ston shāka yem kyi rmi ltas kyang bzang / nga'i bu 'di bstan pa'i gtso bo dang tshul mthun pa 'gro ba la phan thogs pa cig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ ming yang shākya seng ger thog gsung / yum gyi zhal nas/ mig rtsa grung hor pa'i mig 'dra bas skan tā grung ba cig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ ming hor por thogs gsung / de ltar zur shākya seng ge dang mda' tsha hor por grag / de yang 'khrungs dus su yab kyis sgong thag byas nas ci yang med pa'i du gcig dang thug pas/ yum na re/ kha ning nas bu 'di skye ba'i rgyu gi yod/ rkan mar tsam zhig mi 'a ga par da sbyin rgyu med zer bas/ru'i la nas/ khong rang la bsod nams zhig yod na ngas ma bzhag kyang 'ong / ba da nams med na ngas ba ga kyang phan mi thog gsung nas khang thosan bzhugs 'dug tsa na/ btsun ma mo cig gis nas bong rgyab brgya dang mar khal brgya 'bul du byung bas/ ru'i zhal na / rkan mar byung ngo gsang skad/ de nas 'di la bsod nams can 'gro ba la phan thogs pa cig 'ong bar 'dug gsung nas dgyes so/ de'i sras jo btsun rdo rje grags/ sras mo rdo rje lcam mo/ jo btsun rdo rje grags pa la sras lnga/rnal 'byor rgyal tsab/ cung nge / 'khyam ma/ brag ge'o/ lha rje rnal 'byor la sras gnyi / theg dang sgod tsha'o/ sbyosag tshab kyi gras jo btsun kun dga' snying po/ cung nge'i zas rgyal tsha'o/ sras snga 158

tshar jo btsun rdo rje 'bar gyi sras btsang tsha shāka rdor/ de'i sras thag pa lhan po/ de'i sras lha rje bla ma lags so/ de yang bstan pa phyi dar gyi zlog mar skyes bu chen po lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po 'khrungs pa yin te/des lo lnga bcu rtsa bdun bzhes pa shing pho stag la zur chung pa 'khrungs shing /chu pho byi ba la rje mar pa 'khrungs pa'i lo gsum pa la zur chung pa 'khrungs/mar pa'i bcu drug pa/ zur chung pa'i bcu bzhi pa brtsis pa rnams kyi 'das lo'i thog ma me mos shar/ zur chung pas nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhes pa dang mar pas so gcig bzhes shing / lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i brgyad cu rtsa lnga pa chu pho rta la jo bo rje mnga' ris su phebs/ zur chung pa 'di 'gos pa khug pa lhas btsas dang yang dus mchungs la/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po yang zur chung pa'i nyi shu rtsa gcig pa shing pho khyi'o/ de ltar zur chung pa drug cu rtsa gcig bzhes pa'i skang pho stag la 'brum pa'i bsnyun gyis gshegs te/ de'i tshe lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab 'khrungs nas lo bcu drug lon/ chu pho rtog la ma gcig ma/ so chung pa/ sher ni rū pa rnams 'khrungs pa'i bcu gsum la zur chung pa gshegaso sheng / sgro sbug pa 'khrungs/ de la lha rje sgro spug pa chen po ni/ sku na gzhon pa'i dus su yum dang zhang pos bskyangs nas mda' phur lo bco lnga bzhugs/ de nas chu bar du glan gyi sar byon/ de nas skod lungs su yang khyeng gi sar byon nas/ de ltar lo gsum la chos gas / dgung lo bcu dgu la che 'don 159

mdzad pas/ sku bsod chen po rgyas te slob gnyer gyi 'phro byed pa'i skabs ma byung ba la/ skabs btsal nas gong bur skyo'i rtsar lo gcig byon/ de nas sku bsod rgyas pas gzhan du bzhud pa'i skabs ma byung nas/ bla ma mkhas pa dag tshur la spyan drangs shing / go 'degs mdzad nas slob gnyer rnams rdzogs par mdzad de/ de yang ka ba bzhi la mdo sgyu 'phrul sems phyoṭa gsum gyi rgyud man ngag phrin sgrub phyag bzhes dang bcas pa gsan zhing /dbang rnams rdzogs par zhus/ glan shākya byang chub la rdzogs chen skor lugs gsan/ lha rje shangs pa nag po la rdzogs chen brgyud pa tha ma'i skor rgyud gdams ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ de ltar mkhas pa mang po la gsan nas thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad pa lags/ spyir lha rje sgro sbug pa ni gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa yin no zhes grags la/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir gsang sngags kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa la byon nas/ gdul bya'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/slob ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po grwa sa 'dzin zhing bstan pa skyong ba gdugs thogs stong thon nas/ gsang sngags kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad de/ nyi zla ltar grags pa yin no/ de dag gi nang nas kyang thugs zin pa'i slob ma bzhi gsum bcu gnyis byung ba la/ me bzhi ni/dpong ston lcags kyu shab rtse gser pa/ bya ston rdo rje grags/ g.yu ston no/ nag bzhi ni/ lce ston rgya nag zur nag 'khor lo/ myang 160

zhig gis rta ngang pa bzang po zhig la dung gi sga rang gugs legs mo cig bstan nas phul/ 'bul mkhan de 'di nas byung dang 'dir mong 'di 'dra zhig yin zhes sus kyang ngo shes pa ma byung ste/ de lhas 'digs skyel ba yin no zhes grags/ gzhan yang btsan dang ma mo klu rnams kyis kyang 'degs bskyal te/ mi la med pa'i nor sna bzhi byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang jod do/ /sgro phug pa'i bcu dgu pa chu sprel la sa chen kun snying 'khrungs pha yin no/ yi ge gzhan dag na bai ma la slob ma rong chu tshan gyi dge slong ma sgre mo/ de'i slob ma sto brag bya che'i mar pa shes rab 'od/ de'i slob ma shangs lha phu'i lang ston dar ma bson rnams/ de'i slob ma nya ri'i lha rje hor po zer ba yang 'dug go /lha rje sgro phug pa chen po'i thugs kyi zas na po bzhi'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lha rje ston rgya nag ni/ mes po 'a ngas byang brtson bya bas khams su byon nas yar log ste/ slong bang sgron ma'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs nas skyi mkhar lha khang bzheng / de la sku mched gsum yod pa'i a mi sher brtson gyi sras rgyal gsum/ de la za po bzhi sras mo lnga ste dgu byung ba ma/ sras bzhi ni/ rin chen/nyi po/ rgyal bzangs/ rgya nag go rin chen dang nyi po sanyis myangs stod du mtshan nyid kyi grwa sar slob gnyer la btang nas/ lha rje rgya nag gis rgyags skyel du phyin te thor la thun nyan byas pas go bar byung / phu bo gnyi la dris pas khong gnyis kyi lo gsum nyan yang go ba kyi yang mi 162

'dug ste/ 'di 'dra 'ong ba ji ltar yin/ ngas nyan na go bar 'dug ste byas pas/ khong gnyis na re/ nged la de las ma byung khyod kyis go na khyod rang nyon/ nged kyis rgyags bskyal gyi chos shes na sus shes kyang 'dra yis zer nas/ der lha rje rgya nag gis bzhugs nas chos gsan pa la/de yang dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig nas slob gnyer mdzad de dang por mtshan nyid gsan pa las/ dus de'i tshe na mkhas par grags pa she khyung gnyis/'ban 'bre gnyis/ rgya stag gnyis bya ba yod pa'i/ khyung po grags se la pha rol tu phyin pa gsan/ 'ban thams cad mkhyen pa la mngon pa gsan/stag pa kha che la dbu tshad gsan/ de dag gi steng du 'gar bsod yes la'ang gsan te/ de ltar mtshan nyid lo dgur gsan no/ de nas lha rje chen po kro phug pa'i zhabs drung du sngags gsan du byon nas lo bcu gcig bzhugs pa la/ lo gsum bar du jo sras myang stod pa gsung ba tsam las/nan tar gyi thugs phebs mo'i spyan sngar gci nga gleng zhib mo tsam yang ma byung ba (5/ rgya brtson seng dpon g.yog dang lha rje chos 'khor stabs shig tu byung ba'i tshe/ rgya brtson seng dpon g.yog gis rtsod pa btsugs pa'i dus su/ lha rje rgya nag gis khong sun phyung zhing nga rgyal bcag pa la dgyes nas thugs la shin tu 'dogs par byung ba'i steng du/ sras jo btsun rdo rje grags blo kha phye bas rab tu dgyes te/ de dag gi drin lan du bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi gzhung gdams ngag thams cang gnang zhing / khyad par gyi gdams pa 16

zab mo dang cha lag gi yig chung phra mo rang la rgyus med pa thams cad kyang tshur la spun nas gnang bas na/ lha rje lha khang pa zur cho gzhan rnams las man ngag zab cing chos kyi kha tshang ba'i lo rgyus rgyu mtshan yang de yin gsungs/ de ltar lo nyi shu tham pa slob gnyer mdzad nas/ bzhi bcu tham pa bzhes pa na gshegs btsun mdzad de/ de'i dus su dbus pa ston shāka dang dbus pa zhig po la sogs pa sgro sbug pa'i grwa pa sum cu tsam phyir 'breng la shor ba yin lo/ gzhan yang myang stod kyi rgya rtsad skor pa la bdud rtsi gsan/ myang smad kyi sgro dar seng la rnam 'joms dang phur pa rtsa ba sor bzhag gi lugs gsan/ gzhan yang phur pa skyi lugs la sogs pa phur pa'i luzhes mang du gsan/ dam pa spor mang la rdzogs pa chen po spor lugs gsan/ jo mo myang mo la slob dpon a ro'i thugs kyi yang bcud rdzogs chen khams lugs kyi khrid zhus shing / de'i skor gyi gdams ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ de bzhin du rdzogs chen bram ze'i skor dang ske tshang ma la sogs pa yang gzhan dag kun nas mang du gsan te/ sngags mtshan nyid rgyud sgrub thabs/ gzhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa kun gyi bdag por gyur pa lags so/ bdud rtsi'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe na/ sman gyi pho brang las sman gyi lha mo zhig don nas byung ste/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum byas nas de nas pho brang la thim pa kun gyis mthong / de yang bzhi bcu nas lnga bcu rtsa drug gi bar lo bcu drug tu gzhan don mdzad 164

nas gshegs te/ dang por shing pho khyi la 'khrungs/ lo nyer gcig lon pa nas sum cu'i bar du she'u ba dang khyung la sogs pa la gsan pa mang da mdzad/ de rnying sgro sbug pa la gsan pa rgya cher mdzad de/ 'dis zhe gcig bzhes pa'i shing stag lo de la sgro sbug pa gshegs/ lo de nas 'gro don mdzad/ rang lo lnga bcu rtsa drug pa sa sbrul la gshegs/ de'i dbon po lce ston jo gzungs ni/ nyi bo'i sras yin la/ spyir nyi bo la sras gsum/ jo skyes/ bla ma chen po/ dpon nag rdo rje'o/ jo skyes la zas gnyis/ slob dpon nye nye dang / khang gsar ro/ dpon nag rdo rje la sras lnga/ rdo rje 'bum/ nyi khri 'bum/ bdud rtsi 'bum/bkra shis 'bum/ dar ma 'bum mo/ bla ma chen po yon tan gzungs ni/ me pho rta la 'khrungs/ bcu gcig pa la slob gnyer mdzad/ lo bcu gsum khu bo dang 'grogs su byung ste/ bka' bskyed rdzogs gsum gyi rgyud chung man ngag dang bcas pa kun la slob gnyer rdzogs par mdzad/ lo snyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe khu bo rgya nag pa sku gshegs nas gdan sa mdzad/slob gnyer gyi dras thag ma chod pa bag re yod pa kun dbus pa ston shāka dang dbus pa zhig po la sogs pa bu slob rnams la dras thag bcad pa yin no/ de la dbus pa ston shāka ni/ mi chos gzad kyi gcer pa wang thung brgyud yin/ lha rje nya ri ba'i grwa sar yi ge 'brir byon pas dad pa thob nas slob gnyer mdzad/ de nas gong du smos pa bzhin du lha rje rgya nag gi 165

phyir byon/ rgyud gdams ngag thams cad mi lus par gsan nas sgom sgrab mdzad par dgongs te byang ri la dgon pa tshol du byon pas/ yol ba zlog la dam pa yol chung ba brag rko zhing 'dug skad/ 'dir dgon pa mdzad pa lags sam zhus pas/ yin zer/ 'di min pa bya sa mi gda' 'am byas pas/ bar ngos kyi brag se ba kha sbrag can de ni byas na 'ong ba cig 'dug ste/ de bas 'di btsan par 'dug pas nga 'dir byed pa yin/ de min pa py-i sa mi 'dug zer/ de nas dam pa ston shāka gis brag se ba kha sbrag skyes dzi der byon tsa na/ de'i chu mig 'gram na dbus kyu cig 'dug gam yang zer/ zan rdog lnga 'dug gam yang zer te bzang ltas shig byung /de nas der pa zhugs te sgom sgrab mdzad pas dgongs pa tshad du skyol/ lha 'dri dam li thogs/ gdu/ spyo mang po'i don nus pa byung ste/ dam pa se sbrag pa zhes grag pa yin no/ /dbus pa zhig po ni/ mi chos mi ra klungs bya sa ba yin/ rje sgro spug pa'i grwa sar yig mkhan chos la tshud pa zhig ste/ lha rje gye nag gi phyir byon/ bskyed rdzogs gsum la thugs 'byongs par mdzad de/ yul la che 'don la 'gro snyam ste/ de'i cha rkyen du gdugs dang dung dang mchod cha la sogs pa 'don pa'i phyir bal yul du byon pa la/ lam du nub ceg bsams pas chos de tsam shes kyang nyams su blang rgyu mi 'dug sto/ da lta zhi na lam khyir cig med par go nas/ cis kyang mi phan gdams ngag cig zhu dgos par 'dug snyam nas lam nas log 166

ste/ bla mi'i spyan sngar phyin nas zhus pas snyan brgyud rin po che'i gdams ngagaganang nas de la nyams len mdzad kyi byon bas/ mang yul gung thang du byon tsa na/ rdzogs pa chen po ris da kyi dgongs pa zhag bdun byung /der bal po nas mchod cha blangs na byon te mang yul gung thang du slebs tsa na tshad pa phyir 'breng byung ste bsnang ba la/ ka cha rnam grong du bcol te ri la byon nas nyams su blangs pas/ yang ris chad kyi dgongs pa shar te rdo ri brag thams cad la thogs pa med po byung nas ci yang dgos med du shes te che 'don gyi cha rkyen thams cad gang dgar bskyur gol/ ting man ji bdun tsa cig yod pa bla ma'i drin dran te/ nga ladagongs pa 'di 'dra 'char ba yang bla ma'i dron yin pas 'di tsam zhig bla ma 'kha'abul dgosasnyam nas khyer byon pa la/ de yang la du bskyur snying 'dod pa byung ba la/yang bla ma'i drin bsams te lha khang du sleb tsa na/ bla ma'i drung du bskyur te dgos na tshags gyis/ lar khyod kyis ji tsam cig bcings gsung skad/de la ri la bzhugs kyin nyams len mdzad pas/ thegapa thams cad kyi chos tshig gcig kyang ma lus bar thugs la lam lam gsal bar byang /gzhan yang rbab kyis ma tshugs te gzugs snang stong dbyer med min gsung /g.yas ru'i sba gor phur bzhugs pa'i tshe gzims spyil la thog phog ste gzims mal gyi steng du byung yang / ru nyid dang / mchan na byin rlab — zhu ba'i gces phyug cig yod pa'ang ci yang ma nyes par 'dug thog byung 167

ngam zhus pas/ thog gam de byung gsung / 'o na ma gnod dam zhus pas/sgra grag stong dbyer med la thog la rang bzhin ga la yod gsung / rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'di la de la sogs pa'i che ba'i yon tan du ma yod do/ de lta bus khong gi khu bo slob ma bzang po yod pa rnam sa la chos zhas shing / thag chod pa mdzad nas grwa sa bskyangs so/ sgom sgrab la ///cho bsgo bzhugs nas mtshams 'og nas grwa sa skyong ba la lo bco brgyad mdzad de/dgung lo bdun cu pa shing mo yos kyi lo la gshegs so/ bdag nyid chen po de'i slob mar byung ba zhig po bdud rtsi dang / ston pa bla skyabs dang /dbus pa jo bsod dang / snye ston nyi ma rdo rje la sogs pa gzhung lugs smra ba la mkhas pa mang du byon/ gzhan yang la stod kyi mes ston mgon po dang / de dbyal kun dga' rdo rje la sogs pas kyang chos zhus zhabs la gtugs so/ khu dbon 'di gnyis mkhyen pa'i srol snga mas gtong pa yin yang / gdul bya la phan pa'i bstan pa'i bya ba phyi mas rgya cher mdzad pa yin no/ zur chung pa 'khrungs nas yon tan gzungs shing yos la gshegs pa yan chod la lo brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis song byo / /lha rje lha khang pa'i thugs kyi sras dam pa sprul sku zhig po bdud rtsi yin te/ de yang mes rdo rje rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba dge ba'i bzhes gnyen zhig yod pa la/ sras ston pa 'khar re dang 'khar chung zhes bya ba yo ga la mkhas pa zhig yod pa la ge'i 'khar chung gi sras shu ston mon sras bya ba de yang phyi rgyud la

mkhas/ de'i sras ston pa lha snang bya ba nus mthu byin rlabs ldan pa zhig byung / de la sras sangs rgyas dwags chung dang sgom shu gnyis so/ sangs rgyas dwags chung ni/ zhig po bdud rtsi'i yab yin/ dwags po rgya ras kyi phyir phyin pas dwags chung par grags pa yin/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas stong dang / dkar sgom jo nyag dang byung ston rtsegs se la sogs pa bla ma mang po la chos gsan zhing sgro 'dogs cad nas/ lho brag tu gshegs te/sto stod kyi dgon pa phur mo sgang bya bar 'gro don mdzad kyi bzhugs pa la/gzad pa'i yon bdag rnams kyis sgom shu btang nas gdan drangs/ gzad kyi lha gdong dgon pa dang 'ug skad dgon pa la sogs pa gnas dgon mang du phul nas bzhugs te/ bu slob mang du 'phel/ zhig po yang lha gdong dgon par sku 'khrungs pa yin no/ spyir sangs rgyas dwags chung la sras lcam dral bzhi byung / che shos sto brag tu 'khyungs pa'i sto tsha bla ma skyabs ni 'jig rten la zhen pa log pa/ mngon par shes pa mnga' ba zhig byung ba khams su brgyad nas/ sku yang khams su 'das/ ga'og bla ma rgyal mtshan ni zhig por bzhugs/ bya bral klong chen gyi dgongs pa 'khrungs nas/ rtogs ldan dge ba'i phyag bzhes mang du mdzad pa zhig byung ste/yum ni 'brog gi stong ra ma yin/ khong la sras sangs rgyas dbon ston dang /sprul sku sher 'byung ngo / sangs rgyas dbon ston la bras snga tshar gcig dang snyi tshar gsum/ sras mo gcig dang lnga/ snga tshar bdud rtsi dang /16

gyi tshar dbang phyug 'bum/ bdud rtsi dpal/ rin chen mgon no zas mo ston ma bdud rtsi 'byam/ bla ma rgyal mtshan gyi 'og ma jo sras ma rgya ma hor yin/ de'i sras mkhar pa jo nam/ de'i sras sum ston snye mtho/ jo sras ma rgya ma'i yang 'og ma sprul ska zhig po yin te/ bla ma dwags chung gis gzad kyi gcen pa lung thung rgyurdo kyi bu sring mo wang mo rgya gar gsal bya ba zhig bzhes pas/ de la jo sras ma rgya ma skyes nas zla ba brgyad lon pa la ma ma 'das/ de'i a ma'i nu mo wang mo gcig yod pa bos nas nu bcol la btang bas/ de jo mor song nas de la zhig po 'khyungs pa yin/ de la rin po che lhums na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ yum gyi rmi lam na mi dkar po zhig gis gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can zhig mgo la yang yang phub pa rmi ba zhig byung / bla ma zhang 'tshal pas lo stor bdun bzhes shing / yon tan gzungs kyis nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa ga mo sbrul la zhig po bdud rtsi 'khrungs/ sku bltams nas zhib ma'i nang du ba la ba na 'ja' tshon zug pa byung / dgung lo gnyis tsam lon pa'i tshe nub gcig yab kyi zhal nas/ ma ma la wang chung ma yar la longs dang /4la rmi lam ltad mo che ba zhig byung khyod la bshad kyi gsung / ji 'dra cig byung zhus pas/ nga yul thag rings zhig tu 'gro bar 'dug nas ri 'ogs cig nas phar phyin tsa na/ lam kha na pha bong sngon po zhig 'dug nga la thebs gsar pa 'og cag dar phug ron ske la byas pa'i legs mo 170

cig 'dug na / der nga'i zhwa de phud de pha bong de la g.yogs te/ nga 'gro dgo par 'dug pas khyod kyis 'gro ba'i don gyis shig mang byas/ pas/snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'gro don nga rang gis shezabacig zer na mgo ltogs byung / de rang ri zur de 'das nas ri logs cig na mar phyin tsa na/bag shes pa ma dga' ba skyo ba skye ba zhig byung na / bee ro tsa na tsha ba yul du gshegs myo na shing lo'i ga ba sgru khab byil ba ltar brgyad zer ba de'i nyam bro ba zhig byung / de na sprungs su phebs tsa na nyi ma dron pho zhig kyang shar cas byung / lung pa yangs pa chu gtsang ba/ tog mang po rgya pa/ de'i sing dang shin tu nyams dga' ba zhig byung ba na gnyid sad/ da nga 'chi ba 'dug shi na kyang rig 'dzin gyi sa la 'gro bar 'dug 'od kyi bu di la 'gro ba la phan thog pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug cig gsung / der a mas/ zu grongs na bus ci byed bya ngul pha /ma ngu/ na gyi sung la ngu pas grong pas thos na ba 'a 'a ba shor yin snam na 'ong gsung / de na ba gnyi tsam yon pa dang ma dwagasachungasku gsheg te/ ba bcu rtsa dgu pa'o/ de nas zhig po rin po che chung ngu zhig ske mas bskyangs/ cher skyes pa dang gos bcas pa thams cad lam zas pa snying rī ba zhig yod pa la sbyin/ ma ma bar ba kyang ma phan/ mo ma snan po zhig la tham cad rto mdebs kyi 'dug na a mas kyang der phyin tsha na/ mo na re/ khyod gyi tha 'di la ji 'dra kyigata171

'ong ngam/ 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre thams cad 'tshogs nas 'di la skor ba byed/ mchod pa byed par 'dug zer/ ston rka cig 'ongs 'don pa'i dus sa/ a ma na re/ glen pa/ de ring thams cad 'ongs 'don pas gtor ma dang chu gtor gtong gi 'dug khyod rang yang chu gtor dngagator ma 'dra ba thongs/ nged rang yang 'ongs 'don dgos par yod byas pas/ chu gtor med par 'ongs mo'i rtsar song nas/ g.ya' bzang lung pa'i lha 'dre tsho/ /myang nag 'ol po'i lha 'dre tsho/ /sprang po 'u lu'i rgyal nag da nang su'i sar yang ma 'gro bar/ rgan mo wang 'ongs 'don gyi yod pas 'di'i 'ongs las khyer cig gsung nas/ thongs mo las thor thor byas pas/ ma rgan tshig pa log nas 'bod kyin phyar bas/ zhing re ba bya ba nan tar legs na bzhi bcu thon tsam zhig yod pa la/ de'i lo legs nge ba mid pa la lnga bcu byung nas/ der a ma ngo mtshar skyes te sngar phob 'gyod nas phub ma tsho phyar bas kyang khal gsum lhag pa cig byung da/ de nas yid ches te 'di sprul pa'i sku yin nam mi shes par 'dug snyam nas/ zhang po dam pa sbrag pa'i sar slob gnyer la btang ba yin no/ de nas lo ga/sum zhang po dang 'grogs rgyu byung / de'i bar du rdzogs chen rong lugs gyi chos skor rnams gsan/ khyad par sgang dril mkha par mkhyen/ gab byung yang legs par thos shing / dgung lo bcu drug bzhes pa'i tshe na dam pa sku gshegs/ 'da' khar 'di rnams 172

byas nas/ sgom ma 'di 'bra la byin rlabs mi zhu sna myo na / thams cad zhu 'dugapa mthong nas/ a ma yang nan tar dku nga 'dod pa byung nas rang 'a ga mkhan mo dang gnyi rnal 'byor ma'i drung du byin nas byin rlabs rtu pa / rnal 'byor ma de na re/ a ma la/ khyod bla ma skyil mkhar ba 'bra ba la dbang thob/ ma cod pan cho re byas na / nga la byin rlab zhu cang dgos sa zer/ der ma ma skyeng shing mosapar byung na na gyis rgya pa mdzad/ de nas rang rkamakharna bo'i tshung mas zhu pa / mo mkhace re bltas nas/ khyod kyi khyo bo rang ga mkha pos dbubasagatsang ru bzhi ba skor/ gdang sha mi la byin/ byin sho khyi la byin na / sha thang da du btsa ba'i nas la khyod kyi skog ba ga byas nas/sdig pa dbag du da/ khyod la ci ming mi btub gsung pas mo nar gyi byung / ma ma de tsug byas ma byas pas/ bya zer/ de'i sdigakha ltar rgya na 'byang zhu pas/ rna'akha'abyor ma'i zhal da khyod la dbag na rnabasakhal bzhi bcu tsam 'dug spu de/ bla ma bzang po cig la zu'akhum cho 'khor tshug / de napokhakhyogarang khosakhaci zer la nyon la g.yog gyi / de ltar byas na dga' rab thong gi de min na khyod la skyid pho mi thong ga cung / mang ma ma la khyod ming po dam dzi se sgrog khri 'ad pa rgya ngan de tsam bya mi dgos/ khopo gye gar rgyal po'i btsun mo 'di da bya ba'i mngal na zhug yod/ skyes nas chos rgyal chen po 'gro ༷'i don 174

daphag tu ོ ba 'ong bar 'dug gsung / der ngo mtshar nas mngon zhe can du rig na / nga cu jigayod pa di dzi 'ablo zhes nga nged ma bad la gi mog mi 'ong ngam zhus pas ma mtshi war bzhag na mgu' ba nga pa/ cad kyi sbyi 'ag snyigs zla rdu 'ji 'a ba'i kha yo na la sgyur 4mig da ga migo sto nga gos gyenas la hwad/ sgrun 'i tshi skyid la tsāpar 'dus / 'a ba ra nga bo mdus do sa spyor rna sa lha4 rgya haṃ rna la 0 skyo nas dgung lomang mo la lod nde la tha rings ga hūṃ 'gro pa'i nyid yod do ga stongs/ di skos zhig sbo skye mkhar lha khang pa'i drung du mang dung gas nas/ 'khon spra bskyed rdzo ga gsum ga ṣe zug sdo chodami dzad zhal shul ni/ nga sems spyod kho nadzigatho na gsung na mas ga gcig myalas mi ndezhi te/ 7 mas skolal da kho mas cad sa tshe na la mngodatsho'iyid/ las da ji ra zhas pa'i tshul / rgyudakyi skor / kun jid mdo ༷na la sog pa mas sbyo mi ga chen po nyi shu mi bzhi gsan/ rtsa spu sem khi skor la/ rtsa co dzod la skor phugs rol lugasaspyol lugs la sog rdza cu gyi bshad srol lug mig ga pa bcu pa gas mi da du gtub pa bcu ba yod ga nga/ rdzogs chen rong lugs kyi sgom mi chen po rna /rnal 'asbyor rig pa'i nyi la dang / ba mir nalag gi sgron ma dang //75

bsam gtan snying gi nyi ma dang / gdar sha dang gzer bu dang / zhus lan khungs kyis gdab pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas lan la sogs pa sgomayig chen mo phal cher gsan/ gdams pa snyan brgyud kyi skor la/skor lugs rong lugs khams lugs gsum gyi gdams ngag rnams dang /gzhan yang bram ze skor gyi snyan brgyud rnams dang / ske tshang dang rdzong 'brang ston brgyud dang / klong la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa cig gsan te/ tho bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad pa yin no/ /spyir dgung ma bcu gsum bon nas slob gnyer mdzad bcu drug man chad lo gsum dam pa'i sar bzhugs de nas lha khang ga byon/ ma la myang stod du lha rje kubs chu byagashis chos 'khong tshugs pa tshe zhar chol mdzad nas/ dgung blo ba drug sa da pa mdzad di/ skor lugs stong thun gsungs pas mkhas pa'i theg chod lha rje snubs sman na re/ dbus pa'i jo sdos khyod nga'i rta mkhyung dzaḥg kha che dang 'dra ba 'dug zer te/ nas khal bcu gcig gi thogs byas skad/ de nas chos mgo thon nas grags pas khyab kyang dgung mo sum cu man chad slob gnyer mdzad de/ bla ma lha khang pa'i zhabs drung du mo bcu bzhi bzhugs/ bar skabs kun tu zhang po'i gdan sa se bag tu bzhugs te/ sgom sgrub dang bshad pa bag re yang mdzad/ de ltar slob gter tshar ba dang / gzad nas yab gyi slob ma ban rgan bla 'dos bya ba cig yod pas gdan drangs te byon nas/ che 'don gyi tshul tsam zhig 176

mdzad de/ 'ug skad dgon pa la sogs pa gzung / gtsang du se sbrag dang chos sdings la sogs pa mang du gzung ste/ sku bsod rgyas pa lha/de yang dam pa se sbrag pa'i sgom ma rnal 'byor ma shākya gnyan shā / 'od a stag 'od ldan dang bzhis/ nged kyis se sbrag la mi thar bar 'dug pas ri skab 'dir ngal bsos cig byed zer nas chos sdings brtsig pa la/ de'i dus su bla ma zhang 'tshal pa'i slob ma gtsang sgom sgrub rgyal po bya ba cig ti se la 'gro ba'i yar lam/ zhig po'i spyan sngar byon bla ma zhang gi lo rgyus mang du bshad pas/ mjug tu dad par byung nas gdan drangs te chos 'khor btsugs/ chos 'brel ma zhus kyang blo byin gyis brlabs pa'i bla ma yin gsung nas/ mos gus dang zhabs tog che bar mdzad/ de'i tshe bla ma zhang gi zhal nas/ khyod kyi dgon pa 'di chu shing 'dzom par mi 'dug ste/ mi 'du ba 'gro ba la phan thogs pa cig 'ong bar 'dug pas/chos jings su thogs gsung nas/ dgon pa'i ming zhang gis btags/de'i dus su mi rnams na re/ chos lha khang la nyan nas zhabasatog 'tshal pa la byed par 'dug zer smra ba la/ bla ma lha khang pas nas khal nyi shu tsam dang sha mar kha yar bskur te/ chod bla ma bzang po gdan drangs nas chos 'khor 'dzugs pa la/ ngas kyang 'thud byed dgos pa yin te las ma 'byor gsungs pas/ mi rnams kha smras kyang 'phro chad/ nga rang yang bla ma rnying pa la mos gus gsar pa skyes gsung / de lta sku bsod rgyas shing thugs 177

dgongs nam mkha' lta bu la rgyagos rje'i nyi lta bur shar snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs mtshams thams cad du khyab cing / gdul bya'i tshogamakhabasam gyis mi khyab pa 'dus nas bla pa'i zhabs tog dang 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po dpag te mid pa mjod do/ de mang bla ma mnyes pha ga sto/ma gyi marnyas pa mdzad/ gu pa gzhung bzhin du skad cig kyang mi 'gakhasabar mdza / ngas bla ma'i zhabaso drung nas 'gro mi zhab spyi thor ma blang par 'gro me myong gsung / ga ra gyi gyi 'bring ma gsumakhatsākhasog pa mdo chi thocu bdun gyi sna drangs pa chos deng zang zing gi zhab tog bsomadzigyis mi khya pa mngon/ gso dgo ji lta ba bzhin longs/rtogis gro dus gci la byul/ rdzo chi ring snang ris med kyi dgongs pa shar na sa rdo ri brag thams cad la thogaso mdo du 'gro nus pha byung /mi ma min gyis skor bsabyed spu gzig mngon par shes pha mnga' ba'i lo rgyus mang rdu yod/ gzad phu'i da lung dgon par bzhugasapa'i tshe pha yong la dzim pa dang / srin po rir gyang la thogs med du gshegs pa la sogs pa mang ngo / skyes bu chen dzo 'dis byang phyogs kyi rgyud gangs ri'i khrod 'der yul phyogs thams cad du snyon sa/ skye dgu rnams chos la baspyar nas thar pa'i lam la brkan/ rjes su srin las sgrab pa'i da rī/ ba'i bshes gnyin bsam gyis mi khyaspangapaṃ rgyu'i / nyi gli sgar sgog pha yin sgo/ga yang bston pa'i bya ba bde bar gshegi pa'i sku gsung thug kyi rten ci 78

bzhengs pa dang / gso ba ngang / gzhan dag bzhengs pa la yo byad gtong ba sogs pa dpag tu med pa mdzad/ spyo gar nas byon pa'i lo paṇa mkhas pa rnams kyi zhabs tog mdzad/ bstan pa'i bdag po jigs mtshan nyid kyi sdo sgod 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyi zhabs na 'degs/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba spangs nas sgom sgrub mdzad pa dang / mas na dbul zhing phongs pa kun gyi sbyin bdag mjod/ gye gar dang spyo nag dang bal po lasogs skad rigs rtsigacig pa'i skye bo kun kyang 'dus shing / tham cad kyi dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur te/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal tha lta bu yin no/ gzhan yang dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ba'i gnas/ bdun chu gcig la sogs pa kyang gzhig par mi nus pa'i gnas/ byangachub kyi snying po rdo rje'i gdan la mchod pa lan gsum bskyal/ ston pa'isku tshab lha 'i jo bo rnam gnyis kyi zhabs tog lan bzhi mdzad/ de lasogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la dngo dang brgyud pas phan gdags pa'i phrin las dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ byang phyogs kyi rgyud 'dir rtsod med dugrags pa yin sgo/ lha sa'i rdo rags lan bzhi ma nga pa'i phyi ma la gsheg skyims kyi dus su/ 'khor tshos nga 'thab brgyab pas thug log ste/khyed tsho ngas tsun 'dug ste nga yang khyed tshos su 'du cig ngas ga shed cig la khyed tshos mig gis mi mthong rna bas mi thos pa cig bya yis gsung ste/17

dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa gcig bzhes pa sa mo lug gi lo la gshegs te/ de yang gsang phu'i rgya ra gad logs kyi dgon par sku gshegs nas/ spur chab la gdan drangs nas bzad du 'ug skad da na par zla ba bzhi bzhugs/de nas thang skyar gdan drangs/ sa rab tu g.yos/ mdun gyi yon chab kyi sdod nang nas 'ja' tshon lta bu'i padma'i sdong po skyes te/ zhag gsum gyi bar du kun gyis mthong ba byung / nang par spur sbyong ba'i srod la nyi zla dus gcig la shar ba mthong ba dang / spur sbyangs pa'i tshe na sgra dang 'od dang 'ja' tshon dang sku dang yig 'bru dang mchod rten dang ring bsrel gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa byon/ btsan po dang dbon po dang slob mar gyur pa rnams kyis skyes bu chen po de'i gdan sar dgongs nas/ gzad thang skya'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing / chos gsungs pa dang bzhugs pa'i gdan sa che chung kun tu yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang du bzhengs so/zhig po la slob ma mang yang thugs sras su gyur pa ni/ rta ston jo yes dang / ma hā lhun po dang / mkhas pa jo man dang / dbus pa jo bsod dang / bzang ston hor grags dang / gnyos ston bla ma dang drug tu grags pa la/ de'i nang nas kyang gdams pa'i bka' blo zhing / mkhyen pa'i bcud thob pa/ thugs zin gyi zas kyi thu bor gyur pa rta ston jo yes yin/ de yang mes po rta bon dbang grags bya ba chos dang yon tan gnyis ka byed pa'i bu nor dbang gsum 'dzom pa/ g.yu ru stod kyi bdag po /80

byed pa zhig la/ bu brgyad bu mo gnyis ste bcu tham pa yod/ bu brgyad kyi chung shogarta ston jo 'bum de'i bu jo mas so/ jo 'bum gyis chung dus su/ gzad kyi grum bu lung pha'i bla ma mda' byang chub sems dpa'i spyan sngar po to ba'i bka' gdams kyi chos rnams gsan/ de nabasarang yul du bzhugs te/ 'khor 'bangs dang yul gzhis zhir tu 'dzoms par yod pa de dag la skyo ba skyes zhen pa log nas/ g.yog bzhi khrid de lha rje glan nya tshal ba'i thugs sras gnyos chu bo ri pa'i spyan sngar byon te/dpon g.yog lngas stabs gcig tu chos sgor zhugs nas/ sngags rnying ma'i chos mang du gsan/ khyad par du rdzogs chen skor lugs ga zhung gdams ngag dang bcas pa la shin tu mkhas par gyur/ bla ma phag mo gru pa'i spyan sngar byon nas lam 'bras dang phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa ma lus pa gsan/gzhan yang dbu ru stod kyi bla ma 'tshar ston la phyag rgya chen po sgang lugs kyi do ha skor gsum nyan/ zangs ri 'bro ras la lo ro ras chung pa'i chos skor rnams gsan/ dang ston mgon po la rnam 'joms dang phur pa gsan/ dmar ston 'jam la bde mchog gsan/ bde mchog gi dbang brgya rtsa brgyad zhus/ de ltar bla ma mang du bsten kyang gnyos chu bo ri ba dang / phag mo gru pa la rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin/ gsan pa thugs thag chod pa dang chu bo ri la bzhugs te sgrab pa mdzad/ gdul bya'i tshogs kyang mang du 'dus te/ gzhan don rgya ༄cher bskyangs/ de la sras rta ston jo 181

dang / dgyes dor mes lugs dang / 'jam dpal gsang ldan dang /bde mchog snya yi pa dang / mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sgra thabs dang lam 'bras zham lugs dang / zhi byed lug gsu rsha da da khyad par gi lugs gtso che/ chos skyong dug sang la sogs pa zhu ska ma zangs ri ba'i mkhyen pa thams cad bum pha dang byo'i tshul du da na/ cung phyag dum la phyag rgya chen tho tshung gi ga gzhu ཿ ba'i skor/ stong zu gdams ngag gi skor/ phag mo byin tsāb kyi skor dang gsu rte/ de ltar do ha skor gsum du grags pa'i chos skor ma lus pa dang / gtor rgyud chen pho ga na/ mgon po rtog rgod gyis sna drangs pa bstan sbong gi skor bsam gyis mi khyab pha gsan/ grub thob sal bye tshang ba ska sna'i skor zhas/ de ltar ngams shod smad nu gsan pa mngod cing 'o bdun lhag gci bzhugs/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi ya sbyon te/ 4 ba dpon rjo bsod ba dgu 5 gtsang nas mar byon pa dang gung bstun nas sku mched gnyis rī 'don mdzad dgegs sun tshar spu dang khong gcang du gshegs/ jo ye kyi nang ston jo 'khyams la phur pa ga na te chu tho rir bzhugs nas sgrab pha mdzad/ de nas zhig pho'i drung du byon pa yin te/ dang po chos bye ba'i rtog pa med chos kyang nga rang mkhas/ gdams ngag kyang nga rang che/ khong snya pa dang grags pa che bar 'dug pa dang / nu bo'i slob dpon yin pas mjal phrad kyi rnam ba ga cig kyang bya snyam nas/183

zhal blta zhing rnam bzhag la byon pas/ zhig po bdud rtsi 'ug skad dgon pa na bzhugs pa dang mjal/ zhal mthong ba dang gus pa rang dbang med pa skyes nas/ nang par 'gro tsa na'ang zhabs drung du 'ong / gus par byung bas thugs kyis gzung bar zhu/ zhus pas/ mos par byung ngam gsung /min tu mo pa byung zhus pas/ 'o na las 'phro yod pa yin mes da lta rang nas sdod/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid mi rtag pa yin pas gyis kun ji ltar 'ong cha med gsung / da res sdod rtsis med pas cha rkyen ci yang khyer ma yongs zhuma'ibs/ 'dir 'ong ba la rgyags phye khur nas 'ong ba su yang med/ ༷ da gcig pu la cha rkyen logs khri ga na dgos gsung de na de'i tshe rang na zhabs drung du brgyags ti chos gsan pa las/ de yong rgyud ma ra la kun byed rgyal spa ma bu sum bskor/4 bshad rgyud mdo bcu/'khorab rtsad gcod spyi rgyud la bshad rgyud sdo bzhi/ rtsa ba 'grel pa rgyan chos man ngag dang bcas pa gsan/ rtsa ba bco brgyad kyi bshad srol la zab pa gzhung / gab pa mngon du byungs te man ngag sgom sdebs su bshad pa/ de'i sgom 'grel snying gi nyi ma drug yang snying rig pa'i nyi ma drugastan rgyud sbo ba nag po'i chos skor dang bcas pa/ sgom yig chen mo/ri snye/ mig sgron/ gdar sha/— gzer bu rnams gsan/ ba/dmas pa snyan brgyud kyi skor la/ skor lugs rong lugs khams lugs gsum gyi gdamasangag phyag bzhes khrid dang bcas pa rnams la nan tan cher mdzad/184

zhig po'i zhabs la gtugs shing / gsung gi chu rgyun dri ma med pa legs par 'thungs pas thugs dgongs longs/ byin rlabs zhugs/ rtogs grol dus gcig tu gyur pa lags/ chos sku rang la gnas kyang rang ngo ma shes pa/ /thog ma med nas 'khrul lugs bsam mi khyab/ /las 'phro sad dam bsags pa'i stobs kyis su/ /mtshan ldan bla ma gsang sngags zab mo dang / /mang du mjal te thos pa bag re byas/ /sems kyi sgro 'dogs zhig po'i drung du chod/ /mnyam med rin chen de yi thugs kyi bcud/ /brgyud pa bzhi ldan gdams ngag zab dgu gnang / zhes kyang gsung /de la spyir skyes bu 'di ni thog ma nas sngon sbyangs kyi bsags pa dang ldan —pas rigs rgyud dang shes rab gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa/ zhugazhon nu nas bla ma mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs drung ju gtugs pas mkhyen pa'i nor bu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ rgyud gdams ngag mtha' dag gi don thugs su byon zhing rje gong ma rnams kyi byin rlabs zhugs pas snang ba chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du rtogs pa/ 'jig rten gyi sgro bkur la nyam mi nga bas tshul 'chos med pa'i spyod pa mdzad pa/ dus thams cad du bla ma'i gus pa dang ma bral bas bla ma'i 'phrin las sgrub pa dang / gdan sa'i zhabs rtog mdzad pa la skyo ngal med pa/ thugs brtse pa chen po'i sems bskyed dang ldan pas rang gcig pu'i zhi bde'i smra ma skye bar zhi drag gi phrin 'a ga kyis gang la gang 'dul du sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ mdzad pa 185

gang ltar spyod kyang chos nying kyi rtogs pa las g.yo 'gul med pa ri bo lta bu'i rtogs ldan gyi rgyal po yin sna/ /de la spyir rta ston jo yes 'di chu mo lug la 'khrungs/ lo nyer dzi la zhig po dang mjal/ so bdun la zhigangapo gshegs/ de'i bar du lo bcu gcig dbu sngal sgrol/ zhag gcig kyang ma bral bar rgo bdan bltan/ mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes por mdzad/thugs dgongs gnyis cu med par 'dres/ bla ma ci mnyes byed pa ci bsam grub par gyur cig gsung ba lan gsum thob/ spyir bla mkha mas cad la zhabs togam grub pa med khyad bar zhig po la yul gzhes tham cad btsongs nas spong ga pyis te chos 'khor lan bzhi btsugs/ snga phyi bsdoms pa te bzangs bdun cu ba mig tu sang / gad pa gsung sgro mas cad gir ba de bas snyi rabs rjes 'brang rnams la drin che ba lags/ de ltar chos zhu ba'i spros pa rnams chodo nas/ myal ga shing cig tu phyin la nags khrod da ri sul mis mi mthong rna bas mi tho bzhig tu dngos grub thob pa ma byung yang / 'dir song dang 'dir mi med pa zhig bya dgos snyam nas dpe rnams kyang mig chung 'ba' zhig bris pa min te/zhig po tha sngags dus zhig pos ma gnang / de rjes cu dpo song gi gyel dang slob dpon sprul rgyal gnyis kyi gsukho gcig ma phad pa dang /gdan sa'i bya pa yang rshacig gyir gnyi tude nas byung bar blo mi thongs pa sa/ rgas khar bu smad kyi pha 'di 'dra ba cig byung ga jing 'on

kyang mi me zhaXs tog 'ba' zhiba'ibyas pas sgrib pa dag nas/ ting nge 'dzin kyang gong 'phel du song ste/ ri khrod 'grims pha bas kyang 'digarang stobs che ba 'dug snyam pa byung gsung gyi bo dong gi bla ma brag2kar mo tha la/ rin po che gosal pa sgron ma'i rgyud dang / 'phags lam bkode pa'i rgyud gnyis dasan/ gdams ngag phrad dag kyang zhus/ chosazhus tshado kyi bla ma khrirtsis pas pa drug slos stor nan tan byas pa bcu gsum / de'i nang nas kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma drug de las kyang khyed po du drin che tho gsum/ 'gran zla dang bral bzhig po rin po che'o/ yathodang / dmar ston 'a ma dang / kha ragos yab zos gnyi dang /se dur lung pa dang / bla ma rtsags dang / rje btsun nyags dang /zangs ri rgya ras dang / rlung yab sras gnyis dang / zhar chos oṃ dang sto pa sto 'azer dang / mal bye tshang pa dang / nang ston jo 'khyams dang zhig po bdud rtsi dang / mi bya byang partson dang / brag dkar mo pa'o/zhigopo la brten nas yon rtan rgyud la skyes tshul yang / thang skya'i thugasarje can po bzhengs pa'i tshe/ zung mkhar rdu zangs zhus kyi las ba bco bgyed mdzad pa'i dus su rtogs pa skye pa dang / sgrog bo la du ston brgyud spungs ba gsung pa'i tshe thog babs kyi skabs su byin rlabs zhugs na / snang ba chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor du rtogs pa'i myong khri khyad par can 'khyungs/ slotho dpon sprul sku'i chibs pa pho blogashabatsad pos khyer ba'i 187

tshe/ rdor thos phu'i snang gsal brag la chos skyong bsgrub pa'i tshe mgon po'i zhal gzigs/ stod lungs kyi stong khun bde ldan yar bsod stoms la byon pa'i tshe/ nyi shu dgu'i mchod pa'i nub rmi lam du zhig po byon nas gdams ngag gsungs pas/ sdug bsngal rang sangs la song nas/ de nas bzung sdug bsngal rang rgyud la skad cig kyang skye ma myong / da lta gdan sa'i bya ba dang zhig po'i phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ rgyal khams kun tu byon zhing 'gro don rgya cher mdzad/ lha sa'i jo shāka rnam gnyis kyi zhabs tog kyang snga gi bsdoms pas lo drug mdzad de/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa brgyad pa lcags pho stag gi ston zla ra ba'i tshes bcu dgu la gshegs te/sku gdung ring bsrel yang mang du byon no/ /lcags stag 'di la grub chen u rgyan pa 'khrungs te/ de ni dpal phag mo gru pa zhi bar gshegs pa'i lo nas brtsams te/ drug cu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /sangs rgyas dbon ston gyi slob ma rta ston gzi brjid ces bya ba shin tu mkhas pa zhig byung ste/ gsang ba'i snying po'i ṭi ka rgyas pa zhig mdzad/ des brgyud pa 'di'i lo rgyus kyi yi ge mdzad tshul snang bzhin du bris te/ 'di yan chad du sgyu 'phrul dang sems phyogs mtha' dag la mkhas par grags te/ de gnyis ga'i brgyud pa yin/ g.yung ston pa'i khog dbub tu/ sgro sbyag pa'i slob ma rnams 'dir sngar bgrangs pa rnams dang cung zad mi gcig par snang ngo/ sgro sbug pa'i slobam gtsang pa byi ston dang / sgong drings pa nye ston chos kyi seng 188

ge gnyi gyi gtsang nag 'od 'bar la gsungs/ de la mas ston mgon pos gsan/ de la bla ma zos gsan/ de la pa shrī shāka 'od dang /gnag bdur 'dul gyis gsan/ pa shī zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ gong ma si chen gyi lung gis/ brag rdo rje tshe brtan nas slob dpon padmas sbas pa'i tshe chu bton/ ga ra yig pa labaskur bas/ gong ma'i bla ma rnamasadang byas po mnyam ma'i phyir pa rang btags zhe zer rta nag bdud 'dulal mda' shākya 'a la gyis gsan/ de la zur byams pa seng gis gsan te/do ni sku na gzhon nu nyid nas thugs rab dang mkhyen pa'i rtsal shin tu che zhing / khyad par du sgyu 'phrul la mkhas pa zhig ste dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun la gshegs/ de la gsung ston pa dang / 'jam dbyangs bsam 'grub rdo rje gnyis kyis gsan te/ de la gsung sto na pa'i gdung rus na yin 'khri 'khrungs sa ni tshong 'dus pa yin/ gzhon nu nas mkhyen pa shin tu che/ sngags gas rnying dang mtshan nyid kyi'ang mngon pa kun las btus la mkhas/ zur byams pa sengalags shangs pa shāka 'bum la gshin rje'iskor gsan pa'i phyags phyir byon nas/ bla ma dang lhan cig tu legs par rshabaslabs pas/ 'a khrul 'khor las sbyor sogs la shin tu mkhas shing mthu che/ gzhon dus su bong ma'i lung gis rgya yu la du byon/ 'chams la sogs pa'i rnam 'gyur dang / gong ma la 'bru 'dab dgos pa'i mi sde mang pos than pa byung /ba'i tshe/ gong ma la char 'beb pa rdzongs ba zhu ba byas/189

der khong bsnangs pas/ khong gi dkon mchog la gsol ba nya /char mang dag par phebs/ gong ma dgyes rnye gnang sbyin mang po gdang bas/ nom pa chen po dang bcal te bod du phebs pa la/ ca shes dang grogs mched sogs la ci yang ma byin par byu gyi don du bla ma dang dge 'dun la yo byad rnam phul/ za ma mang po la phung dang man ngag gi ga da pa rgon tu rgya che/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje dang / sbu ston rin lo che'i yang thob ma min zhing du kyi 'khor lo la mkhas rdzog pa chen po la sogasami'i ma ba rnams la nyams len drag po ladzad/ mo pa gror rtsonan zas das rtsal na po rgyung ba'i don la mnyam med rgyal ba gsung stonadzo rnyesatha ba la gas pa'i skur ga dkubal khyad par du cang 4 rgo dang 2 sku jig ga gas lang mang du thazhugs/ ba dpas kyang ga napa phadangatshe rgo mdzad/ rgod sgro chu'i grod pa dum bub bcan kyang chu 'bo bo dang / lcags sgrogablang kyang mi 'tshig pa dang /rtsi pa la rdo drug sbyor gyi zhal ba byas pas/ rtsig dzichen po gcig tu gyur pa la stog pa'i rten 'brel nga po yang khyen/ sngags kyi gangs rgyas dang mtshan nyid gyi sangs rgyas gnyis kyi khyad 'gyed thod pa g.yag lde paṇa chen gyi gabyugs pas shin ta dad de/ dngo na slob bca lnga phung po ri bo cher byon na bas la gtug / sku tshe'i smad la tsho ga pa skyo sung pa la bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ mtshan rdo rje 'buca/ zhes pa rdo rje dpal zhes 90

par ༷spyor/ skyes blo dam pa 'di shing yo spre'u la 'khrungs na / brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa shing mo sbral la gi bar gshegs/ 'a ma dbyang bsam 'grub rdo rje ni/ rnying ma'i sku yon tan can rim par byon pa'i sras su rta nag gnas gsor du shing mo lug gi 'o la 'khrungs/ zur byams pa seng ge la gsan pa rgya chen po mdzad/ khyad par du sgyu 'phrul skor la mkhas/ sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang rnams glan nya tshal ba bsod nams mgon po la gsan/ yang de na pa'i zur shākya 'byung gnas zhesapa shin hūṃ mkhas grub tu grags pa de dang / 'ug pa lung pa'i bla snyem seng ge ba gnyis chung chung nas zhabs drung du bzhag na legs par bskyangs pas/ snyigazur pa'i brgyud pa la shin tu bka' drin che/ bye ma song gir rdzogs pa chen po snying thig la thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ thig le chen po'i skur gyur na sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang por byon pa la sogs pa thags dam shin tsu mtho ber mnga' ste/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis ba tshe pho 'brug la gshegs te/ 6go gas khar rang gi sras / nga bde ba can du 'gro/ nyid kyis kyang brgyad cu rtsa gnyis thub par 'dug ste/ de nas bde ba can kyi shog gsung ba'i bka' stsal gnang / smyo shangs pa kun mkhyen pa zhes gshes pa dang snyan pas phyogs spun hūṃ khyab tho de'ang / byis pa'i dus na bla ma 'dis dbang mang du bskur/ legasatsār byin gyis brlabs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur pa yin no/ 111

bdag cag gi bla ma rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes grags pa de ni/ yab kyi lnga bcu rtsa drug pa lcag pho stag la rta nag gnas gsar du 'khrungs/ lcags stag 'di phag mo gru pa 'khrungs nas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa yin/ lo 'di la mkha' spyod pa dang / mkhan chen rin po che rgyal bzangs pa yang 'khrungs/ yab la mi rnams kyis/ khyed kyi sras 'dis phan ni mi thogs/ de tsam gyi tshig kyis ci bya zhus pas/ 'dis 'gro ba la phan thogs pa cig 'ong gsung nas lung bstan/ dgung lo drug pa la gsang ba snying po'i rgyud thugs su chud pa zhig rin po che shāka 'byung ba'i spyan sngar byon pas/ nga'i bla ma'i sras gsung nas gces gces mdzad pa brjed de/ la yang lo brgyad lon pa na thugs la btsud/ cho ga min las rnams kyang rmeb kyis legs par bslab pas/ tsho dgung lo bcu bzhi bzhes pa na gzhan la dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon zar —ba byung yab las sgro 'phrul skor gyi chos rnams legs par thugs su chud pa na/ da nga rab tu byung ba zhig byas nas mtshan nyid kyi pu ti 'ga' re dang gsar ma'i rgyud sde 'ga' rnar yang slob pa yin zhus pas/de legs po ni yin/ 'on kyang nga la khyod gcig pu las med pas/ jo mo zhig longs la sras tsha zhig byung ba na/ gzod rab tu byung bas chog gsung bas/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa la ma cig 'di blangs/ de la sras po drug dang sras mo gnyis/ yum gzhan pa zhig la yang sras gcig byung / 92

de rnams skyor ba'i long la lo mang po thal gsung zhing / dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa na chos 'khor sgang du chig rdzogs mdzad de/ sku shin tu btsun par bzhugs/ sgro 'phrul la shin tu mkhas par gyur pas dgung lo bzhi bcu skor la gsang ba snying po'i rgyud la ṭi ka che ba cig dang / lam rnam par bkod pa yang rnam bshad chen po zhig mdzad/ phrin las shar ba brgyad las/ khro bo la mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa dang / gnas lung la yang cho ga shin tu rgyas pa zhig mdzad/ yab dang thugs zas thub pa rdo rje sogs la man ngag gi gsan pa mang du mdzad cing sku nyams su bzhes/dgung lo bdun cu pa sa mo phag gi lo la sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dbang dang / sgyu 'phrul gyi tshe dbang dang / na rag dong sprulas kyi dbang dang / tshe bdag gi dbang dang / yang dag me gcig gi dbang dang / rta mgrin rna bo ba'i lugs kyi rjes gnang dang / zla rgyal ma'i lugs kyi rjes gnang dang /phur pa sa lugs kyi drag po'i rjes gnang dang bcas pa dang / sems sde bco brgyad kyi rig pa'i rtsal dbang dang / gsang ba snying po'i rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i rnam bshad dang / lam rnam par bkod pa'i snyi ka nyid kyis mdzad pa'i thog nas rgyas par bshad pa dang / gzhan sgyu 'phrul gyi khog gzhung gsal sgron la sogs pa'i gzhung chung bzhi bcu tsam dang / mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa dang / de'i rtsa ba'i rgyud kun 'dus dang / snubasasangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i mdo'i 'grel pa mun pa'i go cha dang /193

sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu pa dang / bla ma gnyis dang / yang dag rtsa ba'i lung rnams kyang gnang / snying jig gi spros bcas la sogs pa'i dbang bzhi dang /me long rdo rjes mdzad pa'i khrid mig gi steng na khrid/ rdzogs pa chen po ma ro'i man ngag kyang khrid du mdzad/ cu gas rje chen po'i dmar khrid 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rjes byang sems rgyal ba ye shes la gsan/ de la chos rje nyid kyis gsan te/ chos rje bla ma'i khrid yig gi steng nas de yang bdag la gnang ste/ gsang sngags rnying ma zhes grags pa'i phyogs la lhag par mos pa thob snang / chos thong ba'i sgrib pas ma sbags tsam mo/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gnyis ma lcags mo lug gi mo la dbus su phebs/ chu pho stag la bsam gling du dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis zhabs nas bteg ste/'du pha mdo dbang la sogs pa dbang mang po dang / gsang snying la sogs mi'i bshad pa dang sang mang du ma da de/ 'brug gi po la gtsang du phebs/ dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa lcags mo phag la gshegs/lcags phag de nas me pho spre'u 'di yan du so bzhi bcu rtsa drug song / spyir zur chung pa 'khrungs nas me pho sbre'u yan la lo bzhi brgya dang drug cu rtsa gsum song ngo yang rgyas sman stag rtse sar gdung rum gnyal/ mtshan sangs rgyas grags zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ des dang po dzambha la bsgrubs pa'i mabar zhing chung zhig yod pa chus khyer te/ de nas bya bral la byon pas sgru gu 194

dor phyug po mdzes khyer ba zhig shi ba'i ro 'khur mi ma byung bar 'dug pa la/rtog med mdzad de/ ro dril ba'i las byas phas/ de'i mal 'braganas ga ra mang po byung / de nas zlar log ste rna snyi khang dmar du khyung po 'o bo'i slob ma byam nam/ khong yang dag sgrub pa'i phyag gyir bzhugs te sgrub pa mdzad bas yang dag mar ze dgu pa'i zhal gzig de na gtsang du byon nam sgro spug la slob ma bya chen po de'i dbon po zhig la mdo dang sgyu 'gru'adil byugs pa'i gsan pa mtshad pa'i tshe phyug po ga gis nas khal brgya tham pa phul/ der mdo dang sgyu 'a la la sogs mkhas par bslabs/ gzhan yang sgro sbug pa'i slob ma myang nag mdo bo/ de'i slob ma lha rje mad 'a seng ge la yang mdo dang sgyu 'phrul gsan pa mdzad/ mkham pa chen por gyur te/ gnyal pa zhig po'i slob ma rgya 'jing ru bas kyang khong la gtugs te gas pa mang du mdzad/ khong gis rang yul du rdo thog thel tab/ de'i slob ma skyi chos kyi seng gi zhes bya ba mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa zhig byung / des stor rgyal po'i spyan sngar byon/ gong ma se chen gyi rgyab chod mdzad de/ mchod rten zhig gi nang du bcug nas sgo legs par bcan de lo dus su bltas pag/ rdo rje phur bu'i skur gyur nas 'dug pa ngo mtshar skyes te/ rdo thog pa la dar rings chen mo la sogs pa'i dngos po tshan char gnang / 'ja' sa bcad pa'i dgon gzhis kyang mang du yod/ skyi chos kyi nga ge la/ 'phyong po khe ru'i myang ston chen po'i pas 195

mnyam med pa la sras lnga 'khrungs pa'i che shos sman lung pa shākya 'od dam/gsang mtshan mi bskyod rdo rje zhes grags pa des mdo sgyu 'phrul skor rnams mkhas par bslabs/ dus gyis glan rdo rje 'od po'i sras glan mkhas pa bsod rgyal la yang gsan nas/ gsang ba snying po'i khog dbub dang / ṭi ka rgyud don rnam nges la sogs pa'i yig cha mang du mdzad/ 'di la dwags po'i sangs rgyas gong la bas gsan nas/ rjes dwags po nyid du'ang slob ma bla ma gnyan la sogs pa mang du thon zhing / gon gyo bdag po'i bla mar gyur te khams su shin tu dar bar mdzad do/ sman lung pa la yar klungs sprul sku'i sras rin po che shāka 'bum pas gsang ba snying po'i bshad pa mkhas par bslabs/ de la mkhas grub chos dpal yab zas gnyis kyis kyang gsang snying gi bshad pa legs par gsan/ yang spyi chos kyi seng ge'i gdan sa rgya ye shes mgon pos kyang / skyi dang glan bsod rgyal gnyis ka la gtugs nas mdo dang sgyu 'phrul mkhas par mkhyen/ de la dpon po dpal ldan rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis dang po gsang phur byon nas tshad ma rnam nges mkhas par bslabs/ phyis rgya ye shes mgon po la mdo dang sgyu 'phrul sogs legs par bslabs shing / gsang ba snying po'i 'grel pa bar khab nyid gzhung du byas pa'i snyi ka dbang gi cho ga la sogs pa mdzad/ ci des khong rang gi dbon po bla ma tshul rgyal ba la gsungs/ de la ri gdong ba shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis gsan zhing / 'dis dwags por byon nas ku rab pa 196

dpon g.yog dang sngags pa rnams la bshad pas/ ding sang gi bar du yang sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lag len rnams ma chad par yod/ shes rab rgyal mtshan gyi slob ma zhang mkhar ba bsod nams bzang po/ de'i slob ma slob dpon bdag nyid chen po bkra shis rgya mtsho ba yin te/ de la bdag gis rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas mdzad pa'i gsang ba snying po'i ṭika chen gyi lung legs par thob/gzhan yang bdag nyid chen po 'di la phur pa lha nag ma'i dbang rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i yig cha'i steng nas zhus shing / bshad 'bum rdo rje don gsal la sogs pa'i khrid 'a 'a zhig kyang thob/ de'i brgyud rim yang / slob dpon padma yab yum/ 'bre a tsa ra sa le/ lang lab byang chub rdo rje/sna nam tshul khrims shes rab/ khyung po 'chal chen/ la la chung / blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ya 'brog pa gu rub yang dag 'dis phur pa mya ngan las 'das —pa'i rgyud la brten na / lha thams cad nag por mdzad/ de'i slob ma 'bos ston rgyang 'bar/ khyung po seng na khyung po khro bo/mnyalaston grags/ skyi chos kyi seng ge rgya ye shes mgon po/ dpal ldan rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ bla ma tshul rgyal ba/ ri gdong ba shes rab rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon bsod nams bzang po/ slob dpon bkra shis rgya mtsho ba'o/rtse pa bang pa dang snye mdo'i phur pa yang / gu rub la rog shes rab bla mas gsan/ de'i sras rog bkra shis grags pa yin/ de nas sras 197

po rnams la brgyud pa'o/gzhan yang mdo dang sgyu 'brul gyi bshad pa'i bka' ni/ rogashes rab 'od kyis bla ma mang po las lugs tha dad pa mang bar gsan te/ dang por rogataston btsan po la so lugs kyi mdo dang sgyu 'phrul dang sems phyogs rnams gsan/ lhab dres ma gong pa la mdo dang sgyu 'phrul skyo lugs gsan/lhab kyi zur chos gaslob dpon yam spyod dngos grub la mdo dang sgro 'phrul zur lugs gsan te/ sgro sbug pa'i slob ma snubs ston/ de kha rag snying po/ des yam shud/ yang na kha rag snying pos sras padma 'bar/des shes raba'od/ so dar ma song ge lamado sgyu 'byolatshan mangs gsan )/ tshu bar gyis glan shākya ba nga po/ des sras min jo btsun sang nge/nas dar ma snang po/ des so dar nga gi'o/ lha rje nya ri ba'i slob ma myang nayasamado bo la'ang mdo dang sgyu 'phrul gsan/ sgyu 'gru'adigyi gzhi la 'bra bu gsum gyi stong rgyan dang / lam rnam ba da kyi ṭi ko brtsams/des snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa la gsung shing / des kyang gsang ba snying bo la ṭi ka dang / lam rnal skad lam na zhib por mdzad de/ de dag lasogs pa rog la gdung brgyud na sa la dbang dang rgyud kyi bshad pa ni shin tu dar ba byung ngo dan bag tu yang sgyu 'phrul gyi bshad pa rim par byung lha nga klong chen rab 'byams kyis kyang der gsan pa mjod nas/ gsang ba snying po'i 198

'grel pa par khab kyi lugs ltar 'chad pa legs pa ma yin gyi/ rong zom gyi ltar legs pa yin zhes gsung mod kyi/ spyi'i khog dbub dang rgyud kyi rnam bshad gnyis mdzad de de man ngag snying thig dang bsnan nas mdzad do/gtsang stod mang dkar du yang mang ston zur pa zhes grags pa rim par byung ba rnams kyis kyang bshad sgrub legs par mjordo de/ las stod sto dang byang thams cad du yang shin tu dar bas/ byang du se ston 'byung gnas 'od ces pa dang / snar seng ge 'od ces pa dang / byang tar la mo pa yon tan dbang phyug ces pa la sogs pa'i bshad pa 'ga' re yang mthong ngo /zur rnam pa gsum gyi slob ma'i grangs snga ma rnams kyis bshar du btab pa ltar de dag las mched pas grangs med pa zhig byung bar mtshon nus mod kyi/ so so'i ming dang rus dang bcas pa ni bsnyad par mi nus so/ khams skyudzisa'i cha rnams su yang yongs su grags pa khams lugs pa zhes pa byung bar rong zom gyi 'grel pa las bshad cing / 'bri chu'i 'gram sbom por dang nye bar ka thog ces pa'i gnas dgon/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i yum spun du gyur pa sga dam pa bde gshegs zhes pas btab par gtsang ston zhes pa las brgyud nas mdo dang sgyu 'phrul gyi bshad pa dbang sgrab kyi lag len dang bcas pa ding sang yang yod par snang la/ gsang ༵ snying po'i rgya cher 'grel pa slob dpon nyi ma'i 'od kyi seng gis mdzad pa yang khams nas byung 199

bar sngar bshad pa ltar na/ bee ro tsa na las brgyud pa'i bshad pa yang khams kyi yul du byung bar shes par ba'o/ di dag ni sgyu 'phrul gtso bor gyur pa'i skabs rdzo/'dus pa mdo'i ba da lugs kyi skabs/de la 'dus pa mdo zhes grags pa la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud kun 'dus rig pa'i mdo dang / bshad pa'i rgyud mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa gnyis yod de/bu rin po che'i rgyud sde spyi'i ma bzhag tu/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ 'dren pa'i theg pa gsum po dag bcom ldan nges par gsung lags na/ /rgyu 'bras lhun grub tu spyod cing / /sangs rgyas gzhan nas mi tshol ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa cis ma gsungs/ /zhes rgyas pa dang /rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas na/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes dngas pa de yang / mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa'i mdo nyid na/ 'dren pa'i theg pa rnam gsum la/ /gang dag rim par bkod lags na /mnyam pas blang dor med spyod cing / /byang chub gzhan nas mi tshol ba'i/ /thabs mchog dpag gis mi lang ba'i/ /nges pa'i theg pa yod ma gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ba de yin par snang ste/ mdo 'di'i brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rje sgro sbug pas 300

mkha' la/ des sku tshe stod la sto brag gi sna nam nyal yon po la sogs pa bzhi la bar du zhu bsod shāka la/ tha ma lha rje 'ug pa lung pa la gsungs so/ yang sna nam tshul khrims byang chub kyis dge bshes mar chung lho brag pa la gsungs/ mar pas lha rje bde gshegs kyi spyan sngar sku drin zhus pas/lha rje shangs chung pa dang dar ma bsod nams grwa sa rnying par bzhugs pa dang mjal nas/ mar pa sku stom pa drag po gcig gi zhabs tog lha rje shangs pas mdzad pas dgyes te/ mar pas shangs pa la thonang lha rje shangs pa bdag gis spyan drangs nas tshul bzhin du zhus pas bdag la gnang ba'o/zhes gsung te/ de man chad sgyu 'phrul gyi brgyud pa dang mthun pa'i smo nas rje btsun sgrol ma bas mdo dang / de'i 'grel pa sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa mun pa'i go cha zhes bya ba'i lung yang bdag la gnang ngo / mdo'i brgyud lugs kyi skabs so/ rong zom chos kyi bzang po'i lo rgyus kyi skabs/phul du byung ba'i skyes bu chen po rong pa chos kyi bzang po zhes bya ba'i gtam brjod par bya ste/ de yang rong ba na yon tan rin chen gyi zas rong ban rin chen tshul khrims zhes bya ba zhig byung ste de'i sras yin no/'di'i che ba'i yo/na tan ni/ de nyid kyi slob ma yol dge bsnyen rdo rje dbang 202

phyug gis mdzad pa bzhin bri bar bya'o/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rong zom chos kyi bzang po zhes bya ba bod kyi pa ta chen por grags pa de ni/ bod ru bzhi'i nang nas ru lag gtsang smad kyi snar lungs rong du sku 'khrungs te/de bas cung snga bar yul khams su slob dpon smra ti dzñā na gīrti zhes bya ba'i pa ta yon tan dang ldan pa zhig byon nas rgyud 'ga' zhig gi 'gyur yang bcos/ tha ga na'i mtshan brjod kyi 'grel ba la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi 'grel ba dang / 'jam dpal gsang ldan dang 'jig rten snang byed zla ba'i no bee ka la sogs pa sgrab thabs mang po bsgyur/ sgra'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad nas sku 'das te/ de nyid rong du sku 'phos pa dge bshes 'di nyid yin par yang grags/ kha cig na re/ a tsa ra phra la ring mo zhe bya ba'i bzlo ta zhig khams su byon nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgya ra 'grel ba chen po la sogs pa bsgyur te bshad pa mdzad nas/ 'das te skyi ba pos pa dge bshes rong zom lo tsā ba yin zhes kyang zer/ gzhan yang jo bo rje zhes bya ba mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa yon tan mang po mnga' ba'i pa ta de nyid dang bla ma chen po mjal bas jo bo'i zhal nas/spyo gar gyi 7tsan nag po zhabs chen po spyod pa nga de nyid tshe 'phos pa jo bo 'di kho na yin te/ kho bos 'di dang chos kyi gtam bya ba ga la thub ces nge par gsung skad/ skyes bu de ni la lar bde bar gshegs pa'i sprul pa yin zhes kyang grags la/ phal cher 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul 203

par grags/ 'di ltar dgung lo bcu gcig pa la mtshan nyid gsan/bcu gsum man chad la ga na pa rdzogs pa dang 'dra bar mkhyen pa che bar gyur/ shes bya thams cad la ma rmongs zhes grags so/ khong nyid kyi zhal nas bdag thos pa chung ba yang min te/ chos thams cad la ma thos pa med do/ thos pa che ba yang min te/ chos phal che ba la tshar re las ma dgos so zhes gsung skad do/ skyes bu de ni shes rab zab la rgya che ba dri ma med kha dang ldan pas/ rgya gar gyi chos bzang po mdo rgyud dam bstan bcos su gtogs pa sngar ma gzigs pa mtha' dag la tshar re re gnyis gzigs pas mkhyen cing / tshig dang don ma lus pa thugs la zin cing thams cad mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob ces grags so/ gzhan yang tsa na ka la sog pa 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos dang / tshad ma'i bstan bcos dang / rig byed kyi bstan bcos dang / don du 'gyur ba'i tshigs bcad dang / snyan dngags mang po mkhyen pa yin/ thugs kyang shin tu che bas chos la mos pa'i mi rnams dang / chos kyi gang zag dang / khyad par du rdo rje'i theg pa la zhugs pa dang / gsang sngags kyi las dang dngos grub sgrub par 'dod pa'i gang zag dge ba can rnams la phan gdags pa'i dgongs pa bzang po mnga' bas/ phyin ci ma log pa'i gdams pa nan tan du phan thogs par mdzad pa/ mngon par shes pa'i cha dang ldan zhing sems can 'dul ba'i dus dang tshad la mkhas pas/ 'gro ba phal pa dang chos 204

kyis bsgyur ba rnams tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka bde ba la 'god pa'i phyir/rsha'abyor zhing 'grig pa'i bstan bcos nyid kyi zhal snga nas phyung sto/ de dag la phan 'dogs pa la dus rtag tu skyo ba mi mnga'/ chos kyis blo ma bsgyur ba'i skyi bo phal ba la yang ser sna dang gnod sems spangs nas thugs rje'i yul du mdzad de zhi bde la 'god pa/ sdom pa dang thuṭa dam la nor bu rin po che dang srog gi dbang po ltar gces par mdzad cing / gzhan yang de la 'god pa/ dam pa'i chos rtsom pa na glegs bam bsdu zhing gzigs pa la sogs pa'i rtsol ba ma mdzad kyang / chos phyogs med la thogs jug med par spro bar nus pa/ des mdzad pa'i chos thams cad kyang lung dang rigs pa dang bla ma'i nye bar bstan pa dang mi 'gal zhing / sgra skyon dang don skyon dang rnam par bral bas gzhan mkhas par grags pa gang gis kyang rtsod mi nus par grags pa'o/ de nyid ni thog ma nyid nas ha cang ma 'bad par sgro ta'i skad la sogs pa rgya gar gyi sgra'i bye brag mang po dang / sgra'i bstan bcos kyi don la ma rmongs par grags/ sku byis chung gi dus su a tsa ra 'dug tshad la dgyes shing de dag gi skad la dgyes/ de nas khri brta'i pu ti la brtags pas mkhyen pa la tshegs ma byung / tha na dud 'gro'i brda dang skad kyang mkhyen par grags/ de'i phyir de mdzad pa'i gsar sngags kyi yi gi rnams la slob pa'i brgyud du byung ba'i gang zag rnams kyi/ lung ma thob par yi ge las byung ba bzhin du sbyar ba las byin rlabs ma byung ga med ces 205

grags so/ lo tsā ba chen po de la dus de'i tshe bod ru bzhi'i mkhas pa mang pos btud par gyur te/ go rub lo tsā ba dge slong chos kyi shes rab ces bya ba/ chos phyogs med la mkhas par grags pa zhig gis/ thog mar bod du skyes pa'i gang zag gis chos mang po rtsom pa zhes dpyas so/ phyis bla ma rong zom gyis mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po'i tshul la 'jug pa'i pu ’ de mthong nas/gus pa chen po skyes te/ zang zing mang pos bsnyen bkur byas te nyes pa /shags nas/ bdag rjes su gzung du gsol zhes bka' zhus pas gnang ste/'jam dpal gsang ba'i rgyud la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ gzhan yang mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba dang mkhas par grags pa'i blo rtsal can mang pos btud cing gsan par gyur te/ gsan pa de dag gi slob brgyud thams cad kyang shin tu dad par gyur nas bla ma dam par 'dzin no/ gsang rgyud kyi skabs na mar dge bshes chen po'i zhal nas/ 'o skol la da lta rgya dpe yod par gyur na 'di ltar 'gro ba yin te/ rgya dpe med pas da lta bcos su med gsung ba la/ go rub kyis de gzung nas phyis jo bo kṛ ba zhes bya ba'i parnyi ta la rgya dpe byung nas de la gsan pas rong pa chen po gsung ba bzhin byung nas shin tu mos te/kro pa la sa byung ba'i dmi zhig rong pa nyid la phul nas yang gsan skad/ gzhan yang rgya gang gyi mkhan po ma shrī warma dang / ma shrī tsā na dang / chu rpā ya shrī mi rtu dang / buddha 'a rka ra bha dra dang / de rpā ka ra tsand+ra dang / pa ra me sha ra dang / a mo snya 206

baspro la sogs pa pa ta mang po bsten nas/ de dag gi lo tsā ba mdzad/rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / gshin rje dgra rgyud dang / 'jam dpal sngags don dang / bde mchog rtsa rgyud la sogs pa mang du bsgyur/ 'gyur yang shin tu bzang bas gsar 'gyur mdzad de phan che bar btags so/ rgya gar gyi pa ta kun na re/ tta rma bha dra khyod kyis chos mang po rtsom la 'gro ba rnams skyobs shig khyod kyi yo tan gzhan lta zhog gi/ sgra tshad kyi lugs 'di'i sum cha tsam las mi shes pas kyang rgya gar na chos rtsom pa yin na/khyod ci'i phyir mi rtsom zhes gsung skad/ de ltar yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan yang / bdag bstod la sogs pa'i dri ma dang bral zhing /gzhan gyi chos lugs dang spyod pa dman yang don du 'gyur ba ma gtogs pa/pha rol khyad du gsod pa'i ngag rtsub la sogs pa thams cad mi gsung ngo / gzhan yang brag gzar po'i ngos la gshegs shing rtsibs bskor ba mdzad pa mthong ba la sogs pa mang du yod pa thos mod kyi/ yi ge mangs kyis dogs nas ma bris so/ yol dge bsnyen rdo rje dbang phyug gis bla ma dam pa'i yon tan gzhan las kyang yang dang yang du thos pa rnams yi ger bkod pa'o/yang yi ge gzhan dag na/ sprul pa'i skur grags pa'i pa ta chen po de/ sku byis pa gzhon nu la myang smad du rje 'gar ston tshul khrims bzang po la gsan pa mdzad/ de tsa na yab rong ban rin chen tshul khrims kyis rgyags skyel du byon pas/ mched po rnams na re/ khyed kyi bu 'di khong 207

rang blo dred nged la yang tho co che ba gnod par 'dug pas/ khyed rang da res khrid pa legs zer skad/ de yab kyis dge bshes 'gar la bstod nas/ khong de skad zer khrid la 'gro'am zhus pas/ slob dpon gyi zhal na / de skad ma zer cig/ khos chos thams cad go nas yod do gsung skad/ de tsa na dgung lo bcu gnyis tsam bzhes te/ gzhon nu des byis pa rtsed sar yang slob dpon gyis gsungs tshad shar re 'ong la/ chosathams cad tshar re gsan pa las tshig gcig kyang ma nor bar thugs su chud skad do/ lo bcu gsum pa la mkhas pa mdo ston nga ge rgyal mtshan bya ba la yang gsan/ nam zhig na khong gi rmi lam du gsang ba snying pos zan byas/sang rgyas mnyam sbyor gyis tshod ma byas nas gsol gyi 'dug pa rmi ba byung nas/ slob dpon la bshad pas/ ru'i zhal nas/ de shin tu bzang /chos de khong du chud pa'i rtags yin pas/ khyod kyis 'grel pa re gyis gsung skad do der dgung lo bcu gsum man chad la gsan pa rdzogs pa dang 'dra bar song / spyir gtam du yang / 'dul ba 'tshur ston dbyig ge mkhas/ cho ga khrigs bzangs kyi ye grags mkhas/ sgra dang tshad ma rong ba mkhas/ thams cad 'joms pa ma pho rang chos grags rang zer skad/ de nas dus gyis bla mas gsungs pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir/bslab pa rin po che gsum la brten pa'i ched du man ngag gsum mdzad de/lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rgyud la bskyed pa'i phyir dam tshig mdo rgyas 208 —

mdzad/ lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa rgyud la bskyed pa'i phyir 'grel patshul bzhi yan lag bco lnga pa mdzad/ mnyam sbyor la'ang 'grel pa marjed/lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa rgyud la bskyed pa'i phyir rdzogs pa chen po'i lta sgom man ngag mdzad/ ngan song sbyong rgyud dang / 'jigs byed dang /smra sgo la sogs pa'i 'grel pa dang bstan bcos mang du mdzad/ de'i dus su shab kyi yang khyed bla ma/ mar ba do ba/ 'u yug pa mda' bsam gtan/mdo'i khyung po hūṃ snying / se khrom rgya mtsho 'bar/ mtshams ston go cha/ bang ka dar chung / 'gos lhas btsas/ rgya rgyal tshul la sogs pa bod ru bzhi'i mkhas pa thams cad rtsod de/ bod du skyes pa'i gang zag gis bstan bcos 'di tsam rtsom pa mi rigs so zhes zer zhing sun 'byin du 'ongs ba la/ bstan bcos re mthong zhing gsung glengs re mdzad bas thams cad ngo mtshar skyes nas zhabs tog re mdzad/ chos re yang gsan/kun rgyas bla mar 'khur zhing spyi pos 'dud par gyur to/ zhes pa yang rong zom gyi thugs sras g.yag rdo rje 'dzin pa las byung ba'o/ skyes bu dam pa 'di'i gdung rabs ni/ rong ban dpal gyi rin po che/ de'i zas rong ban rin chen tshul khrims/ de'i sras rong zom chos kyi bzang po dang sgom chen chos 'phags gnyis so/ chos bzang gi sras gze brjed 'bar dang /'bum pa gnyis/ gzi brjod 'bar gyi sras ston dar dang ston skyabs gnyis so/ ston dar gyi zas ston seng / de'i sras jo sras ra pe/ de'i zas 209
