'bum dpal/ ston skyabs kyi sras jo sras 'od zer/ de'i sras slob dpon 'bum bstan/ rong pa 'bum 'bar gyi sras chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / jo rtsegs dang / jo bzang la sogs pa'o/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sras ru thā na bkro ste rong pa kun dga'/ de'i sras dar bzang dang rdo rje brtan/ dar bzang gi sras slob dpon me dpung ngo / de'i sras chos kyi bshes gnyen dang / chos bzhad do/ rong pa jo bzad kyi sras slob dpon jo bkra/ de'i sras slob dpon gser 'od/ jo brtan gyi sras nyi seng / de'i sras 'od zer 'bum dang 'bum rgod/ rong sgom chos 'phags kyi sras slob dpon ston g.yung / de'i zas jo zas lhas spungs/ de'i sras slob dpon byams chos pa chen po dar ma brtan/ de'i sras slob dpon sra brtan rdo rje yin no/ de ltar rong zom 'di ni 'khrungs pa tsam nyid nas lhun gyis grub pa'i shes rab chen po dang / ngang gis dge ba'i spyod pa can 'di ni/ rang dang dus mtshungs pa'i mkhas pa thams cad kyis mngon par bstod pa/ phyi dang nang gi rig pa'i gnas dang /saṃ sgri ta dang skad rigs kyi bye brag gzhan mang po la ma rmongs pa/ bod kyi skad nyid la yang 'di ni don 'di tsam zhig la 'jug go/ zhes bya ba'i khyad par phra mo dag kyang gzhan las ches lhag ba/ mdo sde dang rgyud sde dang bstan bcos kyi bye brag ma lus pa thugs su chud pa/ tha na 'jig rten pa'i 'tsho tshis zhing las dang / phyugs skyong ba dang / dkar she ji ltar sgrab pa'i tshul gyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad la/ bod kyi lha 'dre phal che ba'i thiganas dang spyod 210

pa yang thugs su chud cing / lta ba mchog tu gyur pa kun las khyad par du gyur pas/ bod gangs can gyi rgyud 'dir 'di dang mnyam pa'i mkhas pa ni su yang ma byung ngo / 'di la sngon gyi man ngag brgyud pa mang du mnga' ba dag kyang bla ma'i brgyud pa'i rim par 'dus par snang ste/ 'di ltar slob dpon padma'i gdams pa rnams kyang sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms/ mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug dom a tsa ra dpal me tog sgro rdo rje gzhon nu/zhang zhung yon tan grags/ rong ban yon tan rin chen/ rong ban rin chen tshul khrims kyi bar du brgyud de gsan no/ yang bee ro tsa nas g.yu sgro snying po/ des bla chen po dgongs pa gsal/ des grum shing glag can/des snubs dpa' brtan/ des ya zi bon ston/ des rong zom la bshad de sems sde'i brgyud pa gcig go /yang ldan slong thang sgron mar a ro ye shes 'byung gnas zhes bya ba grub pa'i skyes bu zhig byung rte/ de la rgya gar bdun brgyud dang / rgya'i hā shang bdun brgyud kyi gdams pa mnga' zhing / des cog ro zangs dkar mdzod khur dang / ya zi bon ston la gsungs te/ de gnyis kyis rong zom la bshad/ 'di la rdzogs chen khams lugs zhes zer/ yang bai ma las myang ting 'dzin bzang po la gsungs pa dang / bai ma las rma rin chen mchog dang / gnyags dzñā na ku mā ra la gsungs pa'i man ngag kyang / de gnyis khu byang chub 'od dang / khyung po dbyig 'od la brgyud nas rim gyis rong zom chos bzang la man ngag rnams 211

mnga' ba yin no/ skyes bu chen po 'di 'khrungs pa dang zhi bar gshegs pa'i lo tshigs ma rnyed na'ang / sngar brjod pa ltar jo bo rje bod du byon dus mjal zer ba dang 'a sa lo dang / de'i bla ma nag po dam tshig rdo rje bod du byon pa'i dus dang / go rub lo tsā ba dang / mar pa do pa dang / yang khyed bla ma rnams dang phal cher dus mtshungs pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ ma cig zha ma'i ming po rje 'khon phubs kyang lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe 'di'i thad du slob gnyer la byon zhes zer ro/ rong zom chos kyi ba nga po'i lo rgyus kyi skabs so/sems phyogs kyi skabs/ming rdzogs pa chen po mas phyogs su grags pa 'di rnams/ slob dbon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi bla ma rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis ban de chung ma can du bstan nas/ zhal lung la sogs pa'i ye shes zhabs kyi chos skor rnams byung ba'i khungs/ 'jam dpa' bshes gnyen de nyid la pa ta shrī sidhas gsan/ de la bai ro tsa nas gsan pa yin la/ bai ros khams su byon nas rgya cher gsungs pa yin no/ spyir na sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi zhal lung skor dang / sems phyogs dang / man ngag gi sde mas chos skad shin tu mthun par yod de/ sems phyogs la dpal 'dzin 212

gyis dgag pa brjod pa na/ gsang sngags gsar ma'i rgyud 'grel pa sgrub thabs man ngag 'di tsam zhig 'gyur ba la/ tha na rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa'i ming tsam yang med ces smra ba ni/ rang nyid mthong ba chung bar ston pa ste/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/ rdzogs pa chen po ye shes spyi gzugs can/ zhes gsungs shing / sman zhabs kyis ji lta ba'i don sgom pa yin par yang bshad do/ ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs kun tu bzang mor yang rdzogs pa chen po zhes bshad cing / sman zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dngos grub 'byung gter du yang rdzogs pa chen po'i mtshan gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir ro/ gzhan yang zhal lung gi 'grel par/ gsang ba'i snying po las gsungs pa'i nus pa'i dbang lnga po de smos nas/ de cha mthun pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las gsungs par yang bshad do/ gzhan yang zhal gyi lung du/ 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron ma kun gyis rab bsngags pa/ /cho rnam kun gyi snying po dngos grub de bzhin nyid/ /srid pa'i dug chu ba ga byed gsum khong bam steng 'bar/ /'jam dbyangs bla ma'i lung gis rtogs phyir bshad par bya/ zhes gsungs pa dang / sems sde bco brgyad kyi dang po rdol gser zhun du/ ston pa 'jig rten sgron mar gyur pa kun gyis mtshungs par rab bsngags pa/ /chos la chos kyi snying por gyur pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i snying po nyid/ /bde gshegs ma lus yum du gyur pas rgyal ba kun gyi lam gcig pu/ /tshul khrims la sogs pha rol phyin lam spyod pa 213

rgya mtsho'i gzhir rgyur pa/ zhes gsungs pa dag tshig gi 'jug pa zhin tu mthun par yang snang ba'i phyir ro/ 'dir/ tshul khrims la sogs pha rol phyin lam spyod pa rgya mtsho'i gzhir gyur pa/ zhes gsungs pa 'di ni rdzogs pa chen po thabs kyi spyod pa rnams 'gegs shing mi 'dod par smra ba yang bsal ba yin no/ de yang zhal gyi lung las/ chos rnams gzugs la sogs pa rnams/ /kun mkhyen bar gyi rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha'i dkyil ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /zab gsal gnyis med ye shes te/ zhes gsungs shing / de'i don 'chad pa na/ rnam par rtog pa kun bral bas/ /bsam brjod yul las shin tu 'das/ /mkha' bzhin dri med kun 'byung ba/brtags bral zab mo nyid ces bya/ /phyag rgya chen po'i gzugs 'chang ba/sgyu ma gzha' tshon lta bu ru/ /rang dang gzhan gyi rgyud sbyong bas/ /yang dag gsal ba zhes bya'o/ zhes grol ba'i thig le las gsungs te/ de lta bas na sems phyogs pa rnams la gsal ba gtan med pa ma yin mod kyi/zab mo'i phyogs shas tshe bar snang la/ man ngag pa rnams la zab mo'i phyogasayod kyang gsal ba shas che bar snang ngo / klong gi skor rnams las ni zab pa dang gsal ba gnyis cha mnyam par 'chad do/ de la slob dpon rnying ma ba rnams/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang de'i slob ma yi ma la yin par bshad nas/ chos phal cher de gnyis las brgyud par 'chad de/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba ni/ slob dpon e shes zhabs kyi dngos kyi 214

slob ma mkhas pa chen po'o/ bee rog khams su snga phyi rim pa gsum du bshad par grags te dang po rgyal mo rong gi brag la mgon po'i dgon par rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po la gsungs pa dang / tsha ba rong gi stag rtse mkhar gyi dgon par gsang ston ye shes bla ma la gsungs pa dang / stong khung rong gi brag dmar rdzong gi dgon par spangs sangs rgyas mgon po la gsungs pa dang / sngar rgyal po la gsungs pa dang / phyis dbus su byon nas dge slong ma la zi shes rab sgron ma la gsungs pa dang rim pa lngar grags te/ de rnams gnyags dzñā nas be ro nyid dang g.yu sgra la gsan zhing / phyi 'gyur rnams bai ma la la gsan no/ de la gnyags ni/ yar klungs gnyags kyi stag sgra lha snang dang / spu gza' sgron ma skyid gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/bai ma la dang g.yu sgra snying po la sogs pa las mkhyen pa che zhing / bka'i chu bo chen po bzhi 'dus pa yin te/ dkyus bshad gzhung gi chu bo 'grel ṭi ka stong thun dang bcas pa/ snyan brgyud gdams ngag gi chu bo gnad yig dmar khrid dang bcas pa/ byin rlabs dbang gi chu bo bskur thabs ngo sprod dang bcas pa/ phyag bzhes phrin sgrub kyi chu bo bstan bsrungs drag sngagasadang bcas pa'o/ des sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ gra dpal gyi snying po/lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ 'o phran dpal gyi gzhon nu/ snyan dpal dbyangs/'tshur nag ye shes dpal/ u pa de gsal/ thang pa zangs dpal gyi rdo rje dgye 'phaṭa pa shes rab/ lhu su ku mchog gi byang chub rnams la 215

gnang nas/ sog pos sangs rgyas ye shes la rim par brgyud pa snye/ lugs gcig go/ 'di'i spangs sangs rgyas mgon po ni/ rdo rje zam pa ba dag gi spangs mi pham mgon po dang gcig pa 'dra'o/yang brgyud pa gzhan rtsad tsha shāka rdor gyis bshad pa ni/ spangs kyis spa rakṣi ta la bshad/ des ya zi dar ma shes rab/ zer mo dge slong ma bde gnas ma la bshad/ rjes mar pa shes rab 'od pas/ des lha rje can bka' drin nod du 'ongs pas/ der bsnyun drag po cig byung ba shangs kyi lang za ston pa dar ma bsod nams kyis bcos pas/ de'i lan du rdo rje me long dang / lam rnam bkod dang / zab mo dbang gi man ngag rnams dang / mdo'i 'gri pa lung bstan rdo rje dang / sems phyogs kyi chos skor ma lus pa rnams gnang / des sgro sbug pa la gnang / des shākya rdo rje la gnang ngo / yang yi gi gzhan na/ 4bra ma la nyid kyis thal ba la sogs pa'i sgyu 'phrul gyi bshad rgyud rnams ji / spre mo la gnang / des mar pa shes rab 'od la gnang /des langs ston la gnang zer ba 'dug ste/ de lta na jo mo zer mo dang smre mo gnyis don gcig pa 'dra'o/ 'di dag rmongs pa chos la log par rtog pa dag gi sdig pa chen po bsal ba'i slad du/ bla ma brgyud pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyogs tsam brjod pa ste/ bdag nyid kyis ni/ gsang bdag mda' tsha hor po nas 'gro mgon dam pa shākya rgyal/ mkhas pa lce ston yab sras/ bla ma thang ston 'bum me/ chos rje bla skyabs rdo rje/216

drin can mkhas pa chen po/ mkha' 'gro dpalagyi ye shes/ ma gcig drin can zur mo/ chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen pa'i bar du brgyud de/rig pa'i rtsal dbang bco brgyad dang / kun byed rgyalapo'i rgyud kyi lung tsam zhig las sems phyogs dag ma thos te/ 'on kyang gus pa chen po dang ni ldan no/ sems phyogs kyi skabs so/ /rdo rje zam pa'i lo rgyus kyi skabs rdzogs pa chen po klong gi sde'i skor la/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud chen po'i don klong dgu dang tshig bam po nyi khri zhes 'byung ba la/ bam po nyi khri ni grub pa'i skyes bu rnams kyi phyag na bzhugs pa'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ 'dir gzhung tshang bar 'gyur ba ni med do/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud chung ba'i don yang klong dgu ste/ dang po lta ba'i klong /gnyis pa spyod pa'i klong / gsum pa dkyil 'khor gyi klong / bzhi pa dbang gi klong / lnga pa dam tshig gi klong / drug pa sgrab pa'i klong /bdu pa phrin las kyi klong / brgyad pa sa lam gyi klong /sto dgu pa 'bras bu'i klong ste/ de dag kyang le'u bcu gcig pa nas bcu dgu pa'i bar le'u re res ston pa yin no/ gzhan yang ye shes gsang ba la sogs pa'i rgyud la brten pa'i rdo rje zam pa'i man ngag rnams bee ro tsa nas spangs mi pham 217

mgon po zhes bya ba lo brgyad bcu rtsa lnga lon pa zhig la gnang ste/ rgas ches te lus kyis zungs ma thub pas sgom thag sgom rten dang bcas te lus gnad 'char bcug gdams pa yid la zin pa'i phyir tshul shing gtad/sngar gzhon pa'i dus chos ma grub cing / rgas te 'khor dang gnyen 'dun yang sdang bar gyur pa zhig la/ slob dpon gyi gsung bzhin nyams su blangs pas skye ba med pa'i don rtogs/ dga' ches te slob dpon gyi mgul nas 'khyud nas zhag gcig gi bar du ma btang / nyams su blangs pas lo yang brgya lhag pa thub zer/ de'i slob ma ngan lam byang chub rgyal mtshan yin/skyal dbu ru ngan lam ral gsum pa yin/ dge slong lo dug cu rtsa bdun lon pa zhig gis/ rgya mo stag rtse mkhar du byon nas spangs mi pham mgon po la gdams pa zhus/ spangs gyi zhal nas yul du ma 'gro bar wa seng ge brag la song la sgoms gsungs nas/ der byon no/ de'i slob ma za ngam rin chen dbyig ces pa mdo khams stod pa zhig gis ngan lam la gdams pa zhus/ wa seng ge brag tu bla ma'i rtsa nyid du bzhugs so/ de'i slob ma yar klungs 'chos kyi khu 'gyur gsal ba'i mchog yin te/ dge slong lo lnga bcu rtsa bdun lon pa zhig gis za ngam 'a/ gdams pa rnams zhus nas/wa seng gi brag tu bzhugs nas yar ma byon no/ ngan lam byang chub rgyal mtshan brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gnyis lon nas lhag med du gshegs/ za ngam rin chen dbyig brgya bzhi bcu zhe bzhi lon nas lhag med du gshegs/218

khu 'gyur gsal ba mchog lo brgya dang bcu bdun lon nas lhag med du /gshegs te/ de gsum ka wa seng ge brag la sbrul lo la gcig rting la gcig gshegs te/ sku na bun yal ba'am 'ja' yal ba bzhin du gshegs so/ de'i slob ma myang byang chub grags ni/ yul myang g.yu 'brug stod pa dge slong lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lon pa zhig gis/ khu 'gyur gsal ba'i mchog la gdams pa rnams zhus nas yar byon te/ bsam yas 'chims phu na bzhugs tsa na/ dbu ru lha'i myang shes rab 'byung gnas dge slong bgres po zhig bzhugs 'dug nas/ khong na re/ bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo nga rgan kyang gdams pa khyed che bar 'dug pas/ slob dpon zhu gsung nas/gdams pa rnams myang shes rab 'byung gnas la gnang ngo / myang byang chub grags ni/ gtsang rgya ma nye'u kha'i phung po ri bo che la da lta 'dug pa'i 'phro la/ ri zur na yar la sku sprin chad pa bzhin du lhag med du gshegs/mje shes rab 'byung gnas kyis 'chims phu/ sgrags kyi yang rdzong /phug po che rnams su bzhugs/ mjug tu phug po che na phug chung zur ra ri bya ba yod pas der bzhugs yod tsa na/ phug po che lha ri'i rtse mo la shug pa rkang gcig la na bza' dang phreng ba dang kā pa li rnams gzar nas/ phung po lhag med du gshegs/ de'i slob ma slob dpon sba sgom yin te/ yul lo mo ba/ rus pa sru/ yul na 'khrug pa yod pas yum na re/ bu 'di sring mo drug gi ming gcig po yin/ slob dpon myang 219

shes rab 'byung gnas la 'chol/ ma she bas chog zer nas/ pa ma lo bcu drug lon pa zhig myang la bcol nas yod tsa na/ myang byang chub grags pa phug po che dang / yang rdzong dang / 'chims phu rnams su sha ba zhig khrid nas byon pas/ myang sha ba can zhes kyang bya/ phug po cher snyi ma dag byon tsa na/ ngas khyed gnyis la ltad mo cig bstan cig stos shig gsung / slob dpon shes rab 'byung gnas dang sba sgom gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas bltas pas/ khong dbus na yod pa de mi snang bar song / de rlung tshub khyu gang ba ga tu song ste phar skyil tshur skyil byas te mer song de chu gtor gtong ba'i 'khar gzhong zhig tu tshur ltems kyis song / de yang sa tshub rid ste slob dpon du dkrongs kyis song / 'byung ba'i snyigs ma dwangs nas dwangs ma ma yal —ba'i bar du de ltar 'ong ba yin/ shes rab kyis sgom rgyu med pa'i don mthong yang / brda la yengs pa med par bskyangs na de ltar rang dbang thob pa la tshegs med/ ma yengs par skyong ba gal che ba yin gsung / de nas dus nam zhig sba sgom gyis bal bu'i nags la shing 'thur phyin pas/ khong rang gi ljags spyil mer dmar ring de mthong / slob dpon ni me mi 'bud ci tsug yin snyam na ltar phyin pas/ ci yang ma byas par 'dug nas/ slob dpon la de ci tsug yin dris pas/ ngas mer bsgoms pa yin/ myang byang chub grags pa'i de ma dran nam gsung / yang nam zhig slob dpon gyi bzhugs sa na chur ltam me 320

'dug pa yang mthong / slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ da mi 'dug na lha ri'i rtse mo la stos shig gsung nas/ ri la skyo bsang la bzhud nas sang dgung 'byon du re yang ma byon nas/ ltar snyin tsa na/ slob dpon phung po lhag med du gshegs/ na bza' dang dbu zhwa dang bo lha mi'i phreng ba lasogs pa shug pa la gzar 'dug skad/ spa sgom ye shes byang chub kyisadagung 'o nyi shu rtsa bzhi lon tsa na myang gis gangams ngag rngams gnang /sba sgom phug chung zur ra na nye gnas btsun chung zhig gis byed kyi yod tsa na 'dzeng gis mjal pa yin/ spyir sba sgom ye shes byang chub rten dge bsnyen du bzhugs pa de/ dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa brgyad lon pa'i tshe bsnyung ba med par gcegs pa 'i tshe jo mo gad mos phyi rol gyi mi rnams mjal du ma bcug par mchod khang du spur me la bsregs pas/ 'od rdza ma tsam zhig nam mkha' la song ba snyi rol gyi mi rnams kyis kyang mthong ba byung / shul du gdung ngus kyang ma byung ngo / 'dzing de ni/ yab bkra shis g.yung drung zhes bya ba tshe smad la rab tu byung nas tshul khrims rgyal mtshan du btags/ lo drug cu rtsa bdun la phur bu bar nan gyi lugs la grub pa thob nas rdo rje gzhon nu'i zhal gzigs lo brgyad cu rtsa lnga la gshegs/ gdung sbyangasapas rdo rje garnon nu'i sku dang ring bsrel mang du byon/ yum ni 'tshar dgu ga 'a skyid de zhes bya ba yar klungs thang chung pa'i btsun ma yin pa/thang chung bcad po'i bu che bas phab nas 'dzeng 'khrungs/ 'dzing byon dus — 221

bang chung btsad po byung zer ba yang yod/ lo brgyad kyi bar da 'tshar dgu klungs su zhang po'i sar bzhugs/ de nas gong po dben tshar bzhugs/de nas skyi khung du lo lnga bzhugs/ lo bcu drug lon tsa na/ zhang po gshen tsha dar ma 'od kyi slob dpon gtsang pa ral gcig ma'i bayon po rdo rje snying po dang / jo sho re dang / gnyags dge ba 'bar rnams kyis dol gyi gdong sna ru tshong la phyin tsa na/ dol gyi 'tshar 'chur na mi mang po 'phungs 'dug der blta na pas dam pa rgya gar dang mjal/ zla b.ril po bcu bzhi dam pa'i phyag phyir 'brengs/ gtsang gi gnas gzhi zangs can du sleb tsa na/ dam pas snam bu ga gnang nas khong ngang thung 'dug pas khyod rang yul du log dwags po nas kham bu khyer la shog/dol du 'gro ba'i zla bo 'dug go gsung / de nas 'dzeng gis byon tsa na/dam pa rgya gar phyin tshur brengs kyis byon nas/ 'dzing gi mdan pa gnyis nas phyag gis 'jus te/ ci yang ma yin gnas gyur pa/ gnas gyur pa la gnyis 'dzin med/ ces gsungs nas mgo thug lan gnyis brgyab pas/sems ci yang ma dran par shes pa sa le ba zhig byung nas/ kha na tshur chu 'dur la byung / der dam pas byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje zam pa dang mjal bar lung bstan par 'dug ste/ da gdod la sa ma go gsung / dam pas rten 'brel 'ga' zung dang sngags kyi gnad mang du gnang / rgyang ro 'tshal mar yi ge drug pa'i gdams ngag gnang nas bsgrubs pas byin rlabs 222

thun mong ma yin pa byung / chu bo chen po 'di'i shar phyogs na tsan dan gyi nags yod/ de na khyod kyi bla ma yod gsung nas lung bstan/ de nas dbus su byon nas ma khu ngapal 'bal la zhing phul nas khrug 'thung dang dpe bkar gsang sgrub zhus/ snubs shangs po che la kṛ ya'i sgrub thabs dang kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen zhus/ khong gis gtsang du ba ri la 'bul ba skyel du btang nas/ ba ri la'ang 'jam dpal dang khyung gi sgrub thabs zhus/ dge bshes sbo la snga 'gyur lnga zhus/ de nas ngams skad na mar byon nas lcang rtsigs su byon/ de'i tshe lo sum cu rtsa lnga tsam lon/ de'i tshe phug po che'i la kha na/ dge bshes btsan kha bo che rgya gar nas byon ma thog cig jo mo bas spyan drangs nas/ chos dang ba 'a dang ltad mo rnams yod zer nang par snga ba nas la khar byon tsa na/ bud med cig na re/bab nas lam zur 'di na yar phyin na/ slob dpon spa sgom bya ba byung tshe ma la sto ster ba zhig yod zer nas phyin pas/ rnal 'byor pa tsho gcig gis sleb nas tsha ba drangs/ phye zangs kyi thum bu re re gtong gi 'dug de tsho khyeb pa dang 'o de na gcig kyang 'dug gsung nas chu bum pa gang len bcug chu gtor btang nas khyim du khrid nas sran ma ke ru'i tshod ma phor pa gang drangs/ de nub kyang sto byin nas brag rtsa cig tu nyal/ nang par 'gro dgos sems tsa na/ yang sto byin nas nga la nye gnas btsun chung zhig yod pa zo thung du gser len du song ba char ches pas ma byung / shing zhig 223

sgrogs dang gsung nas/ nags khrod nas shing skam khur che ba zhig khur nas phyin pas mnyes nas phyag rgya chen po brda'i man ngag gnang / rdzogs pa chen po skor bdun rang chas bya ba'ang bshad/ de nas nye gnas de byung nas mdang sang slobadapon 'o brgyal sems tsa na/ bla mas go bcad 'dug pas da dung zhag 'ga' zhig bzhugs par zhu zer nas/ yang yar klungs lan gcig skor nas byung / de nas sba sgom ngo mtshar can du shes nas yul du ma phyin par 'on dang zangs ri yan chad du ston snga ba kun la blangs nas/ skye zhig nyos/ nas sgro gang dang bcas pa slob dpon sba ma la 'bul du sbyin bas/ nga'i g.yog khyed kyis byas pa yin pas nga la 'di 'bul mi dgos/ 'di la khyod rang gi rgyags gyis/ nga la gdams ngag rdo rje zam pa zhes bya ba skad cig ma'i don rtogs nas tshe gcig gis sangs rgya ba/ phung bo lhag med kyi brgyud pa breng ma chad pa zhig yod/ de gong phan chad su'ang ma smras par gsangs pa min/ da khyod la sbyin no gsung bas/ 'di slob dpon rang la bsngos pa yin gdams ngag thugs la gdags par zhu/ rgyags rnyed 'ong zhig zhus pas/ phag g.yon pas spyi bo la gzung g.yas pas ltag khung nas tab tab byas nas/ 'or che dam tshig can du 'dug pas/ gdams ngag gis phan thogs 'ong bar 'dug cig gsung / der lo chung gi sngags pa cig la gshin rje dmar po'i sgrub thabs shig byin pas/ sran sres nas khal brgyad byung / lo mo dang 324

'phrun du bsrung skyob zhar re byas pas chos rgyags ldang bar byung / rdo rje ma pa'i byin rlabs ma gtogs pa tsho gnang / de byed pa la 'jen ci yang med pas zhu ba ma byung ba la/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas byin rlabs da lta bya/ phyi nas bar chad 'ong gsung / gangs par du grogs po zhig la spar mo zhig bcol yod pa'i rin slong du phyin pas/ jo mo ba bcom pa'i sham thabs shig byin/ de'i snam bu tsho phral nas btsongs/ chang phud dang gtor ma dang nas bre lnga sha gzugs gcig rnams la brten nas/mar me'i dod nyin bar bya'o gsung nas/ grol lam dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur/ gdams ngag ma lus par gnang / byin rlabs snyi nas kyang lan bzhi tsam gnang / zhabs tog kyang nas dang gser la sogs pa lan lnga tsam bskyal/ de'i rting la slob dpon sba sgom la zhabs tog pa jo mo gang mo bya ba zhig yod/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas/ snang ba 'di kun bden snyam pa mi 'dug gsung nas / chu rdo cig la phyag char gyis rgyab pas gru mo man chad thims kyis song / sku lus phyir zhigs kyis mdzad pas brag la sku lus them gyis song nas rjes wal le byung / phug chung rong nas ting nge 'dzin gyis shug pa'i gdung mang po drangs nas/ jo mo'i mchod khang phub pa'i shing rnams yin gsung / sba sgom la jo bo rje'i pha rol du phyin pa'i lam rkyang khug ra ma rpā la'i gdams pa zhus/ 'u lug tu dge bshes hab kyis zhu ba byas nas/ yu mo la dus 'khor gyi sbyor drug zhus/225

de nas dbu rur byon nas/ kham pa lung pa la than brgyad ma/ sne'u zur pa'i slob ma zhig la dmigs pa skor gsum dang / tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs dang / nad sel gyi gdams pa rnams zhus/ yang phug po cher byon pas sba sgom gyis bdud rtsi'i bcud len dang / rdo rje zam pa'i sgrub sde rnams gnang / spyan snga rnal 'byor pa'i grwa sa ru spyod pa byas bas shin tu mnyes/ shong bu lo tsā ba la 'grel chung nyan/ dge bshes dgrol sgom la nā ro pa'i thabs lam zhus/ rdo rje zam pa phar la bshad/lha rje snyi sgom la chos drug dang skyes sbyor zhus/ rtogs pa bsdur bas shin tu mnyes/ so bsnyun gdangs pa sgron sprul dang rgyab sha zhus/ rdza bor ba la bdud rtsi gas gsum/ ri khrod rlung chung la rna brgyud tshig gsum/bla ma rlung dam pa chen po la do ha'i gdams ngag labs sgron la gcod yul/ rgyal ba sbo ston la lhun grub sde skor bdan pa/ snubs shangs po che la ba ri lo tsā ba'i kro ya'i chos lnga gsum bco lnga pa zhus/ la stod du byang chub sems dpa' kun dga' la gdams pa kha yar dang / a ba rā dzi ta'i sgrub thabs zhus/ grogs mched a tsar stag sham can dang /bla ma dbu ltebs dang / bla ma thud kha 'bar/ bla ma drod 'byor/zhang 'bro ston la sogs pa de tsa na'i rnal 'byor pa bzang po sha stag dang 'grogs/ gtsang du gcer bu lo lnga byas/ 'khyag pa'i nang du mchong ba dang / chur mchong ba dang / g.yang la mchong ba dang / mgo brdog 226

pa dang / mtshon rdeg pa la sogs pa ci yang byas te spyod pa'i tshan che shos yin/ dpa' bo 'dzeng chung ba zer ba yin/ so mang btsan la phyag rgya chen po btab pas/ 'khrul snang dag nas ye shes kyi snang ba 'ba' zhig tu shar/ dngul mo rgya le lcam la yi ge bzhi pa dang rdzogs chen gyi gdams pa btab pas zhig mo mi las 'das pa zhig byung / ri khrod klung chung ba/dngul mo rgya le lcam/ mon khru zer mo'i mtsho la song ba'i ma jo/ kong po mtsho rdzong la song ba'i khams pa rnams la gdams pa btab pas phung po lhag med du song / ras pa sgom stag zho ras/ rgya ras/ rlung ras la sogs la gdams pa btab pas drod 'bar ba yang byung / bstan pa tsam gyis rdogs grol la song ba yang byung / nga'i gam du lo tsā ba yang bzhi tsam byung / rab byung dang ston chen dang sgom pa sgom ma yus po che rang mthong can mang zhig byung / tshul bzhin nyams su len pa ma cang che mal dwags por nyams len man re byed pa'i nyi ma bcu gcig tsam la dang por 'chi du thebs pa/ 'chi khar gnad gcod med pa/ ro la 'ja' zug pha byung ba yin/ nga'i gdams pa 'di la bal las byed pa'am/ pha ma sri'u gso ba 'dra ba'i nyams len lo lnga drug cig byas na/ phung po lhag med du song nas shul du mi'i lus po mi 'ong nges gsung / res sku lus 'ja' ru 'khyil ba/ res zhabs sbal mi rig par gshegs pa/ res thag ring po yud tsam res 'khor ba dang / dbu rur dar re dang sbyar sgom 227

dang dpal lcam chos 'bar dang ril pa la sogs pa 'chi ba shes pa dang /gzhan gyi sems shes pa la sogs pa mngon par shes pa yang mnga' jo sras ma rdo rje skyid kyi bu nam phyed na gnyid yur nas rgya mthongs na mar spab tu 'chor la khad pa gzigs pa dang / cod pan rgyu ba'i khab nub mo spur ma'i khrod du brul ba gzigs pa dang / nyin mtshan med par gsal ba yang yod/snyi res gtsang du lo bdun bzhugs nas mar la byon nas phug po cher byon pas/ slob dpon sba sgom gyis rna brgyud tshig gsum gnang nas/ nam mkha' 'di khong du chud par gyis/ de rten med du rtogs na sgom med don gyi gzer chen thebs pa yin gsung pas/ nges shes thun mong min pa skyes/de nas dgas po zhu ru ru bzhugs/ zla ma zhal gdams la bsnyen bkur byas nas gu ru bzhi ba nde bskor bdun pa thun sgrub kyi gdams pa rnams rgyas/zhu ru'i lha zur dgon par bde bzhi lo gsum bskyangs pas chos thams cad la byan tshud/ dgongs pa nam mkha' bzhin du 'dres/ don thams cad spros bral rnam dag la song / gyur cig dang zhog cig la stos ma dgos/rig pa dwangs pas lha ru ku'i zhal mthong / ched du ma bsgrabs par mngon shes shar/ bla ma rnams bsten nas dka' thub mdzad pa'i zlo rgyus ni/ rdo rje zam pa zhus nas phug po cher bdud rtsi'i dka' thub mdzad pas rims kyis mi 'jigs pa byung / snubs shangs po che'i drung du bla ma'i g.yog gi dka' thub mdzad pas gang phyin du bla ma zugs la 'dogs/ dam pa rgya 238

ti sgror byon pas shel phug tu khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba zhal mthong / mi ma yin zhig gis bsnyen bkur cher byas/ btsun gzugs zhig nam mkha' la 'phur nas phar 'gro tshur 'gro byed pa btsal bas ma rnyed/ mi yin min ma shes gsung / dwags po zhu rur a dzi bsgrubs pas nyi ma dro bar khar zhal gzigs/ dam bsres snyam tsa na jo mo phyal le byon pas/ bud med can zer nas nam mkha' la 'od chen po zhig tu byas nas song / lha zur du bcud len gyi sgrub pa byas pas tshe dpag med zhal mthong / chos sang po'i rnam dag rgyud la shar/ de nas jo mo phyal le dang bral nas chos skyid dang 'grogs te 'dzin du byon no/ /de yan du gdams pa mang du ma 'phel/ byin pa yang 'ga' zung las med/ mthu 'ga' re bslabs/grong chog mdzad cing gsang spyod mdzad/ de nas thag ring nas zhu ba yang mang du byung zhing mang du 'phel/ ngo bo mkhar ngos su sbal bu dor las sbyan drangs nas gdams ngag gsungs pas/ nyi ma snga dro dang po la 'ja'i gdugs dang re'u mig dang ka ba lta bu mang po byung ba thams cad kyis mthong bas phyogs su phyag btsal/ chos thon nas ri logs la skyo sangs la byon/ 'ja' de bla ma 'drongs pa min nam/ mi dga' la che byas pas/ slob dpon sba sgom la 'bar ston shes rab grags spun gnyis kyis gdams pa 'di zhus pa'i dus su/ ngams shod lung pa dang phug po che'i rirogs khengs pa tsam byung / gdams pa 'di la 'ong ba yin gsung /230

'dzin na bzhugs pa'i dus su jo sras 'dzing gis bla ma'i sar byon pas/nub phyogs kyi mchod rten rtsa'i gad kha cig na ba sngags 'dug de nas dben khang du phyin tsa na bla ma ni ma mthong / 'od gtsang phub tsam zhig 'dugade nas rtsar phyin tsa na 'od de mi 'dug pa / de tsug lags rgyas pas/mnyam par bzhag tsa na 'ong gi 'dug mi la ma smra gsung / ma jo dngos grub la mdze byung bas/ ngas ba sa sgrogs byas pas mdze ni ma sos/ngas phyag na rdo rje zhal mthong rgod bro gsung / dgung lo brgya dang gnyis lon pa'i dus su bla ma bsnyung bas/ 'khor kun gyis bla ma grongs kyis dogs tsa na/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ mdang rmi lam bzang nga mi 'chi rgya'i bo ra'i steng na nga 'dug pa la nyi zla gnyis shar byung / rus pa'i snyil po mang po'i steng na bud med mang po 'dug khong na re/ bla ma 'dzeng khyod yo bzhi na shog zer ba zhig rmis gsung / 'dzeng gi zhal nas/ ngas chu mang po lon rī ra te nga rang la yang tig pa kha na bshad rgyu med/ skyi khung gi dge bshes hab rngo sras 'jam dpal na re/ 'dzeng sgom de da dung dwags po na 'dug zer/ nga dang gnyi gzhon tsa na grogs po min/ lo bco lnga kho nas khong rgan pa yin/ da ngas kyang dgu bcu go bdun song 'dug zer/ khong de nas lo gcig na zongs/ 'dzeng gis der rjes su yang lo gsum tsam bzhugs te dgung lo brgya dang bcu bdun lon no/ /'khor rnams kyis dge rtsa zhig mdzad par rgyas pas/ 'dus byas kyi dge 231

rtsa mdzad ma nyan/ bcud len zhig mdzad par zhus pas kyang bcud len byas na lo bcu bcu tsam bsring bar 'dug ste/ dus ngan la tshe ring ba la dgos pa mi 'dug gsung nas sku gshegs/ spur sbyangs pas nam mkha' 'jas gang / mchod rten dang ring bsrel mang du byon no/ /'dzeng dharma bo tta 'brug la 'khrungs zer ba go ri bas mdzad pa'i rnam thar du bshad/rnam thar gzhan na 'dzeng gis so lnga lon pa'i tshe/ btsan kha bo che rgya gar nag byon ma thog cig dang mjal zer ba'i tshig 'di gnyis gung bstun pa na/'brug de chu pho 'brug bo rje shing pho rta la gshegs pa'i nye logs de'o/ /'dzeng gis lo bzhi lon pa shing lug la rma sgom chos kyi shes rab 'khyungs/ lo lnga lon pa me spre la rwa sgrong btab/ de nas lo dgu pa shing 'brug la 'brom gshegs/ khong brgya dang bcu bdun la gshegs pa'i lo de sa pho byi ba min/ de'i phyi lo sa mo glang la phya pa gshegs/ de lo g.ya' bzang chos rje 'khrungs/ de'i phyi lo lcags stag la 'gro mgon gshegs/ 'dzeng gis bcu gcig lon pa'i chu stag la so chung pa 'khrungs/khong gis ba ri la 'bul ba bskyal zer bas/ ba ri dang rje btsun mi la'i bcu gsum pa la khong 'khrungs par snang ngo/ /yu mo'i slob ma gnyos skyi khung pa hab jo sras 'jam dpal na re/ khong rang las 'dzeng lo bco lngas gin pa yin zer/ de ltar na me mkha' rgya mtsho'i 'das lo bzhi bcu bsre ba'i zhe gcig pa me mo lug la gnyos 'khrungs par 'ong / des lo go 232

brgyad thub zer/ de'i slob ma ngor rje/ de'i slob ma dol pa rab tu dga' ba'i rdo rje'o/ /snyan brgyud rdo rje zam pa'i gdams pa 'di 'dzeng dharma bo lha'i ring nas dar rgyas chen po byung ba yin no/ khong nas mchen pa'i dngos kyi slob ma brgyud 'dzin yang / slob dpon kun bzangs dang /'dzeng jo sras dang btsan thang pa byung dharma sidha dang / slob dpon gser lung pa dang / bla ma du rdo rje rgyan dang / gzig ye shes dbang po dang / g.yag ston zla ba 'od zer la sogs pa mang du byon no/ /de'i slob ma 'dzeng jo sras ni/ sngags pa'i rigs brgyud du song bas chung ngu nas yig rtsis bslabs/ 'ol kha'i slob dpon lha ris pa la sgyu 'phrul la sogs rnying ma'i skor rnams dang / dgyes rdor dang mtshan brjod zhus/slob dpon lha ris pa 'da' khar ngas gzhung chen po 'di tsam zhig shes kyang 'chi khar phan pa ma ro thun bdun las ma byung / khyod rang kyang gzhung ma ba ba par gdams ngag la nan tan gyis/ dgas po na khyed rang gi bla ma 'dzeng bya ba zhig yod par 'dug pas der song gsung / gang par du rdzogs chen lhun grub mkhan slob dpon zem gyi sar dbyar dgun thog drug bsdad pas thugs la 'dogs po ma byung / gdams ngag gi spros pa ma chod pas 'dzeng la dpal lung du rdo rje zam pa tshar gsum zhus/ sgom tshul bla ma'i byin rlabs kyang mdzad nas/ khyod rang gtsang na yar song la gzhungaslobs/ gtsang nas log tsa na a mis dgon pa cig bsngogs cig gsung /233

gdams pa mi gnang bar dgongs nas/ sus shes dris pas/ spu phyi'i sbyil jo zas zhang la skyabs bya bas shes gsung / khong dang mjal nas zhu bar byas pas khong drongs/ yang dgas por phyin nas 'dzeng la zhus pas ma gnang bas/ btsan thang gi myang / 'ol kha'i dwags chung ba/ ngu gcer bu rnams ༄ sems nas/ sho skyam du slob dpon ngu la zhus pas gnang /ngu'i zhal nas/ 'dis mi 'ong da dung dwags por song la rgyas gsung nas/dwags por byon nas zhus pas/ khyod cis kyang 'dod na nga'i gdams pa la nan tan byed dgos pa yin gsung nas/ gdams pa rnams ma lus par gnang / dbyar dgun thog 'ga' slob dpon gyi drung du bsdad/ lo drug tsam song nas bran rnams kyang ma lus par gnang / gzhan la byin rlabs mdzad pa'i las kyi slob dpon yang mdzad/ thod pa'i slob ma rog tra dga' dang ma jo sgro ba la sogs mi lnga bcu tsam gyis rdo rje zam pa zhus pas/ 'dzeng gi zhal nas/ jo sras kyis shod cig khyed tshos ston cig gsung nas/ slob dpon gyi khri kha nas gsungs/ 'dzing dang 'dzeng jo sras gnyis lo ngo bco brgyad tsam du 'grogs nas gdams pa rnams zhus te/ gdams ngag gi bka' phog nas brgyud 'dzin du bskos pa yin no/ /'dzeng dharma bo ddhi dang 'dzeng chung smyon pa gnyi ga'i slob ma slob dpon kun bzangs yin te/ de'i lo rgyus ni/ khu bo pha jo dbus pa rje khams pa rdor rgyal gyi slob ma sgom chen pa bzang por bzhugs/ ma zi gza' des 234

chog bya ba ma jo smyon ma bsam grub bya ba la chos zhus pa zhig yin/ pha jo dgas pa dang yum gnyis ka la la gyi mtshan lta bzang po dang bca te lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ lo brgyad dgu lon pa ska slob dpon kor ston rā dza dang mjal nas slob gnyer da re bya / lo bco lnga lon tsa na khong drongs nas slob dpon ngu'i gan du lo lnga tsam zhi byed cu zhing ba da nas zhabs tog grub tshad bya / gser lung dgon par slob dpon ngu'i thad du 'dzeng jo sras dang mjal nas/ 'dzeng gi gsang sgrub dang phag mo mngon 'byung zhus/ rdo rje zam pa lhag ma lus par dbu bsnung bzhes pa'i nub mo/ dpon slob gnyi ga la rmi lam ba nga bo rmis/ 'dzeng chung bas khrid nas 'dzeng dha mi bo rnyi dang mjal ba'i tshe/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar ba'i dkyil du ra ma gnyi sgom pa zhig rmis/ de jo zas dang khong rang gnyis la bar 'dug gsung / 'dzeng chen po la der rdo rje zam pa tshar gcig rgya pa de rdo rje zam pa thos pa'i snga shos yin/ de nas 'dzeng spo zas thung rings su spyan drangs na rdo ri zam 4tshar bdun rgyas/ de nas dwags por dgun thog bzhi gyin/ rdo rje ma pa tshar phyed pa cig dang bcu bzhi thos/ 'dzeng jo sras dang lo brgyad tsam ma bral bar 'grogs na rdo rje zam pa tshar bdun zhus/ phyi nas rko ru tshar gnyis/ gser lung du tshar gcig dang / gzhan gsung 'phro la mjal ba dang dril bas/ 'dzeng mes dpon gnyis la rdo rje zam pa tshar sum cu rtsa lnga gsan/ 'dzeng sa 235

dpon gnyis kyi gdams pa'i bka' babs nas gzhung bshad che chung gnyis mdzad/ de'i sras sprul sku 'od 'bar seng ge ni/ blo rno ba/ thugs rab che ba/ dgung lo bcu bzhi la rdo rje zam pa gsungs/ des brgyud 'dzin mgon la gnang / des bya med tshul rin la gnang ngo/ yang yar klungs btsan thang pa myang dharma sidhas 'dzeng dha rma bo lha la rdo rje zam pa tshang bar zhus/ rtogs pa skyes/ byin rlabs zhugs/ dur khrod dgon par bzhugs te 'gro don mdzad/ 'di nas brgyud pa'i gzhung bshad kyang yod/dgung lo don bdun la gshegs/ de'i slob ma badzra pā ṇi/ de'i slob ma bla ma lha'o/ /mang 'dzeng gis gser lung pa la bshad/ des slob dpon rang grol la bshad/ des sras po chos rin la bshang do/ /yang la nga gis ngu rdo rje rgyan la bshad/ des ngu ston dad pe brtson 'grus la bshad/ de'i slob ma zhig gis byas pa'i gzhung bshad kyang yod do/ yang 'dzing gis gzig ye shes dbang po la bshad/ des mkhan po la kha ba la bshad/ des slob dpon mgo skya ba la bshad/ des slob dpon go ri ba la bshad/ des so ston la bshad de/ so ston 'dis byas pa'i gzhung bshad kyang 'dug go /yang 'dzeng la spung rings pa g.yag ston zla ba 'od zer lo bcu drug lon pa zhig gis zhus/ des klog ston dge 'dun skyabs la bshad/ 'di nas brgyud pa'i gzhung bshad kyang 'dug yang g.yag ston gyis lo dgu bcu rtsa bdun thub/ de la 'on nag po stod pa klad ru 236

ban de dgos pa btsan lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad lon pa zhig gis zhus so/ /'dzeng dha rma bo jus skye tshe ye shes dbang phyug la bshad/ des gzig me shes dbang po la/ des mkhan chen dur ba chen po bsod nams 'od la/des du ston badzre sha ra la/ des mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mtshan la/des mkhan chen shes rab rgyal mtshan la/ des mkhan gzhon nu shes rab la/ des mtshungs med gzhon nu grags pa la/ des mkhan chen sangs rgyas bzang po la/ des bla ma brtson 'grus dbang phyug la/ des mtha' bzhi grags pa rin chen la/ des slob dpon shākya rgyal po ba la gsungs so/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sku na gzhon nu'i dus nas khrub la khar rab tu byung zhing / lo lon pa'i tshe bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ mngon pa mdzod dang 'dul ba legs par bslabs nas skyor mo lung la sogs su grwa skor yang mdzad/ thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs pa la/ dgung lo brgyad bcu rtsa gnyis pa shing mo bya'i ston ljang gi bkra shis dgon par spyan drangs nas/ dbang dang byin rlabs rgyas pa dang / 'ol jo sras kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig gi steng nas rdo rje zam pa'i khrid/ slob dpon kun bzang gis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad che ba la sogs pa'i chos phran drug cu rtsa brgyad zhus/ thugs dam rgyun chags yin pas sman bla'i rjes gnang yang zhus shing gnang / rdzogs chen gsang skor gyi khrid lung lha lung pa bla ma lha la gsan pa yang dpe dang bcas pa gnang / yo re bzhin 'bul ba mi 337

mtsher tsam re phul bas shin tu dgyes/ bdag gis zhus pa'i rjes su yang cu mi mang po byung ba la/ spyan mi gsal yang gzhan gyis baglags pa'i rjes su brjod de tshar mang du gnang ba mdzad/ dgung lo dgu bcu rtsa gcig pa shing pho rta'i lo'i dpyid gar zhi bar gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pas dang ring bsrel gyis gang ba'i thugs kyang byon nas ring bsrel zad med du 'byon pa 'di yin no/ /rdo rje zam pa'i lo rgyus kyi skabs so/ /— man ngag gi sde'i lo rgyus kyi skabs/shin tu zab pa rdzogs pa chen po snying ga gi lo rgyus ni/ shrī sidha yan chad sems phyogs dang ma na zhing / shrī sidhas mkhas pa ye shes mdo la bshad/ des slob dpon mi ma la mi tra la bshad/ bai ma la mi rtu ni sangs rgyas gsang ba'i yang dngos kyi slob ma ste/ sgyu 'phrul gyi skor rnams ni sangs rgyas gsang ba las bai ma la dang / des mi rin chen mchog la'o/ /de la slob dpon bai ma la mi du yang / chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan nas mnga' bdag ral pa can gyi bar du/ bai ma la mi tra snga snyi gnyis byung ba sngon gyi yi ge dag la snang ste/ snga ma ni chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan gyi dus su byung ba/ rab tu byung ba'i cha byad du med par rnal 'byor pa'i cha byad dwa yod pas/ rgyal blon rnams phyi pa dang nang pha gang yin the 33

tshom zhing rnam snang gi lder tsho la phyag byas gus pas kyang the tshom thos pa'i gtam snang zhing / the tshom bzlog pa'i gyir skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa mdzad pa las/ rgyal blon yid ches ma gyur pas/ skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa byas/ /zhes kyang 'byung ngo/ /'dis shes rab snying po'i rgya cher 'grel pa dang / rim gyis 'jug pa'i sgom don dang / cig char 'jug pa'i sgom don gnyis kyang mdzad de/ de dag gi tshul la bltas na slob dpon ka ma la shrī la'i rjes tsam la byon pa 'dra'o/ /bai ma la mi tra snyi ma ni so sor thar pa'i rgya cher 'grel pa bam po lnga bcu pa mdzad pa bo : rten yang dge slong du 'thad do/ /bai ma la snga mas snying thig gi gdams pa 'di rgyal bo dang myang ting 'dzin ba nga po gnyis la gsungs nas/ de nas zi ma la rgya'i yul du byon/ myang ting 'dzin bzang po 'di/ rgyal po sku sdo ba'i du dku btsa' 'i bu ji yin/ phyis rab tu rgyung la rgyal blon rnam bgros na / rkyen ris ba nga po byin pa'i yi gi chu dar la bris pa zhig kyang mthong ngo/ khong gi nga ga la nyams len mdzad pas/ lo lnga bcu rtsa lnga na rang rgyud dag ste phung bo zag med du gyur/ rdo rje leg bas khams su ser ba phab nas rnga mo'i khal brgya bkal nas byung ba 'tsheb blangs nas/ nas mang du byung ba'i rgyus dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang bzheng /der snying ga gi gdams pa gter du sbas/ tshigabargyud rnams 'asbom rin chen 'bar la bshad/ de sa sba blo gro dbang phyug la bshad pas na/23

chig brgyud ni gang zag brgyud pa la yang yod do/ /phyi ma'i dus shig na myang mi dar ma dang dus mtshungs pa'i gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal zhes bya bas gter rnams phyung / rang gis nyams su blangs/ gzhan sdod ldan btsal bas/ myang stod nas snye btsun seng ge dbang phyug bya ba rnyed de/de la gdams pa rim pa bdun btab/ de dang dus nye bar kha rag sgom chung la yang btab pas khong yang des grol zer/ phyi zhig na lce btsun gyis ldang ma la nor shin tu mang po 'bul du 'ongs pa/ mal gro'i myang bka' gdams pa dang snye thang du phrad nas/ des ldang ma gshegs pa'i gtam rnams bshad pas/ de na gnas gzhi zhig 'dug pa'i dge 'dun rnams la phul/ myang bka' gdams pas snye btsun bla ma la 'bul ba bzang po byed pa las dpags nas/ khyed la gdams pa zab mo yod par 'dug byas te zhus pa / btsun gyis myang bka' gdams pa la gdams pa rnams gnang / des gzho'i ti sgro brag la bsgoms pas phung po lhag med du gyur/yang lce btsun gyis 'u yug yan chad shangs man chod kyi ri rgyud rnams la gnas 'pho zhing bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes te/ de nas yang lo lnga bcu bzhugs/ de nas zag bcas mi snang bar 'od du gyur/ khong gis gdams pa rnams 'u yug dang yang gro'i 'chad pa ltag dang / jal gyi phu ste gter kha gsum du sbas/ gter sbas nas lo sum cu na rong snar mda'i sgom nag pos gter 'ga' zhig bston/ rang gis nyams su blangs shing ཿ40

gzhan mang po la bshad do/ yang lang grong 'chad pa ltag nas shangs pa ras pa zhes bya bas gter phyung zhing des kyang gzhan dag la bshad do/ /yang yar 'brog gi snubs mtsho gling dgu'i bla do thes bya bar me mo glang la 'khrungs pa'i zhang bkra shis rdo rje zhes bya myang stod na yod pa'i tshe/ rdo rje legs pa mi dkar po zhwa dkar po gyon pa zhig tu byas te/ des myang stod nas khrid lam rnams su gnas mal dang bza' btung gi grogs kyang byas/'u yug mda' na 'khrug pa yod pa yang rdo rje legs pas bsgribs pas/dmag gis ma mthong bar 'u yug nub ma'i ri'i brag mthon po zhig gi steng du bskyal/ der kha byang du lta ba'i phug pa sgo rtswas 'gags pa zhig nas gter rnams bton pa na/ e ka dzā ṭā 'jigs pa'i gzugs ston zhing skad chen po 'byin zhing byung ba la/ rdo rje legs pas 'di lung bstan pa de yin byas pas/ e ka dzā tsā na re/ tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad thong /lo gsum du mi la ma bshad zer nas song / de rjes tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad kyang btang / gter 'don pa'i tshe zhang ston gyi lo nyi shu rtsa gcig pa me mo bya yin zer/ gzhan yang jal gyi phur rtse btsun gyis sbas pa'i chos gter dang / 'chims phu'i brag la bai ma la nyid kyis sbas pa'i chos gter yang thon te/ mi rnams la rgya cher bshad/ zhang ston gyis gter bton pa na/ lce sgom nag pos gter bton nas lo lnga bcu song zer/spyir sku lus zag med du 'gro rgyu/ zas sgrun pas zag med du ma gyur te/241

bdun cu rtsa gcig pa me mo phag la gshegs/ bras nyi 'bum ni/ yab kyi drug cu rtsa gnyis pa sa po rtog gi lo pa min/ nyi 'bum 'dis sbyar bla ma mang po bsten zhing / khyad par sa skya'i ji btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / gzhung gi rngog rdo rje seng ge so sa mang po bsten/ yab dang lo bcu gcig 'grogs pa'i ring la snying zig gi gdams pa bams cad tshar/tshig don chen mo shes bya ba'i bstan bcos kyang mdzad/ bla ma zhang la yang zhabs rtog mang du bgyis/ khong gi lo so dgu pa me pho 'brug gi lo la zas jo 'ber 'thungs/ nyi 'bum nyid rang lo lnga bcu rtsa drug pa chu mo bya ma gshegs/ nyi 'bum kyi yab kyi sne sgom nyid la mjal zhing gdams pa gnang ba dngos kyi slob ma yang na la/ yab zas 'di gnyis sgrongs pa'i tshe spyor sbyangs pa ltas khyad par can mang po dang / ring bsrel yang mang du byon no /rngo 'ber gyis rang lo bco brgyad kyi bang du khu bo dang 'grog shing / gsang ba bla na med pa'i gdams pa ma lus pa gsan/bcu dgu ba shing khyi nas nyi shu'i bar la sa skya paṇa chen la rgyud gsum gdams pa dang bcas pa dang / bde mchog mal gyo'i lugs gsan/chu mig pa la tshad ma bsdus pa/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la khro lu lo tsā ba la grub thob mi tra'i gdams pa/ rnams dang / bal po grags pa 'bum me la phyag rgya chen po kha 'thor gyi gdams pa rnams gsan te/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa drug gi bar la thos bsam gyi spros pa bcad/ gzigs snang rnams phal 242

cher mi gsung / lha sar jo bo la mchod ba phul dus/ 'od kyi zig le'i nang du phyag rdor dang spyan ras gzigs gzig / tho rangs kha cig 'od kyi thig le'i nang du tshe dpag med gzigs/ nged rang la tshe ring brgyud med kyang kho bo legs par byung ba de min pa 'dra gsung zhing /yos kyi lo la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bca te gshegs/ de la 'khrul zhig seng gi rgyab pas thug pa min te/ g.yu ru gra'i phu gad 'phreng gi grong du/ yab bkra shis dngos grub dang sum dpal le gnyis kyi zas su 'khrungs/ bltams pa'i tshe khang pa'i rtse la nyi ma rtse shar la 'ja'i gur bub/lo dgu nas dag snang dang mos gus dpag tu med pa skyes/ bcu la snang ba sgyu mar shar/ bcu gnyis pa la skyo shas drag po skye / bcu gsum pa la nyi zla dus gcig tu shar ba rmis pa sad 'bral du/ zugs rje chen bos snying thig gi don sgoms shig gsung nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas snying rje phyogan med du rgyas bco brgyad ba la snang sems sgyu mar rtogs/ nyi shu pa la mkhan po lde'u sgang pa dang slob dbon bgra shis snang ba gnyis la rab tu byung / nyi shu rtsa lnga pa la zi zhal du nga ge rgyab tu byon nas/ seng ge rgyab pa bar pa la 'tshal pa'i chos skor rnams ga na/ bla ma tsa ri ba la rlung seng ge 'jing bsgol gyi skor rnams zhus/ ra ba dri med 'od/lha ri dpal/ gzhon nu 'bum/ ston char/ byang chub yon tan slob dpon jo sras la sogs pa rnams la byed dang / phyag chen dang /24

gsang sngags gsar rnying gi gdams pa mang du zhus/ khyad par jo 'ber la snying theg gi gdams pa ma lus par zhus nas/ ri khrod lung stong rnams su lo du mar sgrab pa la nan tan mdzad/ skal ldan mang po smin grol gyi lam la bkod rsha/ drug cu rtsa bzhi la gshegs so/ /de'i slob ma me long rdo rje ni/ sgrags phur rnal 'byor pa bsam yas dang yum 'bar ma gnyis kyi sras su chu mo yos la 'khrungs/ lo dgu la grub thob za lung pa dang mkhan chen se lung ba gnyis la rab tu byung / rangs mtshor bsgoms pas nyams 'bar zhing mngon shes cha phra mo shar/ bcu drug la sgrags phu'i zhogs stengs su tshogs brgya tshar byas pas gnas lugs kyi don rtogs/de nas yul phyogs mang bor byon nas bla ma mang du bsten/ sha bug stag sgo dang mkhar chu sa sogs su dka' thub dang dka' spyod mang po mdzad/bco brgyad pa lcags spre la seng gi rgyab tu sangs rgyas dbon po la snying thig rnams zhus/ bsgoms pas nyin zhag drug cu rdo rje sems dpa' nyin mtshan med par mthong / dngos gzhi'i dus bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang rmi lam du mjal nas byin gyis brlabs/ nyi shu rtsa gsum pa la sangs rgyas ras pa la rdo rje phag mo la sogs gter chos mang du zhus pas rdo rje phag mo dang mjal/ 'od phung gi dkyil na bde mchog lhan skyes/ rta mgrin/sgrol ma/ gzugs rje chen po/ kun bzang / rdor sems/ bai ma la/u rgyan/ za lung pa/ sangs rgya ra pa/ 'gro mgon rin po che 244

rnams mthong / dung lung du mkha' 'gro'i sgra thos/ ka ba can du nam mkha' la phag mo dang za lung pa bzhugs pa mthong / lo nyi shu rtsa drug la 'khrul zhig dar ma dang / sprul sku rgya mtsho la sogs bsten nas chos mang du zhus/ mtshur phu'i mdo bo ras pa dang / dgon rtse ba 'khrul zhig dbon po la'ang chos mang du zhus/ mkhan pa ljongs dang / mkhan pa gling / seng ge rdzong / kun bzangs gling / mkhar chu rnams su sgrub pa mdzad cing 'gro don bskyangs/ lo sum cu rtsa bdun la 'das dus yin pa la/ slob dpon kun dga' zer ba'i skal bzangs shig gis gsol ba btab nas/ drug cu rtsa gcig gi bar du bzhugs te chu mo yos la gshegs/chu mo yos ni grub chen u rgyan pa'i bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa/ bu ston kha che'i lo bcu bzhi pa/ ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyi lo gnyis pa/ rig 'dzin ku ra'i sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ 'khrul zhig dharma seng ge'i gya gcig pa/ snye mdo kun dga' don grub kyi lo drug pa yin la/ me long rdo rje'i sum cu rtsa brgyad pa la sangs rgyas ras pa gshegs/ me long pa'i slob ma rig 'dzin ku rmā ra rā dza ni/ me 'ong pas nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa me pho stag la bar gsar rdzing khar jo zas bsod nams dpal dang / khye ga 'a 'bu me gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan thar pa rgyan du btags/ chung ngu nas snying rje dang ldan zhing thugs rab che bas klog yig ma bslabs par mkhyen/lo bdun pa la kong po 'o shod mtho stengs dgon pa'i bla ma dgyes rdor ba la 245

ce rdor dang bde mchog gi dbang rgyas/ lo dgu la mkhan po gtsang pa la dge bsnyen byas/ 'khor bsadong sprugs kyi chos skor rnams zhus/ bcu gnyis pa la phag mo gru'i mkhan po mar pa ba dang slob dpon mnga' ris pa la rab tu byung nas gzhon nu rgyal por btag / 'dul ba bslabs/rin bo che grags ye ba la nā ro chos drug la sogs pa lo lnga'i bar du rgyas 'tshar steng ba la brtag gnyis zhus/ dpon sang she la lha bslabs/ yi gi drug pa bzla pa rmi skam du thugs rje chen po mthong / khyung nag shāka dar la rnying ma'i rgyud lung man ngag mang du zhus/ de nas sgrogs kyi dar cag tu long pa dang mang na / rgya rgya chen po'i khrid zhus pas ngo 'apon/ rtogs pa rgyud rsātsheskye / grub chen pa ston gyi mkha' 'gro gling du 'byon pa'i zur zug na / rdo rje phagatamo'i chos skor la sogs mang du zhus na ba na thomadzad pasapo zi lam du byu rgyan padma dang mjal/ ze ma gsatshanardzithub rtag tu chos gyis zhig gsung / de nas mtshur phur byon namakhabla gnyan ra dang / dar ma mgon po la sar ma ba'i chos skor rnams zhu / de nas las stod kyi myugacar byon/ grub chen u rgyan pa dang rang byung rdo rje rab tu byung ma ga bdun lon pa zhig dang mjal/grub chen pa la gdams gomang du zhu / grub chen pas gnyan ras la snying thig thungaba'i zhar la tshang bang zhus/ rgya na pa bla ma nam mkha' rdo rje la gsang skor gnad kyi ngo sbod dang / skal ldan chos gyi seng ge la gsang ba rtsa 6

gnad kyi me bang lasogs rdzogs chen gsang ba skor mang du zhus/ de na mkhar chur me long rdo rje ba la nga ga gi dbang khrid gnams pa dang bcas pa ma lus par zhu / 'bu rgyu ga na med ba zhabs tog tu dbyar ril po gnyis su lha bris mdzad cing dka' rgyabaral brten pa shig nad byung zhing / thugs dam khyad par can yang 'khyungs/ bla ma mnye nas 'gro don gyes shig pa'i rjes gnang yang thod/ dbang grang du bla 'i dbu'i steng na mgon po phyag ba pha/ gzims khang gi sgo'i thad na e ka dzā:bongs nyis thobashaca pa de'i snyi ngos na la gyi ma mo khrug ral can/ gapas bag brtses nas 'thung gle ma thong / der bla ma lo brgyad du 'du 'bral med par bsten/ smyug tshal zug hūṃ dgun cig ba zhugs pas rdo rje ga mo'i zhalagazig / she rab phyogs zed du rgya / de na yar tsong su ra ltangs gyi ri da btab nagadar migabazhug / de na bla mtsho ra lha nangamakhar chur byon pa skyag su mjal/ de nas tsa ri la na sa ga mo lha dku thosnyingasagingardo sku la 'a tshon sna sta zug pa dang / she ri'i chung ba ba'i ga mtsho zum po ska/ na mkha' gin tu dwang pa la 'ja' tshog lnga gyen drang por zug pa rnamabasamathong /de nabatamatshur phur chos rje rang byung sdo la nga ga gi gdams pa rnams phu'akhanas/ shangs cu byon te sgro dag po'i brgyud bzlob dpon sgom ba 'khagasangaskor dang / ba ma gtan mig sgron me rgyas/ ding ri'i sna 247

dmar du dpon po byang grub la yang dgon pa'i ri chos rnams zhus nas/grub chen pa dang mjal/ mar lam bla ma bkra shis lung pa la gshin rje dgra nag la sogs pa zhus/ slob dpon ye mdon la sogs pa la gsang skor dang / rgod tshang pa'i khrid rnams dang / a ro'i khrid mo che dang don skor la sogs pa'i zhun dar chod par mdzad nas/ thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs chod par mdzad/ tsa ri gsar ma bskos nas/ rnying ma'i 'gram du gcig por zla ba brgyad bzhugs pas cho 'phrul chen po dang /dzam lhas nor bu byin pa dang / gzhi bdag gis khang par spyan drangs nas ba na bkur byasapa dang / mtsho'i dkyil du 'od lnga'i lha ba sel bo tsam cig la cig ma du 'gro ba la sogs ngo mtshar can mang du mthong / dus rtag tu ri khrod dang gangs khrod 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs te sgrub pa snying por mdzad/ kur ma ba rang byung rdo rje la sogs pa mang po la gsang ba bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo mang du bskor/ lam rgya dang nya rgya dang ri rgya la sogs kong po nas ga la sgrog gi bar du ba mas/ snying ga gi gdams pa rdzogs rim gzhan dang ma 'dres par/ chos kyi rang skad grub mtha' rtsal du bton nas gsungs te/ bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa chu mo lug gi lo la gshegs/ de la klong chen pas zhus pa yin te/ de ni g.yu ru gra'i phu stod grong zhes bya bar/ sgrob dpon bstan bsrungs dang 'brom gza' mo bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi zas su sa pho spre'u la 'khrungs/ yo 348

bcu gnyis pa la mkhan po bsam grub rin chen dang slob dpon kun dga' 'od zer las rab tu byung / bla ma mang po la gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud sgrab thabs dbang khrid la sogs pa mang du gsan/ gsang phur btsan dgon༄ pa dang bla brang ba chos dpal rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang du bsten/ byams chos dang tshad ma sde bdun la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan nas mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur te/— lcog la brag khung du zla ba lnga mun khang la bzhugs/ de nas bsam yas su byon nas rig 'dzin pa skyam phu na bzhugs pa'i sar byon pas/ mdang lha'i bya yin zer ba'i ya mtshan can zhig snang ba de khyod la lta bar 'dug nga'i chos 'di'i brgyud pa 'dzin pa zhig 'ong ba 'dra bas gdams pa tshang bar sbyin dgos gsung nas/dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ de'i dpyid de lung stong cig nas cig tu 'pho rgyas lan dgu byas pas/ gzhi re zin dus 'phos pas lus ngag la dka' ba mang du byung / de dus phye bre gsum dang dngul chu ril bu ril ma tsam nyi shu rtsa gcig gis zla ba gnyis kyi 'tsho ba byas/ kha ba bab dus skye zhig yod pa'i nang du zhugs nas gos stan gnyis spu'i go bcad/ chos phyogs su dka' ba mang du spyod nas/ lo gsum gyi dam bca' byas te 'chims phu la sogs pa'i ri khrod la bsgoms shing / skabs skabs su bla ma'i drung du gdams ngag gi zhun ra legs par bcad do/ phag mo dang dbyangs can ma la sogs pa'i sgrub pa mdzad pa / 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang 249

la'ang thogs pa med pa'i thugs rab skyes/ dan bag tu slob dpon gzhon nu don grub la mdo sgyu 'phrul sems phyogs la sogs pa mang du zhus/ gyis gsang ba snying po la snying thig dang mthun pa'i ṭi ka dang yig sna 'ga' zhig dang / rnying thig gi skor la chos tshan sum cu rtsa lnga/ spyi'i ming du bla ma yang tig tsu btags pa mdzad/ de la sogs pa'i rtsom pa mang du mdzad cing / dbur stod du skyi chu'i chu phan tshun gnyis por chos nyan mang du 'tshogs pa la/ ga nga ba bla na med pa'i khrid btab/ sku tshe'i smad la mkha' 'gro snying ga kyang mang du ga zhungs/ ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dpon g.yod gis 'bri khung ba'i bla ma yin zer nas mi mthun par sna ba la/phyis sangs rgyas dpa rin gyis mtsham sbyar mar khur/ 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i ngang nas dgung ma lnga bcu rtsa drug pa chu mo mas la gshegs/'di la yum zi gcig ba'i bras kyang 'ga' ga byung / snying thig ston pa po'i sras brgyud da lta'i bar du ma chad de/ phal cher khyad bar du 'a gas pas mang po'i bla mar gyur pa ste ngo mtshar to/ /yang me long pa la byang sems bsod nams blo gros zhes pa/ rten rab byung du btsugs pa zhig gis snying ga gsan des byung stod kyi ldan yul ri khrod du bzhugs nas/ lo re nga gdul bya mang po la snying ga gi khrid btab/ de la 'jam pa'i dbyangs bas grub rdo rjes gsan nas/de la bdag gi mas gsan te 'gro ba nga po la snying thig gi sgo nas don 250

mdzad/ de la bdag gis snying thig gi dbang dang / me long pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin gyi khrid rim ngo bo tsam zhig thob bo/ /de ltar na 'dir gsang sngags rnying mar grags pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i brgyud pa phyogs tsam zhig bris pa yin la/ bka' brgyad so so dang spyi la sngon gyi bla ma rnams kyis sgrub pa ji ltar mdzad dang / grub pa ji ltar brnyes pa yang mang du byung ste bri bar ma nus so/ /spyir na glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas lo bdun cu lhag cig gi bar du dbus gtsang na rab tu byung ba ni gcig kyang med/ rnying ma ba'i sngags 'chang mang du yod pa rnams kyis yul so sor sgrub pa khyad par can gyis bkra shis par mdzad cing / khyim pa rnams kyis kyang de dag la dad cing zas gos sogs kyis mnyes par byas/ bum dbang tsam re blangs shing / rgyud rim gyis smin pa la brten nas/ klu mes la sogs pa'i dbus gtsang mi drug gam brgyad du grags pa rnams byon pa'i tshe/ yul dang yul rnams su gtsug lag khang dang dge 'dun gyi sde grangs med pa 'phel/ sngon rgyal blon gyi dus su 'gyur ba'i ba /'a bstan bcos rnams la ma nyams par longs spyad pas chog pa byung / mkhas pa dang grub pa'i skyes bu mang du byung ba phal cher yang /rnying ma ba'i grub thob brgyud pa las byung ba yin te/ dpal sa skya pa'i gdung rabs rnams dang / khro phu ba'i gdung rabs rnams dang / rngog gi gdung rabs rnams dang / slob dpon padma'i dngos kyi slob ma byang 251

chub 'dri bkol las rim par brgyud de/ thams cad mkhyen pa rje spyan snga'i dbon brgyud rnams kyis 'gro ba bskyangs pa la sogs pa'o/ /man ngag gi sde'i lo rgyus kyi skabs te/ de dag ni gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi skabs so/ / / /
(nga)sdin po las/ ba'abrang dang bcas

dum bu bzhi pa/ gsang sngags gsar ma/ lam 'bras rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i skaba.a/gsar ma'i 'gyur masa'i skabs/de lta mod kyi dbus gtsang dang nga' ris kyi phyogs su sngags kyi gdams pa 'ga' re thob kyang spyod pa 'chol te/ de kho na nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang bral bas sbyor sgrol dang gtad ra la sogs pa'i rtsub chos mang du byung zhing / de dag mnga' ris tri rgyal po rnams kyis ga gas ba dngos su sun phyung ba ma mdzad kyang / pa ta mkhas pa mang po spyan drangs nas yang dag pa'i lam la skye bo rnams btsud pa nyid kyis nyes pa de dag thabs kyis zhi bar mdzad la/ jo bo rjes kyang / dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen la / /rab tu 'bad pas bkag pa'i phyir/ /gsang dbang shes rab dbang bskur ni/ /tshangs par spyod pas blang mi bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ sngags pa khyim pa'i rtsing chos rnams kyang shug kyis bkag pa yin no/ /gsang sngags gsar ma'i 'gyur gyi mgo jo bo sbo tis btsuṭa so zhes bya ba yod mod kyi/ des dbus gtsang du ni 'gyur ma mdzad la/khams su dus phyis mtshan yang dag par brjod pa sgeg pa rdo rje'i skor dang /255

mched gsum byung ba des/ lo ston la bdag cag gi thad du mkhan slob zung cig gnang nas/ bstan pa spel bar zhus pa la/ mkhan po shākya gzhon nu dang slob dpon se ye shes brtson 'grus gnyis btang nas/ dge 'dun gyi sde legs par btsugs pa'i skabs/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos lo lnga bcu la nye ba tsam gyi skabs su/ mkhan slob de gnyis kyis gros byas nas 'brog mi dang stag lo gzhon nu brtson 'grus gnyis la gser mang po bskur nas rgya gar du brdzangs/ de gnyis gyis bod du khri warta cung zad kyang bslabs/ bal por lo gcig tu bzhugs nas/ shārnyi pa'i slob ma bal po'i pa ta )rto bha dra la skad legs par bslabs/ gsang sngags kyi chos kyang 'ga' re gsan/ khong gis zhal brda mdzad pa bzhin bai kra ma nā la'i mkhas pa drug po/ shar na shārti ba/ sto na ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa/ nub na shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros/ byang na nā ro paṇa chen/ dbus na rin chen rdo rje dang / dzñā na shrī rnams bzhugs pa la/ shārti ba la gtugs shing gzhan rnams la yang chos 'brel tsam re byas/ rgya gar du byon dus mkhan slob gnyis kyi zhal bkod la/ bstan pa'i gzhi ma yin pas 'dul ba nyon/ bstan pa'i snying po yin pas sher phyin nyon/ bstan pa'i nying khu yin pas gsang sngags nyon/ zhes gsung pa dang mthun par/ 'brog mis shārti pa la dang por 'dul ba gsan/ de nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gsan/ de nas gsang sngags mang du 357

gsan nas mkhas pa chen por gyur/ stag los ni/ rdo rje gdan du ba ra ba byed cing bzhugs te/ slob gnyer ma byas/ 'brog mis shā pa'i sar lo brgyad bzhugs nas/ de rjes rgya gar shar phyogs su byon pas dge slong zhig la shing gi lha mos gzugs med pa'i lag pa zhig gis bsod stoms 'dren pa mthong bas de la ngo mtshar skyes te dge slong de la phyag dang skor ba mang du byas nas/ rjes su 'dzin par zhus/ de'i mtshan ni bras mi ru tshe ste/ bod skad du shes rab kyi dbang po gsal zhes bya de yang khri rū pa'i slob ma (sgo nye ru ka/ de'i slob ma mi thub zla ba ste/de'i slob ma yin/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man thog rna sa rgya cher gnang / rtsa ba med pa'i lam 'bras shig kyang gnang /shārnyi pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos rnams las kyang de'i chos la nges pa cher skyes der 'o bzhi bzhugs/ spyir na snye bal du lo bcu gsum bzhugs te bod du byon/ mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pas ga ring po nas bsu ba byas/ 'brog mis sngar bsnyad pa bzhin gyi chos mang du mkhyen cing mkhas par byung ste/ mkhan slob rnams kyang dgyes par gyur/ de nas brtag pa gnyis pa la sogs pa'i rgyud gsum dang / gzhan yang gsang sngags kyi chos mang du bsgyur/ shārnyi pa'i ngag ldan la yang 'gyur legs par mdzad/sngags kyi bstan pa nyid gtso bor spel zhing chos mang du gsung zhing myu gu lung dang lha rtse'i brag ska bzhugs/ re zhig gnam thang dkar po'i 'brog 258

pas spyan drangs te de na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ga ya tta ras pa/ ta 'byon gyi yod pas bsu ba la shog bya ba'i phrin byung bas/ gung thang du byon te bsus nas pa ta dang 'grogs te/ lam du'ang chos mang du bshad/ rgyu gu lung du spyan drangs/ der lo lnga bzhugs pa/ gsung ngag rin po che tshang bar gnang ba/ ga ra srang lnga brgya 'bul ba rnams kyi chad byas/cha gsum na gdam ngag rdzogs/ nga 'gro gsung ba la chad bzhin bzhugs par zhu bas/ lo'ang lnga ba zhug / ga ra zang lnga brgya'ang tshang bar phul shin du dgyes nas gsung ngag bod gzhan la mi gsung bar zhal gyis bzhes nas/ slar rgya gar du gshegs/ snyig yang pa ta gro mo nas 'gos kyis spyan drangs nas byon pa dang mja / yang phyir thegs/ tha ma mnga' ris su gyi jos spyan drangs/ de nas gtsang du phebs pa'i tshe 'brog mi gshegs nas ma mjal/ pa ta kha rag tu sgom chen se rogs gnyis kyi thad du byon te/ der gshegs 'brog mi rgyud rnams dang bsam mi khyab la sogs pa'i gdams pa rnams mang du gnang / gsung ngag tshang ba ni/ lha btsun ka li/ 'brom do ba ston chung / se ston kun rig ste gsum la gnang gi/ gzhan la med lha btsun gyis slob ma ma bskyangs/ do ba ston chung myu gu lung nas la stod stor byon/ der myur du gshegs pas gdams pa ma 'phel/ gsung ngag tshar bar ma gnang kyang / de'i cha shas res/ dgyer sgom se bo/ gshen sgom rog po/ 259

dbus pa grong po che ste pha gsum dang / stod mo rdo rje mtsho/ bzang mo dkon ne/ shab mo lcam cig 'chad mo nam mkha' dang mo bzhi ste/bdun gyis grub pa thob/ gzhung gi bshad pa tshar phyin pa lha rtse'i gyi ljang dbu da /ra ba/ shab kyi brag rtse so nag pa/ 'phrang 'og gi dbrang ston dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa skya'i 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po ste lnga'o/ /de ltar slob ma mchog rnams grangs su byas kyi/ rab tu byung ba dang khyim pa shin du mang po la chos gsangs/'gos lo sto ba dang mar pa lo tsā ba gnyis kyang khong gi slob ma yin/ mar pas/ dpal myu gu lung gi dgon pa ru/ /sgra bsgyur 'brog mi lo tsā la/ /sgra thad klog skad kyi yig tshad bslabs/ khong bka' drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ zhes gsungs/ 'on kyang gdams pa chung ngu re la'ang yon chen po dgos par mthong / des rang nyid rgya gar du 'gro ba'i thugs skyes shing byon no/ /'gos kyis kyang bla ma chos la dam pas/ rang nyid pa ta mang po la gtug snyam nas/ grwa sa de nas byon no/ de ltar na bla chen 'di ni gdams ngag dang bcas pa mang du gsan pa'i yon tan dang /bskyed rdzogs gnyi ga la brtan pa thob cing / rlung gi stobs kyis nam mkha' la skyil dkrung 'cha' ba/ 'chi ba lam du byas nas sku lus de nyid ma spangs par sangs rgya bar bzhed na'ang / sras rnams kyis spur sbyong ba sogs byas pas rten 'brel cung zhig ma 'grig ste/ bar dor phyag rgya chen 260

po'i dngos grub brnyes pa zhig go/ /mdor na gong du bshad pa'i tshulagyis/ lo chen rin chen bzang po la brten nas brgyad stong pa dang / nyi khri snang ba dang / brgyad stong 'grel chen la sogs pa'i 'gyur mang po mdzad cing gsungs pas/ zab mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu snyin pa dar bar gyur pa yang khong gi drin las yin la/ gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde'i phyogs rnams la ni/ mkhas pa dang / so sor sku nyams su bzhes pas grub pa'i tshul chen po yang mnga'/ pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyi ga'i bshad pa'i bka' mang du btsugs/ bye brag tu rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams kyi rgya cher 'grel pa dang cho ga rnams phyag len dang bcas par rgya cher spel bas bstan pa shin du dar bar mdzad la/ gong du smos pa bzhin bla chen 'brog mis ma rgyud gtso bor mdzad pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad cing / rje 'gos kyis gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags lugs gtso bor mdzad pa'i bshad pa la brten pa'i slob ma mkhas pa rim pa rim pa ma chad par 'phel ba dang /rje mar pas kyang nā ro me ci'i man ngag gtso bor mdzad cing / bshad pa yang 'dus pa dang / sangs rgyas thod pa dang / brtag pa gnyis pa dang /rdo rje gur dang / ma hā ma yā dang / dpal gdan bzhi pa rnams kyi bshad pa mdzad pas kyang / slob ma mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes pas bod kyi ri sul thams cad gang bar mdzad de/ sngags kyi bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa yin no/ /bla chen 'brog mis la gsung ngag ma lus pa 26

gnang zhing / zha ma lcam zing la brten nas gdams pa 'phel bar lung bstan pa bzhin/ lcam sring gnyis pos kyang la gsung ngag legs par zhus/ sku nyams su yang bzhes/ gzhan la phan pa yang rgya cher mdzad de/ 'di dag gi lo rgyus ni 'og tu bri bar bya'o/bla chen la slob ma mang du yod kyang / gzhung dang gdams pa gnyi ga'i bdag po chen por gyur pa gi/ dpal ldan sa rgya pa'i bla la mas te/de dag gang las su'i mi brgyud du byung ba'i rim pa yang / bod yul du lha srin dar ba'i tshe yar klungs shar gyi g.ya' spang sa gcig dang si li ma gnyis mjal bar gyur pa na/ srin bag med kyang de la chags pas de gnyis 'khon pa'i bar du lha zas skyes ba la jo bo 'khon bar skyes shes grags pa la/ ma sangs las 'khon nas kyi brgyud rim par byon zhing /rgyal po khri srong the btsan gyi nang blon du gtogs pa 'khon dpal bo che'i sras bzhi sde/ khri mdzes lha legs/ tshe la dbang phyug 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrung ba/ tshe 'dzin no/ /gsum pa de sad mi mi bdun gyi drug pa yin/ bzhi pa'i zas rdo rje rin po che nas bu brgyud rim pa bzhin/shes rab yon tan/ yon tan 'byung gnas/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po/ shakya blo gros/ de dag thams cad kyang gsang sngags rnying ma'i yon tan dang ldan no/ /de la sras gnyis gcen she rab tshul khrims tshangs spyod bzung /363 4

gtsung dkon mchog rgyal po shing pho khyi la 'khrungs/ bzhi bcu bzhes pa chu mo glang la sa skya btab/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa dgu pa chu pho rta la 'das/de'i zas sa chen kun dga' snying po yab kyi nga dgu pa chu pho spre'u la 'khrungs/bcu gcig lon pa la yab gshegs/ de lo rad blo ri lo tsā ba lo drug cu rtsa gsum pa zhig gdan sar bskos/ rang lo nyi shu pa nas drug cu rtsa bdun gyi bar gdan sa lo zhe brgyad gzung nas/ sa pho stag la gshegs/ sa chen la sras bzhi las/ kun dga' 'bar ni/ rgya gar du byon/ mkhas par gyur nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la rgya gar nyid du gshegs/ gnyis pa slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo yab kyi nga gcig pa chu pho khyi la 'khrungs/bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa chu pho stag la gshegs/ gsum pa rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan yab kyi nga drug pa me mo yos la 'khrungs/ rang lo nyer drug pa chu 'brug nas gdan sa bskyangs/ bdun cu pa me pho byi ba la gsheḍa/bzhi pa dpal chen 'od po yab kyi nga dgu pa lcags pho rta la 'khrungs/ nga bzhi pa chu mo phag la gshegs/ de la sras gnyis las/ che ba sa skya paṇa chen yab kyi so gsum pa chu pho stag la 'khrungs/ drug cu rtsa gsum pa shing pho 'brug la gong du byon/ bdun cu pa lcags mo phag la gshegs/gcung po zangs tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan yab kyi so lnga pa shing pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ nga drug bzhes pa sa mo phag la gshegs/ de'i sras bla ma 'phags pa yab kyi nga gnyis pa shing mo lug la 'khrungs/ lo bcu pa'i tshe 263

chos rje pa'i phyags phyir byang ngos su byon/ lam du zul phur na bza' 'phred gsol ba dge tshul mdzad/ bcu dgu pa chu mo glang la se chen rgyal bur bzhugs pa'i bla mchod mdzad/ āoṃ shu rtsa gcig pa shing mo yos ma bsnyen par rdzogs/ nyi shu rtsa drug pa lcags pho spre'u la se chen rgyal sar thon pas gong ma'i bla mar gyur/ so gcig pa shing mo glang la bod la bteg ra sa mo sbrul la gong du byon/ lo bdun bzhags nas slar zhe gnyis pa me pho byi ba la gdan sar phebs/ me mo glang la chu mig chos 'khor mdzad/ bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa lcags pho 'byug la gshegs/ de'i gcung po phyag na yab kyi nga drug pa sa mo phag la 'khyungs/ 'o/ drug lonapa'i tshe chos rje pa'i phyags phyir byang ngos su byon/ nyi shu rtsa dgu pa me mo yos la gshegs/ yang slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan yab zangs tshas nga lnga bzhes pa sa pho khyi la 'khrungs/ zhe gnyis bzhes pa sa mo yos la gsheḍa/ yang slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas kyang tsheb dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan dang dgung lo gcig so bdun bzhes pa shing pho khye lo la ljang yul du gshegs/ phyag na'i sras po dharma pā la ra/ ha phyag na gshegs nas zla ba drug song ba sa pho 'byug shar ba la sku 'khrungs/ snya shu pa me mo phag la gshegs/ lcags sgrul nas me mo phag gi bar lo bdun gdan sa mdzad/ bla ma ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal yab kyi nyer lnga pa chu pho khyi la 'khyungs/ bzhi bcu zhe lnga pa ke pho 264

rta na lo bcu dgu gad sa mdzad/ re gcig pa chu pho khyi la gshegs/ba ma 'di la sras bcu gnyis yod pa las/ dang po slob dpon brtsod nams bzang po gong du 'khrungs/ bod du byon pa'i lam mdo khams su 'ad / gnyis pa bla ma kun dga' blo gros yab kyi so brgyad pa sa mo thogal 'geng skyo nyi zhu rtsa dgu pa me mo yos la gshegs/ gsum pa mkhas btsun chen po rnam mkha' legs pa'i blo gros rgya'angamatshan dpal bzang po yab kyi zho bzhi pa cing mo sbrul la 'khrungs/ nyi shu rtsa gcig pa zhing mo glang nas so dgu pa chu mo lug gibar gdan sa lo bcu dgu mdzad/ chu mo luba'inyid la gshegs/ 'di la gcung gnyis byung ste/ dang po gzhon nu 'khogashegs/ gnyis pa tshob dpon ma mkha' rgyal mtshan dpa bzang po yab gshebatag pa'i shing pho gyi ba la 'khrungs/ nyi shu pa la gong du gshegs/bla rma kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyang gong du byon/ khong gi gcung ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po lcags pho khyi la 'khyungs/ zhe dgu pa sa rdzo khyi la gshegs/ btsun mo re mda' ma la ma sring gsula'akhyung / che ba gcig gzhon nu la gshegs/ chung pa dbang kun dga' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpa'akhab nga po yab kyi zhe bdun pa sa the'i la 'khyungs nyi shu rtsa dgu bzhis pa mi pho byi krol zad kyi sa char sku gshegs/btsun mo zha lu ma ma gcig gzhon nu 'bum la zas gsum 'khrungs pa'i che ba kun dga' nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ta'i dben gu lha'i mtshan ཿ65

chen las gur brtag gi bshad pa gtso bor gyur pa'i bshad bka' rnams yang dag bar blangs/ man ngag ni/ bla chen gyis se ston kun rig glu man ngag rdzogs par byin/ se ston gyis rgyud kyi bshad bka' rnams bla chen gyi dngos slob mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po las blangs/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po la yang gsan/ thugs dam mtho zhing lo brgyad cu rtsa brgyad kyi bar du bzhugs/ bla mas lung bstan pa bzhin gdams ngag rnams phal cher zha ma lcam sring la gnang / dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa la sa chen dgung lo nyi shu tsam lon pa zhig mjal du byung bas dgyes che ste/ gdams ngag byin gyis shog cig gsungs pa la/ gegs cung zad cig gi dbang du gyur te/ man ngag ma gsan/ se myur po yang gshegs/ de nas phyi zhig na sa chen gdams ngag gis yid gdungs te gdams ngag su la yod dris pas/ se ston gyi gdams ngag rnams dgon pa ba sku mched la yod zerashe gcung gshegs/ gcen ngo 'i thad du byon pas rten 'brel 'grig dka' se ba zhig la zhang dgon pa bas dgyes pa dang bcas te lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang / de phyin chad dpal sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rnams gzhung gdams ngag gnyi ga'i bdag por gyur pa yin/ de la 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po shing pho khyi la 'khrungs pa nas sa skya paṇa chen lcags mo phag la zhi bar gshegs pa'i bar lo nyis brgya dang bco brgyad song ste/ de'i bar du sngags mtshan nyid gnyi ga'i char phab 267

pas bod kyi yul 'di legs par gsos shing / dbon po 'phags pa rin po che la gong ma se chen gyis/ bod chol kha gsum po thams cad dbang yon du phul ba la brten nas bla mas bla ma'i bya ba mdzad cing / dpon chen na rims su bskos pa snams kyis 'jig rten gyi bya ba mdzad de/ dpon chen la snga ba shākya bzang po se chen gyi lung gis dbus 0/tsang gi zam klu gun min dbang cu'i dam kha byin nas dpon chen la bskos/ khang gsar chen mo btab/ lha khang chen mo'i lcags ri phyi nang brtsigs/ shing cha drangs nas thog ma phub pa la 'das/ nang gnyer byas pa kun dga' bzang pos dpon chen byas nas/ rin chen sgang bla brang btab/ lha khang lcags ri dang bcas pa byas/ kun dga' bzang pos las ka gtad nas dpon chen zhang btsun/ phyug po sgang dkar ba/ byang rin rnams bla ma'i zhal brdas rim par bskos/ kun dga' bzang po la bla ma ma mnyes nas/ bla ma gshegs pa'i phyi lo se chen gyi lung gis hor dmag gis bsad/ byang rin gyi dus na se chen gyis thugs la btags nas/ zo 'or si'i mi dpon dang shel dam gnang/ de nas dpon chen kun gzhon/ dpon chen gzhon dbang / de'i ring la phye gsal chen mo dang / dbus gtsang gi khrims kyi zhib cha phal che ba byas/ de nas dpon chen byang rdor/ dpon chen mag len/ 'dis sa skya'i lcags ri phyi ma dang / dbon po ri'i lcags ri btab/ khang gsar gling byas/ 'di gsum gyi bar la 'bri khung pa 268

dang 'thabs/ mag len gyi ring la 'bri khung gling log tu grags pa'i bcom khyer chen po de byung / gling log de bu ston rin po che 'khrungs pa'i lcags pho stag gi lo de yin/ yang gzhon dbang skyar nas basmos/ de nas legs pa dpal/ seng ge dpal/ 'od zer seng ge zwan ching dben gyi dam kha bzung / dpon chen kun dga' rin chen/ don yod dpal/yon btsun/ yang 'od zer seng gi/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po/dbang phyug dpal/ bsod nams dpal/ yang rgyal ba bzang po/dbang brtson/ nam mkha' brtan pa/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ dpal 'bum/ blo chen/ grags dbang ngo/ dpon chen dbang brtson gyis yar klungs su khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag lan mang du drangs kyang / ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan ma thub ste/ dbus kyi sa cha phal che ba khong gis lhangs/ gyis rta lo la dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po lha khang bla brang pas brtsen du gzung ba/ si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis dmag gi dpung chen pos bsdigs te/ dpon chen pa btson nas bton/ de nas gtsang gi sa cha phal che ba'i mnga' bdag ta sis byas/ de rting dbus gtsang gi sde dpon thams cad kyis/ dbus gtsang du rdzong bskor 'bebs la sogs pa'i bya ba thams cad si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan shes su bcug pa'i so so nas thel tshe phul/ khong gshegs nas kyang gu shrī chen po la ci yin shes pa'i thel rtse phul/ de la spyir sa skya pas 'jig rten gyi bdag po lo bdun cu rtsa lnga 369

mjod pa la/ nang tshan du bzhi thog nas nyi shu rtsa lnga/ shar bas nyi shu rtsa lnga/ khang gsar chen mo bas nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ lo bdun cu rtsa lnga' rjes la si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis sa mo glang nas sa'i bdag po mdzad nas/ lo nyi shu rtsa lnga pa chu mo glang la gu shrī bas yar klungs chos 'khor ma da/ de lo rang zhi bar gshegs pas phag mo gru pa la yang nyi shu rtsa lnga'i skeg byung zhes zer ro/ /sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi ring la spu rgyan gyi pas ta shes rab gsang ba dang / gyis pazlo ta dza ya se na la sogs ba pa ta mang po'ang byon zhing / phyis 'phags pa rin po che'i ring la shong ston ska me da la sogs pa'i lo tsā ba shen ta mkhas pa yang mang ne byang /༄ ༄ ༄ ༄tshad ma rnam 'grel bshad ba yang dbu gtsang gi chos sdi mas cad du dar ba rno/ bla chos rje ba'i blon yin/ 'phags pa rin bo che bas dgong ba nga bas tso bod kyi chos pa rnams rang rang gi chos lugs gang yod la 'bad pa gyi zhes zer ba'i hor gyi 'ju sa bsgrags/ sdi snad 'dzin pa phal mo chi zang zing gi longs spyod sa kyang tshim par mdzad snang ngo/ /rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi bshad pa'i dar so dang / lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa sa spyo dzi mi'i sras kyi ring la ji ltar 'phel ba'i gtam gyi skabs so/ 270

rma lo tsā ba dang zha ma lcam brang gis bstan nga ji ltar bskyangs pa'i skabs/mas zha ma lcam sring gi drin las lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdalas pa ji ltar 'phel ba'i tshul brjod par bya ste/ de la phyir 'phags pa spyan ngas ga gas dbang phyug gis chos kyi rgyal bo srong btsan sgam por sku sprul te/ bod 'bangs rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis thon mi sasbyo ṭar sku sprul te/ rgya gar gyi pa ta lha'i rig pa seng gi zhes bya ba la bslabs nas rgya gar yi ge la mkhas par mdzad de/ rgya gar gyi phyi mo lnga bcu/ bod du phyi mo sum cur bsdus nas sgra'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhigakyang mdzad/ dang por rgyal po la yi ge legs par bslabs/ snyi nas 'bangs blo gsal ba rnams la yang legs par bslabs pas bod phal mo cu la khyab cing / thams cad kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la blta ba'i skal ba can du gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma ni/ gnas brtan bcu drug spyan 'dren pa po thang tha'i dzu'i dzung gi sras mo rgyal glen kong jo zhes bya ba bod kyi skad du chu'i nang gi padma zhes bya ba der sku sprul nas/ 'phrul snang dzijo bo 'di spyan drangs ming srong btsan gyi btsun mor gyur nas/ nyid kyis ra 271

mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ 'phrul snang la sogs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i sa dmigs rnams kyang bstan/ dkon mchog la mchod pa'i srol legs par btsugs/ de rnams dus re shig 'das pa na/ srong btsan ni/ dus zhabs pa chung ba'i slob ma kha che dgon pa ba zhes bya ba dang / kha che paṇa chen zhes zer ba/ mtshan dngos dza ya ā naner sku 'khrungs/ thon mi ni/ la stod stor rma lo tsā ba chos 'bar zhes bya bar sku 'khrungs/ kong jo ni/ sto'i pha drug tu ma gcig zha ma zhes bya ba der sku 'khrungs pa yin no/ /de yang rma lo tsā bas sto bal du mkhas pa mang po la gtugs te/ 'di rgya gar phyag na'i yang slob ma min/ rgya gar du kha che dgon pa ba dang / ma lha smu kā ra gubha la sogs pa la gsan pa mang du mdzad cing bzhugs pa na/ lo tsā ba la khyod bod du song la/'phags ma sgrol ma'i sprul pa 'di lta bu zhig yod pa phyag rgyar bsten la/gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi nyams len gyis zhig ces gsungs pa dang / ma bha yas kyang de dang mthun pa kho nar gsungs pas/bod du byon nas ma gcig phyag rgyar mdzad pa yin no/ /de yang yul pha drug na/ yab byi ba hab sha zhes bya ba mtshan dngos zha ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan te/ tshogs kyi bdag po ha lu marnya yin zer/ de'i chung ma rgya gar lha mo ni/ bal mo gza' khri btsun gyi skye ba yin zer/ de gnyis la zas lcam sring dug 'khrungs pa'i che ba zha ma rgya le bya ba dge bshes snye ma ba'i thad 272

du rab tu byung / mtshan rin chen 'od zer du btaḍa/ 'phags yog dus gsum la mkhas/ de 'og rgyal chung ste/ yang khyed bla ma la brten nas mdo sbya 'phrul sems phyogs gsum ga la mkhas pa zhig byung / de 'og seng ge rgyashā po ste/ rma lo dang pu hrangs pa dang ga rong lo tsā ba dang rngog rnams la lo tsā bslabs shing mkhas par mkhyen pas/ tshad ma kun las btus pa rang 'grel dang bcas pa bsgyur zhing / ding sang gi bar du tshad ma ba rnams de la brten pa yin/ chos chos nyid rnam 'byed kyang tshiṭa su bcad par bsgyur snang / dka' bzhi shes shing / dbus su yungs dkar bre gyed dang gsum gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i grwa pa bskyangs/ phyis ri bo rtse lnga la gshegs te/ de nas phyir ma byon/ 'byon khar dam pa sangs rgyas la zhus pas/ zha ma/ pha drug gtan yul ni min/ rtse lngar song la 'gro ba'i don gyis zhig de nas 'o skol pha spad dga' ldan du dus bya'o gsung ngo/ /de 'og ma gcig yin/ de yang rma lo tsā ba de/ jo bo rje lha gcig bod du byon nas mnga' ris su lo gsum bzhugs rjes shing pho spre'u'i yo la 'khrungs shing / bcu dgu bzhes pa chu pho stag gi lo la ma gcig 'di 'khrungs/ sku lus la spyir padma can gyi mtshan snams dang / bye brag tu lte ba na pad ma dmar po rtsa ba gsum pa/ nu ma gnyis kyi bar na rin po che'i phreng ba gsum skor duyod pas lte bar sleb pa/ phrag so gnyis la g.yung drung rig re/ rna ba gnyis kyi rgyab na dung padma ltar 'khyil ba re/273

rtse'i thog na ral gri utpalala'i mdog can tī yig gis mtshan pa/ smin mtshams na nyi zla'i rgyal mtshan 'khor lo tog dang bcas pa yod pa zhig byung / de 'og chos rgyal 'khon phu ba sa mo bya la 'khrungs/ de log mkhar rgyal dge bshes rin po che'i thad du rab tu byung / mtshan bsod nams rgyal por btags/ pu hrangs lo tsā ba'i slob ma che shes dge bshes btsun chung bya ba de yin/ ma gcig gis lo bcu bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe rtsal de'i skyes pa ma ba lha rgyal bya ba zhig la thag mar btang bas/ khyim ma bzhed de/ khyo la/ khyod rang yang chos gyis nga yang chos byed byas pas nyan du ma btub pas smyo brdzu mdzad de/ de nas bral/ lo bcu bdud na nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi bar du bla ma ma'i phyog rgya ma mdzad/ mis rgyud dang sgrab thabs mang po'ang khong la bslabs/ nam zhig gi tshe na bla ma rma yi dpe la dbang len ba'i rig ma mdzad pa'i tshe/ bde chen gyi dpa' bo bcu drug dang zhing skyo nga gi mkha' 'gro ma bcu drug gi zhal mthong / rig ma brgyad ki'i nyams shar/ bla ma dang rang nyid nye ru ka yab yum du mthong /zla ba bcu drug tu thig le'i nyams 'bar/ de phyin chad bla ma dang rang nyid tha mal du nam yang ma markong gsung / bla ma'i zhal nas lo bzhir mtshams chod cig gsung ba bzhin byas pas/ ming lam du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i zhal mthong / de nas mtshams lce la ri khrod du song zhig gsung ba bzhin byas pas/ bdud kyi bar chad thams 274
