rnams mthong sto/ de dag las gzhan pa yang mdzad pa 'dra 'o/ / nga sag tu ni ding sang gi bar du khong la brten nas dbu ma'i bshad pa rgyun ma chad par byung / dbus gtsang gi dge bshes bzang po mang pos kyang der gtugs te/ dbu ma la phan pa che'o/ /zhang thang sag pa'i rjes su 'brom ston/ dbang phyug grags pa/ slob dpon shes rab rdo rje/ slob dpon ston tshul dang grags ldan te sku mched gnyis/ lu dbon su kha de ba/slob dpon jo btsun/ bla ma dbu ra ba/ slob dpon ston pa shes rab dpal/ slob dpon dar ma shes rab/ bang ston shes rab rin chen/rje btsun ston pa bsod nams seng ge/ phag ston bsam gtan bzang po/bang ston gzhon nu bsam gtan/ slob dpon thang nag pa/ slob dpon bkra shes seng ge/ rta pa gzhon nu bzang po/ gsas khang ba slob dpon chos grags/ thang sag pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ rtse ba kun dga' gzhon nu/ slob dpon shākya gzhon nu/ kun spangs gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ dmar ston gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon tshul khrims dpal ba/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon rin chen rgya mtsho/ gdan sa ba blo gros dpal rin pa'i bar du tshig gsal 'jug gi 'grel chen gnyis po la gzhung du byas nas bshad pa mdzad pa yin no/ /thang sag pa rnams rang gi rgya gar ba'i brgyud pa brjod pa na/ thub pa'i dbang po/ mkhan po sgra gcan zin/ klu sgrub/ zla ba grags pa/ ma tī// de ba tsand+ra/418

bram zi rin na rdo / ba ra nyi ta/ ha su ma ti/ spa tshab lo tsā rgazhes 'chad do/ /spa tshab brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i skabs so/ / lta mngon pa'i brgyud pa'i skabs/gang can gyi khrod du mngon pa kun las btus kyi bshad pa rgyun chag dku rgyung ba'i brgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas byams pa/ thogs med/da ga gnyen/ blo brtan/ gang spel/ kha che dzi na mi tra ka cog nga gsum/ des lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ nam nang ba'i rdo rje/dbas rgyal ba ye shes gsum la bshad/ dang po gnyis kyis bsgoms pas grub pa thob/ dbas dbus su 'khrug pa byung nas khams su gshegs de la spu rgyal ba'i ye shes/ de nas spu mchog gi ye shes/ so btsun/gang mi yon tan g.yung drung khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung / rwa khri ba nga 'a ra/ rgya tshul le/ li bdud rtsi grags rnams byung ba las/rwa khri bzangs la brang ti dar ma nga sdo gsan/ brang ti ni sgob ma shin tu mang rte/ rngog lo tsā ba chen po pa ta 'bum phrag gsum pa mja ba'i phyir 'khor dge slong sum brgya dang bcas te byon pa'i tshe/ lo tsā ba'i dge slong re re la brang tis khong rang gi slob ma dge slong bcu gsum bcu gsum bsnyen bkur byed du bcug ces grags/ brang ti la ko bo ye shes 'byung gnas/ de la rog chos kyi brtson 'grus/ /'di la brten nas 41

mar klungs stod smad du yang mngon pa kun las btus kyi 'chad nyan mang du byung ste/ 'di'i slob ma yar rgyal ba'i shes rab kyis kyang kun las btus kyi ṭī ka che mo mdzad/ rog la te lung se 'bar/ bya sder ba/ bye skyid pa spyin pa seng gi/ skyi ston grags 'bum/ bcom ldan ral gri ste/byi skyid pa la kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis kyang gsan/ yang brang ti nas 'chims brtson seng / rgyang ro dar ma mgon/ mchims brtson rgyal/skang blo brtan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dpang lo tsā ba/ byang rtse/ nya dbon po kun dga' dpal/ chos dpal mgon po/ bdag nyid chen po blo gros rgya mtsho'i bar ro/ yang / ko bo ye shes 'byung gnas/ 'ban/tho gar ba gcam sde/ 'jad pa byang skyabs/ 'jad pa gzhon byang /'bring mtshams zhang / bo dong rin rtse/ khro phu rin po che bsod nams seng ge/ tshad ma'i skyes bu/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen dharma shrī/des dbus su sde sdod 'dzin pa mang po la gsungs so/ bu ston rin po che yan du brgyud pa'i bla ma de rnams kyis ṭā ka shin tu rgyas nga mdzad pa mang po snang la/ 'bum phrag gsum pa'i gdan sa bo dong na bzhugs pa'i sde sdod 'dzin pa phal cher chos 'di la mkhas par mdzad la/ bo dong ma'i bla ma brgyud rim gyi yi ge ma rnyed na'ang/ grwa sa 'dir lung rigs mngon pa dang 'dul ba sgra snyan dngags la sogs pa'i yon tan rgya chen po dang ldan pa mang du byung ste/ chos grwa 'di ngo mtshar ba'i gnas so/ /mngon 420

pa mdzod 'di bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su 'grel bshad mang po dang bcas pa 'gyur la/ bshad pa ni pa ta spri ti las byung bar grags shing /dbus gtsang du dar rgyas che bar gyur kyang brgyud rim gyi yi ge ma rnyed do/mngon pa'i brgyud pa'i skabs so/ /tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi brgyud ba'i skabs/ thub pa/ dgra bcom chos skyob/ paṇa chen me tre ga dbyig gnyen/ phyogs glang / dbang phyug sde/ chos grags/ lha dbang blo/shakya blo/ dul ba lha/ chos grags/ sher 'byung / nyi ma sbas pa/ja ma ri/ tsā na shrī mi rtu/ chos kyi mchog na / waṃ ku pazlo ta/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī/ sa paṇa/ 'u yug pa/ zhang btsun mdo sde dpal/ 'jam dbyangs skya bo/ dpal ldan pa/ 'jam dbyangs ston gzhon/ nor bzangs dpal/ grags rin pa/ 'jam ston pa/chos seng pa/ rdo thog pa chos kyi bzang po/ mkhan chen rin po che rgyal mtshan bzang po/ yang / chos seng ba la rgyal lha khang ba bsam grub ye shes/ de la slob dpon bsam grub bzang po ba rnams te/ 'di rnam 'grel ba gzhan rnams la mi snang bas/ mkhan chen rin po che rgyal mtshan bzang pos 'bad pa chen pos btsal bas rnyed pa yin gsung ste/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi brgyud pa'o/ /421

byams chos btsan lugs kyi skabs/bcom ldan 'das byam pa chos lnga po 'di la/ lo tsā ba chen po blo ldan shes rab dang btsan kha bo che gnyis gsan sa'i bla ma satsā nar gcig kyang / gzhung gi bshad pa'i tshul ni mi 'dra bar snang ste/ de yang btsan lugs kyi lo rgyus la/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma dang chos chos nyid rnam par 'byed pa gnyis parnyi ta gzhan la yang ma grags/ rje dme ci bas mchod rten zhig dzi ra kha nas 'od 'byung gi 'dug pa gzigs pas chos gnyis ba'i da byung / — de nas rje btsun ma pham pa la nga/sol ba btab pa spron gyi mthongs su byon te/ de gnyis legs par gnang / rme 8 bas pa/ rta dga' ba'i grags pa zhes bya ba la bshad/ dga' ba'i grags pas spang po cha byad kyis kha cher byon/ sa rnga nas dga' ba'i grags gango mtshar can du gzi sa/ te bsnyen bkur nas gzhung gnyis po'i bshad pa zhus shing / dpe yang kha yar bris nas mkhas pa tsā na shrī la sogs pa la bul/ de yang btsan kha bo che de grwa pa mngon shes kyi mkhan bu yin pas/kha cher 'byon khar mkhan po la gtor zhus pas/ mkhan po'i zhal nas/khyod kha che nas ma 'khor bar la so na ba tsam yang mi yong bar ngas khag khur cig gsung nas/ lcags mo bya po pa lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa zhig kha cher phyin pa yin pas/ saḥ na la/ da nga gis pas chos mang po mi 422

lobs bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i cho la 'chi chos byed pas de'i bshad pa yang dag pa zhig gnang bar zhu zhes zhus/ satsā nas lo tsā ba gzu dga' ba'i rdo rje la bcol nas/ btsan kha bo che la gdoms pa dang bcas pa gnang zer/ de dus su gzug zin bris byas pa'i rgyud bla ma la yig cha yang yod par 'dug padma seng ge zhes bya ba'i lo tsā ba zhig la yang btsan dang bshad pa mthun par byung 'dug ste/ des kyang sargyu na la gtugs pa'i skabs kyi zin bris byas pa'i mdo sde rgyan gyi 'a ka chen po zhig kyang snang ngo / /btsan gyi rngog ma tsā ba snga rol du bod du phebs/ gnas tha dad pa rnams su ji ltar rigs par da ba'i bshes gnyen don du gnyer ba rnams la byams chos kyi bshad pa mdzad/ phan yang che bar byung / de'i gnas gzhi ni mar stod kyi brag rgya yin/ des dge ba'i bshes gnyen lcang ra ba zhe ba ba la gsungs/ des 'phyos kyi mdo sde sbug pa dar ma brtson 'grus la bshad/ dar ma brtson 'grus kyis mdo sde'i gyin la ṭwāṃ ka che ba zhig mdzad de/ de'i gligasajibam ni mang du snang / rgyud bla ma la btsan lugs kyi tsā ka yin zer ba'i mdzad pa po ma smos pa/ bshad pa rnams man ngag nyams len kho na dang sbyar ba zhig kyang snang / btsan lugs kyi man ngag ye shes kyi bzhags la sogs yig chung yang 'ga' yar 'dug deng sang lugs de dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di la bzhugs so bya ba ni ma thos/ de ming rngog lo snye ba blo ldan shes rab nas rim par brgyud pa'i mkhas pa mang 423

pos / ka yang mdzad/ de la lo tsā ba chen po dang slob dpon gtsang nag pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba don dam pa'i bden pa la zer mod kyi/ don dam pa'i bden pa ni sgra dang rtogs pa'i dngos kyi yul ma yin pa lta zhog zhen pa'i yul tsam yang ma yin zhes gsung / slob dpon gi pa ni dngos po rnams bden pas stong ba'i med par dgag pa ni don dam pa'i bden pa yin zhing / de sgra rtog gi zhen pa'i yul du yang bzhed/ btsan lugs pa rnams ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po yin pas/ de sangs rgyas kyi rgyu yang rgyang por bzhed/ rje btsun red mda' bas dang por rgyud bla ma sems tsam gyi bstan bcos su mdzad nas sems tsam dang mthun pa'i tā ka yang mdzad/ phyis dben pa brten nas ni/ de snyir rang sems rig stong dbyer med 'di/ / mas can kun la khyab par yod gzigs nas/ /sa 'og gter dang sbrum ma'i mngal sogs dpes/ /'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can du gsungs/zhes bya ba'i mgur blangs/ spyir byams pa'i chos kyi ma gnyis po 'di rje btsun dme ci bas gsar du rnyed pa ni bden pa 'dra ste/ brgyad stong 'grel chen sogs su dbus dang mtha' rnam par 'byed pa dang / dzo mdo sde'i rgyan nas lung drangs shing / bstan bcos phyi ma gnyis po'i lung cung zad kyang ma drangs par snang ba'i gyir ro/ kha che paṇa chen gyis kyang srin po rir byams chos lnga'i man ngag gnang zer ba ni 'dug ding sang ni de'i sgra mi 424

grag go /kun mkhyen jo mo nang pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po bden rtag tu khas blangs pa nor ro zhes kha zer ba dag yod kyang / rgyud bla ma yi dam du byed pa dbus gtsang na mang du 'dug pa rnams ni khong gi drin las yin par snang ngo / rgyud bla ma 'grel pa dang bcas pa jo bo dang nag tshos thog mar bsgyur/ de nas rngog lo/ spa tshab lo tsā ba/ yar klungs lo tsā ba rnams kyis bsgyur/ jo nang lo tsā bas gzhung rkyang la 'gyur mdzad/mar pa do pas byams chos lnga ka la 'gyur mdzad yod ces kyang zer ro/byams chos btsan lugs kyi skabs so/
(jodeb ther sngon po las/ji ltar byung ba'i lta

dum bu bdun pa/ rgyud sde'i bshad srol ji ltar byung ba'i skabs/cas ga'i 41 rgyus /) skabs/da ni rgyud sde'i bshad pa ji ltar byung ba'i tshul brjod par bya ste/de la bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud rnams la bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bshad pa gtso che zhing / pasnyi ta gzhan gyi yang bshad pa la brten nas dpung bzangs dang gsang ba spyi'i rgyud dang / bsam gtan phyi ma la sogs pa dang / spyod pa'i rgyud kyi yang rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud la slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i bsdus don gyi 'grel pa dang / slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i gsung lo tsā bas legs par bzung ste yi ger byas pa dang /phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud la 'grel pa zhig kyang 'gyur zhing / de la sogs pa la bshad pa dang nyan pa'i rgyun yang yod par snang mod/ bstan pa snyi dar nas ni bshad pa'i rgyun cher byung ba mi 'dra'o/bstan pa phyi dar la rnal 'byor snyi nang gnyis spu'i bshad pa rgyun dang bcas te mang du byung ngo / de yang skyes bu'i mchog lo tsā ba chen po 42

rin chen bzang po zhes grags pa des/ spyir pha rol tu phyin pa dang sngags kyi gzhung thams cad mkhyen cing bshad pa yang mdzad mod/ bye brag tu rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi bshad pa ji ltar mdzad pa ni/ lo tsā ba chen po des kha cher lan gsum byon/ der bla ma mang po bsnyen/ bod du yang pazlo ta mang po spyan drangs/ bshad pa'i srol legs par btsugs te/ de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud la 'grel pa slob dpon kun snying gis mdzad pa'i de nyid snang ba dang / dpal mchog gi rgyud kyi 'grel pa slob dpon kun dga' snying bos mdzad pa yang hol khongs 'ga' re lus pa zhig dang / kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje 'byung ba'i cho ga lag len dang bcas pa rnams dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud slob dbon kun dga' snying po'i bshad pa dang bcas pa dang / thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud slob dpon shārti ba'i 'grel thodang bcas pa dang / de dag gi phran mang po yang bsgyur zhing phyag na du mdzad de legs par ba/ngas ba la / mnga' ris dang dbus gtsang ba'i slob ma yang mang du byung ba las/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/mang nang gi gur zhing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ rna pa gzhon nu shes rab/skyi nor dzñā na dang bzhi la thugs kyi sras bzhir grags/ gzhan yang spu hrangs pa an ston grags rin/ rgya ye tshul/ gung ba dge bshes/ mang yul ba dkon mchog brtsegag rnam te/ bzhi po ni lo chen lo chung gnyi ga'i slob ma yin/ gzhan yang skyabastod rgyang ro spre'u dmar gyi rkyang pa chos 430

blos lo chen gyi zhabs la gtugs/ lo chen kha che nas byon ma thog ci cig la rdo rje 'byung ba'i dbang sri nas brgyud pa dang / ko sa la'i rgyan gsan/ dpal mchogakyang hol khongs cung da yod pa'i 'grel pa dbang dang bcas pa/ shab rtse rgya gar dang stabs shed du ga gi/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyang legs par gsan lag len ni dol bo sgom chen la bslabs/ bshad pa rnam gtso bor lo chung zhu / lo chen gyis kha che lan gnyis pa 'khor rje hol khong ba bas pa dang bca pa dang / sngar gyi chos 'phro lus pa yang gsan/ de rjes shangs sam ston ye 'bar gyis lo bdun du lo chen bsten/ de nyid snang ba'i stod 'grel dang / dpal mchog stod 'grel dang / dpal mchog hol khongs can dang / rdo rje 'byung ba dang / 'grel pa gnyis kyi lugs kyi dbang bka' dang dpal mchog rdor sems dang rigs bsdus kyi dbang bka' rnams zhus/ 'o chen ma bka' thob tsam mdzad na sbyangs pa phal che ba tshu chung la mdzad/ de na skyang stod kyi lce zhar gyi lo chen la thug cing / gtso bon yo chung mo bdun du brten nas spyir yo ga thams cad dang / bad par dpal mchog mkhas par byas nas myon/ /de nas spang kha dar chung gi pha gzhon nu rgya mtsho las stod kyi brag steng pa/ kul 'ching ru'i dmar ston cho kyi rgyal ma na/ sdog pa gle ston/bal shākya rdo rje/ thang ston kong kha ba sdobatagong kha ba rnamatsho kyis lo 431

chen la thug pa tsam byas nas/ slob gnyer gtso cher lo chung gi drung du sbyangs/ rngog gi ra dang / shangs kyi srad ye gzhon gyis lo chen la bsnyegs pas ma zin par lo chung la brten te rngog gi ser bas mtshan brjod 'grel chen la mkhas par byas so/ /lo chen gshegs rjes pho brang zhi ba 'od lo tsā la mkhas pas 'gyur mang po mdzad cing / lo paṇa mang po spyan drangs nas dpal mchog gi hol khongs rnams kyang legs par bsabs zangs dkar 'phags pa shes rab kyis lo chen la ma zin par lo chung dang / de'i zur chos pa man ston grags rin la brten nas/ de nyid bsdus pa dang dpal mchog gi bshad bka' dbababaka' dang / spyod rgyud ma bu'i bshad bka' dbang bka' rnams legs par gsan/ de nas pa ta gzhon nu bum pa spyan drangs nas dbus su byon pa'i tshe/ de gong du pa ta gam badzra dang ngas dkar gzhon nu tshul khrims kyis 'dam du rtse mo'i 'gyur ma da pa'i dbe dang / gzhon nu bum pas rgya dpe'i steng nas bshad/zangs dkar gyis lo tsā byas nas smon gro'i mar pa rdor mas/ khams pa zhwa ston/ yam shud klu chung gsum la bshad/ de nas lha sar byon pa'i tshe gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab ces bya ba rten dge bsnyen zhig gis lo paṇa gnyis la rtse mo tshar gsum gsan/ ma na dang yig sna mang du bris/zangs dkar dang nyi ma shes rab kyis gyis bal por skor cig byon/ /de nas lo tsā ba dang dpon slob gnyis pos minga' ris su byon/ lo tsā ba kha cher 0lha

bzhud/ gnyal gyis rtse mo tshar gcig bshad/ phyis kha che dzñā na shrī bod du byon nas chos 'khor ta bor bzhugs pa la/ lo gsum na pa ta bod skad byang bar gyur pas/ de la lo bdun gyi bar du legs par mnyan/mang nang pa la kun snying gi lugs rnams kyang zhus/ skyi nor tsā na la jo po'i lugs kyi sbyong rgyud legs par zhus/ phyis zangs dkar gyis rtse mo la la tsā ka yang mdzad/ pa ta thugs rje chen po dang zangs dkar gyis smad 'grel dum bu gsum yang myang ror rdzogs par bsgyur/ gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ mar pa rdor mas/ gnyan ston tshul 'bar/ spyang tshang pa nga ge rgyal mtshan bzhi la zangs dkar gyi bu bzhi zer te/ spyir zangs dkar gyis rnal 'byor snyi nang gi bshad pa mang po dang / bye brag tu rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la shin tu bka' drin che'o/ /sum ston ye 'bar la gnyan ston tshul 'bar dang / myang stod gtsang po'i rgya mong chos grags dang /stag tshal gdong ston pa sbu ston 'bar thog dang / khams pa shes rab rdo rje la sogs pa byung ngo / /dge shes gnyal pa'i slob ma sdur nyi ma 'od zer/de la glan chos 'byung / rtsa skya dkon mchog grags/ dmar chos rgyal/sgangs ston sher 'bum ste bzhi byung / khong gi sras rdo rje seng gis yo ga'i yig sna mang du mdzad/ chos rje rgyal sras rin po ches khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dbang gsan pa'i snur chos 'phags zhes bya ba de yang 'di pa'i brgyud pa'o/ /snur ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi sras chos rgyal la kun mkhyen 433

'phags 'od kyis mang du gsan/ 'phags 'od kyis bu rin po che la dbangadang bshad pa thams cad kyi bum pa byo'o/ /bu rin po ches ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bsdus pa'i don dang / 'byung ba'i bshad pa chen mo dang /gzhan rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mang du mdzad/ rnal 'byor rgyud la bag chags sad ces kyang gsung ngo/ /ding sang ni rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dbang bka' rnams phal cher yod cing / rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i bshad pa mdzad pa ni ma mthong ngo / yang rngog chos kyi rdo rjes/ dang por skyi bye ma lung pa dang / de nas khams pa shes rab rdo ri la gsan nas rim par brgyud de/ dkyil chog gsang ldan lag len dang bcas pa tshan yang dag par brjod pa'i bshad pa ni rngog pa rnams la ding sang gi bar du yod do/ /yo ga'i lo rgyus kyi skabs so/ /'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi skabs/rnal 'byor nang gi rgyud rnams las dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa ji ltar byung ba 'chad de/ de la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud ces bya ba yang brjod par bya ba don gyi rgyud dang / rjod par byed pa sgra'i rgyud gnyis su gnas pa las/ don ni gsang ba 'dus pa zhes bya ba ni/ sku gsung thugs ni rnam pa gsam/ /gsang ba zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /tshogs pa 'dus par rab brjod de/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 434

mngon brjod byed/ /ces gsangs pa'i phyir nyan rang dang theg pa chen po ba yang shin tu skal pa can ma yin pa dag la gsang bar bya ba nyid kyi phyir/sangs rgyas rnams kyi don dam pa'i sku dang gsung dang thugs la gsang ba zhes bya la/ de yang zhing phyogs gcig pa dang gdul bar bya ba phyogs gcig pa'i dbang du byas pa'i sangs gyis kyi ma yin par/ sangs rgyas thams cad tshogs pa'am 'dus pa'i bdag nyid can zung du 'jug pa'i sku la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sangs rgyas thams cad ces bya'o/ rda ni mthar thug pa'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ de rjod par byed pa'i rgyud la yang rgyud rnams kun gyi spyi bo yin no zhes bshad do/ /rdo rje 'chang zhes bya ba yang sgron ma gsal ba las/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag nyid can/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa/ dang po'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa chen po'i skyes bu'i gzugs/ ye shes kyi sku/ rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i bdag nyid can/ 'jig rten gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ theg pa gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ dus gsulagyi bdag nyid can/ rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ bden pa gnyis kyi bdag nyid can/ zhes gsungs pas na/ 'dus pa ba kha cig rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ci yin pa tshol zhing / sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa yin no zhes bya ba la sogs pa smra ba ni/ da ltar bshad pa'i sgron ma gsal ba'i don zugs su ma chud pa las min par snang la/ 'on kyang 435

gzugs rnam par snang mdzad ces bya ba la sogs pa dang 'dra bar/btags pa'i dbang gis de'i sku mdog dang phyag mtshan ci yin 'tshol na ni/rigs drug par rnam par bzhag pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i sku mdog la sogs pa gang yin pa de yin par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar slob dpon klu sgrob slob mar bcas pa rnams kyis kyang / 'dus pa chos kyi phung po stong zlog brgyad cu rtsa bzhi po thams cad kyi don gyi gtso bo yin par bathed la/ ding sang la la dag rgyud gzhan dang ma 'dres pa'i rang dbang can nyi tshe ba zhig tu khas len pa ni theg pa dman pa la mngon par dga' ba'i bag chags las byung ba yin no de bzhin du dri ma med pa'i 'od du yang / de bzhin du gsol ba 'debs pa po ni dpal 'dus par/ de nas phyag na rdo rje de bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rgyud thams cad kyi bla na med pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dpal 'dus pa sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par brjod pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ zhes pa de lta bu la sogs pas phyag na rdo rjes gsol ba btab bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dus kyi 'khor lo 'grel pa dang bcas pa yang gsang ba 'dus pa 'chad byed du gyur pa yin par bzhed pa yin no/ /dpal kye'i rdo rjer yang / sems ni 'dus pa'i gzugs can no/ /zhes kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'dus pa la mngon du phyogs par gsungs so/ /slob dpon nag po bas gsang ba'i de kho na 436

nyid gsal ba zhes bya ba'i gzhung brtsams pa yang / sang ba 'dus pa'i de kho na nyid de nyid bde mchog 'khor yo gsal bar 'chad do zhes bzhed pa yin no/ /'di ni bstan pa snga dar gyi du su lo tsā ba lce bkra shis zhes bya bas bsgyur nas/ bla ma rnying ma dag gis tan sdi bco brgyad po'i gtso por yang 'chad cing / bod kyi slob dpon snga mas 'grel pa mdzad pa yang 'ga' zhig snang ngo/ gyis ni lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang pos 'di'i rgyud dang / 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba la sogs pa'i 'grel pa dang /bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa ston pa'i bra mo yang mang du bsgyur zhing bshad pa yang mdzad par snang ngo / de bzhin du phyis nas kyi lo tsā ba mang pos kyang 'phags pa'i yul du byon nas 'dus pa bslabs shing bod du yang bshad mod kyi/ de rnams kyi nang nas rje 'gos nyid kyi rjes su 'brang ba dang bcas pa rnams 'dus pa'i bdag por gyur to/ de la 'dus pa ba rnams zhal mthun par 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di o ḍi ya ṇa'i rgyal po chen po ind+ra ṭwā ti zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa'i mthus/ thub pa'i dbang pos der byon nas dbang bskur zhing rgyud bstan te/ rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis kyang spros bcas kyi spyod pas legs par bsgrubs pas rigs pa 'dzin par gyur nas/ o ḍi ya ṇa'i gnas stongs pa lta bur gyur/ de mang klu las gyur pa'i rnal 'byor ma zhig gis rgyal po las mnyan nas/ des sto phyogs kyi sa bdag bai su rka la bshad/ de la bram the chen po sa ra 437

mngon shes can/ za hor gyi mkhas pa btsun mo can/ kong ka ṇa'i rgyal bu sprin gyi shugs can/ rdo rje gdan gyi nag po dam tshig rdo rje/ jo bo rje/ kha che gri bstan gyi mkhas pa tsand+ra rā hu la/ rgyal po'i khab kyi zhi ba bzang bo/ ye rang gi dge bsnyen chen po'am bal po cu gas rje chen po bal po rdzong gi na ba kyā ṭi pa/ nā ro pa'i slob ma kha che gle nā kā ra rnam la 'dus pa gsan/ ngor rje kun dga' 'od ni klu'i byang chub kyis ti tā ba la bshad des nā ro pa la/ des spu sa mi che ba/ de spu sa li chungab/ des ga ra gling pa/ des spa/ pa bsod stoms pa dang / mngonashe can dang / btsun mo can dang / dzñā nā ku ra bzhi la bshad zer/kha cig ni/ rdo rje 'chang / des rdo rje chos/ des i nd+ra thu rti la/des klu las gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba la sogs par 'chad de/rdo rje chos kyis ind+ra lhu ti la bshad zer ba 'di ni/ de kho na nyid kyi sgron ma'i rgyud las/ lha mo gsol ba/ gsang ba chen po'i rgyud 'di gi/shes pa dang ni bshad pa su/ /bcom ldan 'ad kyis bka' stsal ba/byang phyogs su dpal rdo rje'i gnas jo ḍi ya ṇa ru rgyal po i nd+ra :ti zhes bya bas shes pa dang bshad pa dang sems can la gsal bar byed do /lha mos gsol ba/ kye bcom ldan 'das rgyal po chen po ind+ra /ti shes bya ba de sa du'i dbang phyug lags/ /bka' rtsol cig/ bcorngo ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ dpal ye shes thig le'i rgyud kyi rgyal po la sa/ gang 439

zhig ngas bstan pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i rgyal po de nyid ind+ra lha ti sprul pa'i skus sa bcu'i dbang phyug ye shes kyi sku/ sa bcu bzhi'i dbang phyug do /zhes ma 'ongs pa na 'byung ba'i tshul du lung bstan pa'i 'di dang 'byor bar snang la/ gzhan yang lhan cig skyes grub las/ dpal ldan rol pa lha mo che/ /de bzhin dpa' bo rdo rje dpal/ /dam tshig ces bya rdo rje dpal/ /de bzhin padma rdo rje dpal/ /dpal ldan lhan cig skyes rdo rje/ /rdo rje dang ldan bram ze mo/ /de bzhin grub pa'i rdo rje dpal/ /dpal ldan gzhin rje'i rgyal po 'dis/ /dpal ldan 'khor lo mngon brjod pa/ /bla ma dge slong gnyid log ba / /de bzhin gzhan yang gang zhig lha/ /zhes pa'i 'grel phar/ de yang dpal ma ḍi ya ṇa'i yul na rin po ches brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i nags tshal dgon pa zhig na/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po'i sprul par gyur pa drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin pa zhes bya ba skal pa dang ldan pa rnams la lhan cig skyes pa'i rin po che'i man ngag gi rgyud bstan par bya ba'i ched du bzhugs par gyur to/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/drang srong 'gro ba dbugs 'byin pas rgyal po'i bu mo lha mo rol ba chen mo/des rgyal po chen po dpa' bo rdo rje/ des 'dun na 'don dam tshig rdo rje/des zhing pa padma'i rdo rje/ des chang 'tshong ma lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rje/des thag pa dga' ba'i rdo rje/ des bram ze ma rdo rje/ des 'dreg mkhan grub pa'i rdo rje/ des dpal ldan kun 'gro'i mgon po/ des rnal 'byor 440 sto

pa thugs kyi rdo rje/ des lcam la mā chen mo/ des rgyal po ind+ra bu 'amalu ba pa la bshad do zhes bya ba'i don 'di dag gsungs te/ lu ba pas o ḍi yā ṇa'i yul nas 'phags pa'i yul du rgyud rnams dar bar byas so zhes bya ba'i gtam dang sbyar na/ 'dus pa'i bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa khungs can du 'gyur ram snyam ste/ slob dpon ā rlu de bas spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron mar lu ba pa'i lung drangs nas bshad pa'ang yang 'byor ram snyam mo/ kha cig rgyal po ind+ra bu dang lu ba pa gang zag so so bar 'chad pa rnams kyis ni/ lhan cig skyes grub kyi 'grel pa 'di bshad par mi nus so/ /lhan cig skyes grub kyi gzhung 'di yang 'dus pa'i rgyud la brten pa ste/ de'i 'grel par theg chen shin tu yangs pa las/ /theg bya ba ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba ston par byed pa rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud de zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyal po ind+ra hūṃ tis mdzad pa'i ye shes grub pa yang 'dus pa la brten par shin tu gsal la/gsang ba grub pa zhes grags pa yang 'dus pa la brten par gzhung de nyid las shin tu gsal te/ 'di las slob dpon āryā de bas spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron mar lung du drangs so/ /gsang ba grub pa'i mdzad pa po padma rdo rje zhes bya ba yang zhing pa rngasgo'i rdo rje bya ba nyid yin pa 'dra'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa du ma las byung zhing / rgyud thams cad kyi spyi bor gyur pa 'dus pa'i rgyud 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba dang bcas pa la ni/ rje 'gos kyis 441

'gyur bcos kyang lan gnyis su bya / phan pa yang shin tu che bar byung zhing / gzhan yang gung brtag sam gsum/ brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa rin chen phreng ba/ bde mchog bshad rgyud dang bcas pa dang / rdo rje gdan bzhi bshad pa dang bcas pa dang / ma hā mā 'i la sogs pa'i rgyud mang po 'grel pa dang bcas pa bsgyur zhing / bshad pa yang mdzad la/'dus pa'i phran rnams la yang 'gyur bcos mdzad de/ mkhyen pa rgya chen po dang ldan pa de'i slob ma mchog ni/ mang ra seng gi rgyal mtshan/ rngog dbus pa ge ser/ dab mi byang chub rgyal mtshan/ sto pa rdo rje snying po/gnyal pa 'gar chos kyi rdo ri/ dbus pa ha gsum drug tu grags/ de drug ka la rong pa rgyal le dang / rko ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis zhus/ /rtso bo mgon pos dab me'i slob ma rgya nam mkha' dang rong ba rgya le'i slob zhang rgyab ma spang sgang pa gnyis la gsan nas rgya cher bshad pas slob ma shin tu mang bar byung zhing / 'dus pa'i yig sna yang mang po mdzad la/ de'i slob ma sgo9spru chen chos la dga' la sogs pas kyang 'dus pa'i bshad pa mang du mdzad do/ /tre bo 'di 'dus pa'i bshad pa la phan che bas/ khong gi dgon pa na sgron ma gsal ba yang lnga brgya tsam 'dug ces thos so/ /yang 'tshur ston dbang nges 'gos kyi slob ma mang ra seng ge rgyal mtshan/ 'gar chos kyi shes rab/ rngog ge ser/ dbus pa rga sum ste bzhi la 'gos lugs gsan/ de la 'khon gad pa tī rtis 'gos 442

lugs rnams gsan/ de la dge bshes 'gar gyis gser gyi brgyad stong pa dang nor zang bcu phul nas zhus/ de la gnyan ston ri rtse bas zhus/ /yang jo bo rjes 'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi gdams pa rnams nag tsho la gsungs/ des rong pa phyag sor pa la bshad/ des zhus lan pa la/des lha rje ri ston la gnang / de la ngor rje kun dga' 'od kyis zhus/ngor rje 'di ni 'dus pa'i rgyud bran dang bcas pa rnams la rnam par bshad pa yang mang du brtsams/ de las mched pa gnyal dang dgas po rnams su mang bar byung ngo / /yang sho ston rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang rong pa rgyal les shung ke lo tsā ba dar ma rdo rje la bshad/ shung kes dab mi la yang dbang bskur zhus/ shung ke 'di la spa tshab lo tsā bas kyang 'gos lugs gsan zer zhing / shung ke la dol pa 'gar ston dbang phyug grub kyis gsan/des bla ma gze ba'i sras jo bde la/ des jo bo 'tshar pa sna pa la/ des lhab mi la'o/ /mang / mang ra seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis rngog ye shes la bshad/de rngog nyi ma seng ge la bshad de/ nyi ma seng ge 'di ni mkhas pa'i grags pha che bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa shin tu mang bar 'dus ste/ rtsa da kyi ṭwāṃ ka la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du brtsams nas 'dus pa'i bstan pa spel lo/ /des glan rtsang tsha nyi ma lcam la bshad de/ nyi ma lcam gyis rgyud kyi tsā ka mo che zhig kyang mdzad snang ngo / /nyi 443

ma lcam gyis jog ārya de ba la bshad/ /'dis rje btsun grags pargyal mtshan la yang gtugs/ āryā de bas rtag pa rin chen grags la bshad/de la kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis gsan te/ 'di ni kha che paṇa chen gyi skye bar grags zhing / bstan bcos thams cad gzigs pa tsam gyis thugs su chud par gyur pas kun mkhyen zhes kyang grags te/ 'dus pa'i bshad pa yun ring du mdzad pas slob ma'ang mang du byung / khong gi slob ma bla ma 'phags 'od ces pa 'phags yog dus gsum la mkhas pa/gdams pa'i mdzod du gyur pa des khong la gsan/ 'phags 'od kyis thams cad mkhyen pa bu rin po che la zha lu nyid du byon te/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang yo ga'i phyag len dang bshad pa mang du mdzad/ cha bu rin po che'ang 'dus pa la shin tu mkhas par gyur te/ 'phags pa'i gsung gis bskul bar gyur pas sgron ma gsal ba'i ṭā ka chen mo mdzad/ gzhan yang 'dus pa'i chos skor mang du brtsams/ 'gos nas slob brgyud rim par byung ba la bu ston nyid mkhas par rtogs/ des 'dus pa'i skor rnams khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams la bshad/ de la rje tsong kha pa chen pos gsan pa yin te/ de yang spyir bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po dang / bye brag tu 'dus pas sa stongs khyab par gyur pa'i byed pa po ni rje tsong kha pa chen po'o/ 'di dag ni 'gos las brgyud pa'i gtam rags pa tsam zhig bshad pa ste/ zhib par bdag gis bshad ga la nus/444

bsam yas kyi lha btsun sngon mos chos 'khor btsugs pa'i dus su/gsang 'dus 'phags skor la mkhas pa shung ke dar ma rdo rje dang / dbus pa 'phags skor la mkhas pa spa tshab lo tsā ba gnyis spyan drangs pas/ spa tshab gsang 'dus la mon nas shung ke la gsan pas 'gyur la ma mnyes nas/pa ta ti la ka ka la shas mdzad nas spa tshab lo tsā bas 'gyur yang rgyud 'grel phran dang bcas pa la mdzad cing legs par bsgyur/ bshad pa yang mdzad do/ deng sang gi bar da brgyud pa bzhags pa ni ma mthong ngo /ri ra chag chos rje dpal gyis kyang dang por rngog mun de'i slob ma jo btsun ta ga pa/ de'i slob ma gung thang gi jo bo lha mgon po dpal zhes pa la gsang 'dus 'gos lugs bslabs/ de nas bal lo'i pa ta nyi ma'i dbang po'i 'od zer la legs par mnyan nas/ rgyud 'grel dang mdor byas rim lnga sogs kyi 'gyur yang bcos/ sgron gsal gyi bsdus pa'i don pung sgyu ka yang mdzad de skye bo mang po la phan par mdzad do/ /7 yang kha che zla ba mgon pos sgom pa dkon mchog bsrungs la sgron gas man ngag gi bshad pa dang bcas te gnang zhes 'byung ba la/ ding sang de'i daphe la sogs pa ni mthong bar ma gyur to/ /'dus pa 'phags lugs kyi skabs so/ / 445

be shes zhabs lugs kyi skabs/gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs zhes grags pa de mi nga bod kyi yul 'dir sgo du ma nas byung ngo/ /de la slob dpon sangs rgyas shes ni/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa'i pa ta ste/ des yul ma ga dha'i bye brag kha khri zhes bya bar grong khyer rdo 'jog tu/ slob dpon nga ge bzang po zhe bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu gyin pa'i tshul la shin hūṃ khas pa/ rje btsun gyi snang ba thob par yang grags pa de mnyes par byas nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu sbyin pa dang / de las gzhan pa'i gzhung yang mang du thos shing / rigs pas kyang rnam par dpyad pa mdzad nag slar nā lend+rar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa'i 'grel ba la sogs pa brtsams nas gzhan dag la bshad pa mdzad/ de nas sngags kyi theg pa btsal ba'i phyir yul dbus nas byang du dpag tshad nyis brgya sum cu na mo ḍi yā ṇa'i yul yod de/ yul de mkha' 'gro ma mang pos byin gyis brlabs pas gsang sngags kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir der bgrod de/de na nor bu'i gling du sku 'khrungs pa'i slob dpon sgeg pa rdo rje zhes bya ba la/ bya ba dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mang po thos shing 'bad pas legs par bslabs so/ yang gnas de'i phyogs gcig na/ bsam mi khyab kyi rim 446

pa'i man ngag thob pa/ de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma gu ni ru zhe grags pa'i drung du bgrod cing mnyes par byas te/ bla na med pa'i rgyud mang du thos par byas/ dbang dang dam tshig la sogs pa yang dag par blangs te/ de nas sgom pa la yang zhugs so/ /yang lhas rmi lam du bstan pas/ rtso ḍi yā ṇa'i byang gi sgo srung pa gdol pa dza ba dza la zhes bya ba'i bu mo yo bcu drug yon ngasazhig yod pa de ladzi mā chen mo min pas der song zhes byung ba ba na 'bral du song ste/ de dang bshes su 'thams te ba brgyad kyi bar du mnyes par byas so/ /des kyang slob dpon phyag rgya chen po la brod par rtogs na de'i cha rkyen sgrab pa'i phyir phra mo'i lung btsal ba tsam gyis gnod gnas kyi grub pa tho༄ba bo/ de nas dza lan tta rar skyon te grong khyer ko nee dzer gyi phyogs gcig na/ byis pa chung ba'i zhab zhes bya shes rab kyi rgyud la lhag par mkhas pa zhig yod pa de la lung mang po thos zhing sgom pa lanan tan du mdzad do/ /de nas yul dbus nas sto phyogs su dpa tshad sum brgya phyin pa na/ yul rdo zhes bya ba nam mkha' la nags tshal 'khrigs pa zhig yod pa de'i phyogs zhig na/ slob dbon zu sgrub kyi slob ma slob dpon bsrung ba'i zhabs zhes bya ba thabs kyi rgyud la rab tu mkhas pa/ de dag sung rdzu 'phrul slob mas bskor ba zhig yod pa de'i drung du byon nas/ bla ma de la bram ze tsa tra ra zhes bya ba dang /bram ze gu hya brta zhes bya ba dang / rgyal rigs mañdzu shrī zhes bya ba dang /447

rje'u rigasabudma bha dra zhes bya ba dang / dmangs rigs dī baṃ ka ra zhes bya ba dang / dmangs rigs khan bu rtu zhes bya ba dang / smad 'tshong ma ā lo tī zhes bya ba dang / smad 'tshong ma duḥshi la zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul thob pa dag yod de/ de thams cad kyi 'phral gyi yo byad lha mo nor rgyun mas nyin re zhing gser gyi māṇa bcu dang / mu tig gi do shal phyed dang /kārsha pa ṇa sum brgya re sbyor ba zhig yod pa de'i drung du lo dgu'i bar du bsten nas/ skye ba gcig gis thogs pa ste/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor la skye ba gcig gis thogs pa rnal 'byor gsum pa'i mthar phyin par mdzad do/ /gnas der rnal 'byor ma rnams dang lhan cig pa'i spyod pa yang zla ba bco brgyad kyi bar du mdzad do/ /de ltar 'bad kyang de kho na nyid mngon sum du ma rtogs pas/ bla ma bsrung ba'i zhabs la de skad du zhus pa na/ bsrung ba'i zhabs kyis/ de ni kho pos kyang ma rtogs zhes gsung bas thugs cung zad chad de/ rang gi phyag rgya ma glegs bam gyi gzugs su bsgyur te/ mgul du btags nas/ byang phyogs su rdo rje gdan gyi rgyab ku ba dza zhes bya ba'i nags su phyin to/ /nags de yang stag dred la sogs pa shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas te/ spyir byang chub kyi snying po la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i sems can rnams 'khor ba'i nags nyon mongs pa'i gcan gzan gyis gang bar gnas pa yin la/ bdag kyang de kho na na gnas pas de las thar bar bya ba'i phyir/ gnas der lha drag tu skul ba'i cho ga la brtson 448

pas zla ba drug tu gnas pas/ gzod chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid rtogs so/ /ji ltar rtogs na/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis dge slong 'ban po sham thabs bye zhing chos gos la thod byas nas zhing rmo zhing /chung ma ngan ma zhig dang khyi mo dkar mo mtshan ma can zhig tu sprul/ der slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gzigs pas 'di dag ci 'dra ba zhig snyam du the tshom zos so/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshen gnyen gyis sangs rgyas ye shes sngags kyi spyod pa mchog la gnas par gzigs nas/ de la phan pa'i phyir 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor sprul to/ /de yang ston zla ra ba'i mar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi skar ma mgo dang lag gnyis yol ba tho rangs kyi dus so/ /der bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gang la mos zhes dris pas/ dkyil 'khor la mos zhes zhus pas/ dge slong bla ma gnyis dang bcas pa khang pa chung ngu zhig gi nang du zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas sangs rgyas ye shes kyis de kho na nyid blang ba'i phyir/ khyod ni sems can kun gyi yab ste yum yang yin/ /khyod kyis bdag la sogs pa 'jigs pa che las skyobs/ 'gro ba'i dbang po rje btsun khyod kyis sdug bsngal sel/khams gsum gtong byed che bas che khyod skye bo skyongs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gsol ba btab pas/ der dkyil 'khor gyi gtso pos zhal i lung legs par bka' stsal bas/ slob dpon gyis de kho na nyid thugs su chud de yang dag pa'i ye shes la dbang ba'i rnal 'byor par gyur to/ /de 449

nas 'jam dpaladabyangs kyis slob dpon la ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la phan pa'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa'i sgrub thabs kun du bzang po dang / kun du bzang mo dang / kun du bzang po'i don bsdus pa ste rnam pa gsum dang / sbyin bsreg gnyi kyi cho ga dang / gtor ma mi nub pa'i sgron ma dang / tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga dang / rin po che 'bar ba dang / /rgyud kyi rnam bshad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga sgo ka bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa dang / rtsa ba'i ye shes chen po dang / chigs lasu bcad pa'i mdzod dang / grol ba'i jig le dang / bdag sgrob pa dang / byang chub sems kyi thig le dang / dpal bkra shis kyi rnam par bshad pa chen po dang / bzhi pa la'ajug pa thabs dang bcas pa dang / chu sbyin dbang bo'i sgrub pa'i thabs gsum ste/ lung dang mthun pa'i chos bcu bzhi rtsoms shig par bkas gnang ngo/ /de la kun du bzang po gsum po gcig tu byas/ chu dbang gi sgrub thabs gsum po'ang gcig tu byas/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad ni slob dpon gyis ma mdzad bas na/ lhag ma rnams la lung gi chos bcu bzhi zhes grags pa yin nam snyam mo/— /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yang dpe kha cher khyer nas yul dbus na med do/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes de lam mthon po de kho na nyid mngon sum du mdzad pa la mnga' brnyes kyang /gzugs kyi phung po ni gnas ma gyur zhes gsungs so/ slob dpon des rdo rje'i gdan nas rgyang grags lnga bcu yod pa'i sa/ dbang chen ri'i phug tu 450

gnas bcas te bka' stsal ba'i chos/ rgyud kyi rnam bshad ma gtogs pa rnams brtsams shing slob ma rnams la legs par gsungs pas/ slob ma'i mchog bco brgyad byung zhing / de rnams kyi nang nas mar me mdzad bzang po/ rab tu zhi ba'i bshes gnyen/ sgra gcan zin bzang po/rdo rje bde ba chen po ste bzhis ni tshe de nyid la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rgo 'phang mngon du mdzad do/ /slob ma lhag ma bcu bzhi po'i mtshan ni gsalabar ma nges la/ /slob dpon sman zhabs kyang slob dpon gyi dngos kyi slob ma ni yin no/ sman pa zhabs kyis zhal lung gi 'grel pa la sogs pa bstan bcos mang du mdzad la gzhan yang 'di'i slob ma rim par brgyud pa rnams kyis rgyud kyi 'grel pa dang / rim pa gnyis kyi gzhung mang du brtsams pa las bod du yang shin tu mang bar 'gyur ro/ /dus phyis slob dpon bha yas dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rdo rje phreng ba brtsams pa yang /dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhi brgya lnga bcu pa la gtso bor brten pas na/ yeshe'akhalhabs lugs kyi khongs su gtogs so/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas yeshes zhab kyis dus phyis rdo rje gdan dang de dang nye ba dag tu bzhugs te/lha khang gsar du bzhengs pa dang / mchod pa yang rgya chen po mdzad dozhes grags so/ /bod du ni ye shes zhabs lugs rnams dang por lo chenarin chen bzang po la mang du byung nas slob ma rnams la yang gsungs shing rim par brgyud do/ /pasnyi ta tho tis kyang khams su ye shes zhabs lugs 451

rnams mang du bshad/ sngon gyi slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis kyang ye shes zhabs kyi dngos kyi slob ma yin la/ de gnyis kyis mdzad cing 'gyur ba'i chos rnams kyang ye shes zhabs kyi lugs so/ /bar du pani ta su na ya shrī dang gnyan lo tsā bas kyang bod du ye shes zhabs lugs mang du bshad cing / gnyan gyi slob ma snang kha'u ba nas kyang mang du 'phel lo/yang lo tsā ba gnyos 'byung bos rgya gar du byon nas/ dpal nā ro pa dang dus mtshungs pa'i ba li ā tsam zhes kyang bya/ nag po zhabs chung ba zhes kyang bya ba de la ye shes zhabs lugs rnams legs par bslabs/de'i sngar gyi brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i bshes gnyen/ rta ji pa dpal bde ba chen po'am mtshan gyi rnam grangs ka ma la ku li sha dang yan lag med pa'i rdo rje/ slob dpon yi ge pa/ 'di ni rgyal po shrī dharma pā la'i yig mkhan/ sha ba ra pas byin gyis brlabs pa las mchog gi dngos grub brnyes nas/ sngar gyi rgyal po'i bla mar gyur pa'o/ /slob dpon kuṇḍa pa ste rab tu byung ba'i mtshan tsanda ni bra bha wa/ dbang bskur ba'i ming ratna badzre/ 'di yang dngos grub brnyes pa yin/ tsā na shrī mi tā ni khri kra ma shrī la'i dbus kyi ka chen no/ /des ba lin sgyu tsayi la bshad ces 'byung ngo/ /gnyos 'byung pos rang gi sras 452

ngo rje bla ma/ des rang gi sras gnyos dpal le/ des rang gi sras gnyos grags pa dpal/ des rang gi sras rdo rje gzi brjod dam sangs rgyas ras chen rgyal ba lha nang par grags pa de la bshad/ des rtsa rgyud kyi tā ka yang brtsams/ sto brag dang / skyi skad/ lha nang la sogs pa rnams su mang du bshad cing / bye brag tu lha rin chen rgyal po dang gtsang dge brag pa tshul khrims gzhon nu gnyis la gsungs/ de gnyis ka la mkhas pa byang chub dar gyis gsan/ /des gzi brdzid rgyal po la gsungs/ des bla ma mgon po rin chen/ des snyan ston kun dga' dar/ des bla ma ri pa shākya bzang po/ des gnyos rdo rje bla ma zhes bya ba gnyos lo tsā ba'i gdung brgyud du 'khrungs nas/ chung ngu la rab tu byung zhing tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa/ dbus gtsang gnyi sar sbyangs pa phun sum tshogs pa mdzad pas ye shes zhabs lugs la mkhas par gyur pa de la/bdag gi ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang 'jam rdor dang 'jig rten dbang phyug gnyis dang / rgyud kyi bshad pa/ zhal lung la sogs pa'i man ngag rags pa phal che ba thob pa yin no/ /'di'i dbang gi brgyud pa gzhan ni/'jam dbyangs/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ kun dga' snying bo/ tha ga pa/ shārnyi pa/ sri ka ra/ pa/ ka ra/ de gnyis la lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rkyang po chos blo/ dge bshes skyabs se/ rdo rje sra brtan/ dkon mchog 'bar/ ngagi bshes dbang 453

rin/ khams pa sa phug pa shākya rdo rje/ rong pa chos mgon/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ yang sangs rgyas ras chen/ ston mo lung pa ye shes mkhar/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od/ chos rje bu ston/ rin rnam pa/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzangs/ de la bdag gis ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang legs par thob bo/ /yang gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang gi brgyud pa / jo bo rje/ lha btsun pa byang chub 'od/ 'ol ba byang chub rdo rje/ rgya lcags ri gong kha ba/ jing bu kha pa/ bang stod pa chos kyi 'od/ shang yes/ gze ba don grub mgon/ bar thang ba yab zas/ dar ma shākya/ bsod nams dbang phyug so tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bu ston kha che/byang chen 'jam rings pa/ kun mkhyen shes rab dpal bzangs/ des bdag la nang ba lags so/ /ye shes zhabs lugs kyi skabs so/ /gshin rje gshed kyi skor gyi skabs/gshin rje gshed kyi skor rnams jo bo rjes nag tsho lo tsā ba la gsungs shing / 'gyur yang rgyud dang 'grel ba lhan skyes snang ba sogs bsgyur/ yang nag tshos nag po dam tshig rdo rje la yang gsan/ dam tshig rdo rjes phyis dbus gtsang du byon nas gshed skor gyi bshad pa mdzad pa 454

las kyang mang du mched cing / na tshos rong pa phyag sor ba la gshed skor bshad pa las kyang ched/ 'go kyibatakyang gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud la bshad pa 'ga' re mdzad/ nga 'i 'char kur grags pa la yang phyag len mdzad do/ /lo tsā ba gzhan dag la mang lung tsam byung mod kyi/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grag kyis gshed skor mang du bshad cing / rgyun yang ring du gan pa yin no/ de la rwa spo tsā ba rdo rje grags ni/ snye na snang yul du 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus na lha mo re ma tis phu rung nang du bcug nas zla gleganyis su khams bskor zhing / de nas ma la gtad/ dus gyis rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par yang rdzogs/ de nas bal yul du bal po thugs rje chen po la gtso bor brten cing / de la nā ro pa nas pradzñā ra ta/ des bal bo rgyags rje chen po la gsungs nas/ de la rwa los legs par gsan zhing mang du mkhyen pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang / sa ṭa dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / rgyud bla rdzomangon brjod bla ma dang / lha rsha samangon 'byung dang / kun spyod dang /phagaso mngon 'byung dang / nag po'i cho drug dang / ri i pa/ rdo rje 'jigag byed kyi skor dang / gshin rje gshed nag po'i skor dang /gdong drugatagingaskor dang / ma rna brjod dang / zhal gnyis ma'i skor dang / sgom gyi dadams ngag dang / bar phu dang mgon chung la sogs pa grog ser gyi gad bsapa dang bcas pa mapogyi / de rnams pazlo ta 'ba' 455

zhig gi chos las bod chos dang bsres pa ma yin pas/ 'bre shes rab 'bar gyi zhal nas/ bod du 'gyur ba'i chos la dge bshes rwa lo tsā ba'i chos las zhe zhim pa med de/ pa ta mkhas pa rnams kyi dgongs pa lon zhing / bod chos kyi sres slad med pas so zhes gsung / phrin las phun sum chogs pas 'khor yang lha btsun sngon mo la sogs pa che dgu dang /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang 'gar stong btsan nam mkha' dang / zhang tshes chung ba dang / so tshab 'dul 'dzin dang / gnyags ri pa dang / 'bre shes rab 'bar dang / 'ban dkon mchog rdo rje dang / rog mngon pa ba dang / zhu bka' gdams pa dang / mtha' bzhi pa so thang pa dang /stag pa kha che dang dpyal lo tsā ba kun dga'ardo rje dang / zhang sa ga pa dang / zhang gtsang 'od dang / sgang ind+ra dang / snur nyi ma dang ba reg thos pa dga' dang / lha rje dab dang / gran bu ba rin chen grags dang / spun rgyam legs dang / thun se bo shākya rgyal dang / thun tsand+ra dang / thun rdor po dang / rgya lod chos grags dang / mar pa bsod rin dang / ma me mi nyag dang / gyi dar sed dang / byang ran ston pa dang / myang dang / rog kyugs se dang / khyung po dar ma 'bar dang / khyung po phu re dang / sna lo tsā ba dang / 'tshe mi bsod nams 'bar dang / 'tshe mi tshul po dang / bur tsand+ra dang / zhang dang / rwa sgom rdo rje rgyal bo dang / rong pa rgya le dang / ma 456

brgyad cu rtsa bzhi la gser gyi sdud pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi bstan pa ma zhig par du klog pa'i cha rkyen ga ra srang brgya/ bla ma bha ro phyag rdum la gser zang brgya phul/ gser srang gsum bzhi tsam re la rkyen byas nas ha mu nyis brgya tsam bsags pa'i tshogs 'khor brgya rtsa brgyad btang / bal bo thugs rje chen po bod du spyan drangs nas phyir thegs dus gser srang stong brdzangs/ma gshegs bar du 'bul ba thengs sum cu so bdun thengs/ bsam yas kyi 'khor sa klu mes dang sba reg gi chags sda nga gis me pho khyi'i lo la bsregs/ gang tshun chad 'gyel ba la 'ol kha nas shug pa rnams gtsang po la gyen la drangs/ gyang btang / shing bzo/ gser bzo/ lcags mgar/ lha bzo la sogs pa'i bzo bo lnga brgya tsam gyis 'o gsum gyi bar du zhig gsog byas/ de'i zhabs tog lag len ni ston pa rin chen rdo rjes byas/ spyir na de la khal 'bum tsho cig song/ de'i tshon rtsi lhag gis gtsang 'phrang gi khyams dbu rtse dang bcas pa gsos/ kun lo gnyis song /gnyer lo tsā ba rwa chos rab kyis byas/ yo byad khal khri tsho gcig song /gnas gzhi rnams su zhabs tog mdzad pa la/ dur smrig pa la 'bum cha gsum gyis sna drangs 'bul ba mang du phul/ der bstan pa ma zhig bar du 'gron zan gtang ba'i cha rkyen la rjed stoms kyi khal khri tsho gsum phul/bye mda' ba la mdo sdes sna drangs pha'i pu sti brgya/ 'gron zan rgyun gyi cha rkyen khal khri tsho gsum phul/ dkyus thang pa la 'bum chas sna drangs pa'i 458

pu sti lnga bcu/ lo re bzhin 'gron zan zla ba re'i cha rkyen la khal khri tsho gcig nyan tsho ba dang / lcang ra ba la yang de dang mnyam pa phul/sho skyam pa la mdo sdes sna drangs pa'i pu brgya ma pa/ 'gron zan thes khal khri tsho gcig re dul ba la de dang mnyam pa phul/ sma tsa 'bum tsho 'bum btab/ 'bum tsho re la khal bzhi bcu'i cha rkyen du bcad/ klog 'don rgya dpe'i nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa 'don pa'i ma tsa ra'i mchod gnas drug : yi ba sgom pa re dang bdun rgyun du 'degs/ gzhan yang gsung rab brgya tshar stong tshar mdzad/ rngog lo la 'bum gyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba dang / khri tsho phogs byas pa'i chos 'khor btsugs/ de dang mnyam pa glang ri thang pa la yang phul/ de bzhin du btsan kha bo che la yang de dang mnyam pa phul/ rgya 'dul la 'bum gyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba dang / brgya phogs kyi chos 'khor btsugs/ de dang mnyam pa jo btsun khyung la/ de dang mnyam pa 'bre la/ de dang mnyam pa 'ban la/de dang mnyam pa rogs ngon pa ba la/ de dang mnyam pa stag pa kha che la phul te/ gtam 'di rnams bla ma me shes seng gis mdzad pa'i rnam thar las btus pa'o/ khong gis spyir chos mang du gsungs pa dang / khyad par gshin rje gshed kyi skor rnams 'khor nyis stong lhag pa la gsungs snang bas/ de rnams las 'phel ba bgrang bar mi nus la/ gzhan de dag gi bshad pa'i rgyun rwa lo tsā ba chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum 459

seng / rje btsun rgya lo/ bla ma shes rab seng ge ba khu dbon sku mched rnams la nar mar byung zhing / de dag las mched pa yang bgrang par mi nus so/ gshen rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa la/lo tsā ba graṭa pa rgyal mtshan dang shong blo brtan gnyis kyi 'gyur snang na'ang /rgyud la bshad pa'i grol byung bar ni mi thos la/ gshin rje gshed dmar po la yi dam du mdzad pa ni dpyal chos bzangs dang / chag lo tsā ba dang /bu rin po che la sogs mang ngo/ /gzhan yang grub thob dar paṇa dang re benda'i slob ma glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis bai tna ba las brgyud pa'i gshed dmar gyi man ngag gzhung chung dang bcas pa yang dbus gtsang du mang du mched na'ang / dar paṇa las brgyud pa'i rgyud kyi bshad pa ni byung bar ma thos so/ /gshed skor gyi skabs so/ /bde mchog gi skabs/dpal bde mchog gi dbang dang rgyud gyi bshad pa sgrub yig dang bcas pa mang du byung ba rnams dang por lo chen slob brgyud dang bcas pa la yang byung zhing / phyis ni mar pa do ba dang / spu hrangs lo chung dang /mal gyo la sogs pa las rgyud kyi bshad pa mang du byung ste/ de yang rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ sha ba ri dbang phyug de'i slob ma tā yi pa yin te/ 'di la kha cig ni lu i pa zhes zer/ kha cig ni lu 460

nyi pa zhes zer ro/ /bdag gi bla ma paṇa chen gyi zhal snga nas/ des mdzad pa'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i yi ge tshigs su bcad pa bco brgyad pa'i rgya dper sla yi zhes pa snang bas 'di kho na dag pa yin gsung ngo/ /sla yi pas rgya~X po dā ri kā pa dang / blon po tshe pa la bshad/ des je rje dril bu ba la bshad/ des ru sbal zhabs can la/ des dza la ra pa la/ des nag po spyod pa ba la/ des rnam rgyal zhabs la/ des tikhri pa la/ des nā ro pa la bshad do/ /de yan chad kyi rnam par thar pa rnams ni shin tu mang ba snang bas mthong bar sla ba'i phyir ma bris la/ nā ro pa ni bai kra ma shrī la'i byang phyogasakyi sgo bsrungs pa yin/ de la slob dpon shārti ba dang / rje btsun ze ci bas kyang gsan/ shārnyi ba la ni jo bo rje lha gcig gis gsan pa yin te/ jo pos ni mnga' ris su lo chen dpon slob la gsungs shing / gtsang rong gi 'gar dge ba la yang gsungs te/ de yang lha sbas kyi 'grel ba'i steng nas gsungs pa yin zhes grags so/yang dbus su nag tsho lo tsā nga dang / khams pa bgres po zhig la yang gdams pa rnams gsungs so/ yang bal po pham mthing ba zhes kyang grags ma des me chen po zhes kyang zer ba de la/ gcen po dharma ma ti/ gcung sgo dus 'khor ba dang /thang chung ba gnyis te sku mched bzhi yod pa la/ dharma ma tis nā ro pa'i 461

sbyan sngar lo bcu gnyis bzhug / de pham mthing bas spyan 'drin du phyin pas/ gcen gyi zhal nas/ khyod rang 'dir sdod cig nga bla ma'i lung bstan yod bas ri bo rtse lnga la 'gro zer nas gar bzhud cha med par bzhud do/ pham mjing pas ni tsā ro dzilo dgu bsten/ bde mchog dang kye rdor la sogs pa'i chos mang po ga na/ khyad par du bde mchog gi sgo nas dman pa dang 'bring gi dngos grub kyang thob par mdzad/ gcung po dus 'khor bas nā ro pa'i spyan sngar lo lnga bzhugs te/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i chos mang du gsan/ tha chung thang chung bas kyang dus 'khor ba spyan 'dren du phyin pas/ nā ro pa la dbang dang rgyud man ngag da nga bcas pa cung zad tsam thob/ thang chung ba la gcen po'i zhal na / khyod ngag gi dbang phyug bsgrubs sheg gsung nas bsgrubs pa / chu la mi tog bskur ba la lan ga rim du yar log byung ba'i dang po gnyis sus kyang ma mthong / tha ma de yar log byung ba blangs pas ngag gi dbang phyug che 'bring gnyis ma thob kyang / tha ma tshigs su bcad pa rtsom pa dang mang po zin pa tsam zhig byung / tosamar la log dus g.yog po lha dartas de'i chu la 'thungs pas kyang shes rab shin tu che ba gyur / pham mthing ba'i gsung gis thang chung ba la/ khyod bod du song la gser tshol 'dir rgyun bzhag gi ze sbor ba gyis gsung ba la/ thang chung bas lha dasta g.yog tu khrid nas gnyal tshun chad du byon/ g.yog po bha dmas dur smrig 462

tu rta gso zhing bsdad pa'i tshe/ bod skad shes shing brang ti la mngon pa kun las btus mnyan pas shes/ slob dpon dang rtsod pa byas pas kyang bha dasta rgyal/ bha dastas nga pad ta byas te 'ong bas de'i tshe slob dpon gyis sne len dgos zer ba byas/ khong dpon g.yog gis gser srang lnga brgya rnyed/ rgyun bzhag dang tshogs rgyun ring du ma chad par yod pa yin no/lo tsā ba klog skya shes rab rtsegs kyis pham mthing ba la bde mchog skor gsan nas bod du byon pa'i tshe/ mal gyo po tsā ba blo gros grags kyis bde mchog gi dbang dang sgrub skor rnams zhus/ phyi mal gyo nyid bal por byon nas pham mthing ba sku mched dang / nā ro pa'i slob ma byang chub bzang po dang / bal po ka na ka shrī'i slob ma bal po thugs rje chen po rnams la bde mchog skor legs par gsan/ de la bla ma sa chen gyis gsan/ des gyis rgyud la bshad pa mdzad pa'i tshe sku lung pa bsod nams rdo rjes zin bris tsu btab/ de la sa chen gyis ma da pa'i tā rkang yang grags/ sa chen gyi rang gi zas rtse mo sku mched la gsung / rje btsun gyi sa skya pa chen la bshad/ dmar chos kyi rgyal pos rje btsun la bde mchog gas snang / paṇa chen la rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa yang legs par bslabs/ dmar chos kyi rgyal po de ni/ spu hrangs lo chung gi slongam dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbon brgyud yin te/ dpon po dmar shes rabardo rje/ sgrogapa shes rab brtson 'grus rdo rje rnams byung ba las/— 463

rang gi khu bo brtson 'grus rdo rje la ra gi bla ma nas brgyud pa'i bde mchog dang / yo ga dang / lo tsā chos drug la sogs pa yang thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /sa skya pa yab sras las mched pa'i bde mchog gi bshad pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa 'byung bar ni rigs na'ang /dmar chos rgyal tsam gtogs gzhan ma thos pas yi ger bri bar ni mi nas //// sa mar pa do ba ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha stag gi brgyud pa las mar 'brog bla do'i rgyags su sku 'khrungs/ yab dge bshes chos rgyal bya ba yin/ khong rang gi mtshan chos kyi dbang phyug/ dang por pa ta zhig la skad bslabs shing / rong zom chos kyi bzang po la yang gtugs/gyis go rub lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba la yang bslabs/ de nas bal yul du byon/ der mar pa sto brag pa rgya gar nas tshur log pa dang mjal zer/ 'di dang cog ro chos rgyal gyis mjal ba'i gtam brgyud ltar na/lo tsā ba 'di rje mar pa'i sum cu rtsa gcig pa tsam la 'khrungs pa 'dra/ sku tshe'i tshad ni dgu bcu rtsa lnga bzhugs/ des mar pa sto brag pa la gser zho gang gi phyag rten byas pas/ ga ra se ba re la yang 'thogs 'ong bas khyed rang khyer/ nga bod du gser 'chag tu 'gro ba yin gsung zhing /nā ro pa spyodapa ra gshegs nas med pas nā ro pa'i slob ma bzhi la chos nyon zhes gsung / de nas ti ra hu tir phebs dus mi mang po 'du zhing 464

par zhus/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang kun spyod gnyis ka la dpal sgam po ba'i bkas tā ka rgyas par mdzad/ bskyed rim gyi bshad pa dang / dril bu ba'i rim pa lnga pa'i 'grel pa yang mdzad do/ /mar pa do ba nyid kyis kyang rtsa ba'i rgyud dang kun spyod gnyis ka la bsdus don dang tā ka rgyas par mdzad / /ra do'i sras po nam mkha' 'od ces bya ba 'khrungs pa la/ yab kyi bshad pa dang gdams pa ma lus pa mnga' zhing / skyid skad la sogs par byon nas/ gdams pa phran re re tsam gzhan la bshad na yang / yab dang dus gcig tu grongs pas 'phel ba chad do/ /gze bas rang gi sras bde mchog rdo rje la legs par gsungs/ de nas brgyud nas mang du 'phel/ /de la mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis ni yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge la bde mchog gi bshad pa gsan/ khong gis khang gsar ba bsod nams mgon la gsan 'dug na'ang de yan gyi brgyud pa nges pa can ma rnyed gsung ste/ mar do lugs ni yin no/ /dbang ni/ sangs rgyas/ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ sla yi ba/ ṭi ba/ lu ba pa/ ind+ra bo ji/ ka tsa ba/ dril bu༄ ba/ dza la ra ba/ nag po pa/ ku sha la na/ ti khri pa/ nā ro ba/ man ka shrī tsā na/ bal po bha darnya/mar pa do ba/ gze ba blo ldan/ gze ba jo bde/ slob dpon khu lhas pa/ slob dpon lho tshang ba/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpa la ldan seng ge/ bu ston te/ spyir bu ston rin po che la bde mchog gi dbang 466

brgyud mi 'dra ba bdun bzhugs so/ /bu rin bo ches kyang snya yi pa'i lugs kyi mngon par rtogs pa dkyil chog dang bcas pa yang mdzad/ nag bo pas mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la 'khrul spong zhes bya ba'i tā ka brtsams shing / rtsa ba'i rgyud dang kun spyod gnyis ka la yang tā ka mdzad do/ bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga yang mdzad de dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mang du mdzad pa las/ cho ga 'dir dbang bzhi pa rgyas par bshad de/ cog ro chos kyi rgyal mtshan mdo smad du sa pho byi ba la 'khrungs nas/ lo bcu dgu la rgya dmar gyi grwa sar phebs/ 'di'i sa byi dpa spru phag mo gru pa lcags stag la 'khrungs pa'i gong gi sa byi de yin/tshad ma rnam nges dang / dbu ma rang rgyud du grags pa'i skor rnams gsan zhing mkhas par mdzad/ nyi shu rtsa bzhir do la rnam nges kyi bshad pa mdzad/grwa sa der rje phag mo gru pa/ mkhan po ka ba/ 'bal tshad ma ba rnams dang dus mtshungs/ der do pa'i sras jo sras nam mkha' yang byon pas/gdams ngag phran 'ga' yang zhus/ mar dang khams pa e seng la gsan pa mang po mdzad/ gzhung du rngog mdo sde la dgyes rdor dang yo sogs gsan/ ri na chen ljon shing zhes bya ba'i yig cha yang mdzad/ de rting bla ma do pa'i drung du snga phyi lan gsum du byon nas 'bul bas kyang mnyes par mdzad/ lo bzhir bde mchog gi phran ngang bcas pa'i gsan pa mdzad pas mkhas par mkhyen/ rdzo sras kyis khungs byung nas zab pa'i gdams pa yang 467

gnang / der bla ma lo tsā ba dgu bcu rtsa lnga la gshegs/ de dang nye bar jo sras kyang gshegs/ de rting dpyal lo kun dga' rdo rje zhes bya ba/ha mu dkar po'i dngos kyi slob ma de la phag mo bslabs/ de nas rnam nges kyi bshad pa thogs shig mdzad de/ gnam mtsho la lo drug tu bsgoms de nas me dge lha 'tsho btab ste bshad grwa dang sgom grwa gnyis su mdzad/slob ma khyi ra ba lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bzhud pa yang byung / rtsa ba'i rgyud la tā ka mjod nas mang du gsungs shing / rang lo drug cu rtsa dgu'i bar du bzhugs te/ me spre smin drug gi tshes gnyis la gshegs/gzhung bshad pa'i srol dge bshes gu shrī 'brom pa dang / rong po dge rings la sogs pas gzung / byin rlabs dbang gi bka' 'bri khung slob dpon chen pos mdzad/ gdan sa zhang gis bskyangs/ zhang gi mtshan tshul khrims shes rab/ des 'bri khung pa la gtugs nas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ de'i slob ma kun du 'od/ de gnyis kyi slob ma rom po ba'o/ /gtam 'di dag ā tsam dharma ke tu'i bzhed pa mkhas pa g.yor ston las rnyed pa yin zhes grags so/ /de la kun tu 'od ni che ming yin la/ mtshan dngos dbang phyug seng gi/ rno ra ba yang zer/ de'i slob ma zhang btsun smon lam dbang phyug ni/ me spre nas lcagar spre'i bar gya lnga/khro lo'i yang slob ma yin/ shin tu mthu che 'o de'i slob ma rdzod pa ni chu stag la 'khrungs/ nyi shu pa lcags bya la gdan sar bskos/ drug cu 468

rtsa dgu pa lcags khyi la gshegs/ de'i slob ma bla ma dam pa rin po che/zhes 'bod pa de shing mo lug la 'khrungs/ bcu drug pa lcags khyi la gdan sar bskos/ so dgu pa chu bya la gshegs/ 'di la gnyan thog jo 'bum zer ba 'dra'o/ /de ltar bde mchog gi bshad rgyud ring du byung ngo/ /mkhas pa chen po rgya nam mkha' la khye bo mgon pos bde mchog mar do'i lugs bshad pa'i rgyud bzhi dang bcas pa legs par gsan/ de la sdus ra sgang pa gnyan rdo rje seng nas gsan/ des snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa la dgyes pa phul du byung bas gnang ngo/ /mar pa do pa'i lo chung grags pa shes rab kyis ni/ mar dos gsan pa'i bla ma rnams la yang rgya gar dang bal por gsan pa mdzad la/ phyis ni rgyal po'i sras ṭī ma de ba la yang mang du gsan pa mdzad de/ chos lo chen pas lo chung che'o zhes grags pa des kyang / slob ma mang du bsdus nas bde mchog gi bshad pa ring zhig tu mdzad pa'i 'phro de nyid la/ las stod sto'i shrī'i phug par mtshams mdzad de/ de'i mod la mkha' spyod du gshegs so/ /de'i rjes su dmar chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa tsam ma gtogs slob ma gzhan rnams las bshad pa'i rgyun byung ba yang ma thos pa nyid kyi phyir bri bar ma nus so/ /gzhan yang rong gi sum pa lo tsā ba dharma yon tan gyis bal por byon/ parnyi ta dza ya se na zhes kyang grags/ dam pa khang gsar ba zhes kyang bya ba/ dus phyis bod du byon nas rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis kyang bsten pa de la 469

zhus nas bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud dang / de'i 'grel pa grub thob mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa dang / dza ya se nas mdzad pa'i dbang dang mngon par rtogs pa la sogs pa'i rin po che sna bdun du grags pa'i gzhung rnams la 'gyur mdzad/ rgyud dang 'grel pa sanyis la rang gi khu bo dpal mchog dang po'i rdo rje'i bkas kyang 'gyur bcos mdzad de sgo du ma nas bod du dar bar gyur pa las/ chos rje rang byung rdo rjes kyang de'i yig mang du mdzad/ 'grel pa mdzad pa po mtsho skyes de ni 'di nyid kyi brgyud pa la yod pa'i badma rdo rje de nyid yin pa 'dra'o/sdom pa 'byung ba la ratna rakṣi tas 'grel ba mdzad cing chag chatsā ba yang de'i dngos slob min bas bshad pa'i bka' yod dam sems so/phyi ni rje btsun tsong kha ba chen pos kyang bu ston rin po che las brgyud nas rtsa ba'i rgyud labasha da rgyud dang 'grel pa chen po rnams gung legs par bsgrigs pa'i ṭī dku/ dang / mngon rtogs dang dkyil chog/ dril bu pa'i lugs kyi mngon dkyil/ dril bre rim lnga'i rnam par bshad pa/ sbu yi pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor chen po nyams su len lugs/ lnga yi pa'i mngon rtogs kyi bshad ga'adod 'jo rnams mdzad de/ 'khor zlo sdom pa'i lugs nyams par gyur pa gso bar mdzad do/ /bde mchog gi skangags so/ 470

phag mo gabyung drug gi skabs/bde mchog gi bshad pa'i rgyud rnams la brten nas phag mo lha so bdun ma gis bya ba yum 'ba' zhig gi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur zhing / dkyil 'khor de nyid la bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rim pa yang mang du byung ngo/ bye brag tu sdom pa rgya mtsho 'i rgyud la brten nas phag so'i gzhung drug tu grags pa'i byin rlabs/ gzhung gi bshad pa/ nya mas len gyi rim pa rnams gangs can gyi khrod 'dir sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa phal mo che la byung ngo/ /lugs 'di yang mi burnyi'i lcam lha mo dpal mos rje btsun bai rū pa la gnang des a ba ju tī pa chen po'am bsod stoms pa chen po zhes grags pa de la gnang ba yin te/ yul shar phyogs bhaṅga la ba/ rigs rgyal rigs/ phal chen pa'i sde ba las rab tu byung / gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje la rnal 'byor du byed pa zhig yin te/ de nam zhig na nyi zla khong du chud pa la sog pa'i rmi ltas la brten zhing / khrir wa pa'i drung du phyin te rnal 'byor ma'i dbang bskur zhus pas de nyid du zhal gzigs/ rgyud dang gad sa ngag mas cad gsan zhing nyams su blangs/de nas bai rū pas spyod pa la bskul/ spyod pa la zhugs nas gaṅgā'i 'gram na mu stegs nga rtse gsum gyi steng du mchongs te shi ba la bar bar 'dzin pa de'i rtse gsam gzhan gyis bskyod mi nus pa zhig yod pa phyung na gaṅgā la 471

bor/ mu stegs pa rnams kyis gsol ba btab pas slar yang rtse gsu/ma phyung ste khong rang rnams la gtad cing / lam de la thar pa med par bka' stsal/ de lta bu'i grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu des ldong dar ba rjes su gzung ste/ de ni yul ma ga tta pa'i rigs ngan yin/ de yang chos bya bar 'dod pa drag po skyes/ a ba ju tī pa chen po zhes bya ba mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa de bhaṅga la na bzhugs par thos nas rab byung gi chos su zhugs/sa/ pa na mang po khyer te mjal du phyin pa na/ btsun rgan zhig glang dor gyis zhing rmo/ chung mas 'bu 'thu ba zhig mthong / dang por cung zad ma dad kyang / da 'di nyid la gsol ba gdab dgos snyam nas/ kusta pa na phul nas bdag rjes su 'dzin par zhus pas/ khyod nga la ma mos pa gsung / de bden lags zhus shing mang du gsol ba btab nas lo gsum phyag phyir 'brangs pas/ gzod byin gyis brlabs pas phag mo'i zhal mngon sum du mthong / dngos grub khyad pa can yang brnyes/ de nas slar byon te dza lan tta rar bzhugs pa na/ mu stegs pa zhig khri kra ma shrī la ba rnams la rtsod pa dang nus pa 'gran no zhes zer ba la/ kho'i gdong bzlogs pa rnyed dka' bar gyur pa'i tshe sdong dar bas mkhyen te byon nas/ der rgyal por dpang du bzhag nas rtsod par chas pa'i tshe/ kho na re/ nus pa 'gran nam rtsod zer/ khyed nyid gang dga' ba bya'o zhes gsungs pas/'o na ngas khyod la sbrul btang gi zer nas/ bas dug sbrul chen po 'od 473

lhag lhag pa zhig zar btang ba la/ slob dpon gyis phag zhal phyung ste tug sgra dang bcas pas gsol zhing pham par byas nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la btsud do/ /kho na re/ lha phag zhal can nged mu stegs pa'i yin gyi sangs rgyas pa la med zer bas/ sdong dar bas sgrub thabs mdzad/ ldong dar bas bsod stoms pa chung ngu rgyal bas byin rjes su gzung ba yin te/de ni sto phyogs be ta la'i rgyal po bu med pa zhig gis ston mo chen po byas pas bu zhig byung ba de la sto dza de ba zhes bya bar btags/ phyis de rgyal por gyur pa'i tshe nags skad du 'khor dang bcas te byon pas/ der sdong dar bas ci yang med pa'i rnal 'byor pa zhig tu byas te rgyal po la lta stangs yun ring du byas pas/ rgyal po khros te/ 'khor rnams la 'di sod cig par bsgo bas/ de nas sdong dar bas bden pa'i gtam mang du byas pas/ rgyal po de nyid du rgyal srid spangs nas sgom pa la zhugs te/ lho phyogs kyi yul du bsod stoms pa rgyal bas byin zhes bya bar grags shing grub pa brnyes so/ /bsod stoms pa des tsha'o sangs rgyas byin phyags phyir khrid nas bal yul du byon te/ ma he bha ro'i sgo drung du bsod stoms mdzad pas/bha ros g.yog mo zan dang chang skyel du btang bas/ khong gi thod par chang blugs pa'i tshe chang khol bas/ g.yog mo ngo mtshar skyes te bha ro la bzlas pas/ lha ro dad de bha ro nyid kyis bsod stoms skyel du byon/ de nas bha ro la sogs pa'i bsod stoms la spyod cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de ba ā 473

ka ra tsand+ra gsang mtshan stongs nyid ting 'dzin rdo rje dang mjal te/ slob dpon de ni grong khyer chen po la 'gal gyi rje'i rigs/ bu gcig po yin/lo brgyad lon pa'i tshe phas chung ma blangs shing khyim gzung zhig par bsgo ba las/ nga ni chos byed zer nas ma nyan pa la/ gang du byed dris pas/nga la 'gro sa yod zer nas 'phags pa dza ma li la zhag bdun du bskor ba byas pas/ de'i zhag tha ma la da rgya gar gyi yul du thong zhig ces smras te rgya gar du byon/ bai kra ma shrī lar rab tu byung bar zhus pas/ dge 'dun gyi grangs ma tshang zer nas rab tu 'byung du ma gnang / der sgra tshad la bslabs pas shin tu mkhas par gyur te/ bal po ratna shrī dang mjal na sa ṭi dang kye'i rdo rje gsan pas mkhas pa chen por gyur te/ lo yang ṇḍi shur byon/ rang gi khyim du byon pa na sku bsod kyang shin tu che bar gyur to/ /de'i tshe bha ro'i mchod gnas bsod stoms pa zhes bya ba zhig bzhugs zer ba la shin tu dad nas/ ras pa co ra gsum khyer nas mjal du byon/khyod parnyi ta zhig nga ci yang mi shes pa zhig la zhu'am gsung pa la/ yang yang gdams pa gnang bar zhu ba phul bas/ da 'o na byin rlabs bya dgos pas cha rkyen tshol cig gsungs nas/ ma he bhā ro dang gnyis kyis lhan cig tu byin rlabs zhus/ de'i tshe chang ka pā la gang la bla mas byin rlabs mdzad pas/ ji tsam 'thungs kyang zad pa med pa zhig byung / tsha bo sang rgyas byin gyis byin rlabs byas pas kyang de bzhin du byung / der 474

chos bshad cing gdams ngag gnang / de ba ā ka ra tsa nd+ras zhal gnyis ma che ba/ don grub ma che ba/ sbyin bsreg rnams la yi ge mdzad par zhus pas ma gnang / sbyin bsreg ni sangs rgyas byin la bla ma'i bkas gnang nas khong gis mdzad/ yang ha mu dkar pos sbyan drangs nas kyang byin rlabs dang gdams pa tshang bar zhus/ byin rlabs mdzad pa'i tshe bu mo lnga dgug pa'i sbyor ba mdzad de/ ha mu'i chung mas mi mthong bar mdzad pas/ bu mo ma mthong bar chang skyogs nam mkha' la 'dug pa chung mas mthong bas/ 'di ji ltar lags zhus pas/ nga'i byin rlabs yin gsung / de'i tshe bal yul du stong nyid ting 'dzin/ ma he bhā ro/ha mu dkar po/ sangs rgyas byin te slob ma bzhi bla ma dang lnga tshogs par gyur to/ ha mus gser srang gsum phul/ de nas bla ma rgya gar du 'gro gsungs nas slob ma gsum pos rdo rje gdan gyi bar du bskyal/ lam du jag pa byung ba'i tshe da ji ltar bya zhes zhus pas/ thabs yod gsung nas jag pa la byin rlabs phab pas jag pa rnams gar byed cing 'dug pas de'i bar la byon/ slob ma gsum po rdo rje gdan nas phyir log/ bla ma ni sto phyogs be ta lar bzhud do/ stong nyid ting 'dzin gyis lo drug tu bsgoms pas yon tan khyad par can brnyes kyang / zhal gnyis ma che ba dang don grub ma che ba'i yi gi mdzad pa de bla ma'i bka' las cung zad 'ag ge bas zang zing gi sku bsod bri ste/ 'jig rten pa'i mkha' 'gro mas 475

bar chad byas pa yin gsung ngo/ /'dis mdzad pa'i gzhung gzhan yang shes rab ye shes gsal ba dang / bdag med ma'i mngon par rtogs pa dang /spyan ma'i ngan song yongs su sbyong ba dang / kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mdzad pa rnams ni bod du 'gyur ro/ /de la ha mu dkar po ni mtshan dngos bsod nams 'byung gnas bzang po/ yon tan gyi ming ba re/ ru tso ste mchog tu dbang po gsal ba'o/ /'dis stong nying ting 'dzin la yang legs par zhus so/ /de la dpyal kun dga' rdo rjes gsan te/de yang dpyal 'di rnams chos rgyal khri srong sde btsan gyi blon por gyur pa zhig la bu gsum byung ba/ rgyal pos dkar nag khru gsum du btags pa las dpyal dkar nag khru gsum zhes brgyud pa dang bcasapa la grags/ji ma phal cher rnying ma'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag pa sha stag tu byon/de rnams las dpyal 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba des gser mang du bsnams nas pasnyi ta sgri ti ra jir gyur ba las jo bo rnams la gser byin nas thus/ de rjes smre ti la sku bsod chen po skyes/ bres su pa tas chos gsungs pas gser g.yu'i char bab bar gyur/ bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gsan par khams su bzhud do/ /dpyal 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan gyi dbon po se tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis bal por byon nas pham mthing ba la gtugs nas/ kye'i rdo rje la sogs pa nā ro pa'i lugs rnams gsan zhing / kye rdor gyi ṭā la mdzad pa la yang dpyal ba rnams la 'chad 476

nyan gyi rgyun yun ring du byung ngo / /des bha ba bha dra'i 'grel pa la sogs pa 'gyur mang po yang mdzad/ de'i dbon po kun dga' rdo rjes bod du zur lugs kyi rnying ma rnams la shin tu mkhas par sbyangs shing / yab mes kyi gsar ma'i skor dang / bal po kā ya shrī las nam mkha' skor gsum gyi gdams pa la sogs pa yang thob/ /kā ya shrī gser srang lnga bcu tsam gyi 'bul bas mnyes par mdzad/ rte gyis bal por byon nas ha mu dkar po la gzhung drug po rnams byin rlabs dang bcas pa zhus/ ha mus khyad par gyi gdams pa rnams ma gnang ba la/ yang ha mu dang de'i btsun mo la yang 'bul bas mnyes par byas pas khyad par gyi gdams pa bcu gsum po yang banang / de'i tshe rgya gar phyag na yang bal po na bzhugs pas/khong dang stong nyid ting 'dzin gnyis la yang bla mar gzung / phyag na sku bsod che bas spyan mi 'drongs snyam nas/ de ba ā ka ra spyan drangs pas sku bsod tsam ma byung / /yang phag mo'i chos skor 'di rnams snubs ston gyis bal po ha mu la zhus nas de las kyang mched/ khu ge tsos bal por ha mu dkar po nyid la zhus shing / snubs ston la yang mnyan nas 'gyur 'ga' zhig kyang mdzad de de las kyang mched/ /rwa lo tsā bas rgya gar gyi pazlo ta ma snyi yukta la phag mo'i skor rnams gsan zhing / de la rngog mdo sdes gsan nas yig cha'ang 'ga' re cha/dzad 477

snang ngo/ /lo tsā ba blo ldan she rab kyis kyang bal por byon nas ha mu dkar po la gsan te/ stong nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung gnyis po'i 'gyur yang yang dag dzimadzad/ /mdor na bod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal mo che la phag mo'i gdams ngag gis khyab par snang ste/ delas ji ltar brgyud pa'i phyogs tsam zhig bri ba ni/ de la dpyal kun dga' rdo rje legs ston stag ris pa slob dpon ston sa kyis zhus/ de la bla ma lha bzos zhus/ yang dpyal la ra ston gyis zhus/ de la jo zas yang dag dang zhing 'od kyis zhus/ yang dpyal la nyid kyi zas dang bla ma skyi ston gnyis kyis zhus/ de la rin po che rgyal tsha/ khro phu lo tsā ba/bla chen bsod dbang / rin po che bsod nams nga ge/ 4yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge/ bu ston rin po che/ brag nag pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ chos lung tshogs pa'i mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/ /yang dpyal gyis zar ston lo tsā ba/ snar ston zhig bo/ grags pa tshul khrims/ rgyab thob dkon mchog grag / 'phags pa yon tan rgya mtsho/ bla ma 'jam rgyal/ mkhan po klu sgrub/ dka' ba ba dkon mchog gzhon nu/ de nas yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge'o/ /dpyal la yang dben pa bsod seng / sras dpyal kun dga' grags dang / lha lung pa dang gsum gyi zhus/ de la dpyal chos bzangs/rong pa gi lo/ rong pa sher seng / bag ston gzhon tshul/ stag ston 478

gzhon nu dpal/ bla ma a mo snya badzra/ mkhan chen rin rgyal ba/ /yang dpyal kun rdor/ gtsang pa yang dag rdo rje/ dbus pa shes rab rdo rje/ lce mdo sde seng ge/ gru shākya 'bum/ lce blo ldan seng gelce rje btsun bsod nams dpal/ lce dbang phyug rdo rje/ mkhan chen rin rgyal ba /yang mnga' ris skyi ston/ thur la pa tshul khrims skyabs/ thang be pa 'phags pa skyabs/ gser sdongs pa gzhon nu 'od/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer/ lce blo ldan seng gi ste/ de ltar lugs lnga'o/ /phag mo gzhung drug gi skabs so/ /yi ge ba ni dol pa nyi shar yin/ /
(nya)ra༅༅//deb ther sngon po las/ mnga' bdag 'o rngo ba chen po mar pa nas brgyud de dwags po bka' brgyud ces grags pa'i skabs bzhugs so//

tsā'i skad rnams bslabs shing legs par mkhyen/ dus phyis/ dpal myu gu lung gi dgon pa ru/ /sgra sgyur 'brog mi'i lo tsā la/ /sgra thad klog skod kyi yig tshang bslabs/ kha' bka' drin mi chung che bar 'khums/ /zhes kyang gsungs/ rje 'brog mi'i chos rnams la yo byad shin tu che bar dgos pa 'dug pas/ khong gi chos 'di rnams kyang rgya gar nas byung ba yin/ da nga rang/mang rgya gar rdu 'i snyam pa'i 'dun pa skyes/ der yul du byon nas gser srang bco lnga tsam zhig rnyed/ las stod du klog skya jo sras kyis zhwa lham tshun chad nas gser dang bcas pa'i rdzong ba mdzad/ nga rgya gar nas log dus sne len mdzad dgos ga ngas pa / nga rgas pas khyed dang tshe ma la mi shes/ bu kun sna len byed du gzhug go zer/ de nas bal por byon pa'i tshe/ gnyos kha rag pa dang stob tsu byung bas/ khong gi zhal nas/ rgyad la gser ci yang mi 'du pas nga'i g.yon gyi / nga dang chos stobs su zhus pas chog gsung ba la/ khong gi stong ba bzhin cung zad ma bgyis te/ bal por lo gsum chu stom zhing bzhugs/ bal po spyi ther ma la dpal gdan bzhi pa la sogs pa'i rgyud 'ga' yang nyan/ lo gsum song ba dang bal po ben pas 'dren pa 'dzad nas spru tpa ha rir rje nā ro po'i drung du pa la/ dge tshul shes rab nga gi zhes khye bas kyang zhu sna mjode/ cu gas la 'dogs pas lha'i rdo rje'i rdokhri rang ya de lan padun rgya / gzhan rgyud/ sgrub thabs 48

rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i man ngag rnams kyang nags par gnang / gzhan rgya gar nub phyogs tu la kṣe tra'i grong du/ bla ma bar lam ston nam ye shes snying bo la gsang ba 'dus pa rgyung rkyang gi lugs rnams leg par gsan/slar nā ro pa'i drung du byon nas sgron ma gsal ba'i bshad pa legs par gas / ma hā rmā blo yang dbang byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par ga nga / de nas slar bod du byon te/ ming phyogs su phyug bo 'ga'i sri'u gso ba/ lha mo dud sol ma la brten nas mdzad de/ zi'i re re la ga pa'i yon srang bcu bcu phab/ nam ra'i ga ra kha rdo dang 'a ma ma dab / tsam nang gi mar pa mgo yags bya ba des rus gcig pa'i zhen byas nas dbang zhus shing / nye 'bangs dang bcas pa la ga ra 'bul du bcug pas phyag tu gser mang bo yang dag pa byung / ge nas mar pa mgo yags kyis skyi rong gi la rtsa tshun bskyal/ de nas bal po nas rgya gar du gyo / skyal dbus su phebs pa'i tshe nā rdo pa spyod pa la gshegs zi na mjal rgyu ma byung / spyod pa la gsheg khar nā ro pas slo ma rnam la rten rnams so sor gnang nam/ mar pa'i ska ba min zer ba zhig bzhag na snang / der bla ma gzhan chos 'dra ga na zhing /dgyes rdor gyi rgyud tshar gzigs rtogs mdza na/ nā ro pa tshol ba'i 'dod pa chen po skyes te rgya gar shar snyogal da sgyu sto phyogs rnams gyi yul nu mar bzod/ de'i tshe gso ri kro gas pa'i grub thob mang dku 485

dang yang mjal/ rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor ma gzhan 'ga' re la yang gdams pa sna tshogs gsan zhing / dad pa chen pos btsal bas rnam zhig nags gseb cig tu mjal te/ gser rnams phul bas thams cad gtor/cung zhig yid ma ches pa na zhabs kyi mthe bong sa la reg pas sa de gser du song / zhal nas kyang / thams cad gser gling yin no zhes gsungs/de nas mi snang bar gshegs/ de la rje mar pa ni snga gong nyid nas/rje ti khri bas/ sto ṭa'i ma rig mun sol la/ ye shes snang bas khyab par gyis/ /zhes lung yang bstan/ bla ma spyod pa la gshegs nas mjal pa'i skabs tshun chad du thugs dam ji ltar 'khrungs pa la sogs pa'i tshul ni brjod pa las ngadas so/ de nas slar yang bod du byon te bal por phebs nas pham mthing ba la sogs pa'i bla ma rnams kyi drung du nā ro pa'i yon tan dang rang nyid kyi ngang tshul rnams spur blangs/ bla ma mched grogs dang bcas pa rnams kyang dgyes par mdzad/ de'i tshe lo bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa yin/ de nas bod du phebs te yul sa gzung / bdag med ma yang btsun mor blangs/ gzhan yang btsun mo ma phyag rgyar sdo ba brgyad tsam zhig yod par grags te/ kye rdor lha mo dgu po dang sbyor ba yin/ yang ze tri ba'i bsngags pa gsan pa thugs drangs te gyi gar du byon nas/ rgya gar shar phyogs su mnga' bdag ze tri ba dang mjal/ rgyud kyi gsan pa mang po yang mdzad/ phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag gis mngon sum gyi rtogs 486

mar pa mgo ya / rje gzhung pa/ 'tshur dbarnga ji/ mi tsho po/lha rje se ring gye ston zhig bo mang pa byi ze ba/ byung sgom sprong rtog btsun mi la rnams so/ga na mang gnyal gyi shung ska lnga ba can la sgron ma gsal ba'i bshad pa ming dag par ga nga sti/ dir rmādzi rang gi slob ma la bshad pa lan 'ga' ngar bgyis rdo nga rgyu ring za ni ma rgyungagasdo / /de rnams las rngog chos rdor 'chur dbang nge / sa tsho sbo/ mi la rab pa rnams la ka chen ba mja zi / rngog gis dang por rte bzang po zhig phyag rten du bsnams lha mig tu ma la spa ma/ 'od kyi 'di chosi zhu ba'i zhu rten yini ni ni chung / gig bsi cima'i rten 'dzi4 cani chi zhi spya kyi sungs/ dir thubang dang gad ngasagi ri gnang snang sku/ gyis ri bor spyor bee nga sa nir 'ji gdag mjud tsu lha ra tsā dnge / she ma/ zo ba gcig rnams kyang phu la ti rna 'i kyi cardo ba di po'i rgyud gur/ dpol ga don bzhi pha/ la hā mā yā snams gonang kyi ba khrid kyis kyang bskyongs/rngog gi zhal nas/ nga rang gi mo 39do kyi sa de las ma ldangs/ bla ma'i chos la ni zad pa me pa yin ska zhung / yang rje mar pas sku 'di khor ming gzhungangari bong phebs pa zhig yin ya 'dra sti/ rngog gi ma mo mdo sdes rje snar pa las lung tsam tho spu/lo ma da son pha'i tshe rje rnar lha gi ga / bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe yab 4 88

gshegam zhes 'byung ngo / nā ro pa'i ga sta gad ngag hūṃ ma zad/ dme pa'i gzhung bshad dang gnams pa rna spya sbudang pas/ rngog spra rnams gur gyi gzhung re re'i ste du nā ro rī snyikonanyis sa'i bshad pa mi 'tha za re mdzad do/ jog chos kyi rdo ri ni/ rje mar pha nyi zhu sna lnga pa/ gyi ba la 'khrung / rang gi drug cu rtsa bdu dzichu nde rta'i za sa mkha' ston du gshegs/ sbyang rje mar/sa chu pho gyi ma la 'khyung das brgyad cu rtsa drug pha mi mo glang gi mang du bzhud / rda kho na nyid kyi rtogs ma chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang ldan yadzā / — ma sa pa rnams gyi'adzimathos bang byu smad bsrel ba/ la 'gami rna'akhru dang 'thab pha/ mkhor las dang zhing la 'ab zhig mtshan par snang / skal ba dang ldan pa dag gi mig sam du grong 'jug kyang lan bzhir mdzad de/ ṭo nyeci ru pa'i sprul pa do zhes grags lha/ khong gi lo sum cu rtsa gcig bzhes pa'i tshe/ jo tho rje zad/du snyon/ nas lo tsā za dang khu ston brtson 'argyas g.yung sbong gnyi khong las lo gci'akhogis bgres/ mar pa'i lo drug pa me mo sbrul la rgya gar phyag na 'khrungs/ lo de la gru meng gyi thang po che btam rje mar pa'i chu pho byi ba 'di/ la ba rdo rje nasgo phyug gsucagabacu rtsa dun pa yin grwa pa mngon shes zhes ma'i skad khro che de yang rje mar pa dang skye sa lo gcig/ 'di gnyis kyis bcu drug sa pa sgro/ rtsis pa rnam kyi rnamakha' rgya mtsho sa 'das slo ba ba'i thog ma me tho yos de byung ba 48

min/ mar pa'i nyi shu rtsa dgu pa la rje btsun mi la dang ba ri 'o tsā ba gnyis 'khrungs/ mar pa'i sum cu rtsa gsum pa shing pho spre'u la rma ban chos 'bar 'khrungs/ mar pa'i bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa sa mo phag la rngog lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab 'khrungs/ mar pas lo nyi shu bzhes pa lcags mo lug la po to ba 'khrungs/ mar pa'i nyi shu rtsa gsum pa shing pho khyi la 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po 'khrung / mar pa'i drug cu rtsa gnyis pa chu mo glang la sa skya dang ni'u thog btab/ drug cu rtsa lnga pa me pho 'brug la mnga' bdag rtse lde'i chos 'khor byung ngo / 9 rje mar pa la slob ma ka ba bzhir grags pa las/ mes rngog 'tshu ra gsum po ba sgo po'i bka' gzung la/ mi las sgrab pa'i bka' gzung ba mi no/ tsho de la mes tshon po bsod nams rgyal makān gyis myang ro dang gtsang rong gnyis /ra brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa mang du bshad/ gnas gzhi pa do gzung / ṭī ka yang brtsams/ khong rang gi gdung brgyud mes kun po/ jo mthong blo gros kyi bar du grub pa thob pa 'ga' yang byon/chos brgyud ni/ zhang bsod nams mkhar gyis mar mes gnyis ka la thugade nas bde gshegs ye shes snying po/ zhang ston kun dga' grags/bla ma rin chen/ shākya rgyal po/ zhang ston pa grags 'byor gyi bar du mis lugs kyi bshad rgyun dar zhing / rgya mtsho grags la sogs pa brgyud pa'i slob ma ṭwāṃ ka byed pa yang mang du byung / gdan sa sangs rgyas 'bum 90
