mis sgom sder yang mes lugs kyi bshad pa'i rgyun gzung ngo / /rngog gis gzhung du bshad pa'i rgyun sprengs pa las/ slob ma ram tsan can/ spa sgra ba can/ rngog dad pa can/ rgya 'a ma can/ sum pa phod ka can/sto pa chung ma can/ gnyal ba rngog chung ma can la sogs pa mang du byon no/rda'i sras po rngog mdo sde ni/ las stod kyi mkhan po spug ye rgyal gyi skye ba yin/ jog chen po dang / spa ba can gyi ming sring spa mo chos brtson gnyis kyi sras bu lcags pho rta la 'khrungs nas/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa bdun la gshegs pa'i bar du dbang dang rgyud dang gdams pa rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don shin tu rgya che bar mdzad de/ bod kyi sngags pa gcig la bsod nams che bar grags pa yin/ bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i zhal gzigs shing / thabs lam la mnga' brnyes pos/ slob ma rnams la thabs lam gyis skye ba med pa'i don mngon sum du rtogs su gzhug nus pa/bshad pa kheyang rin chen rgyan 'dra la sogs pa'i bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ nya mo gyur du 'chims chen po dang / bla'i zhang la sogs pa'i dge ba'i bzhes gnyen che dgu bsdus nas chos 'khor chenaca mdzad/ de'i dus su rje mar pa'i dpon mo zhig lha sa skor du byung bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po de rnams la bzod pa gsol nas/ dpon mo de nyin gcig gi gral dpon byed du bcug/ des rje mar pa'i gdung rus nyung ngu zhig khyer 'dug pa nga la blang byas pas/ 'di yang byin pas chog der ma 491

zad gdung rus rnams seng ldeng gi bkra shis sgo mang zhig na bzhugs yod spro /sras ja ring 'khor los seng ldeng gi sgo mang rtsed mo la btsongs/ gdung rnams bang ba zhig na byo yod pas khyed rang gis blangs na 'ong zer/ mo lha sa nas 'khor ba'i phyir bsne gnyi gdung len du btang bas gdung tshang bar phebs nas gdung khang chen mo de bzhings/ de'i nang du dngul gyi gdung khang zhig bgyis nas bzhugs tsu bcug ste/ da lta'i bar du yul shin tu bkra shis par mdzad pa yin / 'dis rwa lo/ spa tshab/ gnyal gyi bya lo bla ba 'od zer/ shud phu lo tsā ba 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan /gnyan lo/ zangs dkar 'phagasapa shes rab/ ba ri lo tsā ba/ rma lo tsā ba la sogs ya rnams ma'aX gtug / yab spyo zhal che sa la dgyes rdor ra la nyon gsung 0 yod bas/ gtsang du ram gyi sar byon pas/dang ngos la ma mkhu1 bar 'og nas rngog la gsan pa mdzad/ dus phyis ram lugs dang rngog lugs zer ba'i lugs gnyis su song / kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer gyis ram rngog gnyis po dgongs pa gcig tu sbyar ba'i bstan bcos mdzad do/ ram lugaso pa rnams na re/ ram mkhasapa chen po yin pa ta 'bum phrag gsum pa yang rtsod pas pham par byas/rngog chos rdor la phag rgya ma mdzes ma zhig yod pa yang phul/ chos gsung dus gsang ldan sogs kyi 'dris rgyung ba na/ nga la rje mar pa'i gsung gtsang ma de thugs la gdags par zhu byas nas/ bla ma gcun gyi zhus pas bshad 492

pa zhin tu gtsang mdo ji rngog la nyan pas bshad pa nyog po de byung ba yin zir/ ram des kyang rgyud kyi bshad lamang du mdzad pas/dbod bo ram rdo rje btsan la sogs nga dang / mkhas pa rgya nam yang slob mar gyur/ gyi nam las bo mas/na pos dang por rtsod pa byed du 'ongs/rtsod pa ma thub pas slob mar gyur / kye rdor gyi dbang rgya nam la zhus pa'i tshe/ so skang nam mkha' 40chags pas/ rgyud gsang 'dus la mos kyab ga'abrel tshulardor dang 'dug snyam pa byung / rgya nam gyis kye rdor gyi ’ ka yang legs par mdzad bye bos de gzung nas bshad pa yang mang ca du mdzad/ tre bo'i slob ma chos la dgos kyang ram lugs dang mthun pa'i ṭwāṃ ka brtsams/ snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pas kyang tre bo'i slob ma gnyan rdo rje seng ge la gtugs nas ramakhalugs rnams legs bar mnyan te/ rang gi ma brgyud kun dga' don grub la sogs pha rnams la sang bshad pa de'i rgyun mal do / ci rngog mdo nde laslob ma rtsag dharma rā dza/ 'gar bsdo gi rin chen/ṅka 'tshe'i dar re/ masakozer pa ba/ tre bo ma na po/ngor rje kun dga' 'od/ gshe pa rdogajo 'ab ge mnyam med shākya ye shes/ cog ro chos rgyal/ lha gyu'akhamakhar ba/ sdo mas chos sku/ dran ston ma 'a bral/ sto nag/ rgyal tsha rin chen mgon la sogs pa mtha' mas pa skyon no/ rngog mdo sde gtsang chu mig ta btsugs dus/ mtshan mo zhig spyabasargya ma zhig gi sar 'a na bar rtsams pas/ jo mo sge mo zhes 493

po slob dpon rgyal po dga' shing mo glang la 'khrungs nas/ brgyad cu pa shing pho spre'u la gshegs/ de'i sras po slob dpon seng ge sgra yab kyi so gcig pa shing mo lug la 'khrungs/ bdun cu rtsa bzhi pa sa pho spre'u la gshegs/ de'i gcung po bla ma rin chen bzang po yab kyi so dgu pa chu mo yos la 'khrungs/ khu bo gzi brjid la chos rnams gsan nas dgung lo bcu pa la bshad pa mdzad/ bco brgyad pa la zul phur dge tshul dang / so gsum pa la bsnyen rdzog mdzad/ mkhan po zul phu ba chos grags dpal/las slob 'od zer dpal/ gsang ston ye shes dpal/ yab dang / slob dpon rdo rje rin chen dang / slob dpon bzang mo ba 'phyong po ba dang /slob dpon rin gzhon rnams la chos gsan/ nyi shu rtsa bdun pa la bla ma gzi brjod 'das/ —— rjes kyi zhabs tog bsgrubs nas gdan sa mdzad/de nas lo lnga pha phu khams su byon nas lo gnyis la 'khor/ 'tshal pa'i ya nga dgon sgom sde —dang dpon brgyud gyi bla mar gyur/ gses gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/ lha khang dang gdan sa rgya cher bskyed/ spel bzhi dang zul skyor gyis thog drangs dge 'dun dpag khyu med pa la tshogs gsosadang / de'i sku skal dbus gtsang gi dgon sde 'brel yod kun la mdzad/ mar pa'i sprul par grags shing sku che ba'i yon tan dpa tu med/ cikhong gi zhe gnyis pa shing pho spre'u la rang byung rdo rje 'khrungs/ zhe brgyad pa lcags pho stag la bu rin po che 'khrungs/ 'gro don rgya cher mdzad nas khong rang gi rab lo 495

bdun cu mi bdun pa sa mo lug la gshegs/ rin chen bzang po'i gcung po slob dpon chos rdor me pho rta la 'a khrungs nas re drug pa lcags mo phag la gshegs/ khong gi sras lnga'i che ba slob dpon chos kyi rgyal mtshan chu mo lug la 'khrungs/ so bdun dzi la bla ma rin chen bzang po gshegs/rang lo bdun tsu rtsa bdun pa sa mo phag la gshegs/ 'dis khams su byon/ ri bo che'i rin bo che ba la sogs pa'i slob ma dpag tu med pa byung / dar rtse mdo tshun du theg pas 'bul ba mang /po byung ba'ang spre'u ging du rmim/ de rting gdan sa mdzad ba yin/ yar klungs lo tsā ba sdogs ba rgyal ma na la gtugs nas rdo rje phreng ba gsan pas/ ding sang la'ibar du spre snang ba laphreng pa'i bka'i ma chad par yod po na/ slob dpon chos rdor gyi sdo ba pa slokā dpo se nga gi 'bum gyi sras rin po che don grub dpa ba gas mo phug la 'khrungs/ nyer dgu bzhes pa'i tshe rin po ca cho rgyalab gshegs/ ra nga lo drug cu rtsa ba da pa sa pho stag la ga ga / de'i zas rin po che byang chubarnadapatshongab ni/ rin bo che chos rgya sab gshegs pa'i phyi lo gas pho byi bamiga'akhyungs/ sum cu rtsa dgu bzhis pa la rin bo che don grub dpal ba gshegs/ yab kyi nye gnas dang slob gnyer sbrags nas mjod pas rngog pa'i chos rnams la shin tu mkhas shing byang bar gyur/ ldan grub dpa'akhab ga gas snal gdan sa gzusna zhing dul chos ma chag par gsungs pa la/ log sgrub can gyi gang 496

zag 'ga' re / bdag po drung chen pa 'balo par zhus pas/ bka' baspyon byung ste bya ba rnams 'bring tsam du bzhug pa la/ rje tsong kha pa chen po grum bu lung du chos gsung ba'i tshe mjal du skyod pas/ rjes bkur rtsi chen po mdzad/ mkhyen pa'i yon tan rnams la rtsad gcad gnang /der jo mtshar che ba'i gsung yang yang ba sa pa mdzad cing / ci ma kyang bsngags pa mang du mdzad pa sdo snod 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyang mad ci dzha stongs te/ 'bras spungs chos rje bkra shis dpa ldan pa dang / mkhan chen padrasgrobablang hra la sogs pa'i mkhyen rang cad gyi slo ma yang nga du 'dus stag lung rin po che dpal ngag gi dbang pos sung chos mang du gsan/ chos langs rgyas rgyal ma na gyi kyang rngobakyolug kyi dbaca shus de rjes mi'i bdag po grags pa 'byung gnas kyis spyon drangs nas rngog lugs sbyi dbang dang —rgyud bshad gdams pa dang bcas pa legs par gsan zhing /shin tu nus pa'i sgo na bsur nyi chen po mdzad/ ldum chung ba don grub dpal ba dang / bya sa ming chos rmya rje bsgod nams rnam par rgyal ba dang /tha ba'i khyu mchog chen po dpal cho gyi grags pha dang drung ba da nams rgyalamatshan pa rnams kyang mkhyen rab la shin tu gus shing gsan pa mang du mdzad/ lhag dpe brtag gnyis kyi gzhung rdo ri mar grag pa gdopha chos tshar re la ma tshan ma re btab pa'i grangabra'omi dang brgyad cu rtsa gnyi sa snang / bar skabs mu gdan sa ba rnams la gdan zhe bshad rgyun da 497

pa la/ rje tsong kha pa chen po'i bka' lung la khyed kyis cis kyang gdan bzhi'i bshad pa de yod pa mdzod gsungs pas/ spre'u zhing ming ga ba nas grwa pa slob dpon tshul mgon pa zhes bya ba'i bgres po zhig la lung legs par bzhugs pa mnos nas bshad pa yang mang du mdzad/ rdo ltar 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i ngang nas rang lo brgyad cu rtsa bdun pa me pho stag la gshegs/ me pho stag de nas ding sang me pho spre'u yan la lo sum cu rtsa gcig song ba yin/ —spre'u zhing du rngog gi gdung brgyud byon pa thams cad gtsang tsha brgyud min la/ rgyal tsha brgyud mdo sde'i sras thogs meng grogs ni/ mab kyi sosku cigab gas chu byi kra la 'khrungs ho byi'i bar sum cu rtsa bdun bzhugs/ 〉 lab kyi chos rnams la shin tu mkhas shing yig cha'ang mang du mdzad/ thogs med grags kyi gcung po jo 'od chu stag la 'khrungs/ nyer lnga bzhugs/ de'i gcung po jo bsod sa bya la 'khrungs/ bcu bdun bzhugs/ de'i gcung ston chung dbang mo chu glang la 'khrungs/ bcu gsum bzhugs/ gcung jo bde shing yos la 'khrungs bcu gcig bzhugs/thogs med grags kyi sras rgyal tshar mo yab kyi nyer bdun pa me pho stag la 'khrungs nas chu pho stag gi bar so bdun bzhugs/ de'i gcung po rdo rje seng ge yab kyi so gsum pha chu pho spre'u la 'khrungs/ rang lo drug cu rtsa brgyad pa la gshegs/ ra mos nyer gcig dang rdor seng gis bco lnga lon 498

pa'i tshi mes po gshegs/ ra mo la zas gsum ste/ lcam me/ dzo shākya/ jo bsong/ lcam me'i sras nam mkha' dbang phyug de'i sras kun dga' dang dbang phyug 'bum gnyis/ kun dga'i sras rin chen rgyal po/de la sras rin chen dpal/ grags pa rgyal mtshan kun dga' blo gros dang gsum/ gyi ma'i sras kun dga' bzang po'o/ spre'u zhing du rin po che bkra shis dpal ba ni/ rin po che byang chub dpal ba nyid kyi gdung du 'khrung / chung ngu'i dus nas rab tu byung zhing rtse sa thang du chen po blo gros 'phel ba'i sar gtags/ tshad ma'i slob gnyer mdzad/ de rting yab mes kyi chos rnams rin po che ba la tshang bar gsan zhing mkhas par yang gyur pa la/ rin po che ba nyid sku tshe shin tu ring bas dus chos tsam ma gtogs gzhan nas kyi nyan pa po ni ma byung / rin po che pa bzhugs ring la gdan sar bton/ de'i sras da lta'i gdan sa ba 'di'o/ /rje mar pa chu byi la 'khrungs nas ding sab gi me pho spre'u 'di yan la lo bzhi brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga song ngo / spyir rngog mdo sde'i slob ma migs la sogs pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams kyis bshad pa mdzad pa las rgya zhin tu che bar 'phel zhing / brgyudapa phyi ma rnams kyis brtsams pa'i ’ spus kyang lung sul thams cad khengs te/ masargyud kyi bshad pa la rngog brgyud 'di shin tu drin che'o/ /rngog pa'i brgyud pa'i skabs so/ /499

'dus pa mar lugs kyi skabs/'tshur dbang de ni dol gyi mda' na 'chis dang 'tshur sa bya ba'i rigs gnyis yod ba las 'tshur gyi rigs/ sngags 'a 'a brgyud par byung ba/ yab shin tu mthu chi gzhig gi zas su 'thungs/ chung ngu'i dus nas dge ba'i bshe gnyan myu pa'i sar slob gnyer la byon/ yo byad chung ngu las med pa ma ma bzogade khyod gyi lus rgyas pha na nor mi 'byung bas/ di'i tshe rigapa ba bas pa chog mod da rang gi khyim du ldang zhes bskul ba na/ mkha pha thams cad dka' ba spyad cing brtson pakhabasgrod pa la byung ba yin/ nga'i mas myi bang chad ma byed cig nga sangs rgyas pa'i tshe khyod brtse bas ma 'dor ba yin no zhes gsungs te/slob gnyer la 'bad pa chen po mdzad/ dus phyis sku bsod rgyas te 'bum bzheng pa'i yig mkhan la/ da lta gsang dza 'dus pa'i gdams sprasasu che dris pa / khong rnams na re/ mar pa sto brag pa chi zer/ gi nas dad bas snye brag tu ba na bkung cung zan cig bsnams nas byon/ ga nga ba 'dus pa'i rgyud dang dadams dziganang bar zhus pas/ mang pa'i zham nas/ khyod ma shin hūṃ cu 'juyin phar 'dug pas/ nga'i pha spun mar pa mon nag bya ba 'di nga la shin tu gnod par yod pas/ khyod kyis mthu 500

gyis/ mthu byung na gzod chos ster rī ra bas/ 'tshur gyis zla ba gcig tu mtshams bca da/ mthu'i rtags bad bar cad byung nas ba che ge mo'i gnam stong la kho 'chi bar yod pas dus 'debs zhus mar bas kyang mar pa mon nag la khyod zla ba che ge mo'i gnam stong la zung cig gsung ba'i dus btab/ de'i gnam stong gi nyid par kho rtsig pha'i 'a sa shig na yod pas/ de ring bla ma mar pa'i mthu yod pa'i dul yin ze / re shig gi khang pa'i tha shu sa shing gi bad yod pa chung gis skyur ba'i gsob na rdo yod pa 'ami mgo la phog ste shi/ der bla ma mar pa mnyes nangasachos phra mo 'dra ba gnang zhing / rdzogs par gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes/ gyis 'tshur gyis dol mdar rang gi gdas su mar pa spyan drangabaska chos rim lnga'i man ngag dang rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa rdzogal phar gnang / de yang rje cher ma laphan shes zhabs lugs kyi dza ma dang / ga na dang / snyim sto'i ye tog dang bcas4 pa'i bshad— sgrol ga ma mod/ des la la rgyud don man ngag tu dril na la ra spyomed pas nā ra pa'i gyur spyo nga yon ngag gi lugs la rtsis su chang 0 'a lha cas tshang pa dang tshogs 'khor cig zhus pa'i tshe/ rje char pas rang gi sna gang du chos btsal lugs dang dka' ba spyad lusas rnams mgur rsha ba ngas shing / cas de ltar dka' bar thubs dgongs la/ khyed le lo rmā mdzad sgrab bar zhu gsung nas snye brag tu thegs/ de la 'tshur gyi mtshan cu dbang gi rdo 15 ཿ

zhes zer/ de la slob ma mang du yong kyang khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje/mkhon gad pa gīrti/ 'ches ston bsod nams rgyal mtshan gsum gtso bo yin/ de la khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje ni/ rgya gar du gsang ba 'dus pa tshol ba la byon/ de yang rje che tri ba la nyan 'dod pa la/ de yang gshegs nas ma mjal/ gzhan gsang 'dus nyan pa'i sa ma rnyeng par/rje mar pa la mnyan snyam nas bod du byon pa la/ a tsar gnyis dang lam du mnyam du byung bas/ khyed gnyis gang du 'gro byas pas/ 'tshur la 'dus pha nyan du 'gro zer ba dang / rje mar pa yang gshegs nas mi snang ba / 'tshur la 'khon gad pa gīrti dang mnyam du gsan/ khong gnyis la rgyud man ngag dang —bcas pa gnang / khams bas 'tshur gyi gsung bzhin du rgyud rkyang gi ṭā ka yang mdzad/ de dang mthun par dbang gi cho ga yang mdzad snang rte/ gzhi ni slob dpon klu sgrab kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho gar snang ngo/ 'di dang rjes su 'a la bar rje mar pas mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi spyi don zhig kyang snang la/ gnyis medi rnam rgyal chen po 'di dus gyis bod pas brtsams pa'i rdzun ma yin ra ba mang po byung zhing / la la na re rgya pho ba lung pas byas kyang zer te/ khams pa ro mnyam gyi ṭī ka na 'di tshad mar byas snang bas rgya pho ba lung pa'i don mi snang ngo / /'khon gad pa gīrti de yang / —mang ra seng ge rgyal mtshan la yun ring du brten pa'i slob ma 'phags skor la shin tu mkhas pa yin zhing / khong gi bsam 502

pa la/ 'di la man ngag zhig byung na sgrub pa nyams len du byed pa'i dgongs pa byung nas/ 'tshur la man ngag yod par thos shing gtugs pa yin te/'bul ba rta dang rgyags zong tshos ltang yod pa nyin par mjal kha ma byung srod la mjal kha byung / bla ma sku tshon po zhig snang bas mthong ma thag tu gnam sa ngo mi shes pa'i mos gus skyes/ rta dang tshos ltang thams cad phul/rim pa lnga la nyams len du mdzad pas sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob/sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang po yang gzigs so/ /des bya khang ba bsod nams rin chen la gnang ste/ bya khang ba dang 'khon gnyis kyang ma gcig pa'i spun yin/ sngar bya khang ba slob dpon du yang byed pa la/ slar 'khon la dad pa skyes nas rim lnga'i man ngag zhus pas 'khon dgyes te/ nga'i gdams ngag 'di rta zan bcangs pa 'dra ba/ phag pa nan gyis dbyar lam latshud pa lta bu zhig yin/ ding slob dpon chos kyi bdag por 'dug pas 'bul dgos gsung nas dgyes bzhin du gnang ste/ dbu bskyong yang bzhes/ bya khang bas rgyagaganyamal 4 bzhes pas sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin brnyes/ liṅga sbubs su nub/ 'grongs khar dbu'i gtsug tor yang 'thon/ gshegs pa'i tshe nga'i bar spyong bar thogs gsung bas/thur la'i mchod khang du zhal nub tu bstan na bzhugs su gsol/ de'i rten 'brel gyis rgya mkhar stod du zad pa'i rta bas mi 'chags zer ba tsam yod pa las/ gyis gnod pa med cing bde bar gyur pa yin no/ /des 503

thur la ba tshul khrims skyabs la gan yin te/ de mdo da rgyud sde thams cad mas / mo bcu gnyis sham thabs ma gyon par snan sgrog ga ga ju bsgoms pas rgyab pha brnye gte/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob pas lha dngos byu gzig / dzog pa'i rim pa la rtags thon zhing ngag rdo rje'i ba sa ༷ 'byongs/ snang ba sgyu mar shar/ thugs 'od gsal gyi ngang la bzhug / zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin ma gnas nas tha dad rtog pa thams cad brtsom/ sangs rgyas dang 'bra bar bzhugs pa na no/ /ge nga be ba gas pa skyabs la gnang ba min rnyi/ rna yang skong bor ra tu byung na sa gzhi dmar bor song song du slob gnyer ci mdzad/ de nas skyed rdzogs kyi don nyams su nga pa nyams da rtogs pa bag par cad sgro ci gshegs pa'i tshe gzims khang la 'ja'i skor sum ji du byu ci sog pa 5 mtshar ba'i ltas mang po byung bro / /rna ga ra jings ba gzhon nu 'od 'a ga hā ba min te/ de ni sum pa skyil mkhang gyi ༷na ri / gzhon nu na 'du gdar gzhon nu tshul khrims la mu tāpagacu / jo bo rdo brgyud 'i lam rim man ngag dang bcam pa mang rtu ga na zhing thug nyam su ya ba/ phyis mkhan po gtsang nag pa la sogs pa bsnyen par rdzogs zhu / 'dul 'dzin chen por gyur te 'dul ba'i skor la sbyangs pa chen yo mdzad/ lan cig gral thebs dpon la byon pa zhabs bsnyung nas sha kyi rings su bzhug rnga 'i tshe/ glan 504

mo cho pas zhabs stog mdzad/ khong na ji/ ston pas 'phags skor mi mkhyen nam gsung / 'phags skor mkhano ṣpe gang na bdog bso pas/khong na re/ lha sa'i rgan mi lha ma mthong / thur la na gsang jigs spyo sdong po 'phags skor mkhas pa yod dzi ma ga na rnam ra bas tsung zad skyengs pa zhig byung / tshur 'ongs nas slob dpon gtsang pa la ngo chen bcol nas 'phags pa la rgyas cu pa'i gsol khri btakhri pa / 'phags pa'i gsung gis kho spo glu ma 'thogs oṃ cig bgyid gsung nas gzhung bshad ma ngag thams cad tshang bar gnang / gzhan yong khong la chos skor shin tu ming ba zhig bzhugs pa rnams kyang zhu ma dgo par gnang / rim lnga'i khrid la 'dag 'argya yang byis/ gzhan yang rje sgam po pa'i dngos slob log phug pa zhes sbyi bal chos drug dang phyag rgya chen po'i khrid zhus/ ga nga pa sa bo dbu ma 'a da pa'i zur chos gyis gsung nas mdzad pa'i tshe/ gzhan dang tshags sdong gi rnam pa byung bas min gyi spa gro la sogs par byon te/ de nas bum thang nas 'thon na gro bo lung du byon/ gzhan yang sgrags yang rdzong dang / rgyal gyi rtsibs ri la sogs pa'i gnas chen mang por bzhugs/ de rnams su chu skyes byi skyes rtogs pa skyes gsung / de nas kha che paṇa chen byon pa la mis mo cher ma la nas 'khor pa ta dang bcas pa rnams la chos kyi dri ba drug bduno tsa zhu / de nas ser bu dpe tshar bzhugs te gser sding kyi dgo pa btab/ malas dzi mas 505

cad kyis dris/ mi chen thams cad kyis gtugs sar gyur/ rgyas 'bring rnam gsum las mi nyung ba'i bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad/ gser sdings btab nas lo dgu tsam lon pa na/ nyid kyi slob ma 'bar grags pa dbang phyug bya ba'i sring mo 'gar btsun ma shes rab rgyan zhes bya ba la sras sgrun pa'i cho ga mdzad/ 'gar btsun ma sbrum pa dang tshogs su sbrum par byed pa po dang sbrum ma gnyis ka gnas nas phyung zhig ces bka' stsal/sbrum mas sa gzhan du 'dug cing sbrum pa sos pa na skyes ma thag nas chos spyod byed pa'i lad mo ci nus su byed pa la sogs pa dang / mngal nas btsa' ba'i tshe yang ma'i lus las 'dus pa'i lha so gnyis spro ba la sogs pa'i snang ba yang byung / byis pa rtse ba'i skabs su mi rnams na re/jo mo'i zas po snying sdag go ming ci zer dris pa na/ yum gyis bdag med rdo rje'o zhekā smras te/ bdag med rdo rjer chags/ lo lnga lon pa'i tshe spyod tshul shin tu khyad par du 'phags pas gsang brtol ba'i dus la bab par dgongs te/ dge 'dun la bzod gsol du ja skor byas nas/ bla mas bdag med rdo rje sku mdun du bzhag ste chos nyan du bcug nas zhag shas song ba dang / bdag med rdo rje khyod nga la brnyas sam nga'i chos la brnyas zhes bka' bkyon pas/ tsog tshog por thal mo sbyar te/de'i rgyu mtshan ci lags zhes zhus pa na/ nga'i chos mgo 'dzugs pa dang khyod kyi rtsed mgo mnyam/ chos thon pa dang rtsed mo thon pa dus mnyam zhes 506

gsungs pa na/ chos rna bas nyan pa la rkang lag gi rtse thabs la 'gal ba ci zhig mchis zhes zhus pas/ 'o na mngon par 'gyur gyi nga'i chos rnams caskyor cig gsungs pas/ nyin gsum du nyan pa'i chos thams cad kyi tshig ma nor bar skyor byung bas/ kun ha las te 'di ni sprul pa'i sku chen po zhig go zhes gleng bar byed do/ /de nas bla mas kyang nyid kyi zas su zhal gyis 'ches/ sngon rtsom pa mdzad pa rnams la dge slong gzhon nu 'od kyis sbyar zhes gsung ba la/ de nas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gzhon nu 'od kyis sbyar zhes bya bar mdzad do/ /bdag med rdo rje de ni phyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan chos kyi 'od zer du btags pa ga6 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pas chos sku 'od zer du mtshan gsol/ 'dis chos kyi grwa gang dang gang du byon pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad lan res 'dzin par nus pa de gzhan gyis rdzun nam snyam pa'i brtag pa byas kyang / de kho na bzhin du gyur pa la sogs pa'i che ba'i yon tan du ma yod pa rnams 'dir bris na shin tu mang bas/ 'di'i rnam thar kun spangs zhang gis mdzad pa las blta bar bya zhing / dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud tshul gyi skabs su yang shes par bya'o/ 'di ni yab dang yun ring du 'grogs su byung bas yab la bzhugs pa'i yon tan thams cad mnga'/ de la yon tan du ma mnga' ba'i kun /khyen 'phags 'od kyis gsan/ de la bu rin po ches gsan pa yin te/ de yang bu rin po che bla ma rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i drung na dus 'khor 507

gsan pa'i tshe/ bus kho bo yo ga'i chos 'di rnams mnyan par 'dod pa la mnyan sa mo rnyed zhus pas/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i gsung gis/ 'o na nged kyi mchid grogs bla ma 'phags 'od ces bya ba zhig yod pas de la nyon gsung / phyis zhwa lur phebs nas 'phags 'od rtsad bcad pas/'phags 'od gzhan zhig yid la byas nas de la yon tan chen po yod de/bslab pa mi gtsang zer bas skyug log phyis 'phags 'od yang dag pa de thu gud kyi spre'u zhig la thugs dam mdzad par gsan nas/ chos gsan pa la drung du 'ong ba'i zhu ba 'bul mi btang bas/ 'phags pa'i gsung gis/ 'o na khong cho sde chen po'i bdag po yi pas nga'i spre'u 'dir phan skad/ nga rang khong gi bad du 'gro gsung nas zha phur phebs/ spyir chos mang du gsan/ bye brag tu 'dus pa 'grel pa dang bcas pa gsan pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i zhal nas/ khyed rang mkhas pa yin pas rgya ba'i rgya lugs dang gar ba'i gar lugs la sogs mi dgos/ bshad pa yam me ba zhig byas nas chos thob che bar bya gsung ba la/ bu rin po ches bdag 'di la shen tu mas pa zhig bdog pas zhib cing rgyas pa zhig gsung bar zhus pas/'phag pa'i gsung gis/ ma ba 'o na de tsug gis mi 'ong / sngon la rim lnga'i khrid byas la/ de rting bshad pa ma byas na rgyud la go ba legs po mi 'i ra gsung bas/ zla ba drug gi bar du mtshams bsdams nas rim lnga'i khrid bskyangs pas/ sangs gyis dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po 508

ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsed mo mdzad pa la sogs pa'i yang dag pa'i rtags mang po shar/ de nas mtshams bkrol te/ bu rin po ches khrid lags 'di la yi gir mi 'debs pa'i bka' rgya gnang gi yod par grags 'dug pa bdag la bka' rgya de mi 'debs par zhus pas/ 'phags pa'i gsung gis lar khrid yig byas pa na nyams len med par khrid de klag lung du shar de 'gro bar 'dug da rang gis nyams su mi nan pa 'phan cha tshol ba'i thabs byed pa bam/ dbyug pa la phyugs kyi 'grang sam stogs btags te 'i 'gra pa spyogatapa mi dga' ri shi gsung nas phyag rgya dang bcas pa mdzad/ gsung de'i dbang gis khrid yig ma mdzad par dmigs pa rnams ma bsnyel bar yod pa la/ dus gyis dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas bskul nas khrid yig tu mdzad/ kun mkhyen 'phags pa 'di la bu rin po ches yo ga'i skor gyi dbang / rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa/man ngag dab bcas midang / gsang ba 'du pa mar lugs dang 'gos lugs gnyis ka rgya bar galan/ chos rnam rdzogs na / bu rin ko ches phyag na gang yod kyi bsnyen bkur chen po zhig bshams pa / 'phags pa'i gsung gis/ dngos bo 'di rnams ngad mi da sa/ khyed rang sde gog 'dzin pa la da ga/ nga cho rnams ska'i bar du 'chad da pa'i dam tshig la dgar/ yo ga dang 'phags lug la yig cha rtsom dgo pa'i bka' gnang yang mdzad/ phyi bu rin po che'i ga stong gis 'o sko'akha502

gyis kyang bsgoms na man lungs gu ru tsam zhig 'ong ste/ 'phags pa'i gsung ma chogs pas mi tshe bshad pa la bskyal ba yin gsung / de cas gzung nas ni rim lnga'i khrid lugs 'di chos rje bla ma dam pa la sogs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos gzhan dang gzhan du ding sang gi bar du bskyangs so/ de la rje tsong kha pa chen pos ni/ bu rin po ches mdzad pa'i rim pa lnga'i man ngag dang / de gang la brten pa'i gser sdings pa'i man ngag rnams dpyad pa'i gzhir mdzad/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi gsung rab spyi dang / bye brag tu 'dus pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud dang / rgya gar nas byung ba'i 'grel pa chen po rnams dang / bod kyi lugs rnams la'ang legs par brtags shing dpyad nas rim lnga'i khrid yig dang / de'i don rgyas par 'chad pa rim lnga gsal ba'i sgron me mdzad de/ 'dus pa'i lugs nyams pa rnams gso bar mdzad do/yang rgyud rkyang gi bshad lugs 'khon gad pa gīrti la mi nyag zhang zhung / lu ba pa gsum gyis zhus/ de gsum ga la chos rgyal rin chen ming pas zhus/ yang khams pa ro mnyam rdo rje/ des rgyal lung phu ba chen po/ des mi lha khang sna ba/ des rgyal lung bu ba snyi ma/ de la chos rgyal rin chen gling pas zhus/ de yang rje mar pa gshegs rjes kyi sa pho stag nas brtsams te/ chos rgyal rin chen ming ma sa pho spre'u la gshegs pa yan chad du lo 510

dgu bcu rtsa gcig song / lo 'di la gling ras kyang gshegs/ rin chen gling pa la rgya pho ba lung pas zhus/ de la snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa lo bzhi bcu rtsa gcig lon pa zhig gis ru mtsham pho ba lung du byon nas zhabs la gtugs te/ gsang 'dus rgyud rkyang gi bshad pa dang /bshad rgyud gnyis med rnam rgyal chen mo gsan/ de'i lo phyi ma la bsnyen bkur gyi chas bsnams te/ gnyis med rnam rgyal rigs bsdus chen po'i dbang / dgyes rdor mes lugs kyi bshad pa gdams pa dang bcas pa gsan zhing / gzhan yang sngags phyogs kyi rgyud dang dbang dang gdams pa mang du gsan no/ 'dus pa mar lugs kyi skabs so/bde mchog snyan brgyud dang ras chung snyan brgyud kyi skabs/rnal 'byor gyi dbang byug mi la ras pa ni/ ldog stag ris na rigs sbyi khyung po/ bye brag mi la yin pa zhig gzhis rgyal du btsugs te sho byas pas pham nas yul 'thon te ko ron sar sleb pa'i brgyud pa la/ mi la sher rgyal dang g.yung gyel zhes bya ba gnyis byung / sher rgyal dang myang bza' dkar rgyan gnyis kyi sras su/ rje btsun lcags pho 'brug gi lo la bltams/ mtshan thos pa dgar btags/ ring por ma lon par yab gshegs/ de'i tshe rje btsun gyi yum lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa yin pas/ a 511

khu'i bu'i chung ma byed dgos zer/ de la ma nyan pas khros te nor rdzas thams cad phrogs/ shin tu khas nyen par byung ba la/ nam zhig rje btsun gyis klog slob pa'i slob dpon klu brgyad pa zhig gi sar chang gsol nas glu len zhing log 'ongs pas/ ma khros te/ pha mi la shes rgyal la bu khyod 'dra ba skyes/ nged rang ma smad kyi 'khos 'di la khyod kyis glu dran nam/ da yin na dbus gtsang du song la mthu mkhas pa cig la mthu slob la dgra thams cad kha phung la thong zer/ der rje btsun gyis 'o na a mas gsung ba bzhin bya yis byas pas/ 'khos dang bstun pa'i cha rkyen 'ga' re yang brdzangs/ dpal mo thang gi mgor lam grogs skugs pas/ lam grogari bzang po dus ma 'gor bar byung nas byon/ mthu su che byas kyi rtsad bcad pa la/ yar klungs na gnyags g.yung ston khro rgyal bya ba yod zer bas/ de la dngos po gang yod phul nas/ bdag la stod nas 'ongs/ khas nyen bab pas mthu zhu ba yin byas pas/ khong gis mthu'i kha pho mang po mdzad/ gzhan mthu slob mkhan lnga tsam dang lhan cig tu mthu slob cing lo gcig bzhugs/ der mthu'i man ngag yin yin 'dra ba bslabs nas grogs po gzhan rnams des tshim nas song / rje btsun gyis de rnams la skyel thung ma dzad de phyir log pa na/ slob dngo/ na na re/ khyod mi 'gro'am zer/ khong rnams rgyags chos kyis mthu slob par 'dugang khas nyen po yin pas mthu lag yod du ma byung na mi 'gro byas/ slob 512

dpon na re/ 'o na da gtsang rong gi lha rje snubs chung dang kho bo gnyis/ kyis mthu dang ser ba brjes/ nga'i thad du mthu slob par byung na kho'i rtsar brdzang / kho'i rtsar ser ba slob pa byung na nga'i rtsar brdzang bar byas pa yin pas/ snubs chung gi rtsar song zer nas 'phan chas 'ga' zhig dang / nga'i bu 'di snying rje bar yod pas mthu gzha' ma cig slobs shig zer ba'i yi ge brdzangs/ snubs chung gi rtsar slebs nas/ da 'o na khyod rang gis mtshams gcod cu sa dgos zer/ nus zhus pas/ sa 'og gi khang pa bzang po zhig bzos nas der mthu bsgrubs pas/ zhag bcu bzhi na mthu'i rtags yang dag pa byung ste/ de bla mas shes nas rje btsun gyi rtsar byon te/ thos pa dga'/ khyed rang sgor shog dang ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams ngo so zla ba bzhin phyar nas/ dgra mi sum cu so lnga sod pa'i rtags khyer byung / da chos skyong la gtor ma dang gtang rag byed dgos zer/ de'i tshe a khu g.yung rgyal gyi bu la chung ma blangs nas bag ston byed cing yod pa na khyim rdib nas mi sum cu so lnga shi/ ma khu dang a rna gnyis lus/ der snubs chung la sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa'i chos mang po gsan/ der rje btsun gyi dgongs pa la ngas ma'i ngag la nyan nas sdig pa chen po de lta bu zhig bsags snyam du skyo zhing yod pa la/ yang mas pha mi la shes rgyal la bu skyes/ dgra mi sum cu so lnga dus gcig la shi/ des nga snying tshim ste/ 'on kyang yul mi 'di rnams kyis nga la sdang bar byas513

pas/ khyod kyis yul 'dir ser ba gyang rim gsum yod pa zer ba cig phob/ de byung na nga shi yang 'gyod pa med do zer ba bskur byung ba/slob dbon gyis mthong bas/ 'o na g.yung ston can du rgyug zer nas phyin te/ khong la de skad zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis lan mkhar rang gi phug pa na zhig tu mi la mtshams la bcug nas ser ba sgrub tu bcug pas/ zla ba ma lon bar ser ba'i rtags yang dag pa byung / de nas nam zla'i dus tshod dang sbyar nas slob dpon gyi g.yog dpa' ba zhig dang 'grogs nas phyin te/ yul du sleb nas mtshan mo zhing mang bo la ser ba'i gta' btsud de/ri rtser phyin gis bden ba bdar zhing 'o dod bos pas/ ri lung thams cad grog por song ba'i ser ba chen po zhig kyang phab/ der yul mis khong gnyis ri la yod pa rig nas thog mar rje btsun gyis bros te ding rir dus byas/ g.yog gis dmag gis sleb byung ba dang / dmag rnams la nga thos pa dga' yin/ nged ma smad la sdang bar byas pas da khyed rnams la skyid po byung nge/ da dung du yang yul 'dir mi gcig kyang ma bzhag cig byas nas/ dmag gi steng du sol gyin pas sus kyang 'ju ma nus par thar/der gnyis pos dbus gtsang du 'ongs/ mi las lha ri snubs chung gi mar bzhugs/ g.yog yar klungs su song / snying la chos kho na dran yang cu ma nus pa la/ nyin zhig slob dpon gyi yon bdag bzang po zhig shi nas/des slob dpon skyo ste thos pa dga'/ nged rang gnyis pos sdig chen po 514

bsags yod pas/ yang na khyod kyis chos gsha' ma zhig gyis la nga drongs/yang na chos gsha' ma cig ngas bya/ khyod kyis nga'i rgyags skyol zer bas/'o na ngas chos gsha' ma zhig byed nga ra zhu byas nas/ rong du 'bre ston lha dga' la rdzogs pa chen po zhus/ der sgom tsam mang zu/ skyes pas 'bre ston gyis nga'i chos kyang kha bo ches/ khyod kyis kyang le lo byas pas ci yang ma byung / da yin na/ rje nā ro che ti'i slob ma mar pa lo tsā ba bya ba sto phu chu khyer du bzhugs/ rten 'brel lus la sgrigs nas sems chos nyid ma dang spyod pa zhig yod zer bas/ khyed rang der rgyug gsung bas/mtshan thos pa tsam gyis dad nas yid dga' ches te chu khyer du byon/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur ba byang / bla ma mar pas 'khar las mang po dang phru rlog la sogs pa byed du bcug rdo skyas pa'i sgal ba rnag khrug tu song 'bungs/ de ltar las byed cing yod pa'i tshe/ 'tshur rngog la sogs pa'i slob ma mi chen mang po la bla mas dbang mdzad pas/ der tshung dam snyam nas zhus pas/ gcig kyang ma gnang / der yum gyis ma bzod de/ nā ro pa'i thugs dam padma rā ga zhig yod pa lag rtags su bskur te rngog can du btang / bla ma thugs brel bas khyed kyis 'di la gdams pa rnams gnang ba zhu zer ba'i yi ge bskur/ rje btsun gyis gzhung ri por btol/ rngog gi gsung gis/ nga'i phyugs rnams yal mo bas khyer bas/khyod kyis ser ba phob gsung nas ser ba phab ste/ rngog gi drung du phyin 515

nas/ kho bos chos la 'ongs pa lags te/ las su sdig kho na byed dgos pa zhig byung zhus pas/ des mi sto a'u rtsi gsung nas/ thabs lam gyi gdams ngag rnams gnang / mi la phug tu mtshams gcod du bcug der rngog la lo tsā ba chen po'i bka' byung ste/ nga'i mkhar dgu thog tshar/ de la khyod kyis spen bad rgyu'i spen ma zhig skyol gsung bas/ rngog gis mi la phyags phyir khrid de/ dkon brtsegs shig gis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang po dang / lam du spen khur brgyad cu tsam bsgrubs/ 'bul ba dang spen ma rnams phul/ las rnams tshar ba dang /bla mas bdag med ma la tshogs shig shoms gsung nas/ dpon slob rnams tshogs bzhes pa'i tshe/ rngog la spyan 'bur tshugs su gzigs nas/ rngog zer ba'i ngan pa khyod nga'i thos pa dga' la gdams ngag ster ba ci yin gsung / bla ma'i phyag rtags dang bcas te bka' byung ba lags mod zhus pas/ mi la la gzigs nas/ khyod la phyag rtags sus bskur gsung /yum gyis gnang ba lags byas pas/ der bla ma kog gis bzhengs nas seng ldeng gi dbyug pa zhig la 'jus byung ba dang / bdag med ma bros/der bla ma stan la bzhugs nas zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te/ bdag med ma pos gsung nas/ bdag med mas byon pa dang / da chang legs par drongs shig dpon slob rnams gtam bya'o gsung nas/ mi la la/khyod las can du dang po sleb ma khad nas ngas shes/ 'on kyang sdig chen 516

po 'dug pas sbyong du bcug pa yin/ rngog gis byin pa'i gdams ngag de rnams nga'i mdun du shod dang gsung / rngog thegs nas mi las skyel thung ring du mdzad/ de rting bla mas gdams ngag rnams yang dag par tshang bar gnang / 'di las lhag pa yod re zhes mkha' 'gro dpang du bzhag pa'i dbu bsnyung mdzad/ gro bo lung nas ya zad na rta nag phug bya ba yod pas/der mtshams gcod du bcug 'bad pa chen pos bsgoms kyang yon tan chen po ma skyes/ don de rnams phyis zhi ba 'od la mgur du bzhings pa/'o na khye'u chung bzhin legs po/ khyod rtogs 'dod can de tshur nyon dang / /mi nga ngo khyod kyis shes ma shes/ /mi nga ngo khyod kyis ma shes na/ /nga gung thang gi mi la ras pa yin/ /lte ba gung thang gi smad du bcad/ /slob gnyer dbus gtsang gi phyogs su bgyis/ /pha dar ston dang ngab mis dbu mdzad nas/ /rong ston lha dga' yan chad du/ /spyir drin can gyi bla ma bcu tsam bzhugs/ khyad par lha rje sgrubs chung la/ /drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zhus/ khong lta dgongs kyi mkhyen pa mtho lags shing / /dmar khrid kyi phyag bzhes mkhas na yang / /mi kho bo'i spros pa cung ma chod/ /rje na ro dang ze cis byin brlabs shing / /lus rten 'brel gnad du bsnun nas kyang / /sems chos nyid ma dang sprod pa cig /sto phu chu khyer na bzhugs so skad/ /pha lo tsā'i snyan pa rgyang nas 'khums/ /mtshan thos pa tsam gyis ba spu g.yos/ /lam dka' ba 517

spyod de spyan sngar phyin/ /zhal mthong ba rang gis snang ba 'gyur khong tshe rabs kyi bla ma yin pa 'dra/ /pha sku drin can gyi zhabs drung du/ /lo drug zla mthong brgyad du bsdad/ /lus sku dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs/ /zang zing gi 'bul rgyu ma mchis te/ /lus ngag ṅga zhabs tog rdul du brlags/ /thugs gting nas mnyes pa'i nad ka des/ /snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag rdzogs par gnang / /theg bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa de yin no/ /de yan chad cung zad zhib par bris te/ bcos ma mang po mthong bas 'di tsam zhig 'thad pa yin no snyam nas bgyis so/ /de la rje btsun gyis rang lo sum cu rtsa brgyad pa la mar pa'i zhabs drung du byon/ der lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du bzhugs nas/ zhe lnga pa nas sgrub pa la zhugs zhes yi gi gzhan las byung ba dang / 'bri khung chos rje'i zhal nas/ rje btsun gyis zhi bar gshegs gshegs kyi bar lo bzhi bcur sku lus sgom thag dang ma bral ba yin zhes gsungs pa dang yang 'byor ro/ /de nas rje mar pa'i zhabs drung nas byon te lam du rngog la'ang phyag mdzad/ yul du phebs pa'i tshe/ ma 'das nas khang stong de'i go phugs shig na rul bu bems pos g.yogs pa zhig 'dug pa la dzis mdzad de zhal gcig rig pa gtad nas sdig pa sbyangs/ spur de mes bsregs/ sring mo zhing yod pa'ang yul 'khyar/ yum bras gnyis kyi zhing skal zhig yod pa sus kyang 'debs ma nus par 'dug/ a de sngon dgra yin kyang / rje btsun la tshig 'jam 518

pos btud nas dga' ba ltar byed cing / zhing de ma des btab nas rgyags skyel ba'i chad byas/ grong las sgo zad 'phags pa'i ri rtsa zhig tu zla ba drug bsgoms pas drod kyang cher ma skyes pa la/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhig gis lus gnad bslabs pa bzhin byas pas drod cher 'bar/ da ni dka' ba sbyad nus par 'dug snyam pa'i da ngas pa skyes nas yul nas 'thon te/skyi rong gi ri rtse rnams la byon/ mi la'i rdzong drug tu grags pa yang skyid rong gi ri rnams la yod pa yin/ der lo dgu'i bar du bhā la gsol ba'i tha snyad mdzad nas brtson 'grus drag pos bsgoms pa rlung la rang dbang thob/ de kho na nyid kyi ye shes shar/ mi gzhan gyis phyi nas bltas pa la 'o brgyal brgyal 'dra yang / rje btsun nyid bde ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la brtan par bzhugs shing / bde ba drug gi mgur yang gsungs/lo dgu lon rjes rang dbang gi ting nge 'dzin brnyes pas 'brog pa mang po la phan 'dogs pa'i phyir ti se'i bar du byon/ der bon po zhig rnga la zhon nas gangs kyi rtse mor 'asgro zhing 'dug pa la rje btsun gyis skad cig gis gangs kyi rtse mor gshegs nas na bza' ra gos brkyang bas bon po rnga dang bcas pa thur du lhung ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul yang bstan/ de nas mar byon nas rdor mo la sogs pa'i can bdag mang pos zhabs tog kyang byas la phyir byon pas/ gang mo che bab ste lo gcig tu gyur ma nyan/ de nas cung zad zhu ba dang yon bdag mo rdor mo la sogs pa'i su 519

yon bdag 'ga' zhig gis rje btsun 'tsho ba med pas gshegs nges mod/da gdung btsal snyam nas phyin pas/ ri zur cig na gsa' zhig khong rnams la bya ra byed cing 'dug de log song ba dang khong rnams kyis kyang phyin te/ gsa' song ba'i lam rnams mi'i rkang rjes su 'dug de nas re shig na phug pa zhig na du ba cung zad phyur zhing / mgur gyi gsung zhig kyang grags nas zhabs drung du sleb pa na/ glen pa khyed rnams de tsam ci la 'gor/ ngas ri zur de nas bltas pas khyed rnams sa de 'dra na sleb 'dug pa la/ 'dir da las ma phyin gsung / rje btsun ma mthong gsa' zhig 'dug pa lags zhus pas/ gsang de kha nga yin gsung / sngar gshegs dus rtsam pa bre gsum dang / rna pa'i sha rkang pa zhig las ma bsnams pa la/ rtsam pa phul bzhi tsam las ma god par 'dug rtsam lhag dang sha gzug khong rnams la byin/ da yul ba rnams mya ngan gyis non yod pas gshegs par zhus te byon nas/ yul pa rnams kyis kyang bsnyun smin/rje btsun gyis kyang / rnal 'byor dbyar khams bde bar byung / /yon bdag sku khams bde lags sam/ /bya ba la sogs pa'i mgur mang du gsungs/ de nas chu bar du byon/ lha 'dre'i dmag byung ba zil gyis mnan/ de rjes yul grong dang dben pa'i gnas sna tshogs pa rnams su byon zhing bzhugs nas slob ma yang skyong ba mdzad/ rgya gar dharma bo lha dang mjal du byon pa la khong gis rje btsun la gus pa'i phyag btsal/ dam 520

pa sangs rgyas kyang ding ri na bzhugs pa'i skabs shed du rje btsun dang mjal zhing gsung glengs bgyis/ chu bar du 'dre dmag byung ba de/ ngam rdzong ston pas chu pho 'brug gi lo yin par byas 'dug pas/( rje btsun gyi dgung lo bdun cu rtsa gsum par 'gyur/ rje btsun gyi slob ma yang ras pa mched brgyad du grags te/ gung thang gi gnyan chung ras pa/ lcem lung gi ngam rdzong ras pa/ rta mo'i 'bri sgom ras pa/ 'od khru'i se ban ras pa/ sdi shang gi khyi ra ras pa/ ras pa zhi ba 'od/ bde ba skyong/ ra rdzi ras pa rnams dang / / yang khyung tshang ba ye shes bla mas ni/ sras kyi thu bo lta bur gyur pa ras chung pa dang / sangs rgyas skye ba gcig gis thogs pa byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa rje sgam po ba chen po dang / sgom la sran tshugs pa rong chung rasari pa dang / drod la dbang thob pa rnal 'byor pa zhi ba skyong dang / dad pa dang mos gus su ldan pa 'bri sgom yang legs dang /jo rdor dang / zhang nag dang / se ban ston chung dang / lu skam ras pa dang / yon bdag mo legs se dang / rnal 'byor ma lcam me dang /sgron nee la sogs pa chos nyid kyi don rtogs pa mang du byung ngo zhes 'dren/ras pa zhi ba 'od/ sangs rgyas skyabs/ rong chung ras pa gsum mkha' spyod du bzhud cing / lcam mo be ta/ mdzes se/ chos kyi byang chub/'bring mtshams ma spyo tshab gza' rnams kyang mkha' spyod du bzhud do/ /521

de yang mi'i 'gro ba 'dul ba'i mchog rje sgam po ba/ mi ma min rnams 'dul ba'i mchog bkra shis tshe ring / ṭwā gi ma rnams 'dul ba'i mchog sngags skyes lhan cig skyes pa'i sgron me'o zhes kyang gsung ngo / de tsam zhig ni rags pa bsdus pa ste/ yul gcig tu'ang sku sna tshogs su ston zhing /yul du mar skad cig gis gshegs te sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i rje btsun chen po 'di'i slob ma tshang bar gi su zhig gis bgrang bar nus/rje btsun chen po 'di ni slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen yin no zhes grub pa'i skyes bu chen po dag gsung ngo / /rje btsun 'di ni dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bar du bzhugs nas/ chu mo yos bu'i lo la brin du sku gshegs pa'i tshul bstan/ gdung bzhu bas gdung dang ring bsrel la sogs pa ni cung zad kyang ma byung ngo / /rje btsun ma nyid kyi sprul pa ma gcig zha ma la 'khor 'ga' zhig gis mi la de sangs rgyas sam ma rgyas zhus pas/ khong gi brtson 'grus de gzhan dang mi mnyam pas sangs rgyas par nges so zhig gsung ngo / /de la rje ras chung pa ni/ rje btsun sgrub pa la thog ma bzhugs pa'i shing pho byi ba la khab gung thang gi sa char 'khrungs/ mtshan rdo rje grags zhes zer/ pha snga mo nas shi/ khu bo dang / ma 'dus nas/ khu bo'i g.yog byed cing / gzhon pa'i tshe nyid nas klog legs par mkhyen grong klog byas pa'i skyos mas khu bo dang ma mgu bar byed cing yod/ ras 522

gnyis ga'i dngos slob ti phu ba la tshang bar zhus/ gzhan yang gdams pa mang du btsal nas bla ma'i drung du byon/ chos skor di gu po rnams bla ma la phul/ bla mas ngam rdzong ston pa la gnang / ngam rdzong bas de la yi ga sna yang brtsams shing / de nas mched pa la bde mchog snyan brgyud zer/ras chung pa nyid nas gzhan la mched pa la ras chung snyan brgyud du grags/de ltar ras chung pas rje btsun mi la la brten nas rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes/ rang nyid kyis rgya gar nas blangs pa'i gdams ngag kyang mang du yod/ rje btsun gyi drung du dbus su 'gro bar zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis kyang gzhan la phan pa chen po 'byung bar dgongs nas gnang / drung nas 'byon pa'i tshe rje btsun gyis sa thag ring rab zhig tu bskyal nas/ da phyin chad 'di ltar gyis kyi zhal bkod rnams kyang legs par gsungs/ de nas ras chung pas cung mchog dkar du slob ma 'ga' zhig gi don mdzad cing lo lnga bzhugs/ de nas dbus su phyin nas dbu ru byang phyogs su phebs/bal po a su dang mjal nas gdams pa zhus pas/ a su'i zhal nas/gdams pa byin gyi bu smad gso dgos pas khyod kyis bsod stoms gyis la nas gang byung nga la phul gsung bas/ ras chung pas skyi smad yan chad du bsod stoms mdzad pas nas kyang shin tu mang bar rnyed nas/ a su la phul/ de'i skabs shed du bya yul du bya yul ba'i mang ja la sgrur byon pas sgo ba ra byung / der dbyangs blangs te/ bla ma'i gdams ngag 524

med par kha chus bshal ba la byang chub re bar 'dug ces bya ba'i glu blangs pas/ bya yul ba spyan chab shor ba la/ ja ma la du ba tsha'o gsung skad do/ /de nas lhor byon te mkhar chur thogs shig bzhugs nas/ nā ro pa'i ro stoms skor drug gi chos rnams gter da sbas/ slar ngams shod du phebs pa na/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa'i mthu'i man ngag zab mo zhig yod pa gzhan la mched na mi rung dgongs nas rdzong ri'i brag gseb tu sbas/ 'phyos kyi skyi tshang du yang thogs shig bzhugs/ de nas yar klungs su bzhugs pa la phyag rgya mo lha gcig cig yod pa/ des skyes pa gzhan dang lhan cig nyal bas sags skyo ste bros nas shambu'i gangs la thogs shig bzhugs/ de nas gnyal du byon te/ gnyal byar lo ro gsum du byon zhing lo ror shas che bar bzhugs/ phyis byar du bzhugs pa'i tshe khyung tshang pas mjal zhing / lo ror bzhugs pa'i tshe chos rgyal rin chen gling pas mjal nas snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa rnams thob/ de la spyir slob ma mang yang thugs kyi sras bcu gsum byon nas/ lo byi mgo ba/ gtsang pa sum pa/ byar bo par sher snang / lo ro glan byi mgo ba bla ma sgom chos/ lo ro mi sna ba sum ston chos ngar/ bur sgom nag po/ la stod pa zangs ri ras pa/g.ye chen mo ba 'bri sgom don grub/ gra phyi ba gnyal rdo rje 'od/ gnyal smad pa cung ston rgyan ni/ gnyal smad pa cung ston rgyas pa/ g.ye chung ba dge bshes khyung po dang bcu gnyis kyis dbang yang rdzogs la/ ye shes 525—

kyang ngos zin/ yar klungs pa lha rje lha 'bar gyis ni dbang rdzogs kyang yeshes ngos ma zin zer/ gzhan yang nye gnas rin chen grags/ gnyags gcer bu la rta shod ras pa yang zer/ sgom chen smon lam/ mal ye ra pa ba/ mnga' ris pa gsal mchog jo mo sgro mo/ sto pa byang ston/ 'tshur ston dbang de/ dus gsum mkhyen pa tsa ri sgom chung la sogs pa rnams so/ /sngon mtsho sna dril chung du bu mo lnga dang mjal zhing sbu blangs pa'i dbus na mo des phyis ras chung ba la brten nas bsgoms pas/ se mo do nas mkha' spyod du gshegs par grags so /de ltar gzhan gyi don mang du mdzad de/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa brgyad pa lcags mo sbrul la gsheg so/ /ra chung pa nas byung ba'i grub rgyal ma'i tshe sgrub kyi lo rgyus la/ ras chung bas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bzhugs zer ba cad na'ang /dngos kyi slob ma mchog rnams kyis bstan rtsis zhib yang dag pa mdzad pa las bdun cu rtsa brgyad du gsal ba yin no/lo byi mgo ba ni/ yul tro/nyal ston pa/ ras chung pa la gser gyi ma la phul nas dbang gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par zhus/ rlung ma ba sna tīr tshud nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i zhal gzigs/ bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa'i zhal yang gzigs/rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por bzhugs/ ma gcig g.yang dgos kyi sras mo zhig gis zhabasatog mdzad nas rje ras chung pa'i spyan sngar lo nyi zhu 526 — —

rtsa lngar gral dpon mdzad de 'khor thams cad skyong zhing bzhugs pa yin no/ /rje btsun gtsang pa ni/ las stod cung khu 'i smad kyi sum pa nye'u mkhar zhes bya ba na/ yab sum pa dbang phyu cis bya ba dang / yum rma tshu khye mkhar zhes bya ba'i sras lnga'i che dag tu 'khrungs/ khyim thab byed khar g.yu rdog khyer nas myang stod stag tshal du stod lung pa rgya dmar ba dang /rog mngon pa gnyis kyi ba sar byon nas rab tu byung ste lo gcig bzhugs/de nas rje ras chung pa'i spyan sngar byon pas shin tu mos par gyur nas/phyag ga ga pa'i srin lag bcad de mar me byas nas phul/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gcig gnyis la mjal nas gzims g.yog mdzad de/ zhal mjam tshad la mthong phyag gsum gsum mdzad pa dang / zhag re la phyag brgya brgya mdzad par dam bcas te bzhugs/ dang po nas yab yum gnyis rje btsun gyi yon bdag tu gyur pa dang / thag rings su chos la byon pas/ khong gis rī gnas mdzad phan chad khong med pa'i chos dang gdams ngag thun cig kyang gsungs pa med skad/ ras chung pa gshegag rjes gdan sa gzung /de'i dus na chu bo gaṅgā tshun la bzang bar grags/ gdams ngag ni rgya 'od gnyis ka na che/ thugs rjes sems can thams cad rjes su 'dzin pa zhig bzhugs/ yang sde sgod 'dzin pa na ma de bud med dang byis pa yan chod mi dad pa dang skur ba 'debs pa ni gcig kyang med/ khong gi mdzad spyod sna re mthong bas sems la phan zhing / sprob dpon gzhan la chos dang 527

gad kyis ngag tshar mang po nyan pa bas/ nad ka 'di yin gyi tshig re gsungs pas don mang po khrol nas 'gro ba/ thugs la yon tan rgya chen mnga' yang zhal nas khengs skyung 'ba' zhig mdzad pa zhig bzhugs/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang rgya gar gyi grub thob chen po zhig yin te/ rten 'brel en tsam zhig gis phan thogs che ba ma byung ba yin gsung / 'di la ras chung pa dang slob ma thun mong ba 'ga' re yang yod do/bur sgom ni/ rje phag mo gru pa dang rmog cog pa gnyis ma'i bla ma yin/khyad par phag mo gru pa la mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rjes su 'brang gi 'dug pa dang / gdan sa yang 'di 'dra bar 'byung zhes bya ba'i lung bstan pa rnams ji lta ba bzhin du byung zer/ khyung tshang ba yul stod lungs su/ shing mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ bya 'dul la rab tu byung / rgya dmar la bsnyen par rdzogs/ spa tshab lo tsā la dbu ma gsan pas bsten long ma byung bar dar yon tan grags la rigs tshogs gsan/ bzad pa dbang rdor la spyod phyogs rnams zhus/ rgya dmar pa la dbu tshad nyan/ se la phar phyin dang 'jam dpal/ phug pa ba la ra li dang 'phags skor/ jo bsod la bde mchog dang kṛ ya/ sto ba la kha rag skor/ nad pa dang rwa lo la dus 'khor dang nag 'jigs/ gnam 'phar ba la bka' gdams/ 'khon phu ba lcam sring la lam 'bras/ gling kha ba la gzer lnga/ dge bshes rgya la rim lnga/rngog la dgyes rdor zha mas gsan te/ de'i tshe gdams ngag ma byung nas 'gri 528

sgom gling kha ba'i sar phyin pas 'dag 'byar thon nas zhag bdun song ba zhig ngang mjal gangams ngag zhus pas gtum mo sgyu lus rmi lam rnams khrid byar btub pa zhig byung / gzhan rnams lung du gsan/ khong gi zhal nas/ dbus pa glen ras chung pa dbus na bzhugs yod pa la zer bas/ ras chung pa'i sar byon mjal ba zhus pas/ mi rnams na re/btsun pas sun nas yod pas mi mjal la che zer ba zhig la mjal/ nga'i rmi lam du zla ba rang gsal tsam zhig na re/ nyi ma 'od dang ldan pa 'ong bar yod zer ba rmis/ zla ba de khyong kyi slob mar 'dug nyi ma de khyod du 'dug pas gdams ngag sbyin no gsung nas/ zhag dgu bcu tham pa la snyan brgyud tshang bar gnang / tshogs 'khor kyang dgu btang / da 'dir ma sdod par song / nga ma shi ba'i bar du bla ma dang gdams ngag gsang/ de nas rgyal po nas mdze po'i bar sgod du gyur tshad la shod la/gdams pa thong du ma bsgyur gsung ngo / de nas lan gror khyung tshang brag la lo bdun bzhugs/ gzhan gyis bsnyen bkur byed pa gcig kyang ma byung /ha bo'i gang la'ang bzhugs/ khyung tshang du phug ron la grong 'jug kyang mdzad/ snang ba 'di la thogs pa med gsung / gzhan yang yi dam du ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang / sku 'tshal 'o mar 'bab pa dang / zag pa rgyun chad pa dang / thugs dam mnyam rjes med pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa mnga'/ dgung lo drug cu rtsa gnyis pa me pho spre'u la sga 529

gong du gshegs nas spur sbyangs pas ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon no/ /khyung tshang ba'i slob ma ma cig ong jo ni/ 'o yug tu 'khrungs/ gdung rus rgya yin/ spyir gdams ngag la gzhon dus nas thos bsam ming po mdzad/ bye brag tu khyung tshang ba dang mjal nas/ snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag rdzogs par thob/ gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtogs pa khyad par can brnyas/ dngos po mas cad bla ma la 'bul ba'i sbyin pa dang / sga gong du dbang gi shes rab ma byas pas nyams skyes te sdom pa gsum ldan du gyur ba'i tshul khrims can dang / gshes kyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i bzod pa dang / rim pa gnyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du gyur ba'i brtson 'grus dang / rang mas kyi mi long dag pa la lha dang bla ma dbyer med du shes pa'i bsam gtan dang / chos mas cad skye ba med cing mtshan ma med par bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa'i shes rab ste/ pha rol tu snyin pa drug gi yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /yang khyung tshang ba'i slob ma dge sdings pa ni/ shangs kyi lha phur zi ston ma ri sna'i sras su 'khrungs/ jo sras a seng zhes bya/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung / gangs pa she'u la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang po la dbu ma dang spyod phyogs gsan/ slob dpo rgya ma ba la sogs pa la yo ga la sogs pa'i gsang jigs mang du ga na/ de nas khyung tshang pa'i spyan sngor snyan brgyud zhus/ chos nyid kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pa/ te tu mnyam bang 53

ngabang nge la yan lag bdun ldan la sogs pa'i ras chung pa'i gdams pa mang po rgyas/ bang so ba la spungs pa skor gsum/ sto ba rta sgom dang dbon po jo bsod la mar do'i bde mchog rwa jo dar la dus 'khor dang 'jigs byed/ dbu ma'i slob dpon bsod rgyal 'a/ dgyes rdor ram lugs dang gsang ldan/ bla ma rdo rje skyabs la rmog cog pa'i chos skor/ shangs pa mar ston dang dge sdings pa la snyan brgyud/ rta sgom la snyan brgyud yab skor gyi grol lam dbang dang bcas pa/ lus med la sogs gnyal pa gsung gcad kyi slob ma zhig la'ang ngam rdzong lugs kyi snyan brgyud/ ma cig ong jo la snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa dbang dang bcas pa yod par rig nas zhus pas ma gnang / paṇa chen shākya shrī dang dpyal lo la bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ mtshan grub pa dpal bzang por btags/paṇa chen gyi phyags phyir lo gcig bzhugs te chos zhus/ slob dpon rgyang ro gzhon ring la 'dul ba dang spyod phyogs gsan/ ma gcig song jo'i drung du lan gsum byon pa'i tha ma la snyan brgyud tshang bar gnang / khyung tshang pa'i phyag dpe dang / dam rdzas kyi ril bu/ rgyan drug la sogs gnang zhing lung bstan yang mdzad do/ /shangs pa mar ston gyi slob ma gnyos sgom la thabs lam gyi khrid zhus/ ba ri ba la blo 'phel la sogs/ dgyer phu'i klog skya ba la jo bo rje'i lugs kyi bde mchog dang / 'phags skor/bla ma ko brag pa la lam 'bras zham lugs/ khro phu lo tsā ba la rnam sras 532

la sogs te/ chos zhus pa'i bla ma bdun cu yod do/ nge nas āo bal du byon nas bal yul ye rang du paṇa chen ratna rab ta la sgra tshad bslabs/rgyud 'grel pa dang bcas pa nyis brgya lhag pa zhig dang / dbang yongs su rdzogs pa brgyad cu rtsa bzhi thob gsung / pazlo ta shrī bai ma la kārti la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dbang dang dkyil chog la sogs mang du zhus/ thang ston la rgyud 'grel gsung dus 'grel /ka gzhan du lus nas ma lon pa la/bla ma la gsol ba btab pas gsan pa'i rgyud 'grel thams cad kyi rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud pa dus gcig la grol ba dang / khyung tshang pa la gsol ba btab pas mnal lam du dbang bskur bas rtsom pa la mchog tu gyur/paṇa chen la bde mchog gi dbang zhus dus sa g.yos/ gsang 'dus gsan dus bde mchog gis rgyud gsungs/ gshin rje gsan dus thugs rje chen po ser bo g.yo ba dang bcas pas chos gsungs/ bde mchog gsan dus ṭī gi mas gnang ba byin/ khrid mdzad dus sheg tu rol mo rang 'khrol/ bha ro la dbang mdzad dus gtor mas mkha' 'gro ma btul/stod 'grel gyi dbang gi dus su lce spyang dngos su byung / phreng ba'i 'gyur mdzad dus ltas ngo mtshar can byung / mnal lam du bram ze chen po dang mjal nas chos gsungs/ sa gdon gyi cho 'phrul bdud skor bzlog gis bzlogs dpe dkar gyis gnod pa rtsom pa drag po'i brtul zhugs kyis bcos/ bal yul du mu stegs kyi ngan sngags ma zhum pa'i spyod pas bzlogs 533

jo mo'i byin rlabs kyang zhus/ nā ro chos drug spyod yul/ blo sbyong rnams zhus/ sum cu rtsa bdun pa la cog ro lha sdings su zhang lo tsā ba'i drung du snyan brgyud zhus/ khyung tshang ba nas byung ba'i gdams pa rnams kyi sgro 'dogs bcad / rdo rje phreng ba'ang gsan/ chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rtogs shing / gzhan lus la mnga' brnyes pas gnyen po ched du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa bcom/ mdzad pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems rin po che las ma g.yos pa zhig go /yang ngam rdzong ston pa bo trī rā dza ni/ yul mdo khru snyim lung /gdung rus ngam rdzong yin/ byams chos la mkhas par sbyangs pas ston pa zhes zer/ rje btsun la gdams pa rnams rdzogs par thob/ rje btsun gyi bka' la bsdu ba yang mdzad/ des gung thang ras pa la bde mchog snyan brgyud rdzogs par gcang / des rgya pho ba lung ba la gnang / des chos skor de'i rtsom pa yang mang du mdzad/ gsang mtshan rol pa'i rdo rje zhes zer/ /yang ngam rdzong pa'i slob ma gnyal pa gsung bcad pa ni/ yul gnyal rong ba/ dgung lo bcu dgu la gog dor chos la bros/ bla ma mgon la khams gsum yongs grol rten 'brel dang bcas pa zhus/ de nas la stod du sdom bu la byon pas brin gyi la so na ngam rdzong pa bzhugs pa dang mjal/ gser srang phyed phul nas/ 'khor ba la blo log skye 'chis 535

'jigs nas chos byed pa yin pas/ dbang gdams ngag dang bcas pa zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ ngam rdzong pa'i zhal nas/ rje mi la'i gdams ngag thams cad rgyud dang 'brel ba thabs lam gyi gdams ngag dang / byin rlabs dang 'bul ba snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag gnyis su 'dus/ de la snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag 'di gzhan la byin pa med/ rje btsun ras chung pa la byin pa skad zer gyi 'dug kho bo la rje nā ro pa'i chos brgyad tshang bar gnang ba yin gsung nas/ khyad par gyi chos brgyad gdams ngag dang bcas pa tshang bar gnang / lhan cig skyes pa'i rtogs pa la ngo sprad nas/khyod kyis gsang spyod kyi tshul du nyams su long zhig gsang sngags kyi snod du rung ba shin tu dkon par 'dug pas/ brgyud pa zin pa'i snod ldan gcig gi rgyud smin par gyis la gdams ngag tshang bar byin gsung / spyir spyan sngar snga phyi dril bas zla ba bco lnga bzhugs/ de nas dbus su lha sa dang srin po ri la sogs par yug re byon/ de nas 'chid ru'i 'chad po che'i dgon par zhabs kyis 'byon pa 'ong yang gong bar brdzus/ gsung spru ba bcad nas zhugs brdzu mdzad de lo bco brgyad du phyir ma byon par sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad/ de'i pha zad cig tu lo ba/cig dang / lcang sar ser ma brag gdong du lo 'ga' bzhugs/ der mchog thun mong gi dngos grub la cha/nga' brnyes/ mngon par mkhyen pa mnga'/ dgung lo bdun cu lon pa la gshegs/ gnyal ba gsung bcad pa nyi ma seng gis 536

dmar bu brag pa gzhon nu shes rab la gsungs/ des 'brom ston rin chen shes rab/ dgyer sgom ri ba rin chen tshul khrims/ g.yang skyong ba rgyal ba don grub/ gser gling pa bkra shis dpal/ chos rje dkon mchog rdo rje/ mkhas grub a hūṃ badzra/ spre'u zhing rin po che byang chub dpal/des bdag la bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi dbang dang gdams pa mang po mkhan chen seng ge dpal ba dang lhan cig tu gnang ba lags/ rgya pho lung bas gtsang 'phrang ba chen po/ dge ba spang kha ba/ mtha' bzhi bya bral ba/bla ma gzi brjid pa/ bla ma dkon mchog bzang po/ mkhan chen shes rdor ba/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/ rgod phyug grags pa 'byung gnas kyi bar du brgyud de gdams pa rnams da lta'i bar du ma chad par yod pa'o/gzhan yang sngon byon pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rnam thar du snyan brgyud gsan pa'i yi gi 'dug na 'ang / de dag gang las brgyud ma 'tshal bas/ bdag nyid la brgyud pa'i rgyus 'tshal ba tsam zhig bris pa'o/ /sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo sum brgya na bram ze chen po byon/ des lo sum brgya lon pa la rje ri khrod pas mjal/ de nas lo nyis stong bzhi brgya rdzogs pa na ze tri bas mjal/ de nas gling ras gshegs pa yan chod du lo brgya dang bdun cu song / de rjes nas me pho spre'u yan la lo nyis brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa brgyad song / spyir ston pa 'das nas lo sum stong bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa brgyad me pho spre'u yan la song ba ras chung lugs kyi bstan 537

rtsis yin no/ bde mchog snyan brgyud dang ras chung snyan brgyud kyi skabs so/ / / /sgam po ba gdan sa dang bcas pa'i skabs/rje btsun mi la'i bu slob rnams kyi mchog tu grags pa'i rje sgam po ba ni/ rgyal ba yang dgon pas/ sprul pas sprul pa'i brgyud 'dzin sgam po ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal po'i khab kyi grong khyer du khyim bdag chen po phyug cing rigs mtho ba'i zas zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i tshe/bya rgod phung po'i ri la thub pa'i dbang po la mdo ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po zhus shing / de nyid gyi tshe rang gi khyim du ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas legs par bsnyen bkur/ ston pas kyang khyod kyis snyigs ma'i dus cu mdo sde 'di zung cig ces bka' stsal/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pas kyang srog dang bsdos te mdo sde 'dzin par zhal gyis bzhes/ ston pas kyang khyod mdo sde 'dzin pa'i tshe nga nyid kyis grogs byed do zhes bka' stsal ba'i byang chub sems dpa' zla 'od gzhon nu de ni rje sgam po ba dang /grogs mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i thub pa ni slob dpon phag mo grub legs par gda'/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa de yang bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol tu/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin po che padma'i zla ba rnam par dag pa mngon par 'phags pa'i rgyal po'i bstan pa 'gribs pa na/ byang 538

chub sems dpa' me tog mdze zhes bya bar gyur nas/ kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba'i nags su byang chub sems dpa' mang po la chos bstan zhing /gyis rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du skye bo mang po la chos bstan pas/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin gyis gshed ma la bsgos nas me tog zla mdzes bsad cing dum bur gtubs pa las/ dum bu rnams kyang kha dog ma nyams par yun ring du 'dug pa mthong na / rgyal po cher 'gyod de bshags pa byas pa la sogs pa'i gtam rgya cher mdo nyid nas gsal ba la/ rgyal po dpa' bas byin ni ston pa thub pa'i dbang po nyid yin pa dang / me tog mdzes zla 'od gzhon dur gyur pa nyid min pa dang / zla 'od gzhon nu chos rje sgam po bar gyur pa la sogs pa la skal ba dang ldan pa'i skye bo rab tu mang po chad ches par gyur te/ de'i bka' brgyud 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang mdo sde ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po la gces par 'dzin zhing mchod par mdzad pa yin do /don 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba'i zhal nas/ da ltar gyi phyag rgya chen po skad pa cig yod de/ de mdo sde ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i don min/ 'o skol de la dmad par yang mi bya la/ 'jug par yang mi bya gsung ba'i don de yang / ma po ba zla 'od gzhon nu yin pa la dgongs pa yin/ de lta bas na sgam po ba'i che ba'i yon tan ni gsung rab mas cad las bshad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rnams nyid yin pas na/ yon tan gyi tshad smos su lta kyi yod mod/ de lta na yang skye bo phal 539

pa dang mthun par skye ba gzung ba la sogs pa'i tshul shas shig bsnyad par bya ste de ni yul gnyal snyi/ gdung snyi ba/ yab snyi ba rgyal po/ yum sho mo gza' che lcam gnyis la sras po gsum 'khrungs pa'i bar pa/ sa mo zug gi lo la 'khrungs/ gzhon nu'i dus su sman bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen jo mo zhig kyang bzhes pa la/ lha rje nyid nyi shu rtsa lhag bzhes pa'i dus jo mo de 'das pas thugs skyo ste/ nyi shu rtsa drug pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen shab pa gling pa la tshig rdzogs mdzad/ dwags po skad du mar yul blo ldan la bde mchog dang rin chen rgyan drug ma la sogs pa'i dbang mang po yang gsan/ de nas dbu ru byang phyogs su byon nas/ bya yul ba dang / snyug rum pa/ lcags ri gong kha ba rnams la bka' gdams kyi chos mang du gsan/ de nas slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' la sgom pa'i man ngag zhus nas bsgoms pas zhag bcu gsum tsam du mi 'chor ba'i ting nge 'dzin yang 'khrungs/ de nas rang gi yul du byon nas bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ nye logs na sprang po gsum 'dug pa'i gcig na re/zan rdog ches pa re dang tshod ma phor pa re bzar yod na dga' ba la zer/gcig na re/ smon ni byed na mnga' bdag rtse lde lta bu la smon mod zer/rgan pa gcig na re/ smon ni rang yin na mi la ras pa bya ba zas gos kyi zhen pa med pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur nas phar 'byon tshur 'byon byed pa cig yod par 'dug de 'dra ba ra smon mod zer/ der mtshan thos 540

pas shin tu dad par gyur te/ sprang po de rnams 'dod pa'i bza' btung byin nas/ de 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa de gang na yod pa yin dris pas/sprang po de na re/ brin snye nam gyi ri la bzhugs pa yin/ la las khong mjal du phyin yang mi mthong / la las mchod rten du mthong ba yin zer/de nas de rgongs bsgom zhing bzhugs pa'i rmi lam du rnga chen po cig brdungs pas yul rgya chen por thos pa dang / rag dung cig bus pas kyang skad shin tu che bar byung / bod na 'di las che ba'i rag dung med zer ba rmis pas/bla ma rje btsun de dang mjal ba'i ltas yin nam snyam pa byung / der lam du chas te dbu ru'i bla ma rnams la phyag skyel du byon nas/ da bla ma 'di 'dra ba zhig gi bsngags pa thos pas/ de mjal du 'gro zhus pas/ la la na re/ nged rang gi gdams ngag gis chog mod gsung / de yang btud de zhus pas song zhig pa'i gnang ba dang / nged kyi rtags ma bor bya ba gsung / der 'gongs ston bya ba zhig dang 'grogs byon pas/gtsang tshong 'dus su sleb pa na 'gongs ston na pas der lus/ khong rang gis byon pas/ rje btsun dang nyi ma phyed dang gnyis tsam na mjal ba'i sar bsnyun drag po 'grongs su cha ba cig byung ba la/ rje btsun nyid la gsol ba btab bas myur da sos/ de nas brin du phebs pa'i tshe/btsun pa cig bsur byung nas khyed re bsod nams che na zer/ de ci yin byas pas/ bla mas khyed 'byon bar na ning nas lung bstan/ da lta 541

zhing mchog gi gtum mo gnang / de'i rtags khyad par can byung ba na khyod pho rgod rab tu 'dug gsung / de ltar zhabs drung der zla ba bcu gsum song / da dbus pa ston pa rang dbus su bzhud gsung nas zam sna cig gi bar du skyal nas/ der da 'jig rten blos thong la sgrub pa 'ba' zhig gyis/ dug gsum rgyas pa'i mi dang ma 'grogs/ de rnams kyi kha rlangs kyis rang gi dge sbyor 'grib pa yin pas/ gnas ri khrod dang dgon pa 'ba' zhig bsten/ da ste lo gsum na khyod la dge sbyor gsha' ma cig skye/de'i dus su nga la'ang mthong 'di min pa cig 'ong gsung ba la sogs pa'i zhal bkod mang po gnang ste/ gnyal du phebs/ se ba lung bya ba'i dgon par bzhugs/ der bka' gdams pa'i dge 'dun mang po yod pas/ 'di rnams kyi chos spyod kyi ram ma bteg na sdig sog dgongs nas ram bteg cing / de rnams dang spyod lam bstun pas ting nge 'dzin cung zhig 'gribs/ da 'dis mi 'ong bar 'dug dgongs nas lo gsum stan dang ma bral bar bsgom pa'i brtson 'grus bskyed pas gzod sems kyi ngo bo mthong / chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mkhyen/ bla mas gsungs pa'i dge sbyor gsha' ma de 'di yin par 'dug snyam pa dang / bla ma rje btsun de'ang chos kyi sku nyid du 'dug pa la/ rang res grub thob chen po cig tu gzung 'dug snyam pa'ang byung / de nas bla ma ri btsun gyi gsung bzhin du mi dang 'grogs lugs spangs te/ dben pa'i gnas mang por thogs re 544

thoṭa re bzhugs/ mthar 'o de gung rgyal gyi gangs la bzhugs nas lo mang rab song ba na/ nyin gcig mi rgan la thod can gos bzang po gyon pa zhig byung nas/ ngas 'dir khyed kyi zhabs tog bya snyam pa yin te/ da nga'i bu dgas lha sgam pos gdan 'dren par 'dug pas der gshegs shig zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ de la rje btsun gyi drung du mjal ba'i lo de rje btsun gyi bdun cu rtsa gcig pa/ rang lo sum cu rtsa gnyis pa lcags pho stag gi lo yin phyir 'byon pa'i dus su lcags mo yos bu'i lo/ 'byon khar rje btsun gyi gsung gis lo bcu gnyis na brin gyi ri la zhog cig gsung ba yod pa/ de dben pa bsten pa'i skabs su dran nas 'byon par dgongs te lam du zhugs nas yar klungs su phebs pa na/ rje btsun gshegs pa'i skad thos shing / khyod kyi skal pa yin zer ba'i rten sna 'dra ba yang sprad byung bas/ de nas phyir log pas mkha' 'gro mas khyim dang kha zas khyad par can sprul nas gshos drangs/ gsol tshar ba dang gnas la sogs pa gang yang mi snang / de nas yang dben pa bsten nas bsgoms/'o de gung rgyal nas sgam por thegs so/ /'o de gung rgyal du ma bzhugs pa'i snga rol gyi skabs shed du ni/ cadabu ru'i bla ma rnams dang mjal nas 'gro don gyis shig pa'i zhal bkod gnang byung ba na/ 'gro don gyi rnam par rtog pa me da/ tshe 'o gsum las med zhus pas/ snyug rum pas 'di la sgrub pa gyis dang ro khung brus kyang ma'i tso ba yin gsung nas/ sgrol 545

dkar mo gnang bas sku tshe ring du 'phel/ g.yer dge bshes sgro ba can du byon pa'i tshe/ sgre ba'i zhal nas/ khyed rang da lan nga'i chos skyong 'di khyer na khyed rang la shin tu dga' ba cig 'dug gsung pa la/ de res chos skyong yang ma bsnams/ phyis sgam por byon nas dgon pa dar rgyas byung ba na/ slob ma gnyis zhur btang bas/ sgre ba'i zhal nas/sngar bsgoms zhus pa'i tshe bsnams na thal ba yang 'chag pa cig 'ong bar 'dug ste ma bsnams/ da mar tshud 'di dge bshes pa rang gis phyag tshud la gsol cig gsung nas mar cig gan nga byung ba la/ gsung ba bzhin byas pas mar tshud nas mgon po'i sgrub skor rgyas par byung / nyid kyis yig cha 'ga' re yang mdzad/ gyis mgon po 'di ha cang brtsub dra( 'dug dgongs nas/ nga'i yi ge de rnams cung zad nor 'dug pas so so nas khyer shog gsung nas bsdus te/ yi ge rnams gzhan la ma gnang zhing mgon po 'jam par 'gyur ba'i thabs mdzad/ dge bshes nyan pa bya ba cig la yod pa de ma 'dus shing / de las mched pa yang 'ga' re byung gsung ngo /sgam por phebs ba'i tshe gzungs kyi dbang phyug rgyal pos zhus pa'i mdo'i gleng gzhir/ bcom ldan 'das thog mar chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa zhes 'byung ba bzhin/ rang nyid kyi phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa ni mchog tu gyur/ chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor ba zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ gdams ngag rgya chen po'i 546

'khor lo ni nyin dang mtshan du chad pa med par bskor/ de la rje btsun mi la ni thabs lam dang phyag rgya chen po logs logs su mi ma da pa la/sngags kyi sgod du rung ba rnams la thabs lam gyi gdams ngag bstan/dbang bskur med kyang pha rol tu snyin pa'i sgod du rung ba rnams la phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa btab sto/ lhan cig skyes sbyor zhes bya ba'i khrid rim yang mdzad/ de la dgas ba'i rtogs chos kyang zer/ gsung rab rnams nas ma dang slobama'i mtshan nyid mang bar gsungs na'ang / slob ma la mtshan nyid mang po mi dgos/ mos gus yong ba gcig pus chog gsung zhing / blun po dang dbul phongs dang sdig can du gyur ba 'ga' la yang phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa yun mi ring bar bskyed/ bka' gdams kyi bstan pa'i rim pa'i bstan bcos kyang mjod/ gdams ngag kyang mang du gsungs bas/ 'di nas bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres su grags te/dge ba'i bshes gnyen gzhan dang mi mnyam pa'i snyan pas phyogs thams cad du khyab/ slob ma'i tshogs shin tu dul ba mtha' yas pa mnga' zhes gsungs pa ba na/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang ldan zhing bla ma la mos pa thob/'jig rten 'di'i 'khri ba bcad nas gangs khrod dang / rdza ri dang /g.ya' ri dang / nags khrod dang / dben pa'i sa gang yang rung bar sgrab pa snying por byed pa'i slob ma yang bsam gyis mi khyab rab tu byung ༵'ang thos bsam sngon du ma song ba'i btsun chung mang po yang rtogs pa la 547

bkod pas/ mtshan nyid pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'ga' zhig gis/ blo gsal mang po sgam po bas chud zos su bcug gces 'bar ba la/ gsung gis/ mtshan nyid pa rnams nga la bka' bkyon te/ nga'i btsun chung 'di rnams kyis kyang 'gro don pher ba re 'ong ba yin gsung /sgam por bzhugs pa'i tshe sku mtshams nyid du bzhags kyang / 'ga' zhig gi rab gnas/ 'ga' zhig gi ston mo'i gral dbu/ gnas gzhan dang gzhan 'ga' zhig tu chos gsung ba la sogs pa dus gcig nyid la mdzad pa mang du ston pa dang / bzhugs pa'i sar yang la las thub pa dang spyan ras gzigs la sogs su mthong ba dang / la las gzims mal na ci yang ma mthong ba la/ de ma thag bla ma'i skur mthong ba la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang bstan grol sgom se mo do'i mtsho 'gram du rlung log byung ste 'gyel/ de'i tshe grol sgom la rlung log byung / nga'i ja la dza ti thob gsung nas dza ti btab pa bzhes pas/ grol sgom rlung brgyal sangs te dza ti'i sgegs pa byung / gyis grol sgom phyag 'bul du byung ba'i tshe/ rgyus yod 'ga' zhig gis/ slob dpon khyed la na ning zla ba 'di'i nyi ma 'di la ci byung ba yin dris pas/ de'i nyin kho bo la rlung log byung ba yin zer bas/ mi de na re/ dpon slob rgyud gcig par 'dug pa ngo mtshar che zer/ de la sogs pa'i slob ma yang cho 'phrul can mang ste/se mo dor dpal chen rga los mthe bong gis lus byin theg par mdzad pa la/548

grol sgom gyis/ 'di chos rje sgam po ba gnyen lhug 'bring po zhes bzhed pa yin zer ba byas/ khong nga zil gyis gnon 'dod 'dug ste/ ngas phar zil gyis mnan dgos dgongs nas ngang ba shi ba'i ro la grong 'jug byas te/ se mo do'i mtha' lan gsum bskor/ dpal rga lo'i gdong du sgra mang du bsgrags/ sngar gyi gnas de nyid du ngang ba'i ro bzhag nas grol sgom nyid du byas te/ dpal chen po dang gsung gleng mang du mdzad do/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor chos g.yung gis rang gi tshogs kyi res la sum cu rtsa gsum nas lha'i bdud rtsi blangs te drangs pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul mang po yod de/ de tsam gyis mtshon no/ /tshogs pa yang yun ring du bskyangs nas/ mthar chu mo bya'i lo la mya ngan las 'da' khar/ btsun pa gnyis kyis lag tu gtor ma re thogs te/ nged gnyis thabs lam zhu ba yin pas thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zer ba'i skad btang bas/ tho phyir ma gtong gsung / der nye gnas shig gis phyag rgya chen po zhu ba yin gyis la skad thong byas pas/ de gnyis kyis kyang phyag rgya chen po zhu ba lags na byas te skad ring po btang bas/ da lta thong gsung nas nang du btang /phyag rgya chen po'i gdams pa yang gnang ngo / /de ltar nyid kyi chos rnams las phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig mgo 'don pa mdzad de/ dgung lo bdun cu rtsa lnga pa chu mo bya'i lo'i ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga'i snga dro'i cha la gshegs/ gdung sbyangs bas thugs ma nyams par byon/ mkha' 'gro — 549

'du ba dang / mi ma yin rnams 'du ba dang / lung pa 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba la sogs pa'i ltas snang yang bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / sde ba rnams so so nas gdung skal snyeg tu byung ba la/ slob dpon sgom tshul gyis gdung zhol gzhal nas byin pas thams cad bsam pa tshim par gyur to/ /gsung las skyes pa'i bu chen yang sho rom 'phags pa/ zim shing ye shes snying po/ gser sgom ye shes snying po/ ram nyi ba chos kyi g.yung drung ste grub pa thob pa bzhi/ dwags po sgom tshul/ phag mo gru pa/ 'ba' rom pa/ dus gsum mkhyen pa ste brgyud pa 'dzin pa bzhi/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ 'gar sgom dkar po/ la yag jo sras/ skye bo ye rdor te de dang nye ba bzhi/ jo ston/ legs mdzes/ gsal byang /gsal mas te nye gnas bzhi ste/ de dag la sgam po ba'i bu chen bcu drug ces grags/ gzhan yang rmog cog pa/ khyung tshang ba/ gnyags nagaganyags dmar po/ gsal sdong shor re/ zhang sum thog pa/ bla ma 'ol kha ba grol sgom/ sto pa dar sgom/ rdzi sgom skyes se/ bya sgom rdo rje se// 'bro dmar yu/ nam pa 'phan nee/ btsad po lha sgom/slob dpon sgom chung la sogs pa mang du byon no/ /de la khams pa dbus se nas grub pa'i skyes bu skye ba rgyun mi 'chad par byung ba bzhin du/ rje sgam po ba'i slob ma dge slong tshul khrims dpal zhes bya ba dbu sa'i yang slob mar gyur pa zhig rang lo sum cu rtsa bdun pa la gshegs nas/550

phyis dge slong rnam mkha' 'od du gyur nas skye ba rgyun mi 'chad du byung ba yin te/ de ni gyis slar yang rje sgam po ba'i slob mar gyur te/ de'i tshul ni phyi nas brjod par bya'o/ /rje dwags po rin po che de'i dbon po slob dpon sgom par mtshan gsol ba de ni/ rje sgam po ba'i gcen po rgya ba se re dang / yum tshe lcam gnyis la slob dpon sgom pa/ sgom pa grags mdzes/ sgom chung ste sras gsum byung ba las/ bar ba grags mdzes ni ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ snga mo nas gshegs/ che ba slob dpon sgom pa yum la rmi ltas khyad par can dang bcas te me pho spre'u'i lo la gnyal bong snyir 'khrungs/ lo bcu gcig lon pa'i tshe rje sgam po ba dang mjal/ rje sgam po ba'i zhal nas/ 'di rgya gar gyi pa ta chen po zhig yin gsung / zhal mjal ba tsam gyis sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin 'khrungs/ bcu bdun pa la dge bshes mnga' ris pa la rab du byung lo de nyid la rje sgam po bas sin ju ra'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa legs par gnang ba bsgoms pas/ lo bco brgyad pa la phyag rgya chen po sgom du med pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ thabs lam la yang mnga' brnyes te/ lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i tshe gnyags lha byar ma'i gangs la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ gangs rtser bzhugs kyang ther cham res dros pa dang / 'byung bzhi'i rlung gi kha dog gsal por gzigs shing / steng 'og sprob dang g.yas g.yon sprob la tshegs med pa — 551

byung / rlung phyag sor dang ba spu'i bu ga gang 'dod du 'drongs/ de rnams 'phar tshad du rje'i drung du zhus pas/ rje sgam po bas chos gos nyi zer la bkal/ lo de nyid la zhab pa gling du bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan tshul khrims snying por gsol/ rje sgam po bas gdams ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang nas lam phug dang sha 'ug stag sgo la sogs par byon/der lo gnyis bzhugs nas sgam por byon/ zangs lung du bla mas sna len gyi tshogs 'khor mdzad pa'i tshe/ zho sgom 'phags pa la nyams kyi 'char lugs go lags sam gsungs pas/ lan du/ nyams rtogs ngo bo gcig tu 'dres/ /chos kyi sku la 'du 'bral med/ /nyams rtogs can la nga mi smon/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i mgur gsungs pas/ 'phags pas bshums/sgam po ba'i zhal nas/ 'o skol gyis da kho mi thub nyal du 'gro gsung skad/ gcan chen grangs dang gser len du lo gsum bzhugs/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga pa lcags pho rta'i lo la gdan sar dbang bskur/ nga gis pas da khyed rang rnams tshul khrims snying po la btud cig gsung / de nas lcags mo lug gi lo la gdams pa du ma re gsungs/ de nas lo gnyis lon pa chu mo bya la sgam po ba sku gshegs/ gdung bzhu bas thugs phyag tu byon nas/ de bzhugs pa'i rten gser gyi bkra shis sgo mangs bzhengs shing / mchod khang rnying ma dang sgom sde'i mkhar las kyang mdzad/ de nas gsang phur byon nas der grwa pa brgya tsam 'dus/ der dgyes rdor 552

lha dgu'i zhal gzigs/ de gnyal ston la ba da pas/ gnyal ston gyis nga la yang bstan par zhu byas pas/ khong gis kyang mthong / de nas stod lungs su gnas brtan shes rab grags kyis spyan drangs nas/'tshur lha lung gi dgon pa btab pas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum gyi grwa pa tshan che bar 'dus/ lha sar phebs pa'i tshe/ lha sa sde 'khrug gi rkyen gyis re rgyal du song ba 'di gso bar mi nus sam snyam pa byung ba'i tshe/mnal lam du rje sgam po bas khyod kyis nga 'jog phod dam gsung ba dang /jo bo shākya'i sku la dngos su spyan chab byung bas de nyid du bzhugs nas gso nam rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa legs par grub/de nas yar 'brog la sogs pa gnas gang na 'khrug pa dar ba rnams su byon nas gnya' dang gdums legs par gnang / 'di'i nang gi lha gzigs tshul dang / de slob ma la yang bstan pa la sogs pa ni grangs med/phyag rgya chen po rtogs pas thugs kyi sgrib pa bral te/ gsung rab thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i smra ba po chen por gyur pas/ phyag sor ba la sogs pa'i mang du thos pa rnams kyis ni gus pas btud/ mkhas pa chen po gtsang nag bas/ ska la med skye bo ring nas ngan brjod kyang / /mthong dang 'dris pa'i skye bo dad gyur la/ /mngon rlom dregs pa brgya dag zil gnon pa'i/ /bsod nams gzi ldan sku la skyabs su mchi/ /zhes bya bas bstod par yang mdzad do/ /rgol kha'i mgar phug tu lo gcig 553

chos shin tu dmar bar gsungs/ ston sgam por thegs nas grwa pa rnams la nga su dang yang mi mjal ba'i mtshams byed pas/ khyed rang dge bshes khams pa dang mnga' ris pa la sogs gang mos la brten gsungs nas/ sa mo glang gi lo lnga bcu rtsa bzhi pa dbyug gu zla ba'i tshes nyi shu la gshegs/lo 'di la slob dpon phyu pa yang gshegs/ g.yam bzang chos rje 'khrungs pa yin/ de nas zhag bdun na gdung bzhu bas thugs ljags ma tshig par byon pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pas kyang sems can smin par mdzad do/ /de'i rjes su slob dpon sgom chung gis gdan sa bskyangs pa yin te/ de ni rje sgam po ba nyid la gdams ngag tshang bar mnos nas/ mtha' yas pa'i yon tan mnga' ba zhig ste/ gdan sa lo gnyis bskyangs/ mtshan ni shes rab byang tshub ces bya/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi la gshegs/gdung sbyangs pas thugs ljags byon no/ /de'i rjes rje khu dpon gsum ga'i zas su gyur pa dwags po 'dul 'dzin gyis gdan sa bskyangs pa yin te/de ni yul dwags po zes dkar du bon po'i rigs su 'khrungs/ sku mched gsum gyi che ba gnyal sde/ de 'og sher 'byung / chung ba mkhan po'o/ /gcen po gnyis chos rje sgam po ba'i slob ma min pas/ khong gi rgyags skyel du mkhan pos byon pas sgam po ba dang mjal/ der sgam po pas sgrol ma dkar mo/ mgon po'i rjes gnang / phyag rgya chen po'i ngo sprod rnams gnang / de nas gnas mkhar du snubs sgom chung la rab tu byung 54

zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ de'i nub mo rmi lam du gtsang po la mi mang bo bsgral ba rmis pas/ phyis de kho na bzhin du dgas po 'dul 'dzin la sdom pa thob bam ma thob ces zer ba byung zhing / mkhan bu shin tu mang bar byung / mngos khar ba la phar phyin nyan/ der rnam g.yeng che bas sha mi 'dul 'dzin can du byon pas/ chos gsung ba dang mjal nas 'dul ba mtha' dag mkhas par bslabs te/ zur chos kyang thogs re bshad/de nas bsnyun drag po cig gis rkyen byas nas bshad pa 'phro shol nas/slob dpon sgom pa'i drung du byon pas/ sgam po ba'i chos ma lus pa gnang /yun ring du phyags phyi byas/ de nas nya mo khar slob dpon sgom pas tshogs shig mdzad pa'i tshe/ mdo sde dkar po dang srad ma dkar po bya ba'i yon bdag gnyis 'thabs nas kye co chen po byas pas/ slob dpon sgom pa thugs skyo ste/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa la shog gsung nas/ da phyin chagatshogs mi byed/ sngar byas pa rnams kyang khyod kyi mdun du bshags/nga'i gdan sa yang khyod kyis gyis gsung ba las/ tshogs mi shol bar gsol ba btab pas kyang ma gnang / gdan sa dang ga la 'ong snyam yod pa'i lo mang po ma lon bar slob dpon sgom spru gshegs/ de'i gdan sar sgom chung bzhugs pas kyang lo gnyis las ma thub/ gzhan zho sgom la sogs pa'i chen po mang du yod kyang gdan sa 'du ba 'dzin pa la gtad/ der gdan sar bzhugs pas bya dka' se byung / grwa pa rnams kyang phyogs gzhan 555

du 'gro ba la/ 'di nga rang gis dge sbyor ma byas bas lan snyam nas/lo brgyad kyi bar mtshams bsdams nas thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/grwa pa rnams yang 'dus byung / de nas gnyal ba byang chub 'bum bya bas dug drangs pas bsnyung bas/ 'tshur phur byon nas sman pa mkhas pa cig gis bcos pas legs par dwangs/ de nas byang thang sogs su bzhugs pa na yang tshogs pa cher 'dus/ de 'grol du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rje 'bri khung pas 'bul ba tshan po che dang / gdan sa de khyed min pas mi 'khyings pas/ khyed kyis cis kyang skyong bar zhu bya ba'i gsung byung bas/slar yang sgam pordo bzhugs/ gyis rje 'bri khung pa sgam por byon pa'i dus su/ khu dbon gsum gyi thugs kyi sras/ /bslab pa gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /skye med don rtogs rnal 'byor capa/ —/mkhan po dge ba'i bshes la 'dud/ /ces bstod pa yang mdzad/ de nas khrid rnams kyang bskyangs shing 'dul ba yang gsungs/ de nas grwa pa rgan pa rnams dang gros byas nas/ gtsug lag khang ka ba bcu drug pa cig byed par gros bcad pa la/mkhan po bas ka ba bzhi bcu tham pa'i ming bting / yo gsum na tshar bar byas/ rje 'bri khung pas kyang rta pho bya dmar rlung zhags la sogs pa gtsug lag khang rtsig pa'i cha rkyen mang du gnang / lan cig mnal lam du btub par byung nas/ gtsug lag khang rnying ma'i rten rnams kyang mchod khang gsar mar gdan drangs/ rī 'bri khung pas phag mo grwa'i chos rnams 556
