spyan drangs byung bas logs cig khengs/ rin po che 'grol ba la sogs rta 'i slob ma yang mang du byung / 'jig rten gyi gnya' dang 'dun ma la sogs pa'i gzhan don yang mang du mdzad/ mthar dgung lo bdun bcu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i tshe sku gshegs/ gdung sbyangs pas thugs ljags dang phyag g.yon pa ma tshig par byon/ de rnams na kra'i gdung khang na bzhugs so/ /de'i gdan sa 'bri khung gling bar grags pa dbon shes rab 'byung gnas kyis mdzad/ de nas dam chos gling ba/ spyan snga chos tshul ba/ rin po che lha lung ba/ rin po che bon gnas pa/ rin po che chos dbang ba la sogs pa rnams byon no/ /sgam po ba gdan sa dang bcas pa'i skabs so/ /la sgam po ba'i dngos spob kyi skabs/rje sgam po ba'i bu chen rnal 'byor chos g.yung ni/ klungs shod rong gi ngal mdar yo mi klu phyug bya ba'i sras su/ lcags pho 'brug la 'khrungs/ bcu dgu la bya yul ba la rab tu byung / nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la sgam po ba dang mjal/ yon tan khyad par can brnyes/ sgam po sku mched bzhugs ring la tshogs pa ma bskyangs/ de rjes lo bdun du tshogs pa bskyangs nas don brgyad pa me mo bya la gshegs/ /yang dwags po'i slob ma grub rtags mchog tu gyur pa grol sgom chos g.yung ni/ yul 'ol kha ba/ yab lha rje smon lam 'bar dang / yum 557

rnamashes skyid gnyis kyi sras su chu mo lug gi lo la 'khrungs/ rje sgam po bas nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i lo de yin/ bcu bzhes pa'i tshe yab kyis chos sngags dang sman bslabs/ bco lnga la jo mo zhig blangs pa de lo rang 'das te skyo ba skyes nas da ge bshes brag rtsa ba la sdom pa blangs/ de ma khad 'dul gror byon nas zhang ston shes rab 'bar la 'dul ba mkhyen par bslabs/ de nas sgam po ba la dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes nas spong thag mdzad de gdams pa rnams zhus/ zhag gcig gi bar du 'od gsal thun gcig la bzhugs pa la sogs pa'i thugs dam mchog tu gyur/ 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gro ma dbang du 'dus/ yo byad rnams grogs la byin nas lo ro ras chung pa la snyan brgyud zhus/ 'jam dpal zhal gzigs nas dbu ru phyogs su lung bstan/ phywa yul du lo gnyis bzhugs/ de'i tshe rta mgrin zhal gzigs nas las can gyi slob ma 'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin 'gro mgon zhang byon/ rga los slob mar bsdu dgos dgongs nas 'dug pa la/ ngang pa'i ro la grong 'jug mdzad nas ltad mo bstan pas/zhwa lo dad de bar do'i gdams pa zhus/ de'i tshe gsang gso dang lta stangs kyis dgug pa la sogs pa'i nus pa chen po brnyes/ ba ri lo tsā ba la sgrab thabs brgya rtsa la sogs pa gsan/ dgu bcu rtsa bdun pa mo lu/ gi lo la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas te gshegs/ / / /chos rje 'bab rom pa dar ma dbang phyug ni/ 'phan yul mdar spu 55

ba'i rigs su 'khrungs/ gzhon pa'i dus su sngags chung gzhon pa cig rtsar byung nas/ chos rje sgam po ba'i bsngags pa mang du brjod cing / khyod rang yang khong gi thad du phyin pa 'thad zer bas/ da 'o na khyod kyis 'gro ba'i grogs byed dam byas pas byed par khas blangs te/ kho dang bsdongs nas sgam por byon/ sgam por sleb ma thag nas sngags chung de gar song cha med de/ de rje sgam po ba'i sprul par grags/ de nas sgam po ba dang mjal nas thugs kyis gzung zhing dmar khrid kyis bskyangs pas rtogs pa mchog tu gyur te/ byang du 'bab rom gyi dgon pa de btab/ sku tshe yang ring bar bzhugs nas slob ma mang du 'dus/ gnas der mkha' 'gro 'du bar grags shing bya mang po 'du zhig yod/ de'i brgyud pa khong rang gi gdung brgyud kyis 'dzin zhing / dus phyis gdung brgyud nang ma 'cham par gdan sa re mos byed pa la sogs pa yang byung / ti shrī ras pa yang 'bab rom pa'i slob ma yin pas/ des bdag rkyen mdzad de nang rten gyi dngul gdung chen po zhig mad pa yang ma nyams par bzhugs so/ /yang rje sgam po ba'i slob ma sto la yag pa byang chub dngos grub ni/mes po star ka bo ddhi rā dza zhes bya ba sngags rnying ma'i yon tan dang ldan zhing grub pa brnyes pa/ lo brgya dang bcu gnyis bzhugs pa cig gi sras/ star ka dpal skyid ces pa mngon pa dang gsar rnying mang po la sbyangs pa cig dang / chu ma stag lo zla sgron zhes bya ba me shes kyi mkha' 'gro mar grags559

pa gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ mtshan chos kyi dngos grub tu btags/bu chung gi dus su mi gzhan med pa'i tshe/ lag pa da /ra po rgyan can cig gis bu rdzi byed pa cig byung / lo gsum lon pa'i tshe yab kyis ra klog slob pa byung ba na/ pha jo 'di tsho ngas kyang shes zer nas cung zad kyang slob ma dgos par shes/ lo lnga lon pa'i tshe byis pa zla bos shig me la bsregs pas rang dbang med par brgyal ba ltar gyur/ skye bas thob pa'i snying rje chen po mnga' zhing mi dge ba phra zhing phra ba la yang 'dzem/lo bcu tsam lon nas/ dge bshes smon mda' ba'i sar sgyu 'phrul zhi khro dang yang dag gsan nas sgrub pa yang bag re mdzad/ khu bo cig chu khyer mda' na bzhugs pa la byams chos dang mngon pa dang spyod phyogs phran dang bcas pa yang gsan/ mdo sde rgyan tshar gnyis kyis thugs su chud nas byams chos sngon la tshar bar byas/ bcu bdun lon pa'i tshe gtsang du byon nas dge bshes lcang ra ba rtsam ston dang / mdar skyogs me la sogs pa'i sar byams chos dang spyod phyogs tshar re tsam gsan/ der btsun chung pa ra ga te bya ba'i grub thob cig dang mjal/ hor dar bzang po sham bu cig gnang nas/ khyed nyi ma shar phyogs su song dang skyid kyi nyi ma shar 'ong gi ngo ma nag ces pa'i lung bstan yang byung / de nas yul du byon pas/ dge bshes chab bya ba cig grongs pa'i 'angad kyi chos 'khor la la stod dkon mchog mkhar dang bsam yas pa spyan drangs pa'i sar byon nas pha 560 tsho

ro la du phyin pa'i dka' 'grel gsan/ der bgro rmeng byas pas sngags pa rgan thung chos mang du thos pa cig 'dug zer/ dge bshes la stod pas nga'i phyir 'deng / lo gcig na phar phyin mkhas pa cig bya zer nas 'gro bar chas pa la/ yul na sgam po ba'i slob ma sgom chen zhig yod pas ngas sgam por bskyal zer/ de nas yul du yun mi ring ba cig bzhugs/sgom chen des khrid nas sgam por byon/ khong khrid mkhan de la sgom ba zhi mdzes zer/ rje sgam po ba'i gsung nas/ nyi ma nub kha'i sbang than dang 'dra ste/ 'on kyang sto ba 'di dngang la/ nga dang rje btsun 'dra ba'i las 'brel zhig yod pas/ sgom tshul la 'di'i chos sgo myur du phye gsung /de nas chos rje'i mtshams khongs su bcug nas dbang dang gdams pa gnang /jo sras khyod nga'i tshe stod kyi slob ma cig rkyen gyis shi bas khyod du skyes/da res tshe mthar phyin par 'dug cig gsung / der bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa lta bu'i phyag rgya chen pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ bla mas gtum mo rigs mi 'dra ba mang po gnang nas/ 'di tsho la zin bris gyis gsung bas/ nga nyams len 'ba' zhig byed pas sna kha mang po 'di mi dgos rgyas pa la/ bla ma'i gsung nas/ des mi 'ong /khyod tshe mthar 'khyol zhing sgom chen mgo se yang de ba brgya tsam gyi slob dpon bya dgos par 'ong gsung nas lung bstan/ yang zhal nas/ ngas dang po ba ri lugs kyi bde mchog bslabs pa yin te/ dpe yang med 561

bshad pa yang ma byung bas/ jo sras kyis dpal nā ro pa'i brgyud pa cig la bde mchog zhus shig gsung nas/ ཿ yi pa jo bo lugs kyi 'grel pa lo tsā ba rin chen bzang pos mdzad pa de'i dpe dang lung yang gnang /sgam po ba sku mtshams mdzad pas spyan sngar 'gro ma nus pa la/ nye gnas 'bod du byung nas spyan sngar phyin dus/ nga'i mtshams 'di khyod kyi ched du byas pa yin pas nam yin du shog gsung / sgyu lus la sogs pa'i nyams byung ba rnams zhus pas/ de kun zhor 'byung yin/ da khyod kyi don grub zin gsung / slad kyis yul du byon nas 'bul ba mang po blangs/ khyad par du bab mang po phul bas mnyes mnyes ltar mdzad/ de res lo gcig ste spyir lo bzhi bzhugs nas/ gdams ngag dang ting nge 'dzin dang rtogs pas thugs khengs par mdzad/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan pa'i thad du bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ mkhan po'i gsung gis/ da lta nas sems can la ci phan byed dgos gsung / sngar nas kyang sems can blo phugs su bcug ste rang 'dod kyi rtog pa skye ma myong / de nas gro bo lung dang grub pa'i gnas bdun dang pho ma lha khab la sogs par sgrub pa rgyun ring du mdzad/ pho ma dang nye ba'i brag cig la bzhugs dus/ lha 'dre mang po 'tshogs nas skyogs gnyis kyis 'tshag tu byang ba dang / bla ma bzhugs pa'i brag logs la me 'bar bar mthong nas lha 'dres nye sar 'ong ma nus/ yul de na lha 'dre 562

gdug pa can 'dug pa'ang btul/ de nas nā ro chos drug gi rgyab tu dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud gsan par ri bor rngog gi sar byon nas/ rgyud gdams ngag mang du gsan/ de nas bla ma do ba'i sar byon nas bde mchog gi dbang dang rgyud rnams legs par gsan/ de nas rta gnyis kyis sna drangs pa'i 'bul ba mang po khyer nas lha sar byon pas/ slob dpon sgom pa ma phebs pa la rmi lam brtags pas myur du 'byon par shes shing / mjal ma thag 'bul ba rnams phul/ slob dpon sgom pa'i zhal nas/ khyod nga'i rtsar sdod cig 'di rnams kyi nang na khyod bsod nams che ba cig 'ong gsung / spyir na bla ma 'dis yi dam gyi lha gzigs pa dang / mtshan thos pa tsam gyis rtogs pa skyes pa dang / smyo ba btul ba la sogs pa'i phrin ras dpag tu med pa byung ste/ 'dir phyogs tsam zhig brjod pa yin no/ / ma po ba'i dngos slob kyi skabs so/ / / /sprul pa'i sku'i rim pa dang po'i skabs/rje sgam po ba'i bu chen dus gsum mkhyen pa de ni/ bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i rjes la/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga ge zhes bya bar 'gyur ba yin la bskal bzangs kyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/gzod byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bstan par dam pa'i chos rnga/dma dkar po 563

las 'byung ba'i phyir/ de dag gi skyes pa'i rabs kyi grangs ni sa bcu pa ba rnams kyis kyang rtogs par dka'o/ /de la grags pa'i cha 'ga' zhig brjod de/ sngon slob dpon klu sgrub kyi slob ma pra dzñā a lahā zhes bya ba dang / mtsho skyes kyi slob ma kā ma dha nu dang / dzambu'i gling gi sto nub kyi phyogs su dharma bo lha zhes bya ba spyan ras gzigs kyi grub pa brnyes pa zhig dang / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi bka' blon slob dpon padmas dbang bskur bas dpal rta mgrin gyi grub pa brnyes pa'i rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang / phyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to pa rin chen gsal dang /de gshegs nas dus gsum mkhyen par gyur pa yin te/ de yang mdo khams yul gyi tre shod gangs kyi ra bar/ yab gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa sgom pa rdo rje mgon dang / yum rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma lha thog gza' sgang lcam ming 'dren zhes bya ba gnyis kyi sras su lcags pho stag la bltams/ dpal phag mo gru pa dang 'khrungs lo gcig dge 'phel zhes bya bar mtshan gsol/ yab la rang 'byung rgyal mo'i thugs kyi srog snying zhus nas bsgrubs pas ring por mi thogs par grub pa brnyes/ bla ma rgya gar bee ro dang / dpal 'dzin dang zhal mjal nas gdams ngag mang du gsan/ bram ze mchog sred kyi mgon po zhus nas bsgrubs/ brag la phyag zhabs kyi rjes gsal bar mdzad/ bcu drug bzhes pa'i tshe rngog legs she'i mkhan du/ rngog lo'i slob ma tre bo mchog gi bla ma dgung lo 564

ba bzhugs pa ngang mjal/ slob dpon sgom pa la gdan bzhi gsan zhing sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gzigs/ de nas sgam por byon nas chos rje khu dpon dang mjal/ dar la sogs pa'i me tog phul nas gdams pa zhus pas/ bka' gdams kyi lam rim cig gsungs nas/ ngas kyang 'di bsgoms pas khyod rang yang 'di bsgoms gsung / zhu sna dang bdag gnyer thams cad slob dpon sgom pas mdzad/ de nas re zhig na chos rje la dbang bskur zhus/ thabs lam gyi gdams ngag gnang nas bsgoms pas zhag dgu nas btsan thabs su bde drod 'bar te/ ras gos rkyang cig gsol zhing bsgoms/ zla ba dgur lag pa rdul dang ma bral bar bsgoms pas/ sgom chen brgyad brgya'i nang na sgom sran che bar grags/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan dpag tu med pa 'khrungs/ chos rjes lung bstan nas zangs ri la sgom du byon te/ til phug tu zla ba bzhi/ phag mo grur zla ba gcig dang zhag lnga bsgoms pas sems kyi gnas pa la rang dbang thob pa dang rlung nyams dpag tu med pa byung / lhal mthong sprin bar gyi nyi ma lta bu yang byung / slar bla ma'i spyan sngar byon nas dka' thub mdzad cing lo gsum bzhugs/ lo rer ras chung pa dang mjal nas/ chos drug dang thun 'jog la sogs nā ro me ci'i gdams pa ji snyed pa gsan/ thabs lam dmar khrid du mdzad pas bde stong lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ngo 'phrod pa me long la bzhin mthong ba bzhin byung / rtsi mo nam mkha' la zab 566

mo'i gdams pa zhus pas yon tan 'khrungs/ rong ba 'gar dge ba'i slob ma then phug pa ston rgyal la rdo rje phag mo/ chos spyod/ 'grel ba rin chen rgyan drug dang / dbang bzhi'i nyams sgom la sogs zhus/ mes tshon po'i slob ma rkyang mo sbang khab la dgyes rdor gdams bshad zhus/yar klungs phug mo cher gshen pa rdo rje seng ge la lam 'bras zhus/ brag dkar mo ba la ma ro snyan brgyud zhus/ dar yul ba ral lcags ston tshul la bde mchog dgyes dor/ ma hā ma 'a la sogs rgyud kyi bshad pa dang gdams pa mang du gsan no/ /sgam po bas lung bstan nas 'ol kha'i brag gu ri bo che'i brag phug cig tu bzhugs pas/ bud med gcig na re/ nga'i ma jo 'ong ngo khyod ma bzhugs zer bas/ byams snying rjebyang chub kyi sems la gnad du bsnun zla ba bcu bzhir bzhugs pas drod klungs su tshud/ rtags ngo mtshar can mang du byung / nges shes khyad par can skyes/ de nas chos rje bya skog dgon pa na bzhugs sar byon nas rtogs pa phul bas/ khyod kyi de nor 'dug nga khyod la re che ba yin pa la da dung bsgoms gsung nas zla ba drug bsgoms pas sngar gyi de las ma 'gyur nas/ yang zhus pas/ phyag spyi bor bzhag nas/ bu 'khor ba dang 'brel chod pa yin no gsung nas/ gnas lugs don gyi ngo rjod sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu ngos gzung ba'i gdams ngag gnang / der mu dpon la mthong snang bzang po mang du byung / sgam po bas lung bstan nas 567

tsha bre lnga bsnams nas mon gyi rgyal po ga thung gi sar byon/ des yon bdag byas nas sha 'ug stag sgor byon nas bzhugs/ 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtogs pa brnyes/ de nas sgam por byon nas lo gcig bzhugs/de nas gnang ba zhus nas rgyal khams skor du byon te spa gror byon/ de nas las stod na sa phug cig na mi la'i dngos slob dge tshul sku mched gnyis 'dug pa la'ang gdams pa zhus/ de nas 'phan yul bya bzang gi brag la dbyar dgun gsum bzhugs/ brag la thogs pa med pa'i mngon shes rdzu 'phrul bstan pas bla ma brag par grags/ yang gangs dkar la song gsung nas gangs dkar du byon/ padma'i bzhugs gnas pha bong dkar leb tu zla ba bzhi bzhugs te mkha' 'gro mas 'tsho ba drangs/ de nas snye mo'i 'phrang na mar byon pas mkha' 'gro mas nang du khrid 'tsho ba drangs/ de la brten nas ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa skyes/ de nas gzhu snye'i bar rdzong bya ba'i dgon pa na/ nā ro ba'i dngos slob cig bzhugs pa dang mjal/ mngon par shes pa mang du gsungs/ phyag chen thog babs dang thabs lam gyi man ngag mang du zhus/ bla ma lha rje ci gsung gyis gsung pa'i zhal bde'ang mang du gnang / de nas lha ri rgyan po dang jug por yang byon/ g.yag sde dang 'phan yul rnams su byon/ de nas gru bzhi dgon du bzhugs/ de nas sgam por byon pas rdzong ba'i spyan sngar byon pa sogs thams cad tshur la gsung / der dbyar thog gcig bzhugs/ ci568

de nas /ma po gnas nang du sgrub pa gyis/ 'gro don chen po 'ong gsung ba gnang / de nas chu bo ri dang gru bzhi mar bzhugs/ der sgam ya ba gshegs pa'i gtam gsan nas byon pas/ slob dpon sgom pa dang 'phags pa dang mjal/ chos rje'i na bza' la 'jus nas gsol ba btab cing ngus pas/ chos rje nam mkha' la mngon sum du byon pa dpon slob gsum gas mthong / de nas gru bzhi dgon du byon pa'i tshe/ dam po gnas nang du 'byon dgongs tsa na/ rkam po rdo rje dpal rtsegs kyis kyang bsu ba la sleb/ de nas rta khrab 'ga' bsnams nas slob dpon sgom polha lung na bzhugs pa la phyi phyag la byon/ 'tshur ngos bzangs su cung zad bzhugs/ spyir dbus gtsang du lo sum cu bzhugs nas thos bsam dang sgrub pa mdzad/ lnga bcu pa la khams su byon nas lam po gnas nang du bzhugs/ de nas cir byon dge 'dun stong tsam 'dus/ yul der 'khrug pa rang zhir mdzad/ sgam por g.yu chen bdun dang ja mdzo bdun cu la sogs pa'i 'bul ba bskur/ de nas lho rgyud la byon te/ dbus su byon nas sgam por gser 'bum tshar bzhi/ mdo mangs tshar gcigaglegs bam brgya dang bcu/ g.yu man bcu/ mdzo rta lnga bcu la sogs pa /la/ dbus gtsang gi sde dgon rnams sungang tshogs gsog rgya chen po mdzad/ kho bo dbus su 'ongs pa'i da sa ba/ sgom tshul gyi zhal nas khyod khams su skyid sdug ci byung yang yar shog gsung ba'i bka' sgrub pa 56

dang / gzhu 'tshur gyi bar 'di dgon pa 'debs pa dang / dgas lha sgam por gser gyi glegs bam brgya 'bul ba dang / bla ma zhang gi 'jug pa la mi rnams mi dga' bar 'dug bas/ khong la 'khrug pa mi mdzad pa'i zhu ba 'bul ba rnams la 'ongs pa yin gsung / zhang la 'khrug pa mi mdzad par zhus pas/ zhang gis phyag mdzub la 'jus nas bro mang du brdungs nas de phyin chad 'khrug pa ma mdzad/ 'tshur phur dgon pa yang btab/ de nas sku 'da' khar 'khor bgres pa rnams la dngos po mang du yod pa rnams kyis dkon mchog gi rten dang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gyis gsung ba'i zhal bkod gnang nas/ chu mo glang gi lo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa la mkha' 'gro ma mang pos bsu ba mdzad de gshegs/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas kyang du ma zhig byung ste rgyas par ma spros so/ /de'i slob ma sangs rgyas ras chen ni/ gdung rus gru gu/ yul yar klungs su yab gtsang ba dpal grags dang / yum btsun chung ma bya ba'i sras su 'khrungs nas/ byis pa'i dus nas gar 'byon du 'ja'i gur 'ong ba dang / mkha' 'gro ma ga ra gyi rgyan can bzhi rjes su 'brang ba yod/ lo dgu bzhes pa'i tshe zangs ri ras pa'i sar byon nas ras chung pa las byung ba'i gdams pa rnams gsan pas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams khor yug tu shar/ na bza' ras rkyang du mdzad pa'i ras chen du grags/bca lnga bzhes pa gad sa pa cung ma tshar ba la zangs ri pa sku gshegs/ ci570

der nga'i gdams ngag ma rdzogs par chos rje sku 'da' bar 'dug byas nas bshums pas/ da rgya sgom la gtugs/ ji ltar byas kyang bde bar 'ong gis gsung / de nas phag mo gru pa dang mjal zhing chos zhus/ de nas dol du 'tshur dbang nge la gsar rnying gi gdams pa mang du zhus/ rdo rgyus brag la bsgoms pas ri btsun ma zhal gnyis ma'i zhal gzigs/ thugs gtad pa tsam gyis nad gdon zhi ba yang byung / de nas gnyal du gtsang ston dkon yab sras la chos mang du gsan/ de'i tshe su kha siddhi zhal gzigs/ za chu 'dus su sgam po ba'i slob ma dar ma shes rab bya ba 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa cig bzhugs pa la dbang dang gdams pa mang du zhus/ gnyal gyi grog phugs shed du bsgoms pas spyan dang mngon par shes pa shar/ de nas yar klungs su byon nas rje sgom zhig po la bai ma la'i gdams pa ma lus pa zhus/ der yul gyis thugs dam la gnod par dgongs nas/ g.yer thod pa bsam grub la jo mo'i gdams pa gcod rnams zhus/de nas kong por byon bla ma mnga' ris pa dang mjal/ gdams pa mang du gsan/ spo por gnyal pa jo sras la phag mo/ chos drug la sogs pa dang / khyad par mgon po ber nag can zhus shing zhal yang gzigs/yar klungs nas yum gyis ro zan nag po bya ba zhig 'bod du btang byung ba la ma byon par/ tsha ba sgang dang dmar khams su byon pas de rnams su sku bsod skyes/ sngags grwa btsugs nas 'khrug gdums mang du mdzad/ de 571

la khyod dang slob dpon bka' gdams pa gnyis rnyed pa che gsung ba bzhin du/ gcig pur bzhugs dbang med par phrin las kyi mtha' rgyas par gyur/slob dpon bka' gdams pa'i drung du yang lo gsum bzhims/ sngar dus gsum mkhyen pa'i yang rab tu 'byung bar 'os pa'i bka' yod pa dang /slob dpon bka' gdams pas bskul ba la brten nas/ lo so bdun pa la mkhan po ma dril ba dang slob dpon bka' gdams pa la chig rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan bsod nams grags par btags/ de nas kur ma rin po che dang mjal nas lo gsum bzhugs/ dus gsum mkhyen pa dbus su bzhud pa la tre shod rna rgyang bar du skyel thung mdzad/ de nas dmar khams su byon nas 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i skabs zhig tu chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa sku gshegs pa yang mkhyen/ gyis gdan sa'i zhabs tog kyang cher mdzad bla shā dang grub thob dang yi dam gyi zhal gzigs pa rnams ni brjod kyis mi lang / 'gro don phun sum tshogs pa'i mthar dgung lo bdun bcu bzhes pa dbyar zla ra ba'i nyi shu lnga la zhing dag par gshegs/ de'i rjes su yang slob rmecho rnams la sku'i bkod pa sna tshogs su bstan to /gdung sbyangs pas lha sku dang ring bsrel yang mang du byon no/ /de'i slob ma ni chos rje sprom brag pa yin te/ de ni skye ba snga ma la bya rgod phung po'i ri dang rdo rje gdan gyi bar du sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ye shes blo gros bya bar skye ba ba zhes/ de nas 'dir 'bri rgyal dam snatsho

pa chos phyug ces bya bar 'khrungs/ lo lnga nas bri klog mkhas par mkhyen/dgung lo dgu'i skor du bla ma gnyan lha khang sgang ba yab sras la bde dgyes la sogs pa gsang sngags kyi chos mang du gsan/ bcu bzhi bzhes pa la ras chen pa'i yon tan mang du thos nas dad pa skyes pa tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma 'khrungs/ lan cig ma la lam du bud med dmar mo gzugs ring ba bu mo mang pos bskor ba zhig na re/ khyod kyi bla ma sangs rgyas ras chen ni dwags po sgom chung gi skye ba yin zhes lung ston pa byung /de nas zhag bcu tsam na 'bobs dkar sgang du sangs rgyas ras chen dang mjal bas/ phyag na rdo rje dngos yin pa'i snang ba shar/ snubs ston tshul gyi thor la rje btsun ma'i dbang zhus pas/ byin rlabs phab pa'i dus su steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rje btsun ma'i dkyil 'khor du gsal ba cig byung / bla ma'i zhal nas/ mchod chung 'dis nga'i dbang bskur thob pa yin gsung nas de phyin chad pha dang bu bzhin du thugs la gtags/ de nas kungs dgon par bzhugs pa'i tshe 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gzigs pa de la yengs thabs su gyur pa la/ sems kyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rtogs pa 'khrungs/ de nas myur por sgom med kyi rtogs pa 'khrungs/ sa gzhan du 'gro bar zhus pas ma gnang / gnas skabs dag tu lha dang chos skyong gi gzigs snang la sogs pa grangs med pa byung /ras chen mya ngan las 'da' khar khyed kyi bstan pa sus 'dzin zhus pas/ma

nga'i slob ma rnams rang mgo thon tsam re ni yod/ de'i nang nas kyang khyod dang blo gros rin chen gnyis la re che ba yin/ de'i nang nas kyang khyod la phrin las rgya chen po 'ong ba yin/ khyod kyi bu slob dang yang slob kyi bar du yang phrin las rgya chen po 'ong ba yin gsung ba bzhin du zin las dpag tu med pa byung ba yin no/ /sa gzhan du 'gro 'dod byung ba'i tshe dus gsum mkhyen pa byon nas/ gar yang ma 'gro sa 'di nyid du bsgoms dang rang don gzhan don gnyis ka 'byung zhes lung bstan pa bzhin du/ spel sgo dgon par phyags phab nas lo bcu drug tu sgrub pa mdzad pas dag pa'i snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa shar/ snyan pas phyogs thams cad du khyab bo/ /ka thog gi gtsang ston de snyan pa che bas 'di ji 'dra ba zhig yin rnam dgongs pa la/ thugs 'dun btang bas khong nam mkha' dag pa'i dbyings na longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur 'dug pa gzigs nas/ gtsang ston la chos gsan pas mkhyen pa rgyas par gyur/ de nas khru skad spom brag tu dgon pa gzung / der sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa dpag tu med pa gzigs shing ltar ngo mtshar can mang po byung / de nas sangs rgyas ras chen gyi zhal nas/ dmar khams sgang du ma 'go gsung ba la/ der byon pas sku khams cung zhig ma bde ba'i tshe bla ma mar ma pa zhabs tog tu yod pa la/da lan gyi nad 'dis kho bo 'gro dgos par 'dug sangs rgyas ras chen gyi zhal nas dmar khams sgang du ma 'gro gsung ba'i gsung bcag pas lan/575

'gyur ba med pa la rang bzhin du gnas pa rgya mtsho lta bu byung yang / ngo cung zad ma mkhyen pa na rin po che sprom brag pas ngo sprad de/ spom brag pa dang mjal ba'i dus su/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ de ring nam mkha' la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin gtibs pa bzhin snang / khyod mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlabs pa cig 'dug gsung / de nub dbang mdzad pas khyod las can cig 'dug dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pa'i bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams gsal bar byon/ da nga'i chos 'di tsho nyams su long gsung /de nas ka thog pa byams pa 'bum dang / lcang mang phu ba la so sor thar pa'i bslab pa mnos/ mtshan chos kyi bla mar gsol/ rin po che la khrid zhus pa'i tshe 'bum tshar gcig gi klog yon phul bas/ khru shod spom rag sna 'di nor gyis bkod nas phul ba bas/ sgom chen sems ngo shes pa cig dga' gsung / sgrub pa tshul bzhin du byas pas bla ma mnyes par byung / lo bcu bar med par nyams len bskyangs/ lha dang 'jig rten gyi lha 'dre du mas zhabs tog byed pa gzigs/ khams su grwa pa lnga brgya tsam bsdus nas chos gsungs/ ljang yul gyi bar du drag po'i las kyi nus pa bstan nas lam rgya btsugs/ 'tshur phur byon nas lo drug tu bzhugs/gangs dkar ma dang thang lha la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams kyis kyang bran gyi las byas/ snyan pa'i grags pa shin tu che ba'i tshe hor rgyal pos gser mig pa btang nas gdan 'dren byung bas/ rgya yul du byon/ lam du'ang 577

brang du gzigs nas/ dran shes bzhin dang ldan pas der bzhugs zhing sdug bsngal ba'i snang ba med/ de nas shing pho spre'u'i lo'i yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ smra mkhyen yang mi mkhyen pa ltar mdzad/ de nas yab yum sras gsum rim gyis ding rir byon pas/ dam pa'i sku de 'ja' tshon lta bur 'dug pa las rang la thim pa'i snang ba byung / de nas yab kyis zhi byed kyi chos rnams kyang gnang / sngags 'chang ngo nag dang dbu rtse ba gnyis la yang phur gyi bka' gsan/ yi ge 'bri klog rnams sus kyang slob ma dgos par mkhyen/ mnal lam du dag snang mang po shar/skyid grong 'phags pa'i drung du byon pas spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'gro don 'byung bar dgongs/ mkhas btsun gser khang bas/ bdag la gus pa dang bcas pas dris pa na bar do'i rnam thar la sogs mang po bshad/ de nas lo lnga lon pa na grub chen u rgyan pa'i gsung gis/ sang nga'i bla ma gar ma pa 'byon par yod gsung nas stan mthon po bshams/ der grub chen pa'i drung du phyin pa na stan de la thogs pa med par 'jogs te bzhugs/ grub chen pa'i gsung gis/ byis pa khyod nga'i bla ma'i gdan la gdod pa ci min gsung bas/ bla ma dang nga yin te/da khyed la re dgos par 'dug byas nas thol gyis babs/ de nas u rgyan pas byang chub du mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang / 'khor lo sdom pa dil bu lugs kyi ngabang dang / ma phur gyi dbang rnams gnang / dgyes 580

mdzad dang / sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / dus kyi 'khor lo dang / 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rgyud rnams gsungs/ gzhan yang ro stoms skor drug dang / bsre 'pho dang / sku gsum ngo sprod/ khrid chen brgyad dang /rgyalab rgya mtsho/ do ha dang / lhan cig skyes sbyor dang / gzhan yang chos phran ming du gnang / lo bdun pa la mkhan po kun ldan shes rab la rab tu byung nas bslab gas rnam legs par bslabs/ de'i tshe bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gi deg snang la spyan ra gzigs kyis bdag gi yon tan bsngags pa 'di ltar byung gi pho nya bas bslabs/ la stod gro lung du chu rgyan gu rus dbang bskur bas bla ma pade mchog tu gzigs/ la stod sbu hrar bzhugs pa'i tshe/ mgon po dang sngags bdag gnyis byung nas 'tshur phur myur du 'byon dgos zer/ de nas gdan sa 'tshur phur phebs/ gnyan ras la chos ga na pas brgyud pa'i bla ma mang pos bskor 'dug pa'i snang ba shar/ —der sngags bdag gis chu mig gsar du phul/ shing skam cig btsuṭa pas skyes te sdong po chen por gyur/ bkra shigagasar mar dar ma sgang bas byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams byon/gzhan yang chos gsan pa'i rim pa ni/ bla ma shes rab dpal la sdud pa'i dka' 'grel dang pa〉 ka padma can zhus/ dge ba bshes gnyen rgyal ba la dgyes rdor la sogs zhus/ yang gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum la gsar rnying gi rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag shin tu mang bar gsan/ gnam mtsho 58

ba mi bskyod rdo rje la ma gcig gi spyod yul la sogs mang du zhus/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la mkhan po gzhon nu byang chub dang / slob dpon dge 'dun rin chen pa las bsnyen par rdzogs zhing / lung sde bzhi la sogs pa 'dul ba'i skor mang du gas / sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs la sogs phran 'ga' yang zhus/ de nas gsang phu gling smad kyi gdan sa ba shākya gzhon nu la dbu ma'i skor mang po dang / byams chos lnga/ mngon pa gong 'og dang sa sde/ tshad ma la sogs mang du gsan/ de nas khams su gar mar thegs lha stengs kyi dben gnas btab/ tsha ba sgang du yang byon pas yul lha rnams kyisagabasu ba rgya chen po gas/ mi ma yin bka' la btags pas kol ti'i 'khrug pa chen po yang zhi bar mdzad/ de nas dbus phyogs su byon pa na thang lhas bsu ba byas/ de nas 'tshur phur phebs pas chos skyong rnams dgyes pa'i snang ba byung / lha sar jo bo la gdugs phul tshe/phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi drung du yang mchod pa 'bul bzhin pa'i snang ba shar/ dpal u rgyan pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub pa la du 'khor gyi bshad pa zhib tu gsan zhing / gzhan yang rgyud dang 'grel pa gsar rnying dbang dang gdams pa mang du gsan/ dkon mchog rtsegs pa dang dam chos pad dkar sogs mdo'i lung mang po dang / mngon pa gong 'og sogs rgya cher gsan/ sba ras la gso ba rig pa'i gzhung gsan/ tshul khrims 583

rin chen la gsang 'dus 'phags skor la sogs gsar rnying mang du gsan gzhon nu 'bum la bstan bsrungs kyi bka' mang po dang / ro stoms dang thub lnga la sogs gsan/ tsā na shrī la 'grel pa mtha' drug la sogs gsan/ rig 'dzin ku mā ra rā dza la rdzogs chen snying thig phran dang bcas pa dang ni gu la sogs lapa gsan zhing / ri khong ras pa las tsang gsan/ de nas sgam po dngarang por byon nas gzhan don du ma mdzad/ tsā ri g.yu mtsho ra yang thegs/ — spyir kong por lo gsum bzhugs/ zhasbu'i gangs kyi mdun du snyi nang gi rten 'brel du ma shar/ de nas jo mo gangs su bzhugs pa na slob dpon padma'i snang ba shar zhing byin gyis brlabs/'tshur phu'i kungs na bzhugs pa'i tshe phyi nang gi gza' skar mthun par gzigs pas rtsis kyi bstan bcos mdzad/ de nas yang bde chen stengs kyi dgon pa btab/ der dag snang mang du shar/ kha rag shar gyi ri khrod snying khung la sogs su byon sar yang dag snang mang du shar/ slar yang bde chen stengs su phyi nang gi rten 'brel dag par gzigs pas zab mo nang don gyi bstan bcos mdzad/ sa skya dang / btsan brag dang / myang stod la sogs pa gtsang gi sa phyogs mang du —thegs nas gzhan don rgya cher mdzad/ slar yang kong por byon nas dgon gnas mang po mdzad cing /gdul bya mang po thar pa la bkod cing nags phu la sogs par bzhugs/skog phreng du bzhugs pa'i tshe zab mo nad don gyi 'grel pa brtsams/ stag 583

gi lo la lha sar phebs/ de nas spur mar byon nas gtsug lag khang gso ba dang chos mang du gsungs/ chos dbyings bstod pa'i ṭī ka brtsams/'brug lo la sog zam btsugs/ de nas nags phur byon pas hor yul du thegs dgos par dgongs par gyur/ de nas lhun grub stengs kyi ri khrod btab/ lug lo la dbus su byon/ spre'u lo la hor yul nas hor rgyal po'i spyan 'dren byung nas thegs/ zla ba bcu pa la rgyal po'i pho brang du phebs/ rgyal po btsun mo dang bcas pa la dbang bskur/ rin chen dpal rgyal po la bar chad 'byung bar lung bstan/ gzhan don dpag ta med pa mdzad nas bod la phebs khar/ khyi lo la ri bo rtse lngar thegs/de nas mi nyag 'gar phebs pa na chos mang du bshad/ de nas khams su phebs nas khams kyi 'khrug rtsod mang po zhi bar mdzad/ de nas yang dbus su phebs pas thang lha dang gangs dkar la sogs pas bsus/ de nas bsam yas 'chims phur ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs/ de rjes bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i tshe rab tu gnas pa mdzad pas byang chub sems dpa' mang po dam chos sgrog pa'i snang ba shar/ slar yang rgya'i yul du thegs nas der sku tshe'i 'du byed btang ste/ chos kyi rje nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du bzhugs par bstan pas/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa shin tu dad pa mdzad de/ de ni dgung lo lnga bcu rtsa drug bzhes pa sa mo yos kyi 'o yin no/ /de la 'khrungs pa nas gzung ste chos mang 584

du gsan pa'i tshe dang / ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe dag pa'i snang ba mang du shar ba rnams ni rnam par thar pa nyid las blta bar bya ba yin gyi/'dir phyogs tsam las ma bris so/ /chos rje rang byung bas mdzad pa'i bstan rtsis ni dus 'khor ba gzhan rnams kyi lo grangs kyi 'dod pa las/lag pa gdengs can zla bas dman pa yin te/ grub chen u rgyan pa'i bstan rtsis dang mthun no/ / / /chos rje rang byung ba'i slob ma ni gsung ston rdo rje dpal ba yin te/des rang gis chos rje rang 'byung ba la gsan pa rnams/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje gzhon nur bzhugs pa la sku skye ba snga ma'i chos rngams skyel du byon te/g.yung ston pa'i rnam par thar pa rag pa zhig ni/ sgyu 'phrul gyi skabs su bshad zin to/ /chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje ni/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje nyid kyis skye ba gsar du bzhes pa ltar mdzad pa ste/ ta dben gu shrīs drung nas da gzod gang du skye ba bzhes par kho bo yang der thong 'dod pas nges pa cig gsung bar zhus pa la/ khyod de tsam du mos na nga kong por 'ong gsung ba ltar sku phra ba'i dus nas kong por phebs pa yin te/ de ya yul rdod kyi a la rong go chen spang dkar gyi gnam rdzong du/ yab lha mdong bsod nams don grub dang / yum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro 'dzo ba gza' brtson 'gru rgyan gnyis lhan cig tu gnas pa na/ rje btsun 'di dga' ldan du 585

bzhugs pa/ bcom ldan 'das byams pas yang dag par bskul nas yum gyi lhums su gshegs/ de'i tshe mngal dag pa'i pho brang du gyur pa sogs ni da gdod smos ci dgos/ mngal nyid na bzhugs pa'i tshe ma ṇi'i sgra grags pa dang / 'khrul 'khor mdzad pas yum yang lus 'phar zhing g.yo ba la sogs par gyur/ lcags pho 'brug gi lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ de ma thag ma ṇi dang dbyangs gsal gyi gsung byung bas yab dogs pa skyes pa la/ yum gyis nga la rmi lam bzang po mang po yod pas the tshom mi dgos zhes dogs pa bsal bar gyur to/ /dgung lo gsum pa la skyang bor byon/ de'i tshe yum la nga spur ma pa shi'i skye ba yin/ dzam bu'i gling 'dir nga'i gdul bya mang du yod pas 'ongs/ khyod stos shig gsung nas 'chi med 'khrul 'khor mdzad/ 'di rnams da dung ma smra cig gsung /da lha sar 'byon dgos zhus pas/ da lan rang e thon nam/ sngon la kong po'i zho kha dang brag phyi dang nags phu rnams su phyin nas blta dgos par yod/ kong yul gshin rje dong kha'i 'og na dmyal ba'i zangs kha yod pas/ de nas sems can rnams 'dren dgos/ nga'i zhal mthong bas ngan song du mi 'gro ba yin/ 'tshur phu dang gar ma dang rgyal po'i pho brang rnams su yang rim gyis 'gro/ /rgyal po'i pho brang na nga'i gdul bya dpag tu med pa yod pa yin gsung / drung nyid kur ma pa shi'i skye ba lags na chos rje rang byung rdo rje ma lags sam zhus pas/ de gnyis khyad med da 586

dung phal pa rnams la ma smra zhes gdams/ yum gyi mig la ling thog byung bas smre sngags bton pas/ khyed sems pham mi dgos ye shes mkha' 'gro brgya rtsa brgyad kyi gcig khyod yin/ sang phod da tsam khyod la phyag 'tshal ba mang po 'ong / kong bu chu gser gyi lha khang gi rgyab tu gnas gsar pa cig btab nas der 'dug pa yin/ byi ba lo nas kho bo la gdul bya chen po 'ong ba yin gsung / de nas myang bo dang kong yul gyi sa tha dad pa rnams su byon nas skye bo mang po la khyod 'di dang 'di yin/ khyod kyi khang pa 'di lta bu zhig yod/ khyod kyis nga la 'di lta bu 'bul myong zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i snga phyi dran pa mang du gsungs pas mi rnams shin tu dad par mdzad cing chos kyang mang du gsungs/ khyed grub thob yin na grub rtags ston zer du byung nas mchod khang gi bya rgya'i steng du bzhugs pa sogs kyang bstan/ dom gyi khar 'phangs pas dom gyis gus pa'i rnam 'gyur kyang byas/ rta bar rgyal 'dzin du phebs pa'i tshe la stod pa rtogs ldan mgon rgyal bas drung du sleb/ tshogs gral cig tu me bus gsung bus pas/tshad pa tsha bsil g.yab da khyer la shog gsung / bsil g.yab phul bas de g.yob cing rgya yul dang 'dra bar 'dug rgya yul du bsil g.yab g.yabs kyang tsha 'ub 'ub byed/ de bzhin du 'dir yang tsha 'ub 'ub byed gsung / yang drung nas lo brgyad bcu rtsa bzhir bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes pa la/ lnga bcu rtsa drug las mi bzhugs pa ci yin zhus pas/587

bla ma ba de sdig spyod mang bas lan pa yin gsung / drung nas bde bar gshegs pa'i dus su zla ba'i nang na bzhugs pa mi mang pos mthong zer ba/ ba la bzhugs pa lags sam zhus pas/ de khong rang rnams kyi dad pa dang nga'i snying rje la brten nas mthong ba yin/ nga la khong rnams bltas nas 'di tsug byed cing 'dug gsung nas hor rnams kyi lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi lad mo yang mdzad/ de nas bzhugs stan la bzhugs nas/ zla ba dang glang po che dang seng gi la sogs pa la 'dug pa yang nga yin gsung /drung nas zhi bar gshegs pa'i bcu bzhi'i tho rangs rtogs ldan grags seng ba'i gzigs snang la/ drung nas ras dkar po'i ang rag bsnams nas 'ja' 'od kyi nang na nam mkha' la bzhugs pa mthong ba la/ khong gis drung nas nged bu slob la mi gzigs par bde bar gshegs pa ji ltar la bzhugs pas/ nga la bsam pa bzang po yod kyang snyigs dus sems can gyi bsod nams la mi 'grub par 'dug sdig spyod grangs mang bas skyo ba skyes pa yin/ nga dga' ldan du 'gro gsung ba cig khong gi dag snang la byung 'dug pa/ drung nas de skad gsungs pa lags sam zhus pas/ de ltar yin mod de skyo ba skyes nas phyin pa yin/ gzhan yang cang shes kyi rta dang bya rgod la sogs pa'i sprul sgyur mang po byed cing phyin/ lar dga' ldan de thag ring pa na med gsung / de nas gzhan dag yid ches par bya ba'i phyir co 'dri ba 'ga' zhig zhus te/ chad rgyas nas bzhes par zhu/588

dga' ldan na 'di 'dra yod dam zhus pas/ myos byed 'di 'dra ba med/bdud rtsi yod pa yin gsung / bdud rtsi kha dog nag po de bzang zer ba bden nam zhus pas/ bdud rtsi kha dog nag po ngas ma mthong / kha dog dkar ba la ro sna tshogs pa yod pa yod gsung / dga' ldan de na gung thang gi dar gdugs dang 'dra ba'i mchod rdzas mang ba yang med pa 'dra zhus pas/ bla ma ba mi yul gyi yo byad 'dra ba g.yas chung / me tog re re la yang kog phred tsam yod gsung / yang dga' ldan de na yar chab gtsang po 'dra ba'i chu yang med/ kong po srang dar rta myog gi mkhar khang 'dra ba yang med zer/ rang re mi yul gyi skyed rdo ri mo can 'di 'dra yang med pa 'dra zhus pas/ drung gi zhal nas bla ma pa dga' ldan gyi chu thams cad bdud rtsi yin/ mi yul gyi yar chab gtsang po 'dra ba min/dga' ldan na mi yul gyi sa rdo 'dra ba'ang med/ sa rdo thams cad rin po che las grub pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das byams pa'i gzhal yas khang ngam byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen gyi gzhal med khang ngam/ sum cu rtsa gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa yin/ mi yul gyi mkhar khang 'dra ba g.yas chung gsung /yang rta myog gi rta bzang po 'dra ba dga' ldan na yod dam zhus pas/ chos la dus tshod med na ban rgan 'chol ba yin gsung / chos thams cad thugs su chud du zin kyang dpon slob kyi 'brel ba bstan pa'i phyir/ rtogs ldan 589

mgon rgyal ba la nā ro'i chos drug dang / sbyor drug la sogs pa bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa phran dang bcas pa mang bar gsan zhing dbang yang mang du gsan/ de lta bu'i skabs dang phyis kyi skabs gzhan dag tu yang lha dang chos skyong la sogs pa mang du gzigs pa/ rnam thar mdzad pa po dag gis bkod snang yang sangs rgyas kyis shes bya thams cad gzigs pa'i phyir gzigs snang rnams thos med du byas nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad tshul 'ga' zhig brjod par 'os so snyam mo/ /sngon chos rje rang byung rdo rje chos khri'i rgyab tu shug pa'i yal ga skam po zhig btsugs nas/ 'di chos khri'i rgyab yol dang mnyam pa'i tshe kho bo 'dir 'ong ba yin gsung ba bzhin/rnam thos tshal gyi gnas su byon/ chos khri la bzhugs nas chos mang po gsungs shing skye 'gro mang po'i don mdzad/ nags phu gzims khang du rtogs ldan ye rgyal ba la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud 'grel la sogs sngags gsar ma'i skor dang / mkha' 'gro snying thig dang bai ma la la sogs pa'i rnying ma'i gdams pa mang du gsan/ bla ma rdza gshongs pa shes rab dpal la bka' 'gyur ro cog dang bstan bcos mang po'i lung gsan/ slob dpon blo gros seng ge la byams chos ma lus pa gsan/ de nas snye bor phebs nas zhal brda la chu phar khar mi 'gro bar chad thong gsung bzhin du nan ma theg par byon pas/ bar chad cung zang byung yang skyon par ma gyur/de nas khe nang du byon pa na yang bar chad kyis ma bsdigs/ de nas tsa 590

rir byon/ bka' brgyud kyi bla ma dang lha'i gzigs snang mang zhing rtoṭa ldan mgon rgyal ba la sogs pa'i don du mgur mang du gsungs/ tsa ri ston sngon bya ba la ku ru kukle'i sgrub thabs gsan/ de nas 'tshur phu ba'i thodan 'dren byung bas/ lam dwags po la bstod nas sgam por phebs dus kyang dag snang mang du shar/ de nas phag mo grur byon gnyis med kyi ye shes mngon du gyur tshulabastan/ de nas 'on tshong 'dus su phebs/ bsam yas pa mkhas grub pas dri ba zhus pa la/ 'di rnams lhas rkyang thang du lan btab zin gsungs pas khong lhag par dad par gyur/ ta'i si tu byang rgyal bas bkur nyi rgya chen po bgyis shing / lhag par dad pa mdzad/de nas lha sar phebs gzigs snang grangs med pa byung / gung thang du si tu dge blo bas spyan drangs bsnyen bkur/ sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams gsungs pas dad por gyur/ de nas gnas nang du phebs/ dang por gnas nang du byon dus bla ma dar rgyal ba la/ da nang spyan ras gzigs sprin gyi dbus na bzhugs 'dug bsam tsa na/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems mang pos bskor bar 'dug gsung ba la sogs pa dang / spyil bo so so'i bkod pa sngar 'di bzhin yod ces bya ba la sogs pa gsu/ngas pas nges pa skyes par gyur/ de nas 'tshur phur phebs/ der mkhan chen don grub dpal dang slob dpon bsod nams 'bum la sbrul lo la rab tu 'byung ba'i tshul mdzad/mtshan dpal dha gīrtir gsol/ mkhan po la 'dul ba'i skor mang du 5lo

gsan/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la yang 'jam dbyangs dmar po'i chos 'brel zhus/ de nas bde chen du yang byon/rgyal ba g.yung ston pa dang mjal bar rnye ba'i tshe zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor mang po gzigs/ g.yung ston pa dang mjal nas/ nga bla ma gong ma la mos gus yod pas 'ongs pa yin/ drung pa gong ma rnams yin lugs shig gsung bar zhu gsungs pas/ spur ma pa shir 'khyungs pa'i tshe rgya mcho'i mthar thug par byon nas hor sogs btul ba'i lo rgyus gsungs pas khong rab tu dad nas mang du bshums/ der g.yung ston pa la rdo rje phreng ba/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ mdo sems/ sgyu 'phrul gyi dbang la sogs pa gsang sngags gsar rnying gi dbang dang rgyud dang man ngag rnams mang du gsan/ de nas me mo bya'i lo dgung lo bco brgyad pa la sngar gyi mkhan slob dang /dus bsgo ba slob dpon gzhon nu dpal gyis gsang ston mdzad nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra mo rnams kyang bsrung zhing / sha dang chang spu rtse tsam yang spyan lam du mi 'grim/ nye 'khor du glegs bam rnams mang du bkod nas mnal lam du gzigs pas de thams cad kyi tshig don thugs su chud cing / yi ge'i rigs mi 'dra ba yang drug cu tsam mkhyen/de nas se mo dor byon zhing mtsho mo ru khyung la sogs pa byang rnams su byon/de nas bde chen du slob dpon chen po la pho brang ta'i tu'i bkod pa dang /mi'i grangs la sogs pa 'di yod gsung nas/ yid la zung dang snyis phyin 592

dus nges par 'gyur gsung / de nas rgyal po chen po thog na the mur sras di nga bcas pas chos rje'i snyan pa gsan pa'i stobs kyis/ ding hu dben dpon dang sde dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la sogs pa hor bod kyi gser yig pa mang po la rgyal po'i lung dang / rgyal bu'i li ji lag rtags gnang sbyin rgya chen po dang bcas pa bskur nas spyan 'dren du byung bas/ semasacan gyi don rgya chen po la dgong nas dgung lo bcu dgu pa sa pho khyi'i zla ba lnga pa'i tshes nyi shu la 'tshur phu nas bteg gnam dang snying drung sogs su thog babs kyang mi phyugs la gnod pa med pas rten 'brel bzang por dgongs/ de nas gong dang byang rnams su gzhan don rgya chen po mdzadacing bstan bcos dpag tu med pa mdzad de por mar phebs/ der yabathugs dam khrigs su gnas pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa bstan zhing / khams kyi sde dpon rnams kyis kyang bsu skyel zhabs tog legs par byas/ chagapa'i gnod pa byung ba bzlog par zhus pas kyang de ma thag bzlogs/ de nas ter phebs nas chos kyi gtam dam pa dgyes pa'i sgron ma'i bstan bcos mdzad/ dedas gi chu gling phugs su phebs pa'i tshe chos khri'i sar rjon chad sa phyogs der skye ma myong ba'i me tog rtsa ba gcig la sdong bu brgya/sdong bu re re la yang me tog brgya brgya/ me tog re re la yang 'dab ma ser po stong stong yod pa/ lta bar dmar po/ gi sar ser po cig skyes pa de mthong zhing thos pa thams cad ngo mtshar du gyur/ sa phyogs de stog 593

nad par ba la de nas lo mang por rtog nad zhi bar mdzad/ de nas ga chur phebs pa'i tshe yang gong ma'i gdan 'dren byung na'ang dus khams kyi 'gyur bzlog 'ong bar dgongs nas/ tsha 'phrang nag po'i yul brgyud de mi nyag rab sgang du byon/ sgo sdong gi 'khrug gdums lo nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar du mdzad/ 'ang 'ga' bo'i ri la bzhugs pa'i dus su gong nas long dang gnang sbyin rgya chen po shes rab hu sri la sogs pa'i mi dpon mang pos gdan drangs te mdo smad du phebs pa la/ 'jam dbyangs gu sris 'ja sa phul ba'i 'ju sa'i nang du/ nged dang sems can mang po la phan pa'i phyir ci nas kyang 'byon pa slob dpon chen po rol pa'i rdo rje mkhyen/ zhes pa la sogs byung ma thag tu rab sgang nas bteg de nas shing kun mkhar du phebs/ de'i mkhan po dpal ldan mchog gis thog drangs skye bo grangs med pa thar pa la btsud/ de nas sa paṇa gyi bzhugs gnas sprul pa'i sder phebs/ skad rigs mi gcig pa'i mi mang du 'dus pa la/ bzhugs khri'i g.yas su hor dang yu gur gyi lo tsā ba dang / g.yon du mi nyag dang rgya'i lo tsā ba bkod nas/ lo tsā rnams so sor bsgyur te/ gdul bya rnams kyis gsung gcig thams cad du go bar mdzad/ de nas lcaṭa pho byi ba lo la ta'i tur phebs/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa zhal mthong gsung thos pa tsam gyis rab tu dad par mdzad/ khyad par rgyal po yab sras la rnal 'byor ma'i dbang dang / thabs lam nā ro'i chos drug la sogs pa 594

gnang / rgyal bu chen po la skyes rabs brgya rtsa/ rgyud bla rtsa 'grel/mdo sde rgyan rtsa 'grel/ dus 'khor rtsa 'grel/ de'i cha lag rgya gzhung dang bcas pa thams cad kyi bshad pa gnang / rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dbang yang gnang / gzhan yang rgyal brgyud dang zhing thos kyi mi dpon gyis thog grangs rgya hor dang / yu gur dang / mi nyag dang / ga'u li la sogs kyi mi chen dang sde dpon dpag tu med pa bla na med pa'i byang chub tu nges pa mdzad/ chos rje ma phebs gong du sman tshe'i 'dab sgo lo dgu'i bar du chad pas dngul bre chen re la 'bras ljag lnga re las med pa'i mu ge dang / nad yams dang ngo log mang po phyi nang langs nas rgyal khams ma bde ba las/ drung gis mi ma yin rnams dul bar mdzad pas ngo log rnams kyang so so nas 'dud/ sman gyi bla'i thugs rje bskul bas nad yams rnams kyang chad/ rnam thos kyi bus phrin las bsgrubs pas phyogs kyi 'dab sgo rnams kyang byung bas/ dngul bre chen re la 'bru ljag lnga bcur 'phel bas mu ge rgyun chad/ rgyal bu rme tri sla la 'khrungs pas rgyal khams thams cad bde bar gyur/ than pa byung bas char 'bab pa'i phyir nyi ma shar mtshams la byon pas nyin gung la char chen po bab/ der skye bo thams cad yid tshim yang slob dpon chen po gu'i gung pa la rgyal po'i sku tshe yang mi brtan/ rgyal sred la'ang gnod pa 'ong bar 'dug pas/ da nub phyogs su 'degs gsung ba gnang nas/ rgyal po sras bcas la yang don de'i 595

zhu ba yang yang byas/ rgyal bu chen pos spyan chab phyung zhing nan gyis bzhugs par zhus kyang ma gnang / yang la'o byang ching sang dang zhi ra mu ching sang gnyis kyis sngar bla ma ma byon gong du phyogs rnams ngo log pas 'dab sgo med/ nad yams kyang mang du yod pa la/ bla ma phebs pas thams cad kyis ngo btud/ 'dab sgos sleb pas 'bru ljag brgyad bcur 'phel/ thams cad kyis 'bru 'phel zhing bkra shis pa'i bla ma zhes zer ba'i skabs 'dir bzhugs par zhus pa la/ chos rje'i zhal nas/khrom che ba'i dus su rtsed mo 'phror bzhag na ngo mtshar ba yin/ nged la rgyal srid kyi bya ba lagatogs pa'i shes sgo gang yang med/ ban de bya ba gar bde sar 'gro zhing bstan ba dang mas can la gang phan byed dgos pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas mi dpon de gnyis gsung de rnams yi gir btab nas mos gu kyi rten du gzung / de nas nan gyis zhus pas thegs chog pa'i lung dang 'u lag sogs gnang nas/ mi nyag gi yul tha thal bya ba la lam brgyud nas byang ngos su phebs/ der rgyal bu ratna dang btsun mo bu rtsa tta ri dang mjal nas theg pa chen po'i lam la btsud/ de nas zhor dgon mo cher gtsug lag khang chen po brtsigs/ de ri dben sa zhig tu'ang bzhugs/ ma chu'i nye logs su sa thag rings kyi skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus/ de ring byin rlabs gnang ba rnams sang mi 'ong ba'i khrims bcas nas/ nyi shar nas dgung mo'i bar du byin rlabs rgyun ma chad pa gnang ba 596

zhag bcu dgu'i bar du rgyun ma chad bar mdzad/ de'i tshe stod hor gyi rgyal po tho lug the mur gyi gdan 'dren byung ba la 'byon par ma gnang /gam chu'i zhing du nad yams chen po byung bas gzhan rnams su byung gis dogs nas bred pa la/ gu'i gung bas nad yams bzlogs par zhus pas/'o na nga'i gnyid ma sgrog cig gsung nas re zhig mnal ba ltar mdzad/ de nas khang pa'i steng du sdigs chom chen bo byung ba dang sad de/ da lta ngas khyung chen po zhig tu sprul nas nad yams gtong ba'i gdon rnams zos nas/khang pa'i steng du babs pas sdigs chom de byung ba yin/ da nad rnying pa zhi zhing sar pa mi 'ong gsung / de nas btsong kha dang be ri'i sa mar phebs/ de rnams su 'bul ba byung ba thams cad dbus gtsang gi chos sde dge 'dun bcur longs yod pa yan chad du mang ja bdun bdun/ 'bul ba ma bzhag dang bcas pa sgrub pa la bla ma ri bo sgang ba btang nas/bstan pa la zhabs tog mdzad/ jo bo'i drung du dngul bre chen bcu gcig las rdungs pa'i skong bu/ 'tshur phu'i lha chen la gser bre chen lnga la brdungs pa'i gser shog dang / dngul bre sum cu rtsa gcig la brdungs pa'i skong bu lnga/ dge 'dun sgang pa la dngul bre gsum gyi skong bu/ bde chen du dngul bre gsum gyi skong bu la sogs pa dang / gzhan yang kur ma'i gdan sa la sogs pa'i mdo khams kyi gtsug lag khang rnams su dngul skong dang /rgyun 'bar gyi skong rgyags la sogs pa dpag tu med pa btsugs/ btsun 597

mo pu rkyodha ris rgyal bu ratna'i ched du ba dan yang dben gyi ri 'di dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku zhig bzhengs na 'grub par 'gyur ba'i rmi lam byung zhus pas/ de bsgrubs shig kho bos ku9rgyu grogs bya'o gsung nas srang stong dang dgu bcu'i nor rdzas 'thud/ bzo bo rnams kyis ji ltar byed mi shes pa la/ drung pa nyid kyis ri de'i ngos la rdo dkar po'i bcad mdzad nas/ thub pa'i sku chen po zhig bzhengs/ de la dpe blangs te bzo bo bdun brgyas zla ba bcu gsum du bsgrubs pas grub/ de'i snyan g.yas nas g.yon gyi bar du 'dom bcu gcig/ tshad des dpaṭa pa'i thub pa'i sku yongs rdzogs/ g.yas g.yon na 'jam dpal dang byams pa/ steng na lha'i bu dang bu mos mchod pa 'bul ba/ pad gdan gyi 'og nas bye'u sbug kha mdzes pa dang bcas pa bsgrubs nas/ rab gnas gnang zhing mtshan ma bzang po yang byung / 'phan de chos rje nyid la phul te da lta myang po na bzhugs so/ /de nas pu /dha ris lu be shan du gdan drangs pa rna/ li mi mi'i dmag 'ong ba'i skad chen po byung bas/ zhal brdas ngas sems can la gnod pa ma byas pa'i bden pas dmag mi 'ong gsung nas dbugs phyung /de nas bod yul du chas pa la 'khor rnams kyis lam rgyus ma shes pa la/chos rje nyid kyi gsung gis lam ma nor bar ldan du phyags phab/ de nas rkar mar phebs te chos mang du gsungs/ de nas khams kyi sa cha stod smad mang por byon zhing bzhugs nas/ slar kong por phebs nas gzhan 598

don rgya chen po mdzad de spo bor pheb sa/ slar yang kong por phebs lam du 'bri khung gi spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po dang mjal nas/ nā ro chos drug dang / skyes rabs dpag bsam 'khril shing la sogs pa gsungs pas tshim par mdzad/ rdza a ban gangs kyi me yong gi zhol du sku khams cung zhig mnyal ba la/ nga da lan mi 'chi bas khyed rnams skrag mi dgos/ da gzod sha rkyang mang po 'phyo ba'i sa gtsang sa cig tu sku khams ngan byung srid na/ dpe cha rnams ma 'thor ba byed dgos gsung nas/ 'phan chen mo dang dpe cha rnams la do dam cher mdzad/ chos rje gong ma'i gdung rgya yul du tsan dan a ka rus sbyangs pa yin/ nged rang byang du me shing dkon po byung dogs yod pas shug pa mang po chod la khyer gsung nas bsnams/byang phyogs nas byang phyogs kyi sa shin tu dben pa'i ri zhig gi drung du phebs /de'i tshe ri 'di'i rtser dge slong gtsang ma zhig gi spur sbyangs na/ bod du rgya'i dmag mi 'ong ba 'dug ces pa'i gsung yang byon par grags/ der dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi bzhes pa chu mo phag gi zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gsum nas sku cing zad mnyel ba'i tshul bstan/ zla ba de'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan mo sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la sgor ba lnga bcu rtsa lnga mdzad de/skya rengs tha ma la sku'i bkod pa bsdus nas gshegs so/ /der gdung sbyangs pas 'ja' dang 'od dang sa g.yo ba dang me tog gi char la sogs pa ltas dpag tu med pa byung dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis chos rje nam 599

po gsung pa dang cho 'phrul du ma bstan pa'i rim pa rnams ni grangs las 'das so/ /sne po'i gzhungs chu'i 'gram du rdo'i steng du thegs pa'i tshe zhabs rjes gsal bar byon/ dgung 'o bzhi bzhes pa'i tshe chos rje mkha' spyod pa dang mjal/ stag rtser bzhugs nas rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang dang /chos drug phyag chen/ sbyor drug la sogs pa mang du gsan de nas dgung lo bdun pa rta'i lo la rtse lha sgang du mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po dang / slob dpon mkhan chen yon blo ba las rab tu byung / mtshan chos dpal bzang por btags/ bco brgyad bzhes pa sbrul la mdo khams su thegs/ gon gyo'i dpon chen 'od zer nam mkhas 'bul ba rgya chen po mdzad/ gon gyo'i yul du chag pa'i dmag gis/ gnod pa chen po byung ba la bka' shog zhus nas bsgrags pas de rnams med par song ste gnod pa bzlog par mdzad pa dang / de nas gling gi yul du byon/ gar ma dang ri bo che la sogs pa rnams su'ang byon nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor/ slar kong por phebs/ nyi shu pa rta'i lo la rtse lha sgang du mkhan chen bsod bzangs po dang / mkhan chen yon blo ba la sogs pa dge 'dun brgyad cu tsam gyi dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ gcig la khrid gnang bas khos dge sbyor la 'bad pa ma bton par nyal bas kho'i khang thog tu byon nas sku stod rib tsam dbu rib tsam mdzad de gzigs pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan/de nas kho spyan sngar byung dus zhal 'dzum 'dzum mang du mdzad pas/ kho 601

shin tu 'jigs nas dge sbyor la 'bad pas dge sbyor khyad par du gyur pa skyes pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa grangs med pa bstan/ gzhan la chos gsung ba dang / 'bul ba bzhes pa dang / zhal ston pa dang /khrims la sogs pas yang dag pa'i lam la bkod do/ /de'i dus su gong ma rgyal po'i gdan 'dren gyis dbus su sleb pas nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams su rim gyis phebs te/ lha sa dang 'tshur phur phebs nas gser yig pa'i zhu ba gong ma'i lung la sogs pa bzhes/ de nas rim gyis khams kyi sa'i cha rnams su gzhan gyi don skyong zhing gong du thegs/ de'i dus su rgya'i yul 'od kyis khengs pa dang / gzims khang la 'ja'i ka ba zug pa/ sprin gyi ga ba tu sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon sum du byon pa dang / lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis nam mkha' nas mngon sum du mchod pa 'bul ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul dang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa bstan pas/ rgyal po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa dad pa lhag par spel nas yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ gong nas mtshan de bzhin gshegs par gsol/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang / yi dam/ chos skyong gi snang ba grangs med pa gzigs shing / de dag gi sgrub thabs la sogs kyang mang du gnang / spyir mchog tu gyur pa'i mdzad pa ngo mtshar can phul du byung ba brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad nas/ gdul bya rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkod ces zer/ gong ma rgyal pos kyang dngul rkyang 602

pa'i 'bul ba la'ang dngul bre bdun brgya tsam phul nas bod du phebs so/ /de nas khams kyi sa cha rnams su'ang sems can rnams yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ dbus su snga phyir phebs nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams dang / sgom chen pa dang / thos bsam pa dang / sngags pa la sogs pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa rnams dang / dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan la sogs pa'i mi dpon che phra du ma dang / skye bo tha mal ba rnams kyang gnang sbyin dang / gdams pa bstan pa dang / zhal mthong ba dang / phyag gis dbang bskur ba la sogs pas thams cad byang chub kyi lam la bkod/spyir mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po/ slob dpon gu'i gung ba/ chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po/ mkhan chen rgyal mtshan dpal/ mkhan chen yon blo ba/ bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal/ rgya sangs rgyas dbang phyug la sogs pa rnams las mdo dang sngags dang zab mo'i gdams pa dpag tu med pa dang dbang la sogs pa gsan pa'i rdzu yang rgya cher mdzad/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi 'di dang 'di'o zhes pa'i gsung yang mang du gsungs/ gzhan la chos bstan pas smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i gang zag kyang grangs kyis mi chod/ de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa ni gu shrī sangs rgyas rin chen/ gu shrī blo gros rgyal mtshan/ gu shrī rin chen dpal/ gu shrī don grub 'od zer/ gu shrī chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gu shrī shākya bzang po ba 'a bzhi pa rin chen bzang po/ sprul sku chos dpal ye shes/ ngom 603

pa bya bral ba/ rma se rtogs ldan la sogs pa mang du byon/ de nas rim gyis lha sa po ta lar phebs pa na/ gnas 'di ting nge 'dzin shin tu 'phel/ ring por mi thogs par gnas 'dir 'gro ba la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar 'dug ces pa la sogs pa'i zhal brda mang du gnang / de nas mnyel drag po cig byung nas brtan bzhugs phul bas/ rten 'brel zhig gis mdo khams kur ma'i nye logs shin tu 'dun pa btang tshar/ der gsol ba thob dang / thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin gsung ba dang / gzims dpon la dpe cha lha rten rnams ma 'thor ba gyis dang / bdag po cig 'ong ba yin gsungs nas/ dgung lo sum cu rtsa gnyis bzhes pa shing mo lug gi lo la gshegs/ 'ja' dang 'od dang me tog gi char la sogs pa dpag tu med pa bab/ sku gdung sbyangs bas thugs rje chen po dang bde mchog dgyes rdor yab yum gyi sku ring bsrel las grub pa dang / ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs pa'ang dpag tu med pa byon/ spyir sku'i skye ba na rims su byon pa thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gdul bya phrin las la mnga' mdzad kyang / slob ma rtogs ldan gzhan la phan pa byon pa ni chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa 'di kho na mang ba yin no/ /khyad par rma se rtogs ldan zhes pa 'di mi nyag gi tshang du 'khrungs nas/ yab yum ma gshegs bar du yul du bzhugs shing / bla ma bsten pa dang / gdams pa zhu ba dang / thugs dam la brtson par mdzad/ skabs shed du chos 604

rnams kyis rgol ma nus/ de'i thong mkhan de grwa pas byas na sus byas pha chen rnams kyis gsong bar byas/ de nas der zur mang btab/ gdul bya bskyangs pas grwa pa mang du 'dus/ gling du bsdod pa dang ri khrod 'dzin pa'i grwa gnyis byung / de rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa rtogs ldan ya brgyad/ 'ja' mo mi gsum bya ba phyung ste/ de thams cad thugs dam bzang zhing gzhan don nus pa 'ba' zhig yin/ de'i nang nas kun rgyal che chung gis ldan stod du dgon pa btab/ bsod mas pas zum mang gi zur chos mdzad pas slob ma mang du thon/ chu gsol 'od zer bzang pos ldan smad sribs su chu gsol dgon btab/ khu dro rtogs ldan gyis kyang dgon pa gzung / gzhan gnyis tsam zhig gis gzhan don cher ma bskyangs par sgrub pa kho nas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ snag dpon cig gis gdan sa bskyangs te/ de yang thugs dam shin tu mtho zhing thabs lam la gtso bor mdzad/ mtshan rin po che bar gsol te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i slob ma rnams kyi nang nas phrin las rma se kho na che ba yin no/ /yang ngom pa bya bral ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba yang thugs dam bzang /phrin las rgya chen po skyong ba cig byung ste/ de ni chos rje mthong ba don ldan pa'i yang slob ma yin/ dang po'i dus su sha ba pha ri na 'dug pa la tshuri nas pha bong cig la pus mo gtad nas mda' 'phangs pas sha ba shi/pha bong la khong rang gi zhabs rjes byung ba yin zer/ dus phyis dgon pa 606

cig tu 'dag 'byar mdzad nas thugs dam la bzhugs/ de nas rje zhig na nang na chabazhugs par rig nas grwa pa rnams kyis sgo bsangs nas bltas bas na gza' shul ha re mkha' spyod du gshegs 'dug de narabs/ba' spyod bar grags so/ /gong ma ye dbang gis ba'i skyam chen po gser mig tu mngags nas/ rgya gar sto phyogs nas khri rū ba spyan drangs pa'i skabs su/ rgya nag gi rgyal po'i pho brang gi thog tu mi rū ba'i phyags phyir thul ba cig gsolan byon spa min zhes pa'i gtam yang yod de/ chos rje mthong ba don ldan ni kur skedang nye ba'i sa cha ngom du/ mab sngags pa/yum rnal 'byor ma'i rigs gnyis kyi zas su/ me pho spre'u lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la 'khrungs/ lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe mab sum la rmi stas kyang bzang bar rmis/ sku bltams ma thag tsog bur bzhugs nas yum la gzigs nas bzhad pa dang / lta ba bcad pas dri bzang gis yul khams khyab pa'ang byung / spre lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gnyis kyi nyin ngom ba bya bral ba'i sar bsod stoms slong du byon pa na/ ngom pa bya bral ba gzigs ma thag dgyes pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad/ ma ma zhes rgyun du gsung de nas rnag tu khyod su yin byas pas mdzub mo la phyag gis 'jus nas/ da ni skye med brjod ba kun dang bras/ /gnas med gnas bral 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /ma lus thar pa'i gnas su 'dren pa'i phyir/ skye ragro kun gyi dpal tu bangag gyur te/ /na ma tshar bar yul gzhan mi 607

tho 'dug /zhes gsungs nas/ da dung zhag 'ga' gsongs/ ma ā ikhyu u khyu zhes gsungs pas/ ngom pa bya bral ba dad nas zhabs tog byas/zla ba bzhi lon dus su bya bral ba dmar khams su byon pa dar mas gsang zer ba'i skad chen po byung bas thams cad sdug bsngal ba la khong mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bro yang mdzad/ yum gyi bya bral ba la ci byung dgongs sam zhus pas/ ci yang ma nyes phrad 'ong gsung / de la sogs pa 'das ma 'ongs mang du gsungs/ zla ba bdun bzhes pa nas sangs rgyas kyi mtshan sgrog pa dang yi ge drug pa gsungs/ khri thog tu bzhugs nas byin rlabs mdzad pa'ang byung / nya khang du spyan drangs pa'i tshe rten rnams la gzigs/ khyad par zhwa nag can la gzigs shing bzhed/ 'di su yin zhus pas bdag yin gsung nas thugs kur phyag 'dzugs/ yab kyi bang na yod pa la ngom pa bya bral bas phyag la 'jus nas/ khyod su yin gsungs pas/ nga de bzhin gshegs pa'i skye ba yin shes sam gsung / ngom pa dang ri bo che pa ma 'cham pa la 'di bzhin byas na 'di ltar rgyal bar 'gyur gsung ba bzhin du byas pas yul khams bde bar gyur/ bya lo zla ba gnyis pa la lha khyim du phebs pa'i tshe/ bla ma gcod pa'i dpon pos re zhe gang yin zhus pas/ dgon pa la phyag mdzub gtad nas 'di yin gsung /dgon du phebs nas dus gsum mkhyen pa'i sku 'bum ngos gzung / zhwa nag blangs nas nga rang gi yin gsung nas bsnams/ gzhan yang mngon 608

'brad gsung nas bsngo ba mdzad/ de nas lha stengs su spyan drangs pa'i tshe zla ba gzas gzung ba'i dus su rgya nagagi rgyal po'i 'dra tshul dang / zhal tshoms kyi ring thung la sogs bkod ba rgyas par gsungs/ tshur sgang da na du sku mtshams la bzhugs dus rgyalab rgya mtsho/ sgrol ma/ chos skyong phyag bzhi pa/ per nag can la sogs gzigs/ bka' bzhi bas mi g.yo ba'i rjes gnang phul ba'i dus su lha mo lcags phur ma gzigs/ gzhan yang gzigs pa grangs med/ mngon par mkhyen pa'ang mang du gsungs/skabs su ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pas der yod pa'i sgom chen pa rnams kyang sgom bzang du song / de nas mtshams khong nas rnam rgyal sgang du byon/ de nas tshur pheb pa'i tshe/ tshes bcu'i tshogs gral du rje btsun ma gzigs/ gon gyo bdamakhapos zhwa nag la bltas pas/ 'di hor dus kyi yin/ rgya'i min zhes zhib tu gsungs/ der sangs rgyas byang sems mang po dang gnas brtan bcu drug la sogs ming du gzigs/ skya ser khri tsho gnyis tsam la thugs rje chen po'i sgom ba sa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs gsungs/ de dus dgung lo gsum du ma rdzogs tsam yin na'ang /gzhan la co 'dri ba'i bzhad gad dang chos rnams kyang thogs med du gsung bar mdzad/ than pa byung ba'i tshe ngom pa bya bral bas sku mdun du phyin nas char 'bebs par zhu zhus pas/ gnas po 'ga' ya dge bsnyen chen po da lta char phob/ gal te mi 'bebs na tsa ra dam po byed gsungs pas/610

de ma thag char chen po bab pa dang / dga' ldan gyi bkod pa gsung bar mdzad pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'ang mang ngo/ /de nas rim gyis kong por phebs nas gzhan phan rgya chen bo bskyangs/ dwags po nas brgyud de 'ol kha bkra shes thang du phebs nas/ mkhan chen bsod bzangs po do li la spyod drang nas rab tu gshegs pa'i tshul yang bstan/ dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas nga zhus kyang btang / gzhan yang sprul sku chos dpal ye shes ba dang / chos rje rong bo la sogs pa mang du brten nas gsan pa mdzad pa'i tshul yang rgya che bas mdzad/ mdor na khams kyi sa'i cha rnams dang / kong po dang / dwags po dang / bod kyi sa cha ci rigs pa rnams dang / khams dbus kyi sa cha rnams su zhabs kyis bcags nas 'gro ba rnams smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i tshul rnams ni grangs kyis mi lang ngo/ /chu pho spre'u'i lo la rtse lta sgang du bzhugs pa'i dus su/ mo ma rmi ltas pa rnams kyis shin tu rtsub zer bas/ slob dpon sangs rgyas seng ge bas brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba btab pas/ da lo nged la skyon mi 'ong ba ba dgu'i bar nged rang gis khag 'khur ba yin gsung / de nas dben gnas gsang phur phebs nas sku mtshams la bzhugs dus su rten thams cad la mchod pa dang na bza' phul/ tshos skyong la mchod gtor mdzad nas bka' bsgo mdzad/ tha dad kyi rten sgam du bzhugs su gsol nas phyag dam mdzad/ chos rje snye bo ba la nged ma sleb bar du rgya ma nyams 611

par gyis gsung / rgyu mtshan ci lags zhus pas/ bha la ba dang ma kha gnyis rtsod pa yod pas rigs ldan gyi grogs la 'gro dgos yod gsung /der yun du bzhugs par gsol ba btab kyang / sa g.yo ba dang / nyi ma la 'od med pa dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs gshegs pa'i mtshan mang du byung / nyin cig kho bo yang bka' brgyud kyi gral la 'dug pa yin gsung nas gsol 'debs mdzad/ khyed rang tsho yang gsol pa thob gsung / de'i skabs su sku chos dang dbu zhwa zhwa nag dang bsre 'pho'i zhal gdams la sogs pa'i phyag dpe rnams gu shrī ba la gnang nas lung bstan bka' rgya dang bcas pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo sum cu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa chu mo bya'i lo la gshegs/ de'i slob ma'i mchog ni spyir bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / ban rkar ba 'jam dpal bzang po ba dang / gu shrī dpal 'byor don grub pa rnam pa gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'o/ /da ltar gyi sprul pa'i sku rang byung kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po ni/ rngod kyi sa'i cha u rgyan ri khrod du/ yab grags pa dpal grub dang yum lha mo skyid gnyis kyi sras su/ shing pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs nas sa'i cha rnams su skye bo dpag tu med pa smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa 'di lags so/ /dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa nas sku'i skye ba na rims su byon pa rnams kyi slob ma mchog gi rim pa ni/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma 'od bzhi ni/ mtha' ma tshul khrims 'od/ nam 612

mkha' 'od/ the'u byang chub 'od/ rgya sgom ye shes 'od do /gzhan yang gang rin po che/ mkhas pa dbang rdor/ stag del ba/ gtsang so ba/ rgya pho ba lung ba/ chos rje gangs pa/ rje rdzong ba rin chen nga ge/ sangs rgyas ras pa chen po la sogs pa'o/ /kur ma pa shi'i slob ma ni/ ye shes dbang phyug rin chen dpal/ hor yul du rgyal pos nag la gtugs te mer bsreg pa sogs brgyad byas pa'i dus su 'di gnyis kyang mer bsregs zer/ g.yag ru ras pa/ rtogs ldan zhwa ser ba/ zhwa dmar ba/ zhwa khru ba/ stag mgo ba/ gzig mgo ba/ dom mgo ba/ spyan snga stag shod pa/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros seng gi 'di la grub mtha'i cha nas cung mi dgyes zer/ dbon rin po che/ gnam mtsho ba chen po/ byang sems rgyal yes/ grub chen u rgyan pa/ gnyan ras la sogs pa'o/ /chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i slob ma ni/ rtogs ldan bsam gtan rin chen/ she grags pa seng ge/ rtogs ldan ndhe bo/ rtogs ldan khu yo ba/ khrug skyugs pa/ ye rgyal ba/ sdod ston gzhon nu 'bum/ spyar snga rdor rin pa/ 'di ber nag can la mnga' brnyes/stag lung kun spangs rin po che/ rgyal ba g.yung ston pa/ mkhas grub dharma rā dza/ g.yag sde paṇa chen/ mkhas grub dar rgyal ba/ bla ma dar 'byung / mkhan chen rtsi bar ba/ slob dpon 'jam nyag glog skya bka' bzhi pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mngon pa ba/ sman klungs pa/ la 613

stod pa mgon rgyal ba/ dge 'dun sgang ba'i mkhan bo mkhas btsun pa laṭa so/ /chos ri rol pa'i rdo rje'i slob ma/ slob dpon gu'i gung ba rin chen dpal/ chos rje ri'u sgang ba/ kun spangs kun dga' don grub/ sto rin po che/ rje btsun nags mgo ba/ ri mgo ba/ sha ra pa/ mtsho dkar mo ba/byams chos ba byang chub rgyal mtshan/ gar ma pa dkon gzhon/ chos rje mkha' spyod pa la sogs pa'o/ /dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma chos rje gangs par grags pa de ni/ yul gya bar/ yab gsang sngags rnying ma pa zhig gi zas su shing mo lug la 'khyungs/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i drug cu rtsa drug pa yin/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan rin chen 'od zer/ 'bri khung chos rje/ stag lung thang pa/ rmog spyodas pa/ la mig pa/ dwags po 'dul 'dzin/ nye gnas gsal byang / kha che paṇa chen la sogs pa'i bla ma mang du brten/ gtso bo mdo bo ras ste/ de las phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ jo mo gangs kyi pha bong dkar leb la sogs pa'i gnas rnam / su sgrub pa mdzad/ phyis 'gro don rgya chen po mdzad/ khong gi tshe'i mtha' la hor dmag bod du lhags rang lo bdun cu rtsa lnga pa sa mo bya la gshegs/ de'i slob ma bsam gling rin po che ni/ myang smad kyi sgro lung ser chung ba'i khu lung du/ ma mes rngog rdo rje dbang phyug ces bya ba la/ sras phug pa mgon/ phug pa rgyal/ phug pa dar te gsum gyi che ba phug pa mgon dang por rta nag tu mi g.yog byas/ de nas ding 614

rir phyin na rnal 'byor par rgyur/ de nas shab tho nga ba'i rnal 'byor ma dar ma lcang nga ding ri na yod ba de gnyis kyi za su sa mo bya la 'khrungs/rgo nyer gcig la dargyal chos bzang dang gtsang pa sar sbos gnyis kyis mkhan slob mdzad de rab tu byung bla ma mang du bsten nas thos pa rgya chen po mdzad dpyal gyi zur chos pa'ang lo mang du byas/ myang stod kyi ra phreng dgon pa na dwags po bka' brgyud pa'i sgom chen cig yod pa de la lnga ldan la sogs zhus pas phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pa brnyes/ gangs pa rin tshen 'od zer gyi zhabs la gtugs nas chos mang du gsan zhing /ko brag pa'i ming zlob ma min/ ska tshe'i smad la myang smad bsam gling btab/rtogs pa mtho zhing 'gro don rgya che༄/ rang lo don gnyis pa lcags sprel gshegs 'di chos rje rgod tshang ba dang 'khyungs lo gcig cing rgod tshang ba las lo gnyis kyis sku tshe ring / sprul pa'i sku'i rim pa dang po'i skabs so/ / / /'tshur phu'i gdan rabs kyi skabs/'tshur phu'i gdan sa'i rim pa ni/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pas dgon pa btab/ 'gro don bskyangs nas gshegs pa'i 'og tu sto la yag pas gdan sa chu gnyi ga ga gyi bar du mdzad/ de rjes dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma stod lung gri pa dang rang byung sangs rgya kyis gdan sa mdzad/615

de rjes dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma gya ba gangs pas/ de rjes rgya mtsho bla mas lo gnyis gsum gyi bar du bzhugs/ de rjes rin chen grags te 'di gsum yul gya ba pa yin/ phyi ma 'di gdan sar bzhugs thog kur ma pa shi khams nas byon nas gdan sa mdzad/ de rting gar ma pa'i snag dbon yin pa zhig gis gdon sa bskyangs te dbon rin po che zer/ de rjes gar ma pa'i ru se dbon bla ma gnas nang ba/ de rjes rkar ma pa'i mched ya gtsug tor skyabs kyi sras ma dbang ye shes dbang phyug de'i sras bla ma bkra shis 'bum pas gdan sa gzung / de rjes bkra shis 'bum pa'i mched ya dbon po a dpal gyi sras che ba bla ma dbang rin/ 'di'i lag nas tshad ma pazlo tas blangs nas zla ba drug gdan sa gzung ste gshegs/yang bla ma dbang rin gyis lo 'ga' gdan sa gzung ba la/ bla ma gnas nang ba'i dbon po bla ma rin chen dpal zhes bya ba chos rje rang byung rdo rjes bskos nas gdan sa blangs/ 'di la bla ma nag po zhes kyang bya/ de rjes khong gi pha spun bla ma chos byang / de rjes a dpal gyi sras gnyis pa bla ma chos rgyal gyis yun ring bar brgyags/ 'di la dang por chang gu'i gum gyis las ka gser gyi tham kha shel gyi tho shu dang bcas pa byung / de rjes kon ting gu shrī'i shel gyi tham kha/ 'ja sa 'khor ma dang bcas pa byung / 'di gshegs rjes khong rang gi mched ya chos blos gdan sa dang las ka gzung / de gshegs rjes khong rang gi gcung po dka' thub kyi bu 616

che ba rin po che kun dga' blo gros pas gdan sa dang las ka lo bco lnga tsam gzung ca / mched ya chos kyi 'od zer la gtad/ 'dis lo nyi shu rtsa bzhi gdan sa dang las ka gzung / de gshegs rjes de'i mched ya bla ma bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sras che ba 'jam dbyangs don grub 'od zer gyis gdan sa dang las ka gzung ste/ 'dis gdan sa mdzad thog tu chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa gong du thegs nas gser gyi tham kha/ kon ting ta'i gu shrī'i las ka rka'o ming dang bcas pa phyag tu lon gdan sa lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum mdzad/ de rjes da ltar gyi gu shrī ba 'di'o/ /'tshur phu'i gdan rabs kyi skabs so/ / / /sprul pa'i sku'i rim pa gnyis pa'i skabs/sprul pa'i sku brgyud pa'i rim pa gnyis pa brjod par bya ste/ rje btsun tikhri pa'i slob ma khol bo dga' zhes bya ba las sku tshe 'phos nas/nā ro pa'i slob ma dza lan dha rar skyes pa'i bram ze kun rig ces bya ba zhig tu gyur/ de bal por gzhon nu gsang tshol du gyur te/ des sngags kyi man ngag mang du thos te/ de nas bsams pa/ sngags kyi tshul las sngags lam brten par sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub la/ sngags kyang bla ma kho na la rag las par gsungs na/ bla ma dam pa dang mjal bar smon lam gdab cing gnas pa'i tshe/ri nags su me tog 'thu ru phyin pa na sprin gyi gseb na 617

gnas pa'i gzhon nu ma rgyan du mas brgyan pa zhig gis/ bu bu byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan bod ces grags pa'i yul/ /der song khyod kyi 'dod pa grub byed de/ /bde gshegs nyid sprul khyod kyis mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes lung bstan du byung bas/ rang gi bla ma rgya gar phyag la gsol pas/ des gnang nas byang phyogs su phyin pas/ dge pa'i bshes gnyen mang po dang mjal bas dad pa rab tu 'phel bas smon lam yang mang du btab/ de nas rje btsun mi la dang mjal te phyag mang du btsal/ mchi ma blags zhabs la gtugs te smon lam btab pas/rje btsun mi las/ khyod ni kha ba can ljongs 'dir/ /yang yang skye zhing chos spyod de/ /mi las 'das kyang mi gzugs kyis/ /'gro ba 'dren pa rnams dang 'phrad/ /gang la yid ni rtse gcig pa/ /sngon gyi bsod nams mthus bskyed de/ /nges par de 'bras myur smin zhing / /'dod grub slar grub byed pa nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa lung bstan mang du mdzad/de nas bal bod kyi sa mtshams su dka' thub la gnas pa las sku tshe 'phos te/ dbu ru stod du pha dge bsnyen 'byung song dang / yum sgrol ma 'bum gyi sras su me pho byi ba la 'khrungs/ rje sgam po ba khu dpon gyi spyan sngar byon to/ lo bcu dgu la khu dbon gyi drung du chig rdzogs mdzad/ mtshan tshul khrims dpal du gsol/ bka' gdams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang / rje ras chung pa sogs bla ma mang du bsten/ gtso bor 618

rje khu dbon gnyis la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes pas rtsa ba'i bla mar gzung / chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa rje dwags po khu dbon dang mjal du byon pa'i tshe khong la dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes/ chos kyang mang du zhus/ de yang so bdun pa chu pho byi ba'i tshe gshegs/ de'i sku skye dge slong nam mkha' 'od ni/ ru mtshams kyi sa'i char yab dgon pa don grub bla ma dang / yum lha mo lcam mya zas su chu mo glang gi lo la 'khrungs/chung ngu nas sngon gyi bla ma dran zhing dad pa skyes te/ lo brgyad dgu la chos rje dus gsum mkhyen pa la phul/ lo brgyad dgu phyags phyir 'bral med du bsdad/ gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa dpag med mdzad/ byis pa'i spyod pa med par mos gus kyis bla ma brten zhing gdams pa rtsad bcad pas rje shin tu mnyes par gyur/ chos rje khams su gshegs rjes gangs dkar dang / se so do dang / kha rag dang / thang lha la sogs pa'i dben pa rnams su bsgoms/ mtshams bar du 'gro mgon zhang dang /sto pa dang / skyer sgang ba dang / gling la sogs pha dam pa mang du mjal zhing gdams pa gosan/ khyad par bde gshegs stag lung thang ba la dad pa rab tu thob nas chos zhus/ gtso bor sgrub pa kho na byas/ de nas chos rje dbus su phebs nas gdams pa lhag ma dang rjes su gdams pa dpag tu med pa gnang / de nas 'o bcu bdun du mtshams 'ba' zhig byas/ grub pa'i rtags mtshan kyang 'ga' re rnyed par gyur/ drug cu 619

rtsa bdun pa sa mo lug la gshegs/ de'i sku'i skye ba bkra shis grags pa ni/ yul mdo khams su/ yab 'phags pa rta mchog gi rnal 'byor pa dbang phyug legs pa dang / yum sgrol ma 'tsho'i sras su lcags pho spre'u la 'khrungs/ sku skye snga ma'i dad pas mtshams sbyar nas/ dbus su phebs nas stag lung pa sku yal ba la gdams pa zhus/ shin tu dgyes par mdzad de chos mtha' chod par gnang / sangs rgyas yar byon gyis kyang thugs rjes gzung nas lo mang por sgrub pa mdzad/ chos rje /ra ma pa dang mtshams khongs su mjal/ dad pa dpag tu med pa skyes te/ khyod sngon dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma yin/ skye ba phyi ma kho bo'i slob mar 'gyur/ da lta nyams len dngos gzhi 'di ltar gyis zhes gdams ngag gnad bkrol te gnang / dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gsum pa chu pho rta la gshegs/ de nas de ma thag tu spom por gyi sa'i char/ pha tshan sha 'bu gnyis las sha/gdung rus dbrang gu/ yab stag chung dang / yum a rgod gza'i sras su chu mo lug gi lo la rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge bltams yab yum sras gsum gyis bla ma ston byang ba la dbang zhus pas/ ye shes phab pa'i dus su yum gyis lus kyis gar dang ngag gis saṃ sgri ta mang po mdzad/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma yin gsung / dgung lo lnga nas sgol ma'i zhal gzigs pa dang / byis pa'i dus nyid nas mngon par shes pa thogs med du byung /dgung lo bcu gsum la rje khol ba'i slob ma blo grol grags pa'i drung du dge 620

bsnyen gyi sdom pa mnos/ der khong gi drung du lo gnyis bzhugs/ de nas kha thun shes pa cig gi sar skyal nas bsnyen pa la brtson par mdzad pas dgra la yang rtags mang po byung / dgung lo bcu bdun pa la bla ma ye shes seng ge'i drung du dgon pa spom du rab tu byung / lhan skyes/ jo mo :ཿbskyed dang ba bskyed gsan/ ye shes seng ge ba de rgya pho ba lung ba'i slob ma yin/ rgya pho ba lung bas dus gsum mkhyen pa la zhus/ bla ma de rnams kyi drung du gdams pa mang du zhus khyad par ye shes seng ge ba la thabs lam gyi khrid zhus pas drod khyad par can skyes/ na bza' ras rkyang res chog pas dbrang gu ras par grags/ de'i tshe ber nag can yang zhal gzigs/ chos skyong gis dbus su 'byon par lung bstan/ de nas dbus su byon nas po ti cig kyang slob snyam nas yab la 'gro bar zhus pas ma gnang bas/ gsangs nas rta bzangs zhig dang gser dngul du ma cig bsnams te/ 'ba' ri chos sang dang bsdongs nas bros byon pas lam du bar chad med par thon/ sog chu khar ber nag can gyis ngas khyod kyi grogs byed bya sbri rmis pas gnyid sad dus shes pa bde ba cig byang / de nas 'tshur phur sa pho spre'u la phebs/ de'i tshe chos rje rang byung rdo rje kong pos spyan drangs nas kong po na bzhugs/ der slob dpon tshul rin la gsang 'dus kyi dbang dang rgyud tshar gcig la sogs pa mang du gsan/slob dpon bsod nams seng ge la lnga tshan lnga'i dbang rnams dang sgrub 621

thabs nams zhus/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i phyog dril yin zer ba cig kyang gnang / gnam bar gyi slogadapon dbu ma ba la bde dgyes kyi dbang dang /yo ga'i dbang phyag len dbyangs bri sgrig dang bcas pa bslabs/ de nas ga nga phur byon nas bla chos ba 'jam dbyang shāka gzhon dang / zur chos pa slob dpon blo gros mtshung med la gtugs nas mtshan nyid kyi sde sgod sa nde lnga dang / byams chos lnga dang / tshad ma rnam nges dang /sdud pa dang spyod 'jug la sogs pa mang du zhus/ khyad bar phar phyin gyi ṭī ka cig brtsams pa slob dpon blo gros mtshung med kyis gzigs pas legs po byung 'dug na'ang sgros 'dzin mi ni mi 'ong zhog gsung nas rtsom 'phro bzhag de nas chos rje rang byung rdo rje kong po nas bas te/'tshal pa dag bde gshegs pa'i ston mo'i gral dbu mdzad pa'i sar chos rje mjal du byon/ lo bzhi na phar phyin mkhas par mkhyen nasagatsang phyogs su rna skor la byon pa phar phyin gyi chos skad byang ba'i snyan pa thob/gsang phur bzhugs dus rgya bragachogarje snyan pa che bas mjaladu byon pas/zhal mthong ba tsam gyis snang ba 'gyur nus pa/ stong nyid snying rje 'byongs pa/ spyan sngar bsdod pa la ting nge 'dzin skye ba cig 'dug pas shin tu mos te/ zhi byed mtha' bral gsum gyi gdams pa ngo sprod dang / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed zhus/ gsang phur kun drilangabs lo bdun bzhugs/sgros gsar rnying gi chags rdong laskyo ba skyes nas/ chos rje'i drung nas skungs 622

na dpon slob bcu tsam bzhugs sar byon pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/mdang ber nag can gyis sleb byung / khyed la chos skyong 'khor ba 'dug gsung / de lo chos rjes bde chen stengs btab/ der spyil bo ma grub pa chos drug gi khrid zhus nas dbyar de seng ge lung du bsgoms pas nyams bzang bo 'khrungs/ lung pa chus gang ba'i snang ba byung ba chos rje la zhus pa / chu'i chung zin pa yin snod gsung / dgun bde chen du bsgoms pas sgyu lus dang rmi lam la rtsal thon par byung bas/ stod hor gyi dmag 4da chen po byung yang da ga mtsho ma dros pa nas log pa gzigs pa bzhin/zla ba gyed na dmag mi dgos pa'i skad cha byung / rmi lam du u rgyan du byon pas ji lta ba bzhin du gzigs pa yang dang yang du byung bas/ u rgyan du phyin la grub tshen u rgyan pa lta bu zhig bya dgongs nas/ chos rje la zhus pas/ nyams myong gi rta rgod bya ba mtshar gsung pa tsam ma gtogs rtol mi rtol gang yang mi gsung / de nas chos rje ston kha cig snye mor spyan drangs pa'i phyasgo'i phyir byon/ /der phyi phyag byas nas gtsang phyogs la byon/ /jo mo nang du bya nga sems rgyal mas dang mjal/ nga chos rje'i grwa pa yin/ming grags pa song ge zer/ da dku rgyan du 'gro ba lags zhus pas/ rgya gar gyi bstan pa nub/ hūṃ ru ṣka'i bar chad 'ong bas ma 'byon gsung /khong la dad pa thob nas mi 'ga'i zhor lko dus 'khor dbang gong ma zhus nas/ sbyor drug gi sor sdud zhus te bsgospang pas rtags rnams rdzogasapar 623

byung ba sogs zhus pas/ rjes dran la sleb nas gda'/ sngar bsgoms sam gsung ba la/ chos rje rang byung ba'i drung du khrid mang du zhus pa dang /khyad par snying thig zhus pas kyang rtags rnams mthong zhus pas/ cig char ba'i rigs su 'dug gsung / de nas byang sems pa phug mo'i brag tu bzhud sar phyags phyir byon/ lo gcig bzhugs pas sbyor drug gi khrid rdzogs par gnang zhing / rgya gzhung mang po'i lung dang gzhan la ston cig pa'i bka' gnang kyang byung / de nas sa skyar byon pa'i nub cig rmi lam du sgrol ma'i gsung gis u rgyan du mi thon bya ba byung bas/ u rgyan du 'byon pa'i spros pa bcad/ de nas shrī ri dang mi la'i rdzong drug la thegs pa'i lam du lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa dang mjal nas/ zhag shas bzhugs te don dam bsnyen pa dang / sgrab thabs rgya mtsho'i lung zhus/ sa skya'i gong gi 'bri lcam bya ba'i ri khrod ༄cig na khams pa sbyor drug pa las rgya mdzad pas sku mdangs shin tu legs pa cig la rtsa rlung gi gdams pa kha yar gsan de nas shrī rir phebs nas rgod tshang du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ chos rjes jo mo gangs la bzhugs nas mgur mdzad pa gsal por gsan pa'ang byung /der marmel lam du chos rje rgod tshang ba dang mjal nas chos kyi gsung gleng mang du mdzad/ de na rje btsun mi la'i zhabs rjes kyi steng na rgod tshang ba'i zhabs rjes yod pa zhig kyang gzigs/ shrī ri'i byang na grub thob 'dam pa zhig po bzhugs pa la chos 'brel zhus/ de nas rdzong drug la byon nas 624
