brag dkar dang khu byug dben pa rdzong dang brag dmar gsum du shas tsher bzhugs shing / gzhan rnams su yang gnas 'brel re mdzad/ rje btsun dang yang mnal lam du mjal zhing mgur gsungs/ thugs dam kyang shin tu 'phel/ de phyogs su lo gsum bzhugs/ 'phags pa wa ti yang mjal/ de nas phyir log ste chos rje'i 'khrungs sar yang bzhugs shing /ding rir yang byon/ de nas sbu dur byon pas grub chen pa'i sku skye btsun chung lo bcu gsum lon pa dbang po dwangs pa cig 'dug pa la yang chos 'brel gsan zhing / mab/ na chen bsod nams 'od zer la yang chos zhus/der dpon chen dbon po ting 'dzin bzang po dang mjal/ gser srang gang khong gis phul/ de nas bde chen du chos rje'i drung du phebs/ lo ril po lnga'i bar du bde chen du thugs dam la bzhugs shing chos mang du gsan/ mkhan chen gzhon nu byang chub dang slob dpon bkra shis rin chen la sogs pa las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mkhan po la chos 'ga' yang gsan/der tshogs gral cig tu 'od gsal gyi ngang du dwags lha sgam po'i ri dang dgas po lha rje 'ja' 'od kyi dkyil na bzhugs pa gzigs pa'i mod la sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par gyur te/ sku skye snga ma rnams gsal bar gzigs shing de'i mgur yang gsungs/ 'od ston dang g.yam bzangs pa gnyis kyang de dus nas slob ma yin tshul yang gsungs/ skabs shig tu chos rje rang byung ba bsnyungs nas 'o skol la gtsang phyogs na gtad byed mi 625

'a / ga pas/ khyed rtogs ldan rnams kyis rim gro mdzod gsung nas/rim gro'i rgyu so sor gnang nas/ la las tshe sgrab/ la las rnam 'joms sogs mdzad kyi 'dug nged tshul blo gnyis ༄kyis gshin rje'i bzlog pa la zhugs pas/ zla gcig song ba dang sa skya man chad 'od gsal gyi snang ba la shar ba la/ sngags dgon cig na mon bu mang po ku lhang lhang ngu ba'i sgra thos pas/ sang drung du phyin nas mthu mkhan kun la cig byung yod/'od gsal gyi snang ba la 'di 'dra byung rgyas pas/ slob dpon rdo rje seng ge'i nye gnas shig bltar btang bas mthu byed kyi dgon pa na dmar nad rgyab nas sngags pa 'ga' shi 'dug zer ba byung / rje rin po che yang sku khams dwangs gsung / de nas rtogs ldan ye rgyal dang / mkhan po tshul blo dang / ston pa dang / lha rje g.yam bzang ba la sogs pa nyi shu tsam la lnga tshan lnga'i dbang bskur/ dbang bskur ba la de snga ba yin/ de man chad nas dbang dang khrid kyi sgo nas gzhan don rgya chen po mdzad/chos rje kong po nags phu'i dgon pa 'debs par 'byon khar/ bde chen gyi gdan sar nan gyis bskos pa la/ bka' bcag nas ma mdzad pas/dus phyis rang gi yang 'khor rnams mi nyan pa cig byung gsung / rig 'dzin ku rmā ra rā jo la rdzogs chen gsang skor la sogs gsan/ de nas phug so'i ri khrod du bzhugs/ de nas gsang phur bla ma ston dar la nā ro mkha' sbyod skor zhus/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung bstan byung bas de la 626

thugs dam gyi mthil mdzad/ ra tshag tu byon nas jo mo la mchod pa phul bas byin rlabs kyi snang ba mang po byung / rdo rje gdan gyi ngor lha sa dang /u rgyan gyi ngor ra tshag 'di yin par 'dug gsung / phug mo cher lo lnga bzhugs/ de nas 'tshur ca ra'i phur dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob ma grub thob chu sgom ma bsam gtan rgyan gyis btab pa'i ri khrod rta phug mkha' 'gro'i gling du byon pas/ gnas nang gis dpyad legs par gzigs/ nub cig mnal lam du chu sgom ma nam mkha' la byon nas/ sa cha phag ru dgon pa btab na 'gro don chen po 'ong / nga skye ba dman pas ma thebs pa min pas/ ming pos thebs pas thob gsung nas mi snang bar gshegs/ der spre'u lo la dgon pa btab dgongs pa la nub cig sgrol ma rgyan ngan zhing zhal la thal ba chags pa cig gzigs pas/ de lo rtsis la ma btub pa skad byas bshol/ bya lo nas gnas nang btab/ 'debs dus ber nag can gzims khang 'og ma'i sa der khal thams cad phog song bas der gzims khang btab/ zla ba phyed dang gnyis na dgon pa thebs te dge 'dun yang brgya lhag tsam tshogs/ thams cad thug dam la brtson pas/ nā ro chos drug dang sbyor drug la rtag thon pa mang du byung / ri khrod 'dir mi rabs gsum ridu thugs dam 'phel bar 'ong / de nas thong gshol 'dzin pa 'ong gsung ba'i lung bstan mdzad/ der 'gro don yun ring dwa mdzad nas gzims khang ston pa la gtad/ khrid khong 'debs su bcuganas 627

gzims khang yang dgon btab ste/ der lo gcig tu su dang yang mi mjal ba'i sgrub pa mdzad/ de rting pho brang nas chos rje rin po ches bde chen du bsdod gsung ba'i gser yig pa byung bas bde chen du bzhugs/der gzims khang legs par brtsigs nas dbyar bzhugs mdzad pas cung zhig bsnyung ba la/ gnas nang 'phrod par dgongs nas byon pas de ma khad dwangs/ yos lo la bde chen du sku mtshams dam pa mdzad pa'i tshe/chos rje rin po che pho brang du zhi bar gshegs pa ji lta ba bzhin du mkhyen/dgung lo drug cu rtsa gcig pa'i sku skeg la cung zhig gnas nang du mnyel ba la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' sgrol ma rgyan bzang zhing dri bzang gi ngad dang ldan pa cig gzigs pas dwangs par gyur/ yang byi ba lo zla ba bcu gcig pa la bsnyungs pas/ rje btsun ma lhan skyes gral rims su bsgrigs pa'i bar bar na bu mo gzhon nu ma mang po zhon rtse ba gzigs pas dwangs/ de yan chad du zhing khams mang du gzigs pa dang / bar do mngon sum du gzigs pas de dag gi don mdzad pa dang / sgom chen pa'i gegs mang du bsal ba la sogs pa rnams ni grangs med do/ /mthar dgung lo drug cu rtsa bdun bzhes pa sa mo glang gi lo'i dpyid zla tha chung sa la bsnyungs pa'i tshul bstan/ tshes bcu bzhi nas sku khams zhan du song / der mkhan slob la sogs rnams la zhal brda zhib tu mdzad/ phyag rdzas 'di ltar thong dang / nga tshe 'di la 'ja' lus su 'gro ba cig bya bsam na'ang bar chod 628

'gas de ma byung bas/ da nga'i spur ma sbyang bar rgyan drug gis brgyan nas dngul 'bum dkar sang nge ba cig gi nang du zhal shar du ston la thog gsung ba la sogs pa'i zhal bkod mdzad nas/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyi ma dro bar kha la zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs so/ /nyi shu gsum la gshegs rdzong bsgrabs pa'i tshe me tog gi char chen po bab pa kun gyis mthong /de'i tshe hūṃ skye snga ma'i 'brel gyis stag lung du yang me tog gi char bab ces grag rga/ /sku 'bum du gdung gdan drangs dus su yang phyogs thams cad nas 'ja' zug cing / bcom ldan 'das ma'i tshogs mchod bshams pa'i steng du'ang 'ja' rnams 'khyil zhing bsdod pa byung ngo / /'di la spyir slob ma mang yang bu chen bzhir grags pa ni/ rtogs ldan mgon rgyal ba/'jam dbyangs chos rdor ba/ g.yag sde paṇa che / mkhas grub dar ma rgyalamatshan pa dang bzhi'o/ /de dag las g.yag sde paṇa chen ni/ g.yag sde bye mar/ yab ma mi dkon mchog dpal dang yum skya rgyal chos skyid gte sa kyi sras su sa mo phag la 'khrungs/ bu ston rin po ches lo dgu bdes pa'i phag de yin/ lo lnga lon pa la 'ban po chos dbang la ngan byung spyod rgyud thun cig gsan/ rtogs ldan rin smon dang / jo stan dar brtson la klog yig bslabs shing / phyis 'dul mngon yang gsan/mkhan chen chos dpal ba la dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung mdzad/'a dul ba tshar 'ga' gsan/ ras ston bsod rin la dge tshul mdzad/629

'dul ba'ang ga na/ mkhan chen 'od 'byung dang / zhwa chen rin 'byung las bsnyen par rdzogs/ gsang phu ba blo gros mtshungs med la rnam nges dang / byams chos lnga/ spyod 'jug tshad ma bsdus pa/ snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khri shing rnams zhus/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje la/rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ phag mo/ bde mchog 'jigs byed de/ gdan bzhi rnams kyi dbang / sbyor drug nā ro chos drug lhan cig skyes sbyor/sku gsum ngo sprod rnams kyi khrid/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ brtag gnyis/do ha/ ba mo nang don/ skyes rabs snga phyi gnyis rnams kyi bshad pa/bsnyen sgrub/ ras chung snyan brgyud/ bcud len phreng ba la sogs pa zhus/ 'phan po btsun shāka la gnyan ma'i zhal bzhi pa'i skor rnams gsan/rtogs ldan grags seng ba la nā ro'i chos drug dang / sbyor drug dang /lhan skyes jo mo'i byin rlabs dang / phyag rdor gtum po ras chung lugs dang / gegs sel la sogs mang du zhus/ las stod dbang rgyal la sbyor drug dang / dbang mdor bstan dang / nyi zla sgrub pa dang / sbas pa mig 'byed la sogs pa zhus/ rig 'dzin ku rmā ra rā dza'i drung du rdzogs chen snying thig gi skor rnams zhus/ kun spangs chos grags dpal la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa dang / gshed dmar gyi dbang dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / bde mchogastod 'grel dang / dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma rnams gsan/ dpang lo tsā ba blo gros brtan pa lko rdo rje rtse mo 630

dang / sa sde lnga dang / mngon pa kun las btus dang / thub pa dgongs rgyan dang / snyan dngags me long dang / mtshan brjod la lha gas pa mang du zhus/ g.yung ston pa la ye shes gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud gdams pa dang bcas pa/ gsang snying dbang dang bcas pa/ ma ro'i gdams pa thungs skor dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro snying theg gi dbang khrid lung dang bcas pa/ a ro'i rgyud chung gi lung / tsa mi 'gyur gyi duga'akhor gud 'grel gyi sung dbang dang bcas pa/ gzhin rje gshed kyi lung / mdo da ngas 'dus/ sems lde ma bu bco brgyad la sogs pa zhus/ bu ston pa la dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang bskur/ rgyud 'grel kyi bcad pa/gsang 'dus kyi dbang dang man ngag gi khrid/ rgyud kyi bshad pa/ spyod bsdus/ grub pa sde bdun/ phar phyin rnam nges rnams dang / gshed dmar rdzogs rim sogs mang du gsan/ 'chims blo bzang grags pa la bslab btus dang / dbu ma 'jug pa sogs zhus/ kun mkhyen dol bo ba 5 dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa/ mchog dbang / sbyor drug gi khrid/ nges don rgya ma sodam mang du gsan/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/lam 'bras la sogs gsan/ spyir ma brgya rtsa brgyad bsten zhing / la lar chos thun re tsam dang / la skar sgrub thabs cha re tsam re/ la lar mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel rgya chen po gsan/ sku tshe'i stod la yo byad srab 631

pa byung ba la/ skyes mchog bsam gtan dpal la gdams pa zhur byon pas/khong gis longs spyod kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pas legs par 'grig ste/ na ning bar nga'i khas skyo bo ma rnyed/ da ni skyo bos nga'i kha mi rnyed par 'dug gsung / de ltar rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas e zo gi dgon pa btab/ mngon par shes pa dang ldan pas gzhan don rgya cher mdzad/ slob ma'ang mkhas shing zab mo'i thugs dam la mnga' brnyes pa/ri khrod pa mgon po ye shes dang / gdan sa pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs chos mgon pa dang / mkhas grub byang chub rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chen sangs rgyas blo gros pa la sogs pa mang du byon zhing / nyin cig chos thun re tsam gsan pa rnams la kha zas dang gnang sbyin la sogs pa'i sgo nas rten 'brel sgrigs pas 'gro ba mang po la phan 'dogs nus pa'i bshes gnyen chen po'ang mang du byon/ dgung lo brgyad cu bzhes pa sa pho rta'i lo la zhi bar gshegs/ de'i rjes e rdza na yang ding sang gi bar du de'i chos kyi tshul rgyun ma chad pa ra yod do/ /ri khrod pa mgon po ye shes kyis paṇa chen gshegs rjes e sbra gi gdan sar yun mi ring ba zhig bzhugs nas wa la sna'i dgon pa btab/ chos khrims shin tu dam zhing dge 'dun kyang mang du 'dus/ gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs/ mkhan chen sang blo bas tshogs kyi mkhan po mdzad/ de rjes sa stod smad mang por bzhugs nas khrid kyis gzhan don mang du bskyangs pas/ slob ma mkhan chen rin po che rgyal bzang 632

ba la sogs byon/ phyis yol rin chen gling btab nas 'gro don mdzad/chos rje byang rgyal bas chos 'khor gling du yun ring du bzhugs nas/ phyi zhig na chu mig dgon gsar du bzhugs te/ gzhan don bskyangs pa'i slob ma slob dpon nam mkha' grags pa la sogs pa yin/ 'jam dbyangs chos mgon pas e rdza du gdan sa gzung nas gzhan don mdzad pas 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba dang / rkyang chen pa shākya shrī la sogs slob ma'ang mang du thon no/ /mkhas grub dar rgyal ba ni/ thang lha'i nye logs su yab bsod nams mgon dang yum bkra shis kyi ming can gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs te/ yum gyi rmi lam du rgya gar gyi rnal 'byor pa gcer bu dar dkar gyi aṅga rag dang cod pan can/ gser gyi rna rgyan dang ldan pa/thod pa bdud rtsis bkang bas phyag mtshan pa zhig bud med rgyan gyis brgyan pa lnga brgya tsam gyis bskor nas gan du byon nas dbang bskur/chos bstan/ rdzu 'phrul kyang bstan nas/ 'khor rnams gcig la gcig thim ste methar rnal 'byor pa gcig pur gyur nas rang gi smin mtshams su thim pa rmis pas/ nyams bzang po rkyen gyis mi gnod pa zhag bdun du byung zhing / gzhan yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung / sku gzhon nu nyid nas dad pa dang snying rje che ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten la dga' ba/dge 'dun la gus pa/ rang sdig pa mi spyod par ma zad gzhan byed pa mthong na yang bzod glags med pas bzlog par mdzad pa la sogs pa'i 633

yon tan du ma dang ldan pa zhig go /dgung lo drug bdun la yig klog la mkhas par gyur/ yum rgyas 'bring la sogs gzigs pas tshig dang don rags rim thugs la byon/ bla ma byugs sangs pa rin chen bla ma la sogs bston/ nyin cig byis pa bo du ma dang bcas nas me tog 'thu zhing rtsed mo la byon pas/ lus brdabs te snang ba'i sdug bsngal gyis rkyen byas nas skyabs sangs rgyas kho nar nges pa'i shes pas sangs rgyas la skyabs su song zhing / tshe rabs dran pa'i skyo ba skyes/ glu blangs pas la la dag ngo mtshar du 'dzin cing / la la dag gdon gyis byin gyis brlabs par 'dzin/de dang nye bar chos ri rang byung rdo rje dang ma la bas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su mthong / dad pa drag po skyes na phyags gyir bde chen stengs su byon/ chos rje mkhan po dang / mkhan chen gzhon nu byang chub pas slob dpon mdzad de/ dgung lo bcu dgu la rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs/ snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub/ bla ma tshul rin/ chos rje grags pa seng ge/ rgya brag chos rje/ mkhan chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/bla ma bsod rin/ byang chub mgon po/ bsod nams seng ge la sogs pa'i mkhas pa dang grub pa dang btsun pa'i bla ma mang du bsten nas mdo rgyud bston bcos du ma'i gsan pa rgya cher mdzad/ khyad par man ngag la gtso bor mdzad de sgrub pa la thugs gzhol bar mdzad nas ri khrod dben pa rnams su g.yeng ba rnam par bcad nas bsgoms pas thams cad kyang gus 634

par gyur/ dbu sngas la mi 'jog pa/ rgyab rten la mi brten pa/ chu dang rdo'i dka' thub/ rlung sbyor ba mosgo dus 'da' ba rnams kyis bsgrubs pas nyams myong mang du skyes/ khyad par rtsub nyams kyi shig nad drag po lo gsum/ thugs rlung lo gnyis/ 'dzag pa'i gegs lo gcig rnams byung ba la/ thugs dam kho nas nyams de dag las grol nas nyams rtogs mchog tu gyur pa 'khrungs/ rang nyid mi g.yo ba dang / gshin rje gshed dang / rnam 'joms la sogs par gsal bas bgegs btul ba dang / mgon pos pus mo btsugs te phrin las sgrub par khas len pa dang / tshe dpag med dang shākya thub pa la sogs pa'i dag pa'i snang ba mang po dang / gzhan dag gi yul dang rigs dang spyod pa dang sems kyi rnam 'gyur rnams me long la shar ba bzhin gsal bar gzigs pa dang / rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal phun sum tshogs pa la 'bad pa med par rang nyams su spyod pa dang / chos rje rang byung rdo rje dang rin po che zang zang sna rings pa dri mol mdzad pa na sar har gzigs pa dang / bde mchog gi dbang zhus pa'i tshe ) ru ka rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang bcas par gzigs pa dang / snye mdo ba la zhi byed brgyud pa phyi ma gsan dus dam pa sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma brgya rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba gzigs pa dang /cirtogs ldan ye gzhon pa la sems bskyed zhu pa'i smra seng du gzigs pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod/ thang lha'i ri khrod la sogs su ring 635

yun ring du bzhugs/ de nas phug mo'i ri khrod du chos rje grags pa seng ge'i zhabs la gtugs nas phyags phyir 'brangs/ grub thob chu sgom gyi bzhugs gnas bde chen stengs/ gnas nang la sogs su phyags phyir 'brangs te bsnyen sgrub dang / snying thig dang / mkha' spyod bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa'i gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan/ mnal lam gyi rtsal byang nas u rgyan zhag re la thengs bcu gsum tsam gzigs nus pa la sogs pa brjod las 'das par gyur/ zab mo'i dbang zhus pa'i tshe bla ma lhag pa'i lhar gzigs/ gnyan khrod kyang mang du 'grims nas cho 'phrul du ma snang ba rnam kyang rtogs pas zil gyis mnan to/ /chos rje grags seng ba la slob ma mang yang ri khrod pa 'di nyid rgyud 'dzin gyi sras dam par gzigs nas man ngag thams cad rdzogs par gnang / gnas nang gi gdan sar bskos/ 'gro don skyongs shig par gdams pa la brten nas nā ro'i chos drug dang sbyor drug la sogs pas gdul bya yang dag par bskyangs te smin grol la bkod/ byams snying rje stobs rgyas pas sdug phongs dang / nad pa dang / snyigs dus kyi skye bo log par spyod pa rnams la lhag par phan 'dogs par mdzad/ phyis mya ngan las 'da' bar nye ba na/ nga dang po na so gzhon dus brtson 'grus drag pos lus srog chos phyogs su btang bas tshe stod la da /'a thub dang sgrub pa dang du blangs pas gegs skyon mang du byung na'ang / thabs gzhan ma btsal bar dge sbyor gcig pus bsal/636

nyams rtogs yon tan gyi cha yang ci rig skyes/ mi tshe bya bral la bskyal/sgrub pa kho na mthar bton nas tshe 'di phyi'i bar lag 'gyel ba cig bya snyam na'ang / bla mas 'gro don gyis shig par gdams/ gsung bcag par ma spobs/ 'on kyang bla ma'i bka' bsgrubs pas 'gyod pa med/ blo bde/ tshe yang 'di tsam thub bsam med de bla ma'i phyag phreng gi rten 'brel cig mthong ba de'i stengs su song / mi yul du yang yun ring po song /sems can la phan pa'ang an tsam byas/ da ni bde ba can du tshe dpag med kyi drung du the tshom dang som nyi med gsung ba la sogs pa'i zhal bde mang du gnang / glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyer gsum gyi tho rangs gshegs/gdung sbyangs pas sku dang yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan dang ring bsrel sogs dpag tu med pa byon/ me tog gi char bab po/ sku skye snga ma cig sto phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram du tshong pa'i rigs kyi rnal 'byor par 'khrungs/brag ga ra gyi bya skyibs can du ind+ra bud rnyi tha ma'i slob ma gaspa las rjes su gzung ra bzhed do/ /rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge'i sku'i skye ba chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po ni/ yul byang phyogs kyi ljongs dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pas nye bar brten pa'i ri bo dang nye bar/ gnam gyi bye ma lung na kha na bar ba zhes bya bar/ yab lha rgyal dang / yum 'brog mo'i sras su lcags pho stag gi lo la 'khrungs/ sku bltams nas zhag bdun nas dpal dus gsum mkhyen pa la sogs pas lung bstan pa dang chos 637

gsung pa gsal bar gzigs zhing / dgung lo gsum pa nas skye bo'i tshogs du ma la spyan ras gzigs kyi bsgom ba sa gnang ba dang / gzhan rgyud mkhyen nas ji lta ba bzhin ga gang ba mang po snang ngo / /dgung lo drug bzhes pa na sngon gyi gdul byar gyur pa 'ga' zhig la rtogs ldan grags pa nga ge'i skye ba yin par zhal gyis bzhes shing / sngon gyi spyod pa rnams zhib tu gsung pa mkhas grub dar rgyal bas gsan nas gdan 'dren pha la dbon slob mang po byon/ mjal tsam nas yid ches pa'i zhal brda dang gu/sa pa'i tshul mdzad bas thugs rangs nas 'tshur gnas nang du 'byon par chas pa'i lam bye lung gi chu mdor dpon slob rnams chu'i dbus su lhung nas 'jigs pa dang bcas par gyur ba na/ mngon sum du rje btsun ma sgrol mas bskyabs te bde bar thon pa dang / 'tshur phur da slong dar tshul khrims la nam mkha' 'od du skyes pa'i rabs gsungs/ dgung lo bdun pa la chos kyi rje rol pa'i rdo rje dang mtsho smad du mjal/ da bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa mnos/ chos drug dang phyag rgya chen po sogs kyi khrid ga na bde chen mkhan chen rin po che don grub dpal ba dang / slob dpon chos rje rol pa'i rdo rjes mdzad nas rab tu byung zhing / mtshan ye shegadapal zhes gsol/ mkhan chen rin po che la kwa ri kā sogs chos bran 'ga' zhig gsan/ chos rje g.yung ston pa la'ang sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub zhus/ rje ri khrod pa la rgyud 'bum 638

dab do rga lo rmā stong da do nga rjes gan mang dugasan do por rdu yang lha rgyud kyi ma ngag 'dzi nga pha'akho la rna ta ཿmi sko/ lha sor rdungadzi ga(bzhu go na la cu tsho rjerang byung rdo rje skyi tho 'du cu dbus ryā mis tho 2 ñtsa zhi / 4napal ldan sa ming ga nga dong ra ga mi'i drung nu cu rte na'ang rdzu ṣka nyid lha cas tha rgyur pa'i ji tho na 'od ce rang pazhin gsung dru da jo phro ska lha ༷ rtopas brga napo skyi rdzas /g.yos thongs rno go rda la'ang khri kho mang ga rna kyi ska tsham dom par ma do na mi spu / gan tha gi chi/ sgo da kyi spyodo lam tsho sgo jo su rdu ga na te/ ro tshar gcad thod rje cu 'dzi pha lda sa da na du sngar/ na dgu lo thos do lo pa phu ṣka khado na rido dzo don rgyasad la ba dang tsho da lha 'ji rgyang chos kyi sgo rje/ gso ston rna rdu dpa da 'du rna tho sko cu thi tho rna sgo rdzo po'i bsha skol rdu kha' la nyi 'i dkyi 'khor zhi sho tho dang / ra tab rtesha gyi yog te lha mi du ma kyi chi byas pa'i lta rgya parala'orgyu bde tsan nga ba dpon 'a rin mo cho mdo / tsha dzinam nges/ 'du ba do 039

rtsa rnams gsan/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje'i zhal slob mkhan chen kun dga' 'od zer la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang sogs dbang bskur du ma gsan zhing /byang gi 'dam dang sog las brgyud de re shod kyi bar du phebs/ re sgrub dang yo rgyang gangs su chos rje bla ma cod paṇa bcing ba dang / lung bstan pa gnang ba gzigs shing / yul de dag tu 'khod pa'i skya ser kun gyis 'bul ba mang du byung ba bsnams te/ gnas nang du chos dang mthun pa'i khrims dang dge 'dun gyi cha rkyen du gnang / rje ri khrod pa bde bar gshegs rjes grwa pa dmu rgod rnams la thugs skyo nas gdan sa bla ma bsod nams 'bum la gtad nas/ gnas nang gi sgrub ri sogs/ ri khrod kho nar bzhugs/ mkhan chen 'od zer rgya mtsho la snying thig gi skor cha lag dang bcas pha ga na/ slob dpon 'od zer dpal la snga 'gyur gyi rgyud 'grel dang / gter kha gong 'og gi bka' lung phal che ba zhus shing /nyin mtshan du g.yel ba med par rgyud gzhung la gzigs rtog dang / gtso por thugs dam ting nge 'dzin kho na la mi g.yel bar mdzad/ de nas dpon slob bcu tsam zhig mdzad nas dbur stod nas myang po la lam snang nas rgya ma dar phebs pa na/ rje dus gsum mkhyen pas lung ston pa gzigs shing rim gyis kong po'i yu khams thams cad du byon/ khyod par tsa ri gsar ma byin legs su yun ring du bzhugs shing chos rje rol pa'i rdo ri'i bka' bzhin du ba yo ri dbon dang bcas pa'i bdag rkyen kyang 640

mdzad/ yang chos rje'i drung du dpal nā ro chos drug gi man ngag sogs rgya cher zhus shing / dbu ma rtog gi 'bar ba sogs dbu ma'i gzhung rnams kyang gsan/ tsa ri mtshan gyi brag dkar mor yang lo gsum bzhugs/dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul yang gzigs/ dwags lha sgam por byon cing bzhugs pa na/ dge slong tshul khrims dpal du gyur pa'i tshul gsal bar dgongs pa dang / thugs dam yang sngar las bogs che bar byung / kong po'i stag ma phu dang skog 'phreng la sogs par yun ring du bzhugs/ grwa pa'ang sum brgya zin tsam tshogs pa la rang rang gi 'dod pa bzhin du chos gsungs shing / dbyar dgun du zla ba gsum gsum gyi mtshams ba mas nas khrid nar mar gnang / byar yul du phebs pa na bde bar gshegs pas lung bstan pa gzigs/ rta lo la stag rtse rnam rgyal gyi dgon pa yon bdag rnams kyis phul nas dgon pa btab/ dge 'dun yang brgya brag gnyis tsam byung / mang tsa ri gsar mar bzhugs pa na chos rje rol pa'ir rje bde bar gshegs pa mkhyen nas gdung dbyangs kyang mdzad/ stag lo la dga' ma mo'i dgon pa btab cing chos rje de bzhin gshegs pa dab mjal/ stag rtser bka' lung mang du phul zhing bzhed pa rdzogs par mdzad/ dgon gsar lhun grub stengs dang 'ja' tshon gling du'ang bzhugs pa'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs pa gsan/rgyal gyi ri bor ri bo ma ṇi bha ga la ji lta bar gzigs pa sogs dag pa'i 641

sna ba'i gzig rjolasadapag hūṃ med pa byung / rngos rje de bzhin gsheg pa dbu sto ba stod pa na dpon slob stob mu myang po nas rimangogyis stod lung 'a ra pur byon/ nga ge rgo mdun du rtsom drug gsungs zhing ro dpon rigs ral ma sogs pa na par ma da/ zlar cu yul du rtson na ga cher ri 'od kho nar bzhug / kong lung lung ba ra dmu gyi po zhi ba'i rgya lo gsum mdzad/ mar steng su bzhug shingachom ga nga na rgyang tha gnyi tsam na yod pa'i bo 7kyang gsung ma nyams par tho pha dang / mi ma yin gtum pho tshan sdod sog mang du btu na dge bsnyen snyi brtul zhugs 'dzin du ba ga pa dang shin tu rmong pa'i shasalasashā darnaskol nga thabam sna tshog kyi 'dul bar ma na ma ba sku ma nga ngo sa dmas/ pha ba mo rnam mi mas bache ga ra mdzad pa'i khri phreng dang / nyams mgur da sna sna smon tha ba' nga du ma da cing smos 'ang chos kyi rje dzwa ba da gshed pa dang /bka' zhi pa jigs pa'i ra gri mtshan rin chen bzang sgo nang / na na sun sgangs chos kyi ye she / ger nyag rtogamakhaldan chos dpal ye shes/ dgon bka' bzhi ba rin chen dpal/ ri mi 'a ba ma bsod na ma rin chen/ lha me dbasharin chen rgyal mtshan/ 'a la zhig da rnams bum/ chu dzwa kha ba shes rab dpas la sog pa byung zhing /de ltar mdzad nga ma re shisardzogs par nye ba na/ cho rje de bzhin 642

gshegam 4skong rna /ston pha dang mjal/ rtse lha sga thogs su chos ma du la gong gi gan sbyin rgya chen po mibs/ slar tsa sna ba ga pa na 'chi tshed rtag spra zlog tha nga dzad de dgang ldan ma mo' bas nas phyag na la phyag rtag ces ma na cing phyog 'a ra rgyung du tshe par 'du rtse nye ga rnam la gsung kham pa sgro rna sa kyi zhu na brten nas rna ba ru sa yangayang da na rten la ma byung sagasu kya nan nu pas chu nyi bar sbyod de dang theb sa sod blo chos rnams chor ra gan cu da mnyel ma'i tshul ma da de bcu cug bzhes pa zhi smo skya ba bdun pa'i nyer dgu de da rig pa'i phyogs deng sto ṣka nga rin po mang du na mkha' ma da 6 'a tshon gyi bra ba khyi mor sgyur/ sku gdu do i brnyed ste dga' ldan rdzo ra ga ra sum tsho sna rte/ de'i bum par lhu ma cu rtso sog ma rjo bzang mung /dge zlo zag rdzorgya ga tshan gyi legs par brgya myo/ rdza dgo kun nga nga don du zhu da gi spo skya /da na di dang spam pha no cu ji da na las rta 'ang / jin bo the 'izhing nas da kha' spyod mu 0 'i chos sa la spyod cing gu pas par na rdo/ /'ger nya rtoste lta gyi yu sbo po nga spo⑫zhis dpa mkha spyod pa zha la gsu zhing gnam phas rī 64

byu gzung / ri khrod kho na 'grim pa la grwa pa mang dus sngo brgya drug brgya tsam 'ong ba byung / de'i slob ma gzhan don skyong ba mang du byung ba la/chos rje dri med pa ni/ ljang nag rgyal po'i bla ma mdzad/ phar 'ur gyis gzhan don skyong / sri dkar sang she ni/ yul spom por sgang ba/ mkha' spyod pa la rtsa ba'i bla mar gzung nas spom por sgang du sa ser dgon pa btab nas phrin las sgrub bar mdzad de/ dge 'dun sum brgya tsam 'dus/de rnams ni 'ger nyag gi slob ma'o/ /bka' bzhi pa rin chen dpal gyis ldan sga stod du zur dgon btab/ ri gling gnyis su yod pa la dge 'dun bzhi brgya tsam 'du/ lha gzigs pa ni/ dang po 'bri khung pa'i gzims g.yog pa yin/ dus gyis mkha' spyod pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ gdams pas rjes su gzung bas thugs dam phun sum tshogs par gyur/ gsung rnams la zin bri mdzad pas phan pa yang che bar byung / stod smad tham cad du byon zhing gzhan don rgya cher bskyangs/ de'i slob ma mkhan chen shākya grags pa yin te dang bor mkha' spyod pa nyid la'ang thug mod kyang /gdams pa'i zhib tshegs thams cad lha gzigs pa la brten nas gsan/ gzhan yang bla ma dpag tu med pa brten nas 'gro don yun ring du bskyangs nas/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa shing pho khyi'i lo la gshegs/ 'khrul zhig bsod nams 'bum ni/ gnas nang dang nye ba'i g.yu ma zhes par 'thungs nas/ mkha' spyod pa la sogs pa la chos mang du gsan nas/ gnas nang gi 644

gdan sar bzhugs/ chos rje mkha' spyod pa'i gsung la zin bris su mdzad nas bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid yig chen mo la sogs pa mdzad/ 'di'i slob ma slob dpon bla ma rgyal mtshan pa la sogs pa min sgo/ /yang bla ma chos bzangs pa ni/ 'khrungs yul nags skad pa/ maspu/ 'a spyod pa'i zhabs la gtugs nas gdams pa thams cagazhus/ stog rtse dang ba yo'i gdan sa mdzad nas phrin las rgya cher bskyangs/ bla ma rin bzangs dkar po ni/ 'a ngas yul nags skad po/ dgon pa grib gdong btab nas tshogs pa'ang brgya tsam 'dus te/ mkha' spyod ba'i phrin las sgrub par mdzad cing / phyi ma gnyis po 'dis sprul sku chos dpal ye shes kyi yang zla ma mdzad/ chos rje ri mi 'bab pa ni/ chu pho stag la 'khrungs te/ mkha' spyod pas bcu gsum bzhes pa'i lo'o/ /dge ldan pa la gtugs nas rab tu byung ba'i kun tu spyod pa rnams rnam par dag par mdzad/ sgyumakha' spyod pa la gtugs nas dus rtag tu phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par 'jog ste/ go gnyis pathos pa chu mo bya la dwags po la bar du gshegs/mkha' spyod pa'i sku skye chos rje chos dbal ye shes ni/ mkha' spyod pa'i gsung las/ snyi dus sngags spyodis la 'byor kun tu rgyu/ /zhes lung bstan pa dang / gshegs khar sku skye nagrang bar zhal gyis bzhes pa dang mthun par/ yul myang bo/ bye brag khe brag mdor/ yab bsam grub dang yum bar gza' gnyis kyi sras su te pho khyi'i lo la 'khrungs te/ lta 645

rna thus ma na rtsa sum tshog pa dang ldan pa lhabs ma la dra tar mig ra gyi rgyal sgo pas ma na pa yod ba lnga lon pa na sumangomakhar 'gas byin chubs rgyas pas rim gyis mdzad/ yab kyis 'a sa su ga spyo drangs nas bzhug pa'i tshe/ mkha' spyod pa'i lha pa kha misagi mi bas mas cad yid ches par gyur / lo gcig song ba'i tshe dgi myu dpo rigs pa dang / bla ma chos bzang pa la sogs pas ba mkhas kyis myang chu'i gzhung la ko ba la myun byungs nas stag rtser bzhugs/ 'o lcag bur kun nyis bgrod par dkar ba'i brag gi bya gyi tsu gshegs/ chu lasnyon par gsol bas ji ltar byon ma mthong bar gsheg ra ba dang rtsig dzo sgogs med du thegs pa'ang mdzad/ma lasten tsho ma du gsung de nas mang ra stengs dang dga' ma mor phebs ba sngar gyi gdul bya dag la lo snas rgyas pa'ang gsungs/yo bdag mig ska gdam pa'ang gnang / mkha' spyod pa'i lha chems shog ril pa pa nga to / de sa bla ma chos ba nga la phag mo/rgyal ba mi / ber dag can rnams kyi dbatho ba thabs nams dang /rkar pa/ rol pa'i do ri mkha' spyod rā mas kyi bka' 'bum tshang / chos drug phyag che / chung sems gnyis med/ rdzogs rshatshe / ri rnams kyi jid/ rgyud 'bum la sogs ba/sa// bla ma di rgod tshang ba'i sgro par gzigs nas bstod pa'ang mdzad/ dge slong 646

dbon grags pa la rgyud bcu bdun snying thig dang bcas dzidang/ gzhan la gsung chosamang du gsan/ di nas /bo spyan nga na te dang la sogasapar skyon dgung 'o rgyad zhi la nga da 4gyi sa tshal bang mdor chos rje de/ba na gsheg dzi ca4 dzee nas da za nya misdom pa ba sa/ bsngags po'ang mang duganang rda da sta cing la rsā mkhan po gnang / zlo zos rgyalamatshan dpal sa nga zos spro da ma'od nas rab tu byug/ khrom ji'i drung du4'idzañtsa dbastan bying zas 4dpag tsu med parasan/ ha kheng rgyal tsho rje zhe nga sku rdo rje dri bu/ gan dkang gas gnang/sbyin spyang zhung bcu ga pa la snye bor na/ de nas/kong po'i dgon gnas rnam dar rgya la nga bca sogs par bzhugs/ tsari gra rjong rtsa ra tha med kyi sgrub pa da ba zhalamangon sum du ga ga / di na jo ma la dwags na 'ol kha bkra'akho ri brtsa ma nga/bangon sna na lhan du thabs mtshul mino rpā rdzobasod ma ba 4tho do ra ma dzidang mjal/ der ba dmepa rdzog / 'i da dzin lko nga 'drin bzang po mdzad de phyir 4 rnam da na sar rgya mitsho skang sna du rka' ma b.rags pa'i ral mne byung ba ba ra (54ma/byams chos sngo/ rtsa she/ rtsod tho da rig dzi ska pha/ stong nyid ma'i myu mya la sog mang ru rkangaphu gan ga na gang du dngha 647

gdams pa dang mgur la sogs pa mang du gsungs/ de nas chos rje mthong ba don ldan pa'i phyags phyir glang gi lo la myang po nas brtsams te/ brag gsum/ 'jam rna/ dmar tsha thung / rngod ma rig thang rnams su phebs/de nas sgom sde dang 5sog gi bar du byon/ nags shod du mkha' spyod pa'i slob ma dkar po rin bzangs kyis gdan drangs nas grib gdong dang spud mdar chos mang du gsungs/ bla ma rin bzangs pa la ri chos skor la sogs mang du gsan/ de nas byang lam la brgyud de 'tshur phur phebs/ mang skol dang 'bul 'gyed rgya chen po mdzad/ gnas nang du chos kyang gsungs/ bla ma gangs pa dbang phyug rgyal mtshan la ni gu'i chos skor/'tshal ba'i chos skor/ do ha la sogs pa gsan/ de nas lha sar phebs nas mchod pa dad smon lam rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas dbur stod nas la btogade myang por brgyud nas kong por phebs/ dga' ma mor 'tshur ston chos kyi rin chen la mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang la sogs dbang mang po dang / ba mo nang don/ brtag gnyis/ kun spyod rngams kyi rnam bshad la sogs chos mang du gsan/ de nas yab yum 'a/ sogs pa'i don du sbyin gtong rgya chen po mdzad pa'i phyir/ stag rtser chos rje mthong ba don ldan spyan drangs nas 'bul ba rgya chen po mdzad cing / tshogs pa thams cad kyang 'gyed la sogs pas dag bar mdzad/ de'i tshe bla ma ye shes dbang po ma pa'i sar mdzo yu chen po cig gibs nas khong gi bug sgo chung 6 48 —— —

pa ca ba la/ sgo na yor mdo' dang lha stengasangarnams spyo skyon dar rab khyung bsnyen rdzog kyil kha po zhu nga nga du byung ba'i sa mi theg par da nga kya rna du gsol nde mnyab pa phyo ga na skug ma mi bde sa ra yor mdar bzhugs/ cho rje mthong tha don ldan mi sbyan drangs ta/ sgo na khyung po la pa ba da de snga sor rkang bor na sgar chen rgya'i gyi bzhin phebs/ dga' ma snor bzhug pa'i tshe bzhi rtsa bdun bzhi pa chu rdzo spre'u'i ston ba na mkha' dag pha da mi to dzi ra rgyun ma da ra bab/ chos rje de bzhin gshegs rdzodang /rje btsun ma sgrol mkhal cogakhasatho'ang skyon mchos pa shoms shig pa'i zhal ta'ang mang du ma da ge gshegs 2 tshon dkar po dar dzig brkyang ba lta bu la gas pa rna jo mi ra ba'ang mang du rgyu / sku gdung ni byang chu ma ko pa chod rten nang du bzhug su gso / sko'i cu'i 0 ba chos kyi rje rin po che lha dmar rtsod pa dzin pa bzhi pa ni/ chu mo bya'i la rtse/skad ma 'khudu 'khyung 'khyunga'akhomo mig sa gzhan gyi don rgya chen ko mdzad chos rje /ra pa/ ma ba dkar pha 'jam dpal bzang rdzo/ gu shrī dpa 'byor don grub pa rnams la chos mang du gsan nas dang 4po phebs/ sgrob dpon ma rgyal mtshan pa'i zhal snga nas kong por rgyan tpa sa sa/ rdo rī sgrong ba sog pa'i da nga bka' mang po dang /khrid kha mang po/ bka' 'bum ming po'i lung la sogs pa ga na pa rgya 650

tsher ma da cing stod tshe rnams ri ga / di rna rī yang mdo kham nas nga mkhar gyi pa du thog rna ma can bam can 'khor tho mo 'a can du mjod/ de na gyor gyi yu du gas na hor rlungs dzi rna sa gdul rgyar rgyu / ram gyi sdog chin pho rgyun ba de/ man de la gu tha rgyad rdu btsug da pa'i chos khri na/ bu khri nga tha bzhes te byang chub tu nges par ma thu nas/ ra kham kyi rnams ji pa brgyun de/ kong sbo 5 nyi mngodabus kyi gyi kham dku rna ga na don rgya na tha ma do cing / gi brtan lha /ra bzhugs so/ /sgrol pa kyi ri po gnyis pa'i skabs so/ / / / dpal phag mo pa spob ma dang ba sa pa'i skabs/rje rwag po tshe ma na sa po'i sku tshe'i ma ra bas la gaḥg nas rtog mngan mkhang dang mnya par gyur snang / der bzhug pa'i da 'du gong da kyi gra'akhagyi sgog mar bzhugs tsu gsol te/ gtam gsung na tsong / dge 0she kha pha chen po gral gyi gung la thozhug she skobya rdzo gas pa bston mdzado de/ don gyi na bka' pa da kyi bdag nde dbang bskur khri/ daphal phag mo rgya pa zhe rtan pas jigangarten gsu du khyabab de che ba'i bdaganganyig rnam pa gsum du grags te/dbang po rab tu gyur pa la nga rgyaganyid dang / 'a nga du gyur pa la grub 651

mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis wa ba dum bur bgos te thos pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams lug tu bsgyur ba la/ rgyal pos de shes nas slob dpon la gsol ba btab pas/ mkha' 'gro ma de rnams chad pa khas len du bcug ste/slar bud med kyi lus su mdzad pas wa ba par grags pa'i ind+ra bu ni dpal phag mo gru pa nyid yin par yang zhal gyis 'ches so/ /tha ma tshu so skye bo skal ldan rim gyis smin cing grol bar gyur pa'i tshul ni/ yul mdo khams kyi sto rgyud 'gri lung sne shod kyi stag ngos sab khang bya bar/ gdung rus dbas smre na 'phan thog gi rigs/ yab dbas wa na ma dar bya ba dang /yum re 'bye gza' btsun rna bya ba'i sras su lcags pho stag gi lo la bltams/yum gyi rmi lam du gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa cig skyes pa thu bar bzhag pa las phyogs bcur 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs thams cad snang bas khyab pa zhig mis/ zhal snga nas ni skyes pa'i sdug bsngal 'jur mig nas phyung ba lta bur ga nga spokyang / kho bo tho ba stong pa zhabs rtol zhig nas phyung ba'i snab ba tsam la ma byung gsung /— de'i du su yangades pha lkog cig khyer nas byung ba dran/ lo gnyis lon pa sgo gnas pa rang byung / byis pa groṭa cig gis g.yeng ba la 'di kho bo yin ṣka rung ba sa snyam pa'i thugs rje chen po yang 'khrungs/ lo gsum lon pa'i tshe mas pang nas chu btsags pas ngo tsha mi bsrung bar 'dug snyam pa byung ste/ des skye ba dran pa brjed/ dus der sbrul cig bsad pas dus gyis ro stod tsha kham kham byed pa 'di des lan pa 653

'dra gsung / lo bdun yon pa'i tshe gnas pa rang 'khrung dang mang rgyala'od rgyung bstan dzi zung 'a ngas tho sog po dran po ma pa pha ma sha sbyin pa brjed/ ma chung ngu na shi bas nu za sha yod pa ma du bzhagan khu yo grogaralabyalasate bya khyi lha khang bya bar khan pho nga de yan thub bu tshul ma shā gdang slob dayon steng di 'od ra rgyal mtshan las dgung lo dgu zhesapa'i tshe rabaci byung / mo na rdo rje rgya por gsol/ ji ge thabaslabs par mkhyen na masan po dngu 'bum rig nga pa'i blo rnyi gcig zhab tog ma da/ lha ji sung mi bslabs par khyen bla la chen po ladabang skur zhu ba'i tshog 'kho du nga gtan du gsol pa'i da bcang dzad rjong dpon ming mnyes de nas spyod chug sog ba'i ga na pa mong nga du pas su ring na 'bar lha ba'i ga jo dzig kham dku gdagu la so pa'i cho rgyabasang rwa gsan/ de gzhan snang tsho bo tha mal gcig tu bang sang sa bcu ba'i byabachub migad 'a ga zhung /skying khams dku tsā dpon ba drug tsa yod/ spyoda' ga bshad pa 'ga' ji yang la da/ mkhan zlotho sogs pha zug mnye brten su rdzong thor zhal 'cham yang dngos gyigasachung 'a 'a re las da/dbas chen po dang stab su byon pha khong la rdza da bo nga' ba nged rang gnyis gcig tu byam thos chogagasung na thon spra ma da/ sog nga 45

dag khang babal pa'i cho dang gtsang gi sa phyogs rnams nag po ra ri cig gis ngas 'jug la/ rngo wo 4spyo bas sku chung ngu zhis sgo lhas bcad las/ phyog mas gaskya ba nga ba'i snang ba byung gsung /dgung blo bcu dgu bzhis sde las rtsa / ston mung rgya dmar sor rta sga log tshad nyamarsha ra chos par bsnyo gamor nyan la zhu / rda bsgo bas su bka' lo sa ba rṣa gnyidamang ko b.rang ga dod ngasaX da / byamulatholasog pa la smon 'chag gi tshems nga dazhu shi4 —9 rnalas mnyan rgya dmang 4 gson palta da ṣe bzhu kho tshi na ba sbru ba sdig4bas ma gad du'abyang ma nyan sang /sang lo shu rtsa lnga la zul phung spya 'dus gyisabaltar wa/ rgya da ra sa rmob sdog mar garna rṣa sa na na bsnag lakhasargo 'du go rtsa gas ne dugs /sgyu nga bra gying sku ga na/ mtshan nyid grwa sang bzhu mu che ga zur kyi pha ra dzad/ mkhyi la 〉bas rnatsha chamang gas/ bsharaba'i 'dud ma yong cas/rdaras 0snangasalo chung sgro cho kyi rgyal 44na lke stodi la ba'akhorgyud la gas po'i mang dulas na/ dpalal mulo༄ mjal nas i tsho ca༄༄khas/ sa sa gho3lo ma ma sne la༄na pa'i tshe gal ja dzi mi gasta ba la cung —5

zad ma dad pas/ bla ma rgyab kyis phyogs shing na bza' ngan pa'i mnalalam yang byung bas/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang brgya rtsa brgyad blangs pas sor chud/ sbyor drug la sogs pa zhwa lo'i chos skor rnams mang du gsan/ de nas gtsang du byon nas brag dkar po ba la a ro'i gdams pa zhug pas/zhi gnas rkyang bar 'dug dgongs nas thugs cung zad ma khengs/ 'gos dang ba ri'i slob ma 'jang brag stag pa/ de'i dbon po rngog mu la 'phags skor dang mngon pa gsan/ de na bur du bur sgom nag po'i sar byon/ lo ro ba'i gdams pa rnams zhus pas legs par gnang / bur gyi drung du zla ba brgyad bsgoms pas sku thams cad bde bas gang ba dang zhabs la tsher ma zug pa yang bde bar 'char ba byung / de nas sa skyar byon nas skya pa chen po la lam 'bras la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du gsan/ khong chos kyi dri ba la dgyes pas chos mang po tshur dris pa la lan legs bar gsol bas khams pa shes rab can zhes mnyes/ 4de nas ma 'byim lo tsā ba ku ཿ ra burnya'i drung du rim pa rnam —gsum la sog mi'i gsang sngags kyi gdams pa mang du gsan/ byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan la thugs rje chen po dang smon 'jug gi sems bskyed kyi lag len zhus/ khong gi zhal nas/ zla ba mar ngo la mtsham bcad/ yar ngo la chos bshad/dbang bskur dang byin rlabs ma byas na gzhan la phan che bar 'ong gsung /yang kha rag sgom chung gi slob ma sto ba/ de'i slob ma myang sgom rgod po la 656 —

kha rag skor gsum gsan/ bla mang mkhar ba la mang mkhar ba'i chos brgyad gsan/ stod lungs su ston 'jam dang bsdongs nas sangs rgyas gnyal chung ba la chos zhur byon nas sgom ma cig la phrin btang bas mjal du ma gnang /nan bskyed nas zhus pas 'o na gtor ma cigabatang gsung nas/ de nas mjal nas chos zhus pas/ do nub rmi lam brtag gsung nas khong steng da gzims pa la bltas pas skyems mang po gsol/ khyi thul gyis dbu gtums nas thar pa rtsog rtsog gzims pa la/ 'di la rmi lam cang 'ong ngam snyam nas ba /tsam ma dad pa dang bar mkhyen byung / khams pa ston pa khyod gyi rjes su mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi rgyan can bzhi 'brang bar 'dug ngam shod ri nag gi drung du 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa cig 'ong bar 'dug pas chos bshad gsung nas/ thabs lam gyi gdams pa zab mo lag len 'khrul 'khor dang bcas pa gnang / de nas gzhan la chos 'dra ba bshad pas 'bul ba 'ga' re rnyed pas/ slar yang sa skya pa chen po'i drung du byon/ gzhan yang ma gcig gi ma la sogs pa'i la 'byor ma'i bla ma bcu gsum tsam layang gtugs/ lar gdams pa 'di che zer ba la ma gtugs pa tsam med/sa skya pa'i drung na khams pa shes rab can zer nas snyan pa che bas dge bshes zhang yang gus par byung ste/ spyan drang pas 'grogs nas byon/ khong gis bya sa gtsang po la sogs pa'i sar yang can mchod du 'gyur snyam nas bzhugs su bcug pas/ mthun 'jug ma mdzad pa la bla ma zhang cung ma 657

mnyes/ zhang la nyes pa med pa'i sku pa chen po cig byung bas/ ging gi 'gro ma na la/ nga pa nye pha ci na chad/ 'di 'dra ba'i gtamakhaji ltar bya na zhi bar 'gyur dris pa / 'gro mdon gyis dge ba'i bshes gaston chen 4 cig la brten na zhi bar 'gyur ra gsungs pa / 'o na dge ba'i bshes gnyen su che rī ra/ da lta dwags po snyi sgom kho na stan pa che bar dug thogasang pa / dge ngashes kham bas grogs gyed na gi nga khong gi drung du 'gro zer ba / der gnyis po tho ngas te rnam por phyon pa theb pha / gimangapo ba sku cung zhig madhe bas zhag 'a 'a ma mjal/ de nas ma la dus cho kyi slo rgyus mang po gsungs/ chos kyang nyin ri ga nga gi chad pa la/nyin cig gi tshe dge ba ris kham pa dang tshed rnams khrid so sor bya da sa pa 'dug gsung nas/ ga na rnam chos rgyan thon na phyir song bltan/'gro don spyan ra byon gsung nas skyon/ khyed kyis sngar jos ci 'dra ba thos/ nyam len ci bya pa gsung ba la/ gdams pa mtha rdu ga na tshul dang ra gyi skor ma snyan du gsol te/ 'di che gyi mthong lam rnam par mi rtog pa'i yi she su jo myud zhus pas/ ba khyed de de tsam gyi rtsis yod dam gsung / rtsis bdog lags zhus pas/ da ji musangagasol ba mdzad pa'i dzin chang zhig 'dug pa lhag tu bsnam na /khyed kyi de bas 'di mi dgan ri nil/sung / der cu ga skyog gis song ba na/lham po ba'i zhal nas/ khyed rang shar gyi ri de'u pha zhi'i khar sku khams gseng 658

ba smyo / khong 'a 'a zhig gi tshe zin pa dang 'o skol gsung zeng bya'o gsung tho / de'i shar 'i khar smyon na mno bsam mdzad pas/ ji zhig ltar la snga gyi chos thams cad gyi zhun da sbun par song nas nam mkha' rnam par dag pa lta bu'i rtogs pa ba nga 4 'khyungs/ cu gas rab kyang namakhamakha' la mdung skor bltar song byung de nas yang spyan sngar byon pa dang sgom po bas mkhyen te/ da nga la yang de bas lhag pha ba na rgyu med/ 'o na ming nga rang ga ga jigs skad de ba cig mod pa de bya dgos gsung nas/lhan jigasaskyes spyor gyi khrid gnang / dir bla mi la ja rdzo phyog kyi dri ba 'ga' zhig zhus pa la/ dge bshes pro khyod kyis chos leg par go ba 'dug pa / ngas 'chad dgos gsung zhing / kho za sa ba pa'i pying chub somabashadapa' yin par gsol bya mang gsung / de na ring po mi can par rje rnam po ba sku gshegs nas/ lha po nyid du sku 'bum la sogs pa'i bya ba dang / slob dpo sgom pa'i sdu grog mdzad de ba zhug / de nas mir phyon te bla ma skya ba chen po de ji nga la khams pa shes rab can gsung zhing mnyes/ nga shesarab 'di 'dra ba skyes pa khong gi drung du phyin la zhu da sa dgongs nas/ slar ming skyar byon pas/ de res di dri ba tsam tshong mi mdzad par spyan rtsa 'gyurapa dug pa / gyir 'on du phe sa nas mtshal gi du bzhugs/ der slob yang ming du 'dus/ lo ja 4 tsam gyi bar du slob ma 'dus pa rnams dgas po'i gdams pa gtso bor gyur ba'i 659

chos kyi rnam grangs mang pos cha cha nas tshim par mdzad/ dge 'dun gang bzhugs pa rnams bka' lung gis bcad de dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i kun du spyod pa las mi 'da'/ gdams ngag btab pa rnams la theb sla zhing bsam gtan gyi sgo mang du skyes pas/ de nyid du ma zad phyogs paṃ mas cad du snyan pa'i 'ur chen po byung / de yang rje sgam po ba de bka' gdams dang / rje btsun mi la gnyis ga'i lugs 'dzin pas bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres su grags pa bzhin/ mtshal sgang du mdzad pa'i gar gyi nyams dgu yang de dang mthun/ de nas der grong yul dang nye ba ni mi legs pas dben pa zhig thuṭa la dgongs nas/ nags khrod dben pa stes dbang gis/ /spyod cing rang dbang bsten mdzad gsol/ /zhes pa'i gsol ba yang btab/ de nas nang cig dge 'dun la gros med par gdan sa rin po cher 'byon pa'i lam du tsha rong btsad po'i sgo drung du byon nas dar sham cig bskur/ kho bo mtshal sgang na sdod pa de lags/ da phag mo gru'i phu'i nags pha gir sdod snyam pas spyan ras kyis btsa' bar zhu bya ba'i lan bskur bas/ btsad po'i gsung gis nang du tsha ba la byon zer/ kho bo them pa mi 'gong ba'i dam bca' yod pas tsha ba 'di nyid du gnang bar zhu byas pas/ khong rang sgo drung du byon nas tsha ba zhus/ 'phrod pa'i gtam yang mdzad/ de nas dre'u cig chibs yod pa phag mo gru'i grong dang nye ba'i lung nang nas zhugs nas byon pas/ sku shin tu lci bas dre'u de yan lag ka ba bzhin du rengs nas 'gro ma nus/ de nas 660

rin chen spungs ba'i mtha' rtsa der gdan phab pas rin po che mtha' rtsa bar grags/ grwa pa rnams kyang phyir snyegs nas byon/ mang gar sgang dang bde gshegs phug par yang thogs re bzhugs/ der rgya sgom rmi ras bya ba cig sngar nas ba da yod pa / kho'i spyil bur tsha ba la spyan drangs pas/ khyod kyi spyil bo 'di skyid bya ba lan gsum gsungs pas bzhed na phul bas chog zer/ sa de gnas kyi snying por dgongs nas/na 'o na kho bo'i kom stan long la shog cigasung ste de nyid du gnas bcas/ sgyur chogadan sa der sa pho stag gi za la phebs/ der dpal stag lung thang ba chu pho khyi'i lo pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi la bab pa'i shing mo bya la zhabs drung du sleb/ der khong gis rmis ras kyis phul ba'i spyil bo de 'jag spyil las med pas/ blang ma'i spyil po cig byed par zhus pas/ nyin cig la grub na gyis de las ring ba mi rung gsung nas nyin gcig kho na la blang spyil de bsgrubs/ der phyogs nas rna pa mang du 'dus pas gzims 0la nang na bang ba chung ngu nas khal re lhag tsam sho ne ba cig las med kyang mangs zo rgyags 'gyed rgyu yang byung / stag lung thang pas zhabs drung du sleb ma thag nas nye gnas mdzad/ na bza' yang 'di bas bzang pa re bzhes par rgya byas pas/ khyod kyis kho bo la ci 'dug par mthong / kho bo dge 'dun skyong dgos pa lags mod gsung nas dge 'dun skyong 'ba' zhig mdzad/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi gsung dang mthun par mar ngo la mtshams mdzad/ yar ngo la yang 661

snga dro mtshams mdzad cing snyi dro zhin dang chog cho gsungs/ dme'i'adun rnams spung shin tu dad pas gzims spyil nas chos kṣ-i'i bar gyi lam lha rna cad du zhwa shasadang dar kha la sogs pa 'ding / der re re/garnya gnyam tsam/ma gtogs sgom btab pa ma cad la myong ba phun sum tshog pha skye pas phyogs thams cad du zhabs drung du sleb phagachog pa'i snya nga bza/yon bdag gi bsnyen bkur dang 'bul pha yang so so nas mang du byung ba/ rnam kyisad /'dun kho na snying zhing sha ma sbyang nu skyid smos mdzad/'on bang sku mdun du rgyung ma'i yon bdag tham cad la btsad pho dgang phal dang / smrang yo pham phal kyi tshu'adzidu ri pha da de gnang gan / rnar ma po rtog nas lcags yo stalhari ra ma ngo bcu da ma thigs pha lasgrol rgyab pa'i kyis bu mang rgya sgron/ zwa pa brgyad brgya la gdugs zod rgya sna grag / sngar chos gsung ba tshe kho bo'i grwa pha ma 'dus gas da / kru 'a mung cho ji rten da la na ga spyan sngar 〉ba pa na da ni kho'i shākhopa 'dus shes kyang bsung / cho rje za cad sdong dusnaphyag gyi chen tho'/rtogs pa shar gathams cad mgo la thod pa rmiga'agibazla bya ba'itsho bga' :la yod pa la/ chos rjes snyebazla das rtogs ldarna skye ba'i 'khorapusgo bskong ba ma sog tsho nga dang mi 'dra ba'i chos mang du nga bar grags/rna ltar dge 'thun skyong ba du nyid nas gzhan dang gzhan du sku lus gyi ma da tho bcu gnyiradzisu bstan pa dang rtsa rgyan gyi gnas su byon nas mkha' mi 662

'gro ma rnams pa da sde chen pho gsan pa'i rgyud lha'ile'u grang dang don bsdu ba'i yi ge yarā mdzad/ de sogs pa phyogs ma khacad chu ska bo 'a ba mang por byas nas som can gyidon byed cas bya ba la sogs pa'i mdzad pa rgya chen po rnams ni lhang ma rnam kyi rnam bar na gsal bas 'dir mdo tsam las ma zis so/ /de lta bu'i ston pa gnyis pa de ni lcags pho rtog gi zla ba bdun pa'i nyer lnga lko sa pa'i thu brdzu ba mdzad/ de'i tshe jo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang / gdung ji khar gdan zang pa'i tshe'ang sa chen sgo g.yogazhing / yon chab rnams gyed phyed tsa po dang / cu togagi char dang / glu snyan dang / ngo mtshar ba'i cho blo sngal bas gyis mi khyab pha byung /sangs rgyas dang byang chub tshemasadapa' ming pho lhags pa da / dpa' jo dngakosakhal 'gro 'jugapa'i dag pa'i snang ba'ang grwa pa ma pho lko shar/ ring ba ma zhi du mang po dang / thug ljag ma chogaphar skyo pa 'khaljags dum bu gnyis su skyas na gdung khang re mu bzhug pa da nya kham tsho yod gsu / cu gas ni gdung rten bkra ska 'od 'tho na pha gas pa/ lta gtsugangalag khang gi rten gtso mi sta na la che blon rdzongani/ mo gu ma cha gyig rtog srung bang ba/ rgod pa'i ma cha rgyag sna phu ba/ shes rab ma ra lhag po ra phu ba/ nu pazhi ma cha thuga'achan phu rgya ra sa ma mthar lhag gi bu bzhi zer/ skal ldan na shes sem/ rtogs ldan mi nyag sgom rings/ grub thotho tag rngu cho / kun ldan gtsang pa ras chung 663

rnams la gdams pa'i bu bzhi zer/ chos rje 'jig rten mgon po/ 'ban bha phug pa/ chos rje rtsam/ chos rje gtum rnams la ro gcig rtogs pa phyed dang bzhi zer/ gshen sgom dkar ba/ myang gshen grong pa/ rngog sesge kha ba/ rtsi lung ba rnams la thugs kyi zas bzhi zer/ rin po che shug rtsar ba/ lha sa ba dge 'dun skyabs/ sbu ku ston pa blo gros sesgo/ rgyan thang pa rnams la yi ge ma'i bu bzhi zer/ bla ma dmar ba/ ye phug pa/ngagyer sgom dge ba'i bshes gnyen seng ge dpal rnams la nye ba'i sras bzhi zer/ de dag grangs su bcad de sngon rabs rnams la grags pas brjod piyin mod kyi/ gzhan yang kun ldan ras pa'i khu bo rin po che rgyal tsha la soṭa pa dang / gzhan yang grub rtags du ma ston pa'i dge slong nam mkha' 'od la sogs pa grub pa'i skyes bu mang du byung ba rnams phyogs so so na grags pa che zhing / phrin las che bar yod kyang / bla ma gong mas bsdus pa tsam zhig bris pa'o/ /'bri khung sgom pa shāka rin gyis/ /gdan sa dpal gyi phag gru de/ /chu mig brgya rtsa'i mgo bo yin/ /zhes smra ba ltar bod kyi yul 'di'i gtsug lag khang dang sde dgon la sogs pa grangs med pa gdan sa 'di las mched de/ 'bri khung chos rje las mched par gyur pa'ang bod khams gsum du bgrang gis ga la lang / gling ras pa las mched pa 'brug skor rnams kyis kyang bya rgod kyi nyin lam bcu gsum du khyab par grags/ dpal stag lung thang ba las gyes pa'ang dbus dang khams kyi sa char shin du mang por mched/664

skal ldan ye shes seng gis bsdubs 'dul ba 'dzin pa rjes su gzung bas g.yam bzangs pa mtha' rgyas dang bcas pa shin tu che/ kham su'ang chos rje dmar bas sho dgon btab pa las tshogs pa nyis stong tsam 'dus shing / chos rje dmar ba'i rjes su sha yang dgo pa/ rmog spyan snga rin po che/ sha dbu rtse ba/ rnal rin chen gling pa la sogs khyad 'phags mang du byon/ de las brgyud pa'i bu chen yang gi li chos 'od kyis ri rgya dgon btab/ de'i dgon lag rgyal dgon la sogs mab du yod/ khyadapar rnal rin chen gling ba la sbong 'od zer bla mas thug rdzi thugs rje chen po'i grub thob tu grags/ bum chu'i ril bus bod dang rgya thams cad du khyab/ buchen rtogs ldan dge ba rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ shing mgo ba sogs gzhan don mdzad pa mang du byon no/ /nyag re se bo 'gro mdon dang mjal nas grub pa brnyes te khams su byon nas gles da na btab/grub rtags mang du bstan/ 'di gar ma pa shi yin zhes gar ma pa shi rang gis zhal gyis bzhes so/ /gshen dgon dkar ba gdung rus gshen/mtshan rdo rje dbang khyug tsa'i dang na dgon pa btab pas dam skad smad pa zhes grags/ zhang mtshal ba la sogs sgrob ma mang dubyon/ myang gshen grong ba ni/ yar klungs gshen grongaspub/ sku stogazhon nu nas rab tu byung / 'gro mgon dang mjal nas gdams pa rdzogs par zhus/ khong rang gi 'khrungs ra sgrub pa mdzad pas mkha' sbyod du gshegs/ sngag seng ge kha ba ni/ ljang 665

seng gi khang na na pa btab pas seng ge kha par grag / bla ma gnan ma la ga da dogs nas rna ma rnams bgyi nam rang yul du spyod/ sku chos nyi zer la 'a la ba soṭa mjod pa 'gro don 'a la ra byung / de zlo ma dab na tshos zhi na/ ཿ lung bas tsi lung brtab ste gzhan don skyangs/'a ga rten mgon pos ra rgyung gi blo gtsun mdzad/ bla ma rgyan thang pa 'gro ma na dang mngal/ gan sa pa mang du gsan/ cho tshung gi spru pa'i bya rog gis gtor ma khyer ra da na pha btab na da lta'i bar du phrin lam gyi rgyun ma chad do/ /bla ma ye phug pa she rtseshas gi/ byang rta sna da sto phug shar sto rdzong rnams tab/ dgyeng skom gnyis byung ba las ga snangagi mal sgro phyogs su thugs da ma da/ 'a khu rtso rje sus jigs pa la nu mdzad pa cig byung jo / /bla 'gro gyis skam da 'julus ngata / 'gro skon rgyas par byung jo / /'a na rgya ngas gi spyir grub pa brnyi / bad par chos skyong gis rjes su gzung ngo / nya sgom rings ni/ 'gro ma na dang ma la na ཿkhrid ga na gyi yod pa la 'dzo mgod gyi kho'i mdun du ga pa'i rgya cig rsā / la cig kyang zhobaltagasung ma de dang nye bar spyil bo gdo nu khong gi pha gsod mi snabasdu thod pa de khong gi rtsar khrid na 'gro gon gyis can pas/ sgo rings zhe ldang sgros ) ral gri de khyer nas rgyug pas 'gro mgon gyi stod rang ri ldang gi mas de sto ga ga4 bko' gnas bas de nyid du na 84

su snyi rto sa pha bad pa rna ma phan mas che ba gro mgon gyi thob ma mu ba rnam rsā sgomasame leg pa slob/ gyis 'bri khung du da na pha 0tab das ba migs sa pa ba ‘ 'du / klog mkhyen pha gzhan don sa cung zad gnod sa stong / lha da sa 'ad khar grwa pa rnams kyis ngu sprum khyen rnam ma chod nu 'a / ga sa gi na pha chong mi da /lta'od na da bsnyen ma shes pa jig yod de bo da ga nga na gsheg ca/ /spar g.yo lhu bang 'thung /gdung ru na gzhon rwa thos sa nga spya ngan rgyan par tshe dpon snab 'dziring nu brten pas khong gyirjo ma rnams nang nam zhe rab cu ba zag rig tshog sa nga na bsgos mang nu ba mas zhing bshad sta'ang mjod dus gyis gro cu da ma pa/ mu ma byu ba rjo chu gsaḥkhesatheganas yod pha pa tshog 'dzi zhe rtse gyi do ha rgor rnam gas pas/ de ma ba rgyad la 'a ba gas rkyang ngu dug nga ma rte dang ma na nyams stong khyod par can mang stong nges bsam nas skar mi / tha sa na gyi spyan snar thengs gcig 'aston pa 'a da chu pas/ rnang stag bamangolhag pa/cang yod dam gsung pas ni kyang 'byon par zhu dang lhag mi' thong/snyid zhu pas/ sgar sga ba ma mnyes pas phag mo snar 'a ma na cang 5 ma la/ 'gro ma na dang gsung gleng kyang mang rtu ma da/ de ra phu ba thug la/ bla ma 'ji che dzi 67

'gro mgon la gsol 'debs 'dod 'jo'i ba mo yang mdzad/ phyis sbar phur dgon pa btab/ yi dam gyi lha mang po'ang zhal gzigs/ grub thob tu yang grags/ tshugs pa'ang lnga brgya tsam 'dus/ rang gi rtogs pa dang sangs rgyas kyi rtogs pa gnyis ngo bo la khyad med dgongs nas rtogs pa skyed med bya ba'i grub mtha' yang yod/ des na rnal 'byor bzhi po nyams rim yin gyi rtogs pa'i rim pa min zhes gsung / 'di la grub thob gling ras pa la sogs pa'i mched grogs mang pos kyang do ha gsan/ gnyan ras dge 'dun 'bum dang yel ba la sogs mang pos gtugs so/ /yang 'gro mgon gyi slob ma sangs rgyas gnyan ras ni/ 'khrungs yul bsam yas khams gsum pa/ gdung rus gnyan yin/ phag mo gru pa dang lo ro ras pa'i slob ma li ras la gdams pa rnams gsan/ ma yul rong gi rdo rang thag gi phug par lo dgu sgrub pa mdzad/ ma yul du mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin dgon pa btab/ dus phyis lo ro 'phar la du dgon pa btab nas bzhugs/de'i dpon po rgyal bas kyang ma yul dgon par stan thog gcig du lo dgur sgrub pa mdzad pas dbu skra dang bzhugs gdan gyi bar du srog chab/sa kyi tshang chas ba'ang byung / ye shes mgon po'i grub pa phul du phyin/ gnyan ras la bla ma rdzong pa sogs sgrub brgyud 'dzin pa mang du byung ngo / /bla ma zhang ni/dang por 'gro mgon dang mched grogs yin pa las/ phyis mos pa rnyed nas slob ma mdzad/ se gse ba dang ngang rkyal gyi gtsug lag khang chen po btab/669

da 'du gyi yang skya sa 'a mi sgo ba gshegs sa gad sa zhabs togakyang ma bya bsgrubs/ 'ji khu rje'i mkhan po mi mdzad do/ /la dzras bu dang bcas 'i gdadzo dang rdzo sa rī / sa sgo ga garang gis yig cha'ang dzad gad dzin dzad pa'i slo rgyud yang rgyan ga pa rgyang 'dor dpal thog spa lha ba na cas 'i cutham sgo/cu/cu/ga cu
ci'i shā sdu — — byu ci/ mi
